words.en: Having a slight red color.

words.ex: The box remained untouched on the table.
words.ex_cn: 盒子原封不动地留在桌子上。
words.en: If something is untouched, it has not been changed or affected by something.

words.tr: adj. 原因不详的；未解释的；未说明的
words.ex: The disappearance of the documents remains unexplained.
words.ex_cn: 文件的消失仍然原因不明。
words.en: If something is unexplained, it is not known why or how it happened.

words.tr: adj. 非法人的；未合并的
words.ex: The business operates as an unincorporated entity.
words.ex_cn: 这家企业以无法人地位的实体运营。
words.en: If an area is unincorporated, it does not have its own local government and is governed by a larger administrative division.

words.ex: The unused book is still on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 那本未使用过的书还在书架上。
words.en: If something is unused, it is not being used, especially because it is not needed or has not been used before.

words.ex: Smartphones are ubiquitous in modern life.
words.ex_cn: 智能手机在现代生活中无处不在。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as ubiquitous, you mean that they seem to be everywhere.

words.tr: adj. 不变的；不能改变的
words.ex: The rules are unchangeable.
words.ex_cn: 这些规则是不可改变的。
words.en: If something is unchangeable, it cannot be altered or modified in any way.

words.ex: His argument is based on anecdotal evidence.
words.ex_cn: 他的论点基于轶事证据。
words.en: Anecdotal evidence is based on personal accounts rather than on research that can be verified.

words.ex: He is a talented singer.
words.ex_cn: 他是个有才能的歌手。
words.en: Someone who is talented has a natural ability to do something well.

words.ex: The frog is poisonous.
words.ex_cn: 这只青蛙是有毒的。
words.en: Something that is poisonous will kill you or make you ill if you eat it, drink it, or absorb it.

words.tr: adj. 有节奏的；有韵律的（=rhythmic）
words.ex: The drum beats are rhythmical and loud.
words.ex_cn: 鼓点有节奏且响亮。
words.en: Having a regular repeated pattern of sounds or movements.

words.ex: The gemstone had a faceted surface that caught the light beautifully.
words.ex_cn: 宝石的小面表面美丽地捕捉到了光线。
words.en: Having many sides or aspects; multifaceted.

words.ex: Eating wholesome food helps you stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 吃有益身心的食物有助于保持健康。
words.en: Conducive to or suggestive of good health and physical well-being.

words.ex: He was conscious after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故后他醒了过来。
words.en: If you are conscious of something, you notice it or are aware of it.

words.ex: It is debatable whether he is the best player.
words.ex_cn: 他是不是最好的球员是有争议的。
words.en: If you say that something is debatable, you mean that it is not certain whether it is true or right.

words.ex: He is a horticultural expert who grows vegetables in his garden.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位园艺专家，在自己的花园里种植蔬菜。
words.en: Relating to the art or practice of garden cultivation and management.

words.tr: adj. 圆柱形的；圆筒状的；
words.ex: The glass has a cylindrical shape.
words.ex_cn: 这个玻璃杯是圆柱形的。
words.en: Something that is cylindrical is in the shape of a cylinder.

words.ex: The storm caused disastrous damage to the village.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴给村庄造成了灾难性的破坏。
words.en: If you describe something as disastrous, you mean that it is very unfortunate or unsuccessful.

words.ex: This is a genuine diamond.
words.ex_cn: 这是一颗真正的钻石。
words.en: If something is genuine, it is real and exactly what it appears to be.

words.ex: The governmental office closed early on Friday.
words.ex_cn: 政府办公室星期五提早关门。
words.en: Relating to the government or the public affairs of a country.

words.tr: adj. 支持的；支援的；给予帮助的；
words.ex: My parents are supportive when I study hard.
words.ex_cn: 当我努力学习时，我的父母总是支持我。
words.en: If you are supportive, you are kind and helpful to someone at a difficult or unhappy time in their life.

words.ex: He earned a respectable salary last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年挣了一份可观的薪水。
words.en: Someone or something that is respectable is approved of by society and considered to be morally correct.

words.ex: The plant shows vegetative growth in spring.
words.ex_cn: 这株植物在春天表现出植物生长。
words.en: Relating to vegetation or plant life; also used to describe a state of minimal consciousness in a person who is severely brain-damaged.

words.tr:
adj. 极重要的；
n. 紧急的事；
words.ex: It is imperative to drink water every day.
words.ex_cn: 每天喝水非常重要。
words.en: If it is imperative that something is done, that thing is extremely important and must be done.

words.ex: The presidential speech was broadcast on TV.
words.ex_cn: 总统的演讲在电视上播出。
words.en: Relating to a president or presidency.

words.tr: adj. 组织上的；构造上的
words.ex: The painting's textural quality added depth to the composition.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画的结构质感为作品增添了深度。
words.en: Relating to the physical feel or appearance of a surface or a substance.

words.tr: adj. 最终的；最后的；极端的；
words.ex: This is the ultimate solution to the problem.
words.ex_cn: 这是这个问题的最终解决方案。
words.en: You use ultimate to describe the final result or aim of a long series of events.

words.tr: adv. 妥善保管地；安全地；稳妥地；安全地；
words.ex: She safely stored her jewelry in a safe.
words.ex_cn: 她妥善保管地把珠宝存放在保险箱里。
words.en: In a way that is not likely to cause harm or damage; securely.

words.ex: She instinctively reached for her phone when it rang.
words.ex_cn: 电话响时，她下意识地伸手去拿手机。
words.en: If you behave instinctively, you do something without thinking about it because it seems natural or the right thing to do.

words.ex: The pollution affected the fish adversely.
words.ex_cn: 污染对鱼类造成了不利影响。
words.en: In a way that prevents success or development; harmfully or unfavorably.

words.ex: She tapped her foot impatiently as she waited for the bus.
words.ex_cn: 她在等公交车时，不耐烦地用脚敲打着地面。
words.en: In a way that shows you are annoyed by somebody/something because they are not doing what you want them to do or because something is not happening as quickly as you want.

words.ex: The paint was applied unevenly on the wall.
words.ex_cn: 油漆在墙上涂得不均匀。
words.en: In a way that is not level, smooth, or regular.

words.tr: adv. 直角地；径直地；公平地；直接了当
words.ex: He stood squarely in front of the door.
words.ex_cn: 他直角地站在门前面。
words.en: If something is squarely placed or aimed, it is placed or aimed directly at something.

words.tr: adv. 意外地；出乎意料地；
words.ex: He arrived unexpectedly at my house.
words.ex_cn: 他意外地来到我家。
words.en: In a way that was not expected; surprisingly.

words.ex: They live ecologically to protect the environment.
words.ex_cn: 他们以环保的方式生活以保护环境。
words.en: In a way that relates to ecology or the environment.

words.tr: adv. 粗糙地；粗鲁地；天然地
words.ex: The tools were crudely fashioned from stone.
words.ex_cn: 这些工具是用石头粗糙地制成的。
words.en: In a crude manner; roughly or unskillfully.

words.ex: He refused the money, because morally it was wrong.
words.ex_cn: 他拒绝了那笔钱，因为道义上这是不对的。
words.en: In a manner relating to principles of right and wrong behavior.

words.tr: adv. 独特地；唯一地；珍奇地；
words.ex: She uniquely solves every math problem.
words.ex_cn: 她独特地解决每一个数学问题。
words.en: In a way that is unlike anything else; uniquely.

words.ex: The children cleaned their rooms separately.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们分别打扫了自己的房间。
words.en: If people or things are dealt with separately, they are dealt with individually, not in a group.

words.ex: The products are manufactured industrially.
words.ex_cn: 这些产品是工业化生产的。
words.en: In a way that relates to industry or the production of goods in factories.

words.ex: The lamp shone dimly in the corner.
words.ex_cn: 灯在角落里昏暗地亮着。
words.en: If something is dimly lit, it is not very bright because there is only a small amount of light.

words.ex: He worked intensely to finish the project.
words.ex_cn: 他强烈地工作以完成这个项目。
words.en: If something is intense, it is very great or extreme in strength or degree.

words.tr: adv. 僵硬地；严格地；固执地
words.ex: He follows the rules rigidly.
words.ex_cn: 他严格遵守规则。
words.en: In a strict or inflexible manner.

words.tr: adv. 精心地；苦心经营地
words.ex: The cake was decorated elaborately with flowers and ribbons.
words.ex_cn: 蛋糕用花朵和丝带精心装饰。
words.en: In a detailed and complicated way, often involving a lot of effort or careful planning.

words.ex: She finely chopped the herbs for the soup.
words.ex_cn: 她把香草精细地切碎用于汤中。
words.en: In a fine manner; excellently.

words.ex: The paint was applied uniformly on the wall.
words.ex_cn: 油漆均匀地涂在墙上。
words.en: In a way that is the same in all cases and at all times.

words.ex: The two products are comparably priced.
words.ex_cn: 这两种产品的价格相当。
words.en: In a way that is able to be compared; similarly.

words.ex: He reliably finishes his homework every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都能可靠地完成作业。
words.en: In a way that is consistently good in quality or performance; able to be trusted.

words.ex: He answered the question instantly.
words.ex_cn: 他立即回答了问题。
words.en: If something happens instantly, it happens immediately.

words.ex: He routinely checks his email every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上例行检查邮件。
words.en: If something is routinely done, it is done as a normal part of a job or process.

words.ex: He likes math, and additionally, he enjoys science.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢数学，此外，他还喜欢科学。
words.en: You use additionally to introduce extra information or to emphasize a point.

words.ex: She is intrinsically kind.
words.ex_cn: 她本质上是善良的。
words.en: If something is intrinsically good or bad, it is so because of its own nature, and not because of any external circumstances or factors.

words.ex: He walked quietly into the room.
words.ex_cn: 他安静地走进了房间。
words.en: In a manner that does not attract attention; silently or calmly.

words.ex: This rule is universally accepted.
words.ex_cn: 这条规则被普遍接受。
words.en: In a way that is done or shared by all people or things in the world or in a particular group.

words.ex: The vegetables are grown organically without chemicals.
words.ex_cn: 这些蔬菜是有机种植的，没有使用化学物质。
words.en: In a way that relates to or is derived from living organisms; in a systematic and organized manner.

words.ex: The scientist tested the theory experimentally.
words.ex_cn: 这位科学家通过实验检验了这一理论。
words.en: In a way that relates to or is based on experiments.

words.ex: He aptly answered the question.
words.ex_cn: 他恰当地回答了问题。
words.en: In a manner that is appropriate or suitable in the circumstances.

words.ex: He passed the test, albeit with a low score.
words.ex_cn: 他通过了考试，尽管分数很低。
words.en: You use albeit to introduce a fact or comment which reduces the force or significance of what you have just said.

words.ex: He characteristically arrived late to meetings.
words.ex_cn: 他总是特征性地迟到参加会议。
words.en: In a way that is typical of a particular person, thing, or group.

words.ex: She greeted him customarily with a smile.
words.ex_cn: 她习惯性地对他微笑问候。
words.en: If something is customarily done in a particular way, it is usually done in that way.

words.ex: He is absolutely sure about the answer.
words.ex_cn: 他绝对确定这个答案。
words.en: Used to emphasize that something is completely true or correct.

words.tr: adv. 无限期地；不确定地；
words.ex: The meeting was postponed indefinitely.
words.ex_cn: 会议被无限期推迟了。
words.en: If something will happen indefinitely, it will happen for an unlimited or unknown period of time.

words.ex: We need to plan realistically about the budget.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要实际地规划预算。
words.en: In a way that shows a sensible and practical idea of what can be achieved or expected.

words.ex: He works hard, and correspondingly, he gets good grades.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习，相应地，他取得了好成绩。
words.en: In a way that corresponds to something else; in a corresponding manner.

words.ex: He was sexually harassed at work.
words.ex_cn: 他在工作中遭受了性骚扰。
words.en: In a way that relates to the instincts, physiological processes, and activities connected with physical attraction or intimate physical contact between individuals.

words.ex: He looked afar and saw a small boat.
words.ex_cn: 他远远地望见了一条小船。
words.en: At, to, or from a great distance.

words.ex: The story was graphically described in the book.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事在书中被生动地描述了。
words.en: In a way that relates to or is represented by a graph or other visual image.

words.ex: The specimen must be examined microscopically to identify the bacteria.
words.ex_cn: 必须通过显微镜检查标本以识别细菌。
words.en: In a way that relates to or is done with a microscope; extremely small.

words.ex: She is waiting anxiously for the results.
words.ex_cn: 她焦急地等待着结果。
words.en: If you do something anxiously, you do it in a way that shows you are worried or nervous.

words.tr: adv. 口才好地；令人信服地
words.ex: He argued persuasively for the adoption of the new policy.
words.ex_cn: 他令人信服地为新政策的采纳进行了辩论。
words.en: In a way that is convincing or able to persuade.

words.ex: The sailors swam ashore after the boat sank.
words.ex_cn: 船沉没后，水手们游到了岸上。
words.en: If someone or something comes ashore, they come from the sea onto the shore.

words.ex: He started his project anew after the failure.
words.ex_cn: 失败后，他重新开始了他的项目。
words.en: If you do something anew, you do it again, often in a different way from before.

words.ex: This tool is specially designed for children.
words.ex_cn: 这个工具是专门为儿童设计的。
words.en: In a special manner; particularly.

words.ex: The scavengers fed on the carcass of the dead deer.
words.ex_cn: 食腐动物以那只死鹿的尸体为食。
words.en: The dead body of an animal, especially one that is ready to be cut up as meat or eaten by animals.

words.tr:
n. 溢出；
v. 泛滥；
words.ex: The rain caused an overflow of the river.
words.ex_cn: 雨水导致河水溢出。
words.en: If a liquid or a river overflows, it flows over the edges of the container or place it is in.

words.ex: The wolf howl at the moon.
words.ex_cn: 狼对着月亮嚎叫。
words.en: If a dog or wolf howls, it makes a long, loud, crying sound. If a person howls, they make a long, loud cry expressing pain, anger, or unhappiness.

words.ex: He won the spelling contest.
words.ex_cn: 他赢得了拼写比赛。
words.en: A contest is a competition or a struggle for victory between individuals or groups.

words.tr:
n. 枯萎；凋谢；憔悴；
v. 枯萎；凋谢；憔悴；
words.ex: The flowers showed signs of wilt after the long heat.
words.ex_cn: 这些花在长时间高温后出现了枯萎的迹象。
words.en: If a plant wilts, it bends over because it is too dry, too hot, or too weak to stay upright.

words.ex: He burst into rage when he heard the news.
words.ex_cn: 当他听到这个消息时，他勃然大怒。
words.en: Rage is a feeling of intense anger that is difficult to control.

words.tr:
n. 离婚；
v. 和…离婚；
words.ex: They filed for divorce after ten years of marriage.
words.ex_cn: 他们结婚十年后申请了离婚。
words.en: Divorce is the formal ending of a marriage by law.

words.ex: Please fetch me a glass of water.
words.ex_cn: 请给我拿一杯水来。
words.en: If you fetch something or someone, you go to the place where they are and return with them.

words.tr:
v. 摔跤；扭斗；奋力对付
n. 摔跤；角力；扭斗
words.ex: He tries to wrestle the dog away from the trash.
words.ex_cn: 他试图把狗从垃圾桶旁拉开。
words.en: To engage in a physical contest, typically involving grappling and trying to throw or immobilize the opponent, or to struggle with a difficult problem or decision.

words.ex: She scoured the pan until it was clean.
words.ex_cn: 她把锅擦得干干净净。
words.en: If you scour something, you clean it by rubbing it hard with something rough.

words.ex: His discourse on climate change was clear and logical.
words.ex_cn: 他关于气候变化的论述清晰而有逻辑。
words.en: Discourse is spoken or written communication between people, especially serious discussion of a particular subject.

words.ex: The soldiers raided the enemy camp at night.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们在夜间突袭了敌人的营地。
words.en: A raid is a sudden attack on a place by soldiers, police, or other officials, in order to search for something or to arrest someone.

words.tr:
v. 侮辱；辱骂
n. 侮辱；辱骂
words.ex: He insulted her with rude words.
words.ex_cn: 他用粗鲁的话侮辱了她。
words.en: To insult someone means to say or do something that is rude or offensive.

words.tr:
v. 牺牲；
n. 牺牲（品）；
words.ex: He sacrificed his time to help his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他牺牲了自己的时间来帮助朋友。
words.en: If you sacrifice something that is valuable or important, you give it up, usually to obtain something else for yourself or for other people.

words.tr:
n. 喧嚷；大声的要求
v. 喧嚷；大声地要求
words.ex: The crowd made a loud clamor for justice.
words.ex_cn: 人群为正义发出大声喧哗。
words.en: If people are clamoring for something, they are demanding it in a noisy or angry way.

words.tr:
n. 请求；要求的事；
v. 要求；请求；
words.ex: He made a request for help.
words.ex_cn: 他提出了一个帮助的请求。
words.en: If you request something, you ask for it politely or formally.

words.ex: He crushed the can with his hand.
words.ex_cn: 他用手把罐子压碎了。
words.en: To crush something means to press it very hard so that its shape is destroyed or so that it breaks into pieces. It can also mean to defeat someone completely, or to make someone feel extremely upset or disappointed.

words.ex: The two countries signed an accord to stop the war.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家签署了一项协议以停止战争。
words.en: An accord is an official agreement or treaty. It can also refer to a state of agreement or harmony.

words.tr:
v. 征收；征税；征募
n. 征兵；征税
words.ex: The government will levy a new tax next month.
words.ex_cn: 政府下个月将征收一项新税。
words.en: To levy means to impose or collect a tax, fee, or fine. It can also refer to the act of enlisting or drafting individuals into military service.

words.ex: He submitted a requisition for new office supplies.
words.ex_cn: 他提交了一份购置新办公用品的正式要求。
words.en: A requisition is a formal, official request demanding that something should be done.

words.tr:
n. 吱吱声；尖叫声
v. 短促而尖厉地叫；吱吱叫
words.ex: The mouse makes a small squeak.
words.ex_cn: 老鼠发出一声小小的吱吱声。
words.en: If something or someone squeaks, they make a short, high-pitched sound.

words.ex: He is grappled with the math problem for hours.
words.ex_cn: 他花了好几个小时努力解决这道数学题。
words.en: To grapple with something means to try hard to understand or deal with a difficult problem or subject.

words.ex: Bananas have a lot of potassium.
words.ex_cn: 香蕉含有大量的钾。
words.en: A soft silver-white reactive metal of the alkali metal group, occurring principally in the form of salts in seawater and in minerals such as sylvite and carnallite.

words.ex: He is a true patriot who loves his country.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位真正热爱祖国的爱国者。
words.en: A patriot is someone who loves their country and is willing to defend it against enemies or detractors.

words.ex: The poplar trees grow tall by the river.
words.ex_cn: 白杨树在河边长得很高。
words.en: A poplar is a type of tree that grows quickly and is often planted for its wood or to provide shade.

words.ex: His impersonation of the famous actor was spot on.
words.ex_cn: 他对那位著名演员的模仿非常到位。
words.en: The act of pretending to be another person for the purpose of entertainment or fraud.

words.ex: The play ended in a tragedy when the hero died.
words.ex_cn: 当英雄去世时，这部戏剧以悲剧收场。
words.en: A tragedy is an extremely sad event or situation.

words.ex: The caribou migrate across the tundra every year.
words.ex_cn: 北美驯鹿每年都会穿越苔原迁徙。
words.en: A caribou is a large North American deer with large flat antlers, also known as a reindeer in Europe.

words.ex: Angiosperms are the most diverse group of plants.
words.ex_cn: 被子植物是植物界中最多样化的群体。
words.en: A plant that has flowers and produces seeds enclosed within a carpel. The angiosperms are a large group and include herbaceous plants, shrubs, grasses, and most trees.

words.tr: n. 编篮技艺；篓编织品
words.ex: He makes basketry from woven reeds.
words.ex_cn: 他用编织的芦苇制作篮子。
words.en: The craft or process of making baskets.

words.ex: This apple is a variant of the red delicious.
words.ex_cn: 这种苹果是红富士的一个变体。
words.en: A variant is something that is slightly different from other similar things.

words.ex: The main criterion for winning is fairness.
words.ex_cn: 获胜的主要标准是公平。
words.en: A criterion is a principle or standard by which something may be judged or decided.

words.ex: The cuticle protects the base of the nail.
words.ex_cn: 甲皮保护指甲的基部。
words.en: A cuticle is a term used in botany and zoology to describe the outer layer of tissue that covers the surface of a plant or animal.

words.ex: They walked along the waterfront and enjoyed the view.
words.ex_cn: 他们沿着滨水区散步，欣赏景色。
words.en: The part of a town or city that is next to a river, lake, or the sea, especially the part where there are docks and where ships load and unload.

words.ex: The deglaciation changed the shape of the land.
words.ex_cn: 冰川消退改变了土地的形状。
words.en: The process by which glaciers and ice sheets diminish in size and retreat.

words.ex: He received compensation for his injured leg.
words.ex_cn: 他因腿部受伤获得了赔偿。
words.en: Compensation is something, typically money, awarded to someone in recognition of loss, suffering, or injury.

words.ex: The government gives a subsidy to farmers.
words.ex_cn: 政府向农民提供补贴。
words.en: A subsidy is money that is paid by a government or other authority in order to help an industry or business, or to pay for a public service.

words.ex: His immaturity made him cry over small problems.
words.ex_cn: 他的不成熟让他为小问题哭泣。
words.en: The state of not being fully developed or grown.

words.ex: They had a discord about the movie ending.
words.ex_cn: 他们对电影的结局有分歧。
words.en: Disagreement or strife between people or groups.

words.ex: The cold weather put the animal into torpor.
words.ex_cn: 寒冷的天气让动物陷入麻木状态。
words.en: a state of physical or mental inactivity; lethargy.

words.tr: n. 不可预测性；不可预见性；
words.ex: The unpredictability of the weather made planning difficult.
words.ex_cn: 天气的不可预测性使规划变得困难。
words.en: The quality of being unable to be predicted; the state of being unpredictable.

words.ex: Her disloyalty to her friends was unforgivable.
words.ex_cn: 她对朋友的不忠实是不可原谅的。
words.en: Disloyalty is the quality of not being loyal to someone or something.

words.ex: The tribespeople lived in harmony with nature.
words.ex_cn: 部落成员与自然和谐共处。
words.en: Tribespeople are the members of a tribe, especially those living in a traditional way.

words.ex: The treasury decided to lower taxes.
words.ex_cn: 财政部决定降低税收。
words.en: The treasury is the department within a government that manages its finances, including the collection of taxes and the allocation of funds.

words.ex: The theater's repertory includes classic plays and modern dramas.
words.ex_cn: 这家剧院的全部剧目包括经典戏剧和现代戏剧。
words.en: A repertory is a collection of pieces of music or plays that a company or performer knows or is prepared to perform.

words.tr:
n. 侧面；侧翼；胁腹
v. 在…侧面（有）
words.ex: The soldiers moved to the flank to avoid the enemy.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们移动到侧翼以避开敌人。
words.en: The side of something, especially a part of the body between the ribs and the hip; to be situated on each side of or on one side of (something).

words.tr:
n. 塞子；
v. 插上；
words.ex: The sink is clogged because the plug is stuck.
words.ex_cn: 水槽堵塞了，因为塞子卡住了。
words.en: A plug is a small object at the end of a wire that is used for connecting a piece of electrical equipment to the main supply of electricity. It is also a piece of material that is used for blocking a hole.

words.tr:
n. 铲；铁锹
v. 铲；铲起
words.ex: He uses a shovel to dig the garden.
words.ex_cn: 他用铲子挖花园。
words.en: A shovel is a tool with a long handle and a broad blade or scoop, used for moving material such as earth, snow, or coal.

words.ex: He used common sense to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他用常识解决了这个问题。
words.en: Common sense is the natural ability to make good judgments and to behave in a practical and sensible way.

words.ex: The concept of a supercontinent helps explain the distribution of continents over geological time.
words.ex_cn: 超大陆的概念有助于解释地质时期内大陆的分布。
words.en: A supercontinent is a landmass comprising more than one continental core, or craton.

words.tr: n. 超级计算机；巨型计算机；
words.ex: The lab uses a supercomputer to solve complex math problems.
words.ex_cn: 实验室使用超级计算机来解决复杂的数学问题。
words.en: A supercomputer is a computer that is at the frontline of current processing capacity, particularly speed of calculation.

words.ex: The star exploded into a supernova.
words.ex_cn: 那颗恒星爆炸成了超新星。
words.en: A supernova is the explosion of a star, which causes it to become extremely bright and then fade away over several weeks or months.

words.tr:
n. 车床
v. 用车床加工
words.ex: He uses a lathe to shape wood.
words.ex_cn: 他用车床加工木材。
words.en: A lathe is a machine tool that rotates a workpiece about an axis of rotation to perform various operations such as cutting, sanding, knurling, drilling, or deformation with tools that are applied to the workpiece to create an object with symmetry about that axis.

words.ex: He used an idiom to explain his idea.
words.ex_cn: 他用了一个成语来解释他的想法。
words.en: An idiom is a group of words in a fixed order that have a particular meaning that is different from the meanings of each word on its own.

words.ex: He made a commitment to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他承诺按时完成这个项目。
words.en: A commitment is something that regularly takes up some of your time because of an agreement you have made or because of responsibilities that you have.

words.ex: The continuance of the drought has caused severe water shortages.
words.ex_cn: 干旱的持续导致了严重的水资源短缺。
words.en: The continuance of something is its continuing existence or presence.

words.tr:
n. 服务人员
adj. 随之而来的
words.ex: The attendant helped me find my seat.
words.ex_cn: 服务员帮我找到了座位。
words.en: An attendant is someone whose job is to serve or help people in a public place.

words.ex: The farmer sprayed herbicide on the weeds.
words.ex_cn: 农民在杂草上喷了除草剂。
words.en: A herbicide is a substance that is used to kill plants, especially weeds.

words.tr:
n. 雏鸟
v. 偎依；抱；“nestle”的现在分词
words.ex: The nestling birds were still too young to fly.
words.ex_cn: 这些未离巢的雏鸟还太小，不会飞。
words.en: A nestling is a young bird that has not yet left the nest.

words.ex: He got a penalty for breaking the rules.
words.ex_cn: 他因违反规则而受到惩罚。
words.en: A penalty is a punishment that is imposed on someone for doing something that is against the rules or the law.

words.ex: The prevalence of flu increased in winter.
words.ex_cn: 流感在冬季更加流行。
words.en: The fact or condition of being prevalent; commonness.

words.ex: The biographer wrote about the artist's life.
words.ex_cn: 传记作家写了这位艺术家的一生。
words.en: A biographer is a person who writes an account of someone's life.

words.ex: The wound caused a serious infection.
words.ex_cn: 伤口引起了严重的感染。
words.en: An infection is a disease caused by microorganisms such as bacteria, viruses, or parasites invading the body.

words.ex: The signal transmission is clear and strong.
words.ex_cn: 信号传输清晰而强劲。
words.en: The act or process of sending or passing something from one place, person, or thing to another.

words.ex: The seafarer's life is filled with adventure and danger.
words.ex_cn: 船员的生活充满了冒险和危险。
words.en: A seafarer is a person who travels by sea, especially one who works on a ship.

words.ex: The harbor was filled with various kinds of watercraft.
words.ex_cn: 港口里停满了各种各样的船只。
words.en: A watercraft is a vehicle designed for travel on water, such as a boat or ship.

words.ex: She carefully arranged the bedcover before going to sleep.
words.ex_cn: 她睡觉前仔细地整理了床罩。
words.en: A bedcover is a decorative cover for a bed, often used to protect the bedding and add aesthetic appeal to the bedroom.

words.ex: The rose has a sharp thorn.
words.ex_cn: 玫瑰有一根尖刺。
words.en: A thorn is a sharp, pointed projection on the stem or other part of a plant.

words.ex: The lion lives in the jungle.
words.ex_cn: 狮子生活在丛林中。
words.en: A jungle is a dense, tropical forest that is home to a wide variety of plants and animals.

words.ex: His attainment of the goal took many years.
words.ex_cn: 他达到这个目标花了多年时间。
words.en: The act of achieving something, especially through effort; a skill or accomplishment that has been achieved.

words.ex: The bloodhound's keen sense of smell makes it an excellent tracker.
words.ex_cn: 侦探猎犬敏锐的嗅觉使其成为出色的追踪者。
words.en: A bloodhound is a large breed of dog known for its ability to track scents over great distances, often used in police work to find missing people or track criminals.

words.ex: The eland is a large antelope native to Africa.
words.ex_cn: 大羚羊是一种原产于非洲的大型羚羊。
words.en: The eland is a large African antelope, known for its size and the impressive horns of the males.

words.tr:
n. 大炮；火炮
v. 猛撞；碰撞
words.ex: The soldiers fired the cannon at the enemy.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们向敌人开炮。
words.en: A cannon is a large, heavy piece of artillery which was used in wars to fire heavy metal balls or shells.

words.ex: The children carried paper lanterns at the festival.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在节日上提着纸灯笼。
words.en: A lantern is a lamp in a container that has a handle for holding or hanging it, and it usually has a protective case around the flame or bulb.

words.ex: The magnitude of this decision will affect everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这个决定的重要性会影响每个人。
words.en: Magnitude refers to the great size or extent of something, or the importance of something.

words.ex: The remote needs a new battery.
words.ex_cn: 遥控器需要新电池。
words.en: A battery is a device that produces electricity to provide power for radios, cars, toys, etc.

words.ex: The wire has high conductance.
words.ex_cn: 这根导线的电导率很高。
words.en: Conductance is a measure of a material's ability to conduct electric current.

words.ex: The cable connects the computer to the printer.
words.ex_cn: 这条电缆将电脑连接到打印机。
words.en: A cable is a thick wire or rope, or a bundle of wires or ropes, used to carry electricity or electronic signals, or to support a structure.

words.ex: He took the elevator to the 10th floor.
words.ex_cn: 他乘电梯上了十楼。
words.en: An elevator is a device that moves people or goods up and down inside a building.

words.ex: The artist used a burin to delicately carve the metal.
words.ex_cn: 艺术家使用雕刻刀精细地雕刻金属。
words.en: A burin is a tool used for engraving, typically made of steel with a sharp point at one end and a handle at the other.

words.ex: Urbanism has influenced the way people interact and live.
words.ex_cn: 都市生活影响了人们的互动和生活方式。
words.en: Urbanism refers to the way of life or the planning and development characteristic of cities and towns.

words.ex: His painting shows great originality.
words.ex_cn: 他的画作展现了极大的独创性。
words.en: The quality of being new and original in a way that is not derived from something else.

words.ex: He paddles a canoe on the lake.
words.ex_cn: 他划着独木舟在湖上航行。
words.en: A canoe is a small, narrow boat that you move through the water using a paddle.

words.tr: n. 读者（数）；高级讲师职位
words.ex: The newspaper has a large readership.
words.ex_cn: 这份报纸拥有大量的读者。
words.en: The number or type of people who read a particular newspaper, magazine, or book.

words.ex: The goose is swimming in the lake.
words.ex_cn: 这只鹅正在湖里游泳。
words.en: A goose is a large bird that has a long neck and webbed feet. Geese are often kept for their meat, feathers, or as guard animals.

words.ex: Ancient warriors rode in a chariot during battles.
words.ex_cn: 古代战士在战斗中乘坐双轮战车。
words.en: A chariot is a type of vehicle used in ancient times for racing or fighting. It had two wheels and was pulled by horses.

words.ex: He paints on a canvas with oil colors.
words.ex_cn: 他用油画颜料在帆布上作画。
words.en: A strong, coarse unbleached cloth made from hemp, flax, cotton, or a similar yarn, used to make items such as sails and tents and as a surface for oil painting.

words.tr: n. 反射率；反射性；反射能力
words.ex: The mirror has high reflectivity.
words.ex_cn: 这面镜子具有很高的反射率。
words.en: Reflectivity is the property of a surface that determines how much light is reflected by it.

words.tr: n. 反射动作；本能反应；反射作用；
words.ex: The knee jerk is a simple reflex.
words.ex_cn: 膝跳是一种简单的反射动作。
words.en: An automatic and often inborn response to a stimulus that typically involves a nerve impulse passing inward from a receptor to the spinal cord and then outward to an effector (as a muscle or gland) without reaching the level of consciousness.

words.ex: Bread often contains a preservative to last longer.
words.ex_cn: 面包中常含有防腐剂以延长保质期。
words.en: A preservative is a chemical that is added to substances such as food, wood, or medicine to prevent them from decaying or spoiling.

words.ex: The radio signal suffered from interference.
words.ex_cn: 收音机信号受到了干扰。
words.en: Interference refers to the action of interfering or the process of being interfered with, especially in a context where it is unwelcome or inappropriate.

words.tr: n. 探视权；正式的视察；显现
words.ex: During the visitation, the priest offered prayers for the deceased.
words.ex_cn: 在访问期间，牧师为逝者祈祷。
words.en: A visit, especially an official one.

words.tr: n. 飞行员；飞机驾驶员
words.ex: The aviator flew a plane over the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 飞行员驾机飞越了山脉。
words.en: An aviator is a person who flies an aircraft.

words.ex: Farmers spread manure on the fields to help crops grow.
words.ex_cn: 农民把肥料撒在田里以帮助庄稼生长。
words.en: Manure is organic matter used as fertilizer in agriculture.

words.tr:
n. 车费；费用；
v. 进展；成功（或不成功等）；
words.ex: The bus fare is two dollars.
words.ex_cn: 公交车费是两美元。
words.en: The fare is the amount of money that you pay for a journey that you make, for example, in a bus, train, or taxi.

words.ex: The store offers an assortment of snacks.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店提供各种各样的零食。
words.en: An assortment is a group of similar things that are of different types or sizes.

words.ex: The analyst studied the data carefully.
words.ex_cn: 这位分析者仔细研究了数据。
words.en: An analyst is a person whose job is to analyze a subject and give opinions about it.

words.ex: The moon's surface is covered with regolith.
words.ex_cn: 月球表面覆盖着月壤。
words.en: The layer of loose, heterogeneous material covering solid rock. It includes dust, soil, broken rock, and other related materials and is present on Earth, the Moon, Mars, some asteroids, and other terrestrial planets and moons.

words.ex: The bees built a hive in the tree.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂在树上建了一个蜂巢。
words.en: A hive is a structure where bees live, consisting of a series of cells in which they store honey and raise their young.

words.ex: The hummingbird flies quickly around the flowers.
words.ex_cn: 蜂鸟快速地在花朵周围飞翔。
words.en: A very small, brightly coloured bird with a long thin beak, whose wings move very fast and make a humming sound.

words.tr: n. 孵卵器；育婴箱；培养的器具
words.ex: The eggs are kept in an incubator to hatch.
words.ex_cn: 鸡蛋放在孵卵器里孵化。
words.en: An incubator is a piece of hospital equipment which helps weak or small babies to survive. It consists of a transparent container in which the oxygen supply, temperature, and humidity can be controlled.

words.ex: The battery gives out 9 volts.
words.ex_cn: 这节电池输出9伏特。
words.en: A volt is a unit used to measure the force of an electric current.

words.ex: The captive man sat quietly in his cell.
words.ex_cn: 那个被监禁的人安静地坐在牢房里。
words.en: A captive is someone who is being kept as a prisoner or in a confined space, or something that is held or confined.

words.ex: The government punished the official for corruption.
words.ex_cn: 政府因贪污惩罚了那名官员。
words.en: Corruption is dishonest or illegal behavior, especially by people in positions of power.

words.ex: There was a resurgence of interest in classical music last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年古典音乐的兴趣再次兴起。
words.en: A resurgence is a process in which something becomes active or popular again after a period of inactivity or unpopularity.

words.ex: He is in rehabilitation after his surgery.
words.ex_cn: 他术后正在康复。
words.en: Rehabilitation is the process of helping someone to have a normal, useful life again after they have been very ill or in prison, or the process of returning a building or area to its previous good condition.

words.tr: v. 复制；复印；再做一次；
words.ex: He duplicated the file to save a copy.
words.ex_cn: 他复制了该文件以保存一份副本。
words.en: To duplicate something means to make an exact copy of it.

words.ex: He is an innovator who created a new app.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位创造了新应用程序的创新者。
words.en: An innovator is someone who introduces changes and new ideas in the way something is done or made.

words.ex: Each child shows their individuality in different ways.
words.ex_cn: 每个孩子都以不同的方式展现他们的个性。
words.en: The qualities that make someone or something different from others.

words.ex: The factory specializes in toolmaking for the automotive industry.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂专门为汽车行业制造工具。
words.en: The process or activity of making tools.

words.ex: He went to the bathhouse after work.
words.ex_cn: 他下班后去了澡堂。
words.en: A bathhouse is a building with facilities for bathing, often including a variety of baths such as steam rooms, saunas, and pools, and sometimes serving as a social gathering place.

words.ex: The duke lives in a big castle.
words.ex_cn: 公爵住在一座大城堡里。
words.en: A duke is a male ruler of a small independent state, or a man of very high rank in the British nobility.

words.ex: He bought one liter of milk.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一升牛奶。
words.en: A liter is a metric unit of capacity, equal to one cubic decimeter.

words.tr: n. 拱廊；有拱廊的街道；游乐中心
words.ex: The old arcade has stone pillars and a tiled roof.
words.ex_cn: 这座古老的拱廊有石柱和瓦片屋顶。
words.en: A covered passage with arches along one or both sides.

words.ex: The farmer dug a ditch to water the fields.
words.ex_cn: 农夫挖了一条沟来给田地浇水。
words.en: A ditch is a long narrow trench or furrow dug in the ground, especially for drainage or irrigation.

words.ex: His eccentricity makes him unique.
words.ex_cn: 他的古怪使他与众不同。
words.en: The quality of being eccentric; behaviour that is unusual, peculiar, or odd.

words.ex: A paleoecologist studies ancient ecosystems to understand how they have evolved over time.
words.ex_cn: 古生态学家研究古代生态系统，以了解它们是如何随时间演变的。
words.en: A paleoecologist is a scientist who studies ancient ecosystems and the interactions between organisms and their environments in the past.

words.tr: n. 固定物；固定装置；固定成员
words.ex: The shelf is a fixture in the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 这个架子是厨房里的固定物。
words.en: A fixture is a piece of equipment or furniture which is fixed in position in a building or vehicle.

words.ex: The old ship was a monster on the sea.
words.ex_cn: 那艘旧船在海上是个庞然大物。
words.en: A monster is an imaginary creature that is very large, ugly, and frightening.

words.tr: n. 关税；税率；（旅馆、饭店等的）价目表
words.ex: The government raised the tariff on imported cars.
words.ex_cn: 政府提高了进口汽车的关税。
words.en: A tariff is a tax that a government collects on goods coming into a country.

words.ex: His conception of the new app was simple but clever.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个新应用的构想简单而巧妙。
words.en: A conception is an idea or a plan that someone has in their mind.

words.tr: n. 官僚主义；官僚机构
words.ex: He hates the bureaucracy in government offices.
words.ex_cn: 他讨厌政府办公室里的官僚主义。
words.en: Bureaucracy refers to a system of government or business that has many complicated rules and ways of doing things.

words.ex: The supervisor checked the workers' progress.
words.ex_cn: 主管检查了工人们的进展。
words.en: A supervisor is a person who oversees and directs the work of others.

words.ex: The calotype process was one of the earliest photographic techniques.
words.ex_cn: 卡罗式照相法是最早的摄影技术之一。
words.en: The calotype is an early photographic process introduced by William Henry Fox Talbot in the 1840s, which uses paper coated with silver iodide.

words.tr: n. 广大；巨大；浩瀚无垠
words.ex: The immensity of the ocean surprised him.
words.ex_cn: 海洋的浩瀚让他感到惊讶。
words.en: The quality or state of being immense; vastness or hugeness.

words.tr: n. 海港；港口；港口城市
words.ex: The seaport was bustling with activity as ships were loading and unloading cargo.
words.ex_cn: 海港里船只正在装卸货物，一片繁忙的景象。
words.en: A seaport is a town or city with a harbor where ships load and unload.

words.ex: The porpoise jumped out of the water.
words.ex_cn: 海豚从水中跳了出来。
words.en: A porpoise is a small to medium-sized marine mammal, similar to a dolphin but generally smaller and with a shorter beak.

words.ex: The company's consolidation improved its market position.
words.ex_cn: 公司的巩固增强了其市场地位。
words.en: The act of combining two or more things into a single more effective or coherent whole.

words.ex: He is a collaborator in the science project.
words.ex_cn: 他是这个科学项目的协助者。
words.en: A collaborator is someone who works jointly on an activity or project; an associate.

words.ex: The needlefish is known for its long, slender snout.
words.ex_cn: 颌针鱼以其细长的喙而闻名。
words.en: A needlefish is a long, thin fish found in marine environments, known for its pointed jaws and swift swimming ability.

words.tr:
adj. 红外线的
n. 红外线
words.ex: The remote uses infrared to change the TV channel.
words.ex_cn: 遥控器使用红外线来切换电视频道。
words.en: Infrared refers to the region of the electromagnetic spectrum with wavelengths longer than visible light but shorter than microwaves, often used in technology for night vision and heat sensing.

words.ex: Countries rely on each other for trade and resources, showing interdependence.
words.ex_cn: 国家之间依靠彼此进行贸易和资源交换，体现了相互依赖。
words.en: A situation in which people or things depend on each other.

words.ex: The chipmunk scurried across the path, gathering nuts.
words.ex_cn: 花栗鼠匆匆穿过小径，收集坚果。
words.en: A chipmunk is a small, striped rodent of the squirrel family, found in North America and Asia.

words.ex: The glider flies silently over the hill.
words.ex_cn: 滑翔机静静地飞过山丘。
words.en: A glider is a light aircraft that flies without an engine, using the movement of air currents to stay in the air.

words.ex: The chemist discovered a new element.
words.ex_cn: 这位化学家发现了一种新元素。
words.en: A chemist is a scientist who specializes in chemistry, or in some contexts, a person who is qualified to prepare and dispense drugs and medicines.

words.ex: He showed skepticism about the new claim.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个新说法持怀疑态度。
words.en: Skepticism is a questioning attitude or doubt towards one or more items of putative knowledge or belief.

words.ex: He felt the stigma of being unemployed.
words.ex_cn: 他感受到了失业的耻辱。
words.en: A stigma is a strong feeling of disapproval that most people in a society have about something, especially when this is unfair.

words.ex: The interviewer asked him about his work experience.
words.ex_cn: 采访者问他关于他的工作经验。
words.en: An interviewer is a person who asks someone questions at an interview.

words.tr: n. 火球；大流星；工作起来干劲十足的人
words.ex: The boy threw a fireball at the target.
words.ex_cn: 男孩向目标扔了一个火球。
words.en: A fireball is a bright, burning sphere of light and heat, often associated with explosions or meteors entering the Earth's atmosphere.

words.tr: n. 获得；得到的东西；收购；
words.ex: The acquisition of new skills takes time.
words.ex_cn: 获得新技能需要时间。
words.en: An acquisition is something that someone buys, often to add to a collection of things.

words.ex: Many people died of starvation during the famine.
words.ex_cn: 许多人在饥荒中饿死了。
words.en: Starvation is a severe deficiency in caloric energy intake, below the level needed to maintain an organism's life.

words.tr: n. 即兴表演；即兴创作
words.ex: He made a song by improvisation during the concert.
words.ex_cn: 他在音乐会上即兴创作了一首歌。
words.en: Improvisation is the activity of making or doing something that you have not planned, using whatever you find.

words.tr: n. 一群人；组合；集合；聚集
words.ex: An assemblage of people gathered in the square.
words.ex_cn: 一群人聚集在广场上。
words.en: An assemblage is a collection of things or people that have been gathered together.

words.ex: The assembly of the car took three days.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车的装配花了三天时间。
words.en: An assembly is a group of people gathered together for a particular purpose, such as a meeting or a legislative session. It can also refer to the process of fitting together the component parts of a machine or other object.

words.tr:
v. 集合起来；振作；复苏
n. 集会
words.ex: The crowd rallied to support their team.
words.ex_cn: 人群聚集起来支持他们的球队。
words.en: A rally is a large public meeting that is held in order to show support for something such as a political party or a sports team. It can also mean to come together again in order to continue fighting or arguing after a defeat or a period of confusion.

words.ex: The children laughed as they rode the carousel at the fairground.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在游乐场上坐旋转木马时笑了。
words.en: A fairground is an open space where fairs, circuses, or exhibitions are held.

words.tr: n. 计件工作；按件计酬的工作
words.ex: He gets paid by piecework, earning $5 for each item he makes.
words.ex_cn: 他按计件工资领取报酬，每制作一个物品赚5美元。
words.en: Piecework is a type of employment in which workers are paid according to the number of items they produce, rather than the amount of time they spend working.

words.ex: They placed a memorial at the site of the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他们在事故地点放置了一座纪念物。
words.en: A memorial is a structure or event established to remind people of a person or event.

words.ex: The mechanic fixed my car quickly.
words.ex_cn: 机修工很快修好了我的车。
words.en: A mechanic is a person whose job is to repair and maintain machines and engines, especially those of vehicles.

words.ex: The continuation of the project depends on funding.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目的继续取决于资金。
words.en: The act of continuing something or the state of being continued.

words.ex: She took a course in homemaking to improve her skills.
words.ex_cn: 她参加了一个家政课程以提高自己的技能。
words.en: The activity or skill of managing a home, including tasks such as cooking, cleaning, and budgeting.

words.ex: I watched a clip of the movie on YouTube.
words.ex_cn: 我在YouTube上看了这部电影的一个片段。
words.en: A clip is a small device, usually made of metal or plastic, that is specially shaped for holding things together. As a verb, to clip means to cut something, especially to make it shorter or neater.

words.ex: Methyl is a common chemical group in organic chemistry.
words.ex_cn: 甲基是化学中有机化学中的常见化学基团。
words.en: A methyl group is a functional group derived from methane, containing one carbon atom bonded to three hydrogen atoms — CH3.

words.ex: His supposition is that it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他的假设是明天会下雨。
words.en: A supposition is a guess or a theory that you have about something, which may not be true.

words.ex: The police used fingerprint identification to find the suspect.
words.ex_cn: 警察使用指纹识别来找到嫌疑人。
words.en: Identification is the act of recognizing and naming someone or something, or the process of proving who or what someone or something is.

words.ex: He is a connoisseur of fine wine.
words.ex_cn: 他是优质葡萄酒的行家。
words.en: A connoisseur is a person who is especially competent to pass critical judgments in an art, particularly one of the fine arts, or in matters of taste.

words.ex: She rolled out the paste for the pie crust.
words.ex_cn: 她把面团擀平做派皮。
words.en: Paste is a soft, wet, sticky mixture of a powder and a liquid, which can be spread easily. It is also used to refer to the action of sticking something onto a surface using a sticky substance.

words.ex: The teacher learned new pedagogy from the workshop.
words.ex_cn: 这位老师从研讨会中学到了新的教学法。
words.en: The method and practice of teaching, especially as an academic subject or theoretical concept.

words.tr:
n. 接缝；缝合处；矿层；煤层
v. 缝合；有裂痕
words.ex: The seam of the shirt came loose.
words.ex_cn: 衬衫的接缝松开了。
words.en: A seam is a line where two pieces of fabric are sewn together in a garment or other article.

words.ex: The proximity of the school to the park makes it nice for kids.
words.ex_cn: 学校靠近公园，对孩子们来说很好。
words.en: Proximity refers to the state of being near in space or time.

words.ex: The doctor found a small nodule on her thyroid.
words.ex_cn: 医生在她的甲状腺上发现了一个小结节。
words.en: A nodule is a small lump or swelling, especially in the body.

words.ex: The painting is considered a masterpiece by art critics.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画被艺术评论家视为杰作。
words.en: A masterpiece is a work of art such as a painting, film, or book that is made with great skill and is considered to be the best work of a particular artist or writer.

words.ex: He follows the Ten Commandments.
words.ex_cn: 他遵守十诫。
words.en: A commandment is a rule or order, especially one of the Ten Commandments in the Bible.

words.ex: The economist predicts higher prices next year.
words.ex_cn: 这位经济学家预测明年价格会上涨。
words.en: An economist is a person who studies, teaches, or writes about economics.

words.ex: The durability of this plastic makes it good for outdoor use.
words.ex_cn: 这种塑料的持久性使它适合户外使用。
words.en: The ability of something to last a long time without significant deterioration.

words.ex: The museum displayed a collection of 16th-century faience.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆展出了一批16世纪的精巧彩色陶器。
words.en: Faience is a type of glazed ceramic ware, in particular a fine tin-glazed pottery on a delicate pale buff earthenware body.

words.ex: The watch works with great precision.
words.ex_cn: 这块手表运行得非常精确。
words.en: Precision is the quality of being exact and accurate.

words.tr: n. 精心制作；详尽的细节；
words.ex: The chef gave an elaboration to the dish with fresh herbs.
words.ex_cn: 厨师用新鲜香草对这道菜进行了精心制作。
words.en: The process of developing or presenting a theory, policy, or system in detail.

words.ex: The purification of water removes harmful bacteria.
words.ex_cn: 水的净化可以去除有害细菌。
words.en: The act of making something pure by removing dirty or harmful substances.

words.ex: The boxing match took place in an arena.
words.ex_cn: 拳击比赛在竞技场举行。
words.en: An arena is a place or scene of activity, debate, or conflict, especially one where a competition or performance is held.

words.ex: He drank beer in a small tavern.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家小酒馆里喝啤酒。
words.en: A tavern is a place where alcoholic drinks are served and people gather to drink and socialize.

words.ex: He ended up in the poorhouse after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后最终进了济贫院。
words.en: A poorhouse is a place where people who are unable to support themselves financially are housed and supported at public expense.

words.tr: n. 居住；定居；驻留期；住院医生实习期
words.ex: He completed his residency in New York.
words.ex_cn: 他在纽约完成了居住。
words.en: Residency refers to the state of living in a particular place or the period of advanced medical training and education that a physician undergoes in a hospital or clinic, usually after completing medical school.

words.ex: His greatness inspired many people.
words.ex_cn: 他的伟大激励了很多人。
words.en: Greatness is the quality of being great, distinguished, or eminent in some positive capacity.

words.ex: He felt sad after the rejection.
words.ex_cn: 在遭到拒绝后，他感到很难过。
words.en: The act of refusing to accept, believe in, or agree with something.

words.tr:
n. 聚光灯；
v. 使公众注意；
words.ex: The spotlight shone on the singer during the concert.
words.ex_cn: 演唱会上，聚光灯照在歌手身上。
words.en: A spotlight is a powerful light, for example in a theatre, which can be directed so that it lights up a small area. If someone or something is in the spotlight, they are getting a lot of attention from the public and the media.

words.ex: The resolution of the conflict took many meetings.
words.ex_cn: 这个冲突的解决花了多次会议。
words.en: A resolution is a formal decision made at a meeting by the vote of the people who are there. It can also refer to a firm decision to do or not to do something.

words.tr:
n. 最高统治者；君主；元首
adj. 独立自主的；拥有最高统治权的
words.ex: The sovereign makes important decisions for the country.
words.ex_cn: 君主为国家做出重要决定。
words.en: A sovereign is a king, queen, or other supreme ruler.

words.tr: n. 采伐森林；森林开伐；
words.ex: Deforestation is killing many animals.
words.ex_cn: 采伐森林正在杀死许多动物。
words.en: The act of cutting down or burning all the trees in an area.

words.ex: The predictability of the weather helps farmers plan their work.
words.ex_cn: 天气的可预测性帮助农民规划他们的工作。
words.en: The ability to be predicted; the quality of being predictable.

words.ex: Snakes are a common example of ectotherms.
words.ex_cn: 蛇是冷血动物的常见例子。
words.en: An ectotherm is an organism that relies on external sources of heat to regulate its body temperature, such as reptiles and amphibians.

words.tr:
n. 背心；马甲；汗衫
v. 授予；使穿衣
words.ex: He wears a black vest over his shirt.
words.ex_cn: 他穿着一件黑色背心，上面是衬衫。
words.en: A vest is a piece of clothing without sleeves that you wear over a shirt.

words.ex: The boat stops at the wharf near the sea.
words.ex_cn: 船停在海边的码头。
words.en: A wharf is a platform built out into the water where ships can be tied up and goods can be loaded or unloaded.

words.ex: Magnesium helps muscles work properly.
words.ex_cn: 镁有助于肌肉正常运作。
words.en: Magnesium is a silver-white metallic element that is essential for human nutrition and is used in various industrial applications.

words.ex: Her attractiveness made everyone smile.
words.ex_cn: 她的吸引力让每个人都笑了。
words.en: The quality of being pleasing or appealing to the senses.

words.ex: The cat sat in the doorway.
words.ex_cn: 猫坐在门口。
words.en: A doorway is the space in a wall where a door opens and closes, or the covered area just outside a door.

words.tr: n. 迷宫；错综复杂的曲径；
words.ex: The children got lost in the maze.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在迷宫里迷路了。
words.en: A maze is a complex system of paths or passages in which it is easy to get lost.

words.tr: n. 喜爱；类同；密切关系；亲和力
words.ex: She has an affinity for painting.
words.ex_cn: 她喜爱绘画。
words.en: A natural liking for or attraction to someone or something.

words.ex: The cottonwood tree has large, cottony seeds that disperse in the wind.
words.ex_cn: 杨树有大而蓬松的种子，随风传播。
words.en: A cottonwood is a type of tree that grows in North America, known for its broad leaves and the cotton-like substance that its seeds produce.

words.ex: Vaccines help build immunity against diseases.
words.ex_cn: 疫苗有助于增强对疾病的免疫力。
words.en: Immunity is the state of being immune from or insusceptible to a particular disease or the legal status of being exempt from certain obligations or penalties.

words.tr: n. 描绘；描述；描写；展现方式；
words.ex: The movie's portrayal of love is very touching.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影对爱情的描绘非常感人。
words.en: A portrayal of someone or something is a description or depiction of them in a particular way.

words.tr: n. 鸣禽；鸣鸟；女歌手；〈俚〉告密者
words.ex: The songbird's melody filled the morning air.
words.ex_cn: 鸣禽的旋律充满了清晨的空气。
words.en: A songbird is a bird that has a musical song, or it can refer to a female singer.

words.ex: The warbler sang melodiously in the early morning.
words.ex_cn: 啭鸟在清晨用颤音歌唱。
words.en: A warbler is a small songbird that is known for its melodious singing.

words.ex: He rides a motorcycle to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天骑摩托车去上班。
words.en: A motorcycle is a vehicle with two wheels and an engine.

words.ex: The train's destination is Beijing.
words.ex_cn: 这列火车的目的地是北京。
words.en: The place to which someone or something is going or being sent.

words.ex: The clergy prayed in the church every morning.
words.ex_cn: 神职人员每天早上在教堂祈祷。
words.en: The clergy are the official leaders of religious activities in certain religions, especially in Christianity.

words.ex: The shepherd walks with his sheep every morning.
words.ex_cn: 牧羊人每天早上都带着他的羊走路。
words.en: A shepherd is a person whose job is to look after sheep. As a verb, it means to guide or direct someone or something in a particular direction.

words.ex: The irritation on his arm hurt when he touched it.
words.ex_cn: 他手臂上的疼痛处一碰就疼。
words.en: Irritation is the feeling of annoyance, especially when something keeps happening that you do not like.

words.ex: The sign glows with bright neon light.
words.ex_cn: 这个标志发出明亮的霓虹光。
words.en: A colourless, odourless inert gaseous element occurring in minute amounts in the earth's atmosphere, used in fluorescent lights and illuminated advertising signs.

words.ex: The brewster was known for her exceptional craft beer.
words.ex_cn: 这位酿酒师以其出色的精酿啤酒而闻名。
words.en: A person who brews beer or other alcoholic drinks.

words.ex: The wildebeest runs across the savanna with the herd.
words.ex_cn: 角马与群体一起在大草原上奔跑。
words.en: A wildebeest is a large African antelope with a long head, a beard and mane, and a sloping back.

words.ex: The engine produces a lot of torque.
words.ex_cn: 发动机产生很大的扭矩。
words.en: Torque is a twisting force that causes rotation.

words.tr: n. 农场所有权者；占有宅地者；自耕农
words.ex: The homesteader built a small cabin on the land he had claimed.
words.ex_cn: 这位自耕农在他认领的土地上建了一间小木屋。
words.en: A homesteader is someone who owns and lives on a piece of land, especially in a rural area, and often cultivates it.

words.ex: The rise of agriculturalism in the 18th century marked a significant shift in economic thought.
words.ex_cn: 18世纪农业主义的兴起标志着经济思想的重大转变。
words.en: Agriculturalism is the belief in the importance of agriculture and rural life in society.

words.ex: The radiator is hot in the winter.
words.ex_cn: 冬天时，散热器是热的。
words.en: A radiator is a device for heating a room or building, consisting of a series of pipes through which hot water or steam is circulated. It can also refer to a device for cooling an engine or other mechanism, typically consisting of a bank of thin tubes with fins attached, through which coolant flows.

words.ex: The elimination of waste is important for health.
words.ex_cn: 排除废物对健康很重要。
words.en: The act of removing or getting rid of something completely.

words.tr:
adj. 批发的；
n. 成批出售；
adv. 大批地；
words.ex: He buys clothes at wholesale prices.
words.ex_cn: 他以批发价购买衣服。
words.en: Wholesale is the business of buying and selling goods in large quantities, especially for resale to retailers.

words.ex: The corpus callosum is a thick band of nerve fibers that connects the two hemispheres of the brain.
words.ex_cn: 胼胝体是连接大脑两个半球的一束厚厚的神经纤维。
words.en: The corpus callosum is a wide, flat bundle of neural fibers beneath the cortex in the eutherian brain at the longitudinal fissure. It connects the left and right cerebral hemispheres and facilitates interhemispheric communication.

words.ex: He used a jigsaw to cut the wooden board.
words.ex_cn: 他用竖锯切割木板。
words.en: A jigsaw is a machine with a fine blade used for cutting shapes in wood or metal. It is also a puzzle consisting of a picture printed on cardboard or wood and cut into various pieces of different shapes that have to be fitted together.

words.ex: The knight rode a horse and wore shiny armor.
words.ex_cn: 骑士骑着马，穿着闪亮的盔甲。
words.en: In the Middle Ages, a knight was a man of high social rank who had a duty to fight for his king. Knights are often depicted as noble warriors on horseback.

words.ex: The rider rode his horse quickly across the field.
words.ex_cn: 骑手快速骑马穿过田野。
words.en: A rider is someone who rides a horse, bicycle, or motorcycle, or a clause added to a document that provides additional information or conditions.

words.ex: The steamer sailed across the river.
words.ex_cn: 汽船驶过了河。
words.en: A steamer is a ship or boat that is powered by steam engines. It can also refer to a kitchen utensil used for steaming food.

words.ex: The submarine sailed quietly under the sea.
words.ex_cn: 潜水艇在海底安静地航行。
words.en: A submarine is a type of ship that can travel underwater. It is used primarily by the military for defense purposes, but some are used for scientific research.

words.ex: The encroachment of the desert is destroying farmland.
words.ex_cn: 沙漠的侵蚀正在摧毁农田。
words.en: Encroachment refers to the act of gradually taking something, especially someone else's rights or property, without permission.

words.ex: The clarity of her explanation helped everyone understand.
words.ex_cn: 她解释的清晰帮助了每个人理解。
words.en: Clarity is the quality of being clear, in particular the quality of being easy to understand or see.

words.ex: The meteorite is a chondrite.
words.ex_cn: 这块陨石是一种球粒陨石。
words.en: A chondrite is a stony meteorite containing small, round particles called chondrules.

words.tr: n. 便装（等于 deshabille）；随便；混乱
words.ex: She answered the door in a state of dishabille.
words.ex_cn: 她衣冠不整地开了门。
words.en: The state of being partially or carelessly dressed.

words.ex: The authenticity of the ancient painting was confirmed by experts.
words.ex_cn: 这幅古画的真实性得到了专家的确认。
words.en: The quality of being genuine or not corrupted from the original.

words.ex: The Philippines is an archipelago of thousands of islands.
words.ex_cn: 菲律宾是一个由数千个岛屿组成的群岛。
words.en: An archipelago is a group of islands, especially small islands, scattered in a body of water.

words.tr: n. 秃鼻乌鸦群居地（群栖地）
words.ex: The rookery near the forest is full of crows in spring.
words.ex_cn: 春天时，森林附近的秃鼻乌鸦群居地全是乌鸦。
words.en: A rookery is a colony of breeding animals, especially seabirds or seals.

words.ex: The trash receptacle is full.
words.ex_cn: 垃圾桶满了。
words.en: A receptacle is an object or space used to contain something.

words.tr: n. 分解；分裂；溶解；解体；解除；死亡
words.ex: The dissolution of sugar in water is quick.
words.ex_cn: 糖在水中的分解很快。
words.en: The act or process of ending or breaking up an organization, agreement, or legal arrangement.

words.tr: n. 乳状液；感光乳剂；乳胶漆
words.ex: The pharmacist prepared a new emulsion for topical application.
words.ex_cn: 药剂师为局部应用准备了一种新的乳剂。
words.en: An emulsion is a mixture of two or more liquids that are normally immiscible (unmixable or unblendable).

words.ex: The door is a gateway to the garden.
words.ex_cn: 这扇门是通往花园的通道。
words.en: A gateway is an entrance or a means of access to a place.

words.ex: The asthenosphere lies below the lithosphere.
words.ex_cn: 软流圈位于岩石圈之下。
words.en: The asthenosphere is the highly viscous, mechanically weak, and ductile region of the upper mantle of the Earth. It lies below the lithosphere, at depths between approximately 80 and 200 km below the surface. The asthenosphere is involved in plate tectonic movements and isostatic adjustments.

words.ex: The rabbit ate a green clover in the field.
words.ex_cn: 兔子在田野里吃了一株三叶草。
words.en: Clover is a small plant with leaves that have three rounded parts, often used as food for animals.

words.ex: The monk meditates every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这位僧侣每天早上冥想。
words.en: A monk is a member of a religious community of men who live by certain vows and usually wear a habit.

words.ex: She spun wool into yarn to make a sweater.
words.ex_cn: 她把羊毛纺成纱线来织毛衣。
words.en: Yarn is a long, continuous length of interlocked fibers, suitable for use in the production of textiles, sewing, crocheting, knitting, weaving, embroidery, or ropemaking.

words.tr: n. 山崩；塌方；压倒性的胜利
words.ex: The heavy rain caused a landslide.
words.ex_cn: 大雨引发了山体滑坡。
words.en: A landslide is a victory in an election in which a person or political party gets far more votes or seats than their opponents.

words.ex: The village is built on the mountainside.
words.ex_cn: 村庄建在山腰上。
words.en: The side or slope of a mountain.

words.ex: The quotient of 10 divided by 2 is 5.
words.ex_cn: 10除以2的商是5。
words.en: A quotient is the result you get by dividing one number by another.

words.ex: The bird rides the updraft to save energy.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿借助上升气流节省能量。
words.en: An updraft is a current of air that moves upwards.

words.ex: He is taking sociology at university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学里学习社会学。
words.en: Sociology is the study of society, patterns of social relationships, social interaction, and culture that surrounds everyday life.

words.ex: His stature in the scientific community is very high.
words.ex_cn: 他在科学界声望很高。
words.en: The height of a person or an animal in a standing position; the level of respect that people have for a person or organization because of their importance or success.

words.ex: The neuron sends signals to the brain.
words.ex_cn: 神经元向大脑发送信号。
words.en: A neuron is a cell that is specialized to conduct nerve impulses.

words.ex: He used a piece of rawhide to lash the post.
words.ex_cn: 他用一块生皮鞭抽打柱子。
words.en: Rawhide is the untanned hide of cattle or other animals, used especially for making whips, ropes, and other items.

words.ex: Morphine is an alkaloid derived from opium.
words.ex_cn: 吗啡是从鸦片中提取的一种生物碱。
words.en: An alkaloid is a naturally occurring chemical compound containing basic nitrogen atoms. This group also includes some related compounds with neutral and even weakly acidic properties. Some synthetic compounds of similar structure may also be termed alkaloids.

words.ex: He tied the box with a strong rope.
words.ex_cn: 他用一根结实的绳子把箱子绑了起来。
words.en: A rope is a thick cord made by twisting together strands of natural fibers such as hemp or artificial fibers such as nylon.

words.ex: The police found a corpse near the river.
words.ex_cn: 警察在河边发现了一具尸体。
words.en: A corpse is a dead body, especially the dead body of a human.

words.ex: Many people face unemployment during the economic crisis.
words.ex_cn: 在经济危机期间，许多人面临失业。
words.en: Unemployment refers to the state of being without a job, especially when one is actively seeking employment.

words.ex: The practicality of this tool makes it popular among workers.
words.ex_cn: 这个工具的实用性使它在工人中很受欢迎。
words.en: The quality of being suitable for a particular purpose or situation; the ability to be put to practical use.

words.ex: The deer is a herbivore.
words.ex_cn: 鹿是食草动物。
words.en: An herbivore is an animal that gets its energy from eating plants, and only plants.

words.ex: The archaeopteryx had feathers and could fly a little.
words.ex_cn: 始祖鸟有羽毛，能飞一点。
words.en: Archaeopteryx is a genus of bird-like dinosaurs that is transitional between non-avian feathered dinosaurs and modern birds.

words.ex: The clan lived in a small village for centuries.
words.ex_cn: 这个氏族几个世纪以来一直住在一个小村庄里。
words.en: A clan is a group of families or relatives who are connected by blood or marriage and who often share the same surname.

words.ex: He shows adaptability when things change quickly.
words.ex_cn: 当事情快速变化时，他表现出适应能力。
words.en: The ability to adjust to new conditions or environments.

words.tr:
n. 装璜工人；室内装饰工人
adj. 适于室内装饰的
words.ex: He is a decorator who paints walls beautifully.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位擅长漂亮粉刷墙壁的装饰工。
words.en: A decorator is a person whose job is to decorate the inside of buildings, especially people's houses.

words.ex: The farmer uses a harvester to collect wheat.
words.ex_cn: 农民使用收割机收割小麦。
words.en: A harvester is a machine used to gather a crop.

words.ex: The withdrawal of the offer surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 撤销这项提议让所有人都感到惊讶。
words.en: The act of removing or taking something away, especially money from a bank account, or the process of stopping taking a drug or medicine.

words.ex: He plays the accordion at the street festival.
words.ex_cn: 他在街头音乐节上演奏手风琴。
words.en: An accordion is a musical instrument that you play by pressing keys or buttons on one side and pulling and pushing a bellows on the other side to force air through reeds, producing notes.

words.ex: Bees help with pollination of flowers.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂帮助花朵授粉。
words.en: The transfer of pollen from an anther to a stigma; thereby enabling fertilization and sexual reproduction in plants.

words.ex: The theropod ran fast on two legs.
words.ex_cn: 兽脚类恐龙用两条腿快速奔跑。
words.en: Theropod refers to any member of a suborder of carnivorous dinosaurs that walked on two legs.

words.ex: The bookseller recommended several new releases.
words.ex_cn: 书商推荐了几本新书。
words.en: A bookseller is a person or company that sells books.

words.tr: n. 出师的学徒工；熟练工
words.ex: He is a journeyman plumber who fixes pipes.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名熟练的水管工，负责修理管道。
words.en: A journeyman is a worker who has completed an apprenticeship and is fully trained in a particular trade or craft, but is not yet a master.

words.tr:
n. 树桩；残段；残根
v. 难倒；重步走
words.ex: The tree stump is still in the yard.
words.ex_cn: 树桩还在院子里。
words.en: A stump is the base part of a tree that remains after the rest of the tree has been cut down. It can also refer to a difficult problem or to the act of walking heavily.

words.ex: The jellyfish floated gently in the sea.
words.ex_cn: 水母在海里轻轻漂浮。
words.en: A jellyfish is a sea creature with a soft, clear body and long tentacles that can sting.

words.ex: The lake is a popular spot for observing waterfowl.
words.ex_cn: 这个湖是观察水禽的热门地点。
words.en: Waterfowl are birds that live on or around water, such as ducks, geese, and swans.

words.ex: The mariner sailed the ship across the ocean.
words.ex_cn: 这位海员驾船横渡了海洋。
words.en: A mariner is a sailor.

words.ex: He filled the bucket with water from the well.
words.ex_cn: 他从井里打了一桶水。
words.en: A bucket is a round container with a handle, used for carrying liquids or other substances.

words.ex: He went diving with scuba gear.
words.ex_cn: 他带着水肺去潜水。
words.en: Scuba is an apparatus containing compressed air and used for breathing underwater, typically consisting of a mouthpiece, a demand valve, and one or more tanks of compressed air.

words.ex: His utterance made everyone silent.
words.ex_cn: 他的话让所有人都沉默了。
words.en: An utterance is a word, statement, or sound that someone says.

words.tr: n. 死记硬背；机械的做法；生搬硬套
words.ex: He learned the poem by rote.
words.ex_cn: 他通过死记硬背学会了这首诗。
words.en: Rote is the process of learning something by repeating it many times without thinking about it or understanding it.

words.ex: The prospector searched for gold in the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 矿工在山里寻找黄金。
words.en: A prospector is a person who searches for mineral deposits, especially by drilling and excavation.

words.ex: He poured molasses on his pancakes.
words.ex_cn: 他把糖蜜倒在煎饼上。
words.en: A thick, dark brown liquid obtained from raw sugar during the refining process, used in cooking and as a sweetener.

words.ex: He ate a ripe peach for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃了一个熟透的桃子。
words.en: A peach is a soft, round, slightly furry fruit with sweet yellow flesh and pinky-orange skin. Peaches grow in warm countries.

words.ex: The archaeologist found a potsherd in the ancient ruins.
words.ex_cn: 考古学家在古遗址中发现了一块陶瓷碎片。
words.en: A potsherd is a piece of broken pottery, especially one found in an archaeological context.

words.ex: He was arrested for intoxication after drinking too much.
words.ex_cn: 他因饮酒过量而被逮捕。
words.en: The state of being intoxicated, especially by alcohol or drugs.

words.tr: n. 特性描述；人物性格塑造；
words.ex: The characterization of the hero shows his bravery.
words.ex_cn: 对英雄的特性描述展现了他勇敢的品质。
words.en: The act of describing or representing the qualities or peculiarities of a person or thing.

words.ex: He acted as an intermediary between the two sides.
words.ex_cn: 他充当了双方之间的中间人。
words.en: An intermediary is a person who acts as a link between people or groups in order to try to bring about an agreement or reconciliation.

words.tr: n. （唱机的）唱针；触笔；手写笔
words.ex: The stylus on the record player needed replacing.
words.ex_cn: 唱片机的唱针需要更换。
words.en: A stylus is a small, pointed tool used for writing, drawing, or engraving. It can also refer to the needle of a record player or a pen used on touchscreen devices.

words.ex: The old bike has rust on its chain.
words.ex_cn: 这辆旧自行车的链条上有锈。
words.en: Rust is a reddish-brown substance that forms on the surface of iron or steel when they are exposed to air and moisture, causing them to corrode.

words.ex: The school concert was held in the auditorium.
words.ex_cn: 学校的音乐会是在礼堂举行的。
words.en: An auditorium is the part of a theatre, concert hall, or other public building in which the audience sits.

words.ex: He walked home with his companion.
words.ex_cn: 他和同伴一起走回家。
words.en: A companion is someone who you spend time with or who you are travelling with.

words.ex: The two devices need synchronization to work together.
words.ex_cn: 这两个设备需要同步才能一起工作。
words.en: The process of causing things to happen or operate at the same time or rate.

words.ex: I feel sympathy for the poor children.
words.ex_cn: 我对那些可怜的孩子感到同情。
words.en: If you have sympathy for someone who is in a bad situation, you are sorry for them, and show this in the way you behave towards them.

words.ex: The speculator bought gold hoping it would rise in price.
words.ex_cn: 这位投机者购买了黄金，希望它的价格会上涨。
words.en: A speculator is someone who buys goods, property, money, etc. in the hope of selling them at a profit.

words.ex: The teacher drew a diagram to explain the water cycle.
words.ex_cn: 老师画了一个图表来解释水循环。
words.en: A diagram is a simple drawing which consists mainly of lines and is used, for example, to explain how a machine works.

words.ex: The family had a reunion last Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 这家人上个星期天举行了团聚。
words.en: A reunion is a gathering of people who have been separated, especially members of a family or old friends, coming together again.

words.ex: The rocket uses chemical propulsion to fly into space.
words.ex_cn: 火箭使用化学推进力飞入太空。
words.en: Propulsion is the force that moves something forward, especially in vehicles like cars, planes, or spacecraft.

words.ex: From the clues, he made a logical inference.
words.ex_cn: 从线索中，他做出了一个合理的推论。
words.en: An inference is a conclusion that you draw about something by using information that you already have about it.

words.ex: The bulldozer cleared the path for the new road.
words.ex_cn: 推土机为新道路清理了路径。
words.en: A bulldozer is a large tractor with a blade in front, used for moving earth and rocks in construction work.

words.tr: n. 局外人；无取胜希望者；
words.ex: He felt like an outsider at the party.
words.ex_cn: 他在聚会上感觉像个局外人。
words.en: An outsider is someone who does not belong to a particular group or organization.

words.ex: The cake has a sweet flavor.
words.ex_cn: 这个蛋糕有一种甜味。
words.en: The flavor of a food or drink is its taste, especially a pleasant or distinctive one.

words.ex: The park is full of greenery.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园里到处都是绿色植物。
words.en: Plants and foliage, especially when used for decoration.

words.ex: The linguist analyzed the English corpus to find common phrases.
words.ex_cn: 语言学家分析了英语语料库以寻找常用短语。
words.en: A corpus is a large collection of written or spoken texts that is used for language research.

words.ex: The government is working to reduce illiteracy in rural areas.
words.ex_cn: 政府正在努力减少农村地区的文盲。
words.en: Illiteracy is the condition of being unable to read and write.

words.tr:
adj. 文盲的；无知的；
n. 文盲；无知识的人；
words.ex: He is illiterate and cannot read simple signs.
words.ex_cn: 他是文盲，无法阅读简单的标识。
words.en: Someone who is illiterate cannot read or write.

words.tr:
n. 污点；
v. 玷污；
words.ex: There is a coffee stain on the table.
words.ex_cn: 桌子上有一个咖啡污点。
words.en: A stain is a mark on something that is difficult to remove, especially one made by a liquid such as blood or coffee. To stain something means to leave a mark on it that is difficult to remove.

words.ex: The city cleaned the sewage from the streets.
words.ex_cn: 城市清理了街道上的污水。
words.en: Sewage is waste matter such as faeces or dirty water from homes and factories, which flows away through sewers.

words.ex: The sinkhole swallowed the entire car.
words.ex_cn: 这个污水坑吞噬了整辆汽车。
words.en: A sinkhole is a hole in the ground that forms when water dissolves surface rock, often limestone, creating a void that can collapse and form a depression or hole.

words.ex: His ignorance of the rules caused the mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他对规则的无知导致了这个错误。
words.en: Lack of knowledge or information.

words.ex: We had a quick luncheon at the café.
words.ex_cn: 我们在咖啡馆简单吃了顿午餐。
words.en: A luncheon is a formal lunch, or a formal word for lunch.

words.ex: Selenium is often used in solar cells.
words.ex_cn: 硒常用于太阳能电池中。
words.en: Selenium is a nonmetal with properties that are intermediate between those of its periodic table column-adjacent chalcogen elements sulfur and tellurium.

words.ex: The rarity of snow in this city surprises visitors.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市下雪的罕见现象让游客感到惊讶。
words.en: Something that is rare, or the state of being rare.

words.tr:
v. 想要；
adj. 花哨的；昂贵的；
n. 爱好；
words.ex: I fancy a cup of tea.
words.ex_cn: 我想要一杯茶。
words.en: If you describe something as fancy, you mean that it is special, unusual, or elaborate, often because it has a lot of decoration or is very expensive.

words.ex: You need basic math as a prerequisite for this course.
words.ex_cn: 你学习这门课程的前提是掌握基础数学。
words.en: A prerequisite is something that must exist or happen before something else can exist or happen.

words.ex: The film was shot on location in a small village.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影是在一个小镇上实地拍摄的。
words.en: A locale is a place where something happens or is set, or that has particular events associated with it.

words.ex: The country is working on modernization of its roads.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家正在努力改善其道路的现代化。
words.en: Modernization is the process of making something modern and more suited to present-day needs.

words.ex: He ate a chunk of cheese for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃了一大块奶酪。
words.en: A chunk of something is a large piece or amount of it.

words.ex: The portraitist skillfully captured the essence of her subject.
words.ex_cn: 这位肖像画家巧妙地捕捉到了她主题的精髓。
words.en: A portraitist is an artist who specializes in creating portraits, which are representations of a person, especially of the face.

words.ex: Good digestion helps your body absorb nutrients.
words.ex_cn: 良好的消化有助于身体吸收营养。
words.en: The process by which food is broken down in the stomach and intestines so that the body can absorb it and use it for energy and nutrients.

words.tr:
n. 钉；支柱
v. 钉（木桩等）以固定；限定
words.ex: He hung the hat on a peg.
words.ex_cn: 他把帽子挂在了一个钉子上。
words.en: A peg is a small device, usually made of wood or metal, that is used to fasten things or to hang things on.

words.ex: The cerebellum is crucial for coordinating movement.
words.ex_cn: 小脑对于协调运动至关重要。
words.en: The cerebellum is a major feature of the hindbrain of all vertebrates. Although usually smaller than the cerebrum, in some animals such as the mormyrid fishes it may be as large as or even larger. In humans, the cerebellum plays an important role in motor control. It may also be involved in some cognitive functions such as attention and language, and in regulating fear and pleasure responses, but its movement-related functions are the most solidly established.

words.ex: Good coordination between teams improves work efficiency.
words.ex_cn: 团队之间的良好协调能提高工作效率。
words.en: The organization of the different elements of a complex body or activity so as to enable them to work together effectively.

words.ex: He wants to study psychology at university.
words.ex_cn: 他想在大学学习心理学。
words.en: Psychology is the scientific study of the human mind and the reasons for people's behaviour.

words.tr: n. 新生；振兴；恢复元气
words.ex: The city plan aims at revitalization of old parks.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市计划旨在使旧公园重新焕发生机。
words.en: The process of making something grow, develop, or become successful again.

words.ex: He wants to study journalism after high school.
words.ex_cn: 他想在高中后学习新闻工作。
words.en: The profession or practice of reporting about, photographing, or editing news stories for one of the mass media.

words.ex: The moon looks like a crescent tonight.
words.ex_cn: 今晚的月亮像一弯新月。
words.en: A crescent is a curved shape that is wider in the middle and pointed at the ends, like the shape of the moon in its first or last quarter.

words.ex: Biology students learn morphology to study plant shapes.
words.ex_cn: 生物学生学习形态学来研究植物的形状。
words.en: Morphology is the study of the form and structure of organisms or their parts.

words.ex: The light causes excitation in the atoms.
words.ex_cn: 光使原子产生激发。
words.en: Excitation is the act of exciting or the state of being excited, especially in a way that causes strong feelings of happiness and eagerness.

words.ex: He rubbed his chest after the cough.
words.ex_cn: 他咳嗽后揉了揉胸部。
words.en: The front part of a person's body between the neck and the stomach, or a large strong box used for storing things.

words.ex: The park is within the precinct of the city center.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园位于市中心的范围内。
words.en: A precinct is a part of a city or town that has its own police force, or a division of a city for police or voting purposes.

words.ex: The snowdrift blocked the road.
words.ex_cn: 雪堆挡住了道路。
words.en: A snowdrift is a deep pile of snow formed by the wind.

words.tr:
n. 雪橇；大锤
v. 乘雪橇；用大锤敲打
words.ex: The children rode on a sledge down the snowy hill.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们坐在雪橇上滑下雪坡。
words.en: A sledge is a vehicle that is used for traveling over snow and ice. It is typically pulled by animals or a motor.

words.tr: n. 回路；环行；电路；巡回；
words.ex: The battery connects to the circuit to make the light work.
words.ex_cn: 电池连接到回路，使灯亮起来。
words.en: A circuit is a roughly circular line, route, or movement that starts and finishes at the same place. It can also refer to the complete path that an electric current travels along.

words.ex: The constriction of the pipe reduced the water flow.
words.ex_cn: 管道的狭窄减少了水流。
words.en: The action of making something narrower or tighter by squeezing or pressing it.

words.ex: The smoke came out of the chimney.
words.ex_cn: 烟从烟囱里冒出来。
words.en: A chimney is a pipe through which smoke goes up into the air, usually through the roof of a building.

words.tr: n. 扩展；延长期；延伸；电话分机；
words.ex: The company added an extension to its office building.
words.ex_cn: 公司为办公楼加了一个扩建部分。
words.en: An extension is a part that is added to something to make it longer or larger, or the act of adding this part.

words.ex: The building is built on solid bedrock.
words.ex_cn: 这座建筑建在坚实的基岩上。
words.en: The solid rock underlying loose deposits such as soil or alluvium.
