words.ex: The coalescence of small businesses led to the creation of a large corporation.
words.ex_cn: 小企业的合并促成了一个大公司的创建。
words.en: The process of coming or growing together to form one thing or system.

words.ex: The table is made of a composite material.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子是由一种合成材料制成的。
words.en: A composite is something that is made up of several different parts or materials.

words.ex: The new law was passed during peacetime.
words.ex_cn: 新法律是在和平时期通过的。
words.en: A period when a country is not at war.

words.ex: The red color in apples comes from anthocyanin.
words.ex_cn: 苹果的红色来自花青素。
words.en: Any of a group of water-soluble pigments that give flowers and fruits their red, blue, or purple colors.

words.ex: The injury caused necrosis in the tissue.
words.ex_cn: 受伤导致组织坏死。
words.en: The death of most or all of the cells in an organ or tissue due to disease, injury, or failure of the blood supply.

words.ex: A raccoon is digging in the trash at night.
words.ex_cn: 一只浣熊在夜里翻垃圾桶。
words.en: A raccoon is a small, nocturnal mammal with a distinctive black mask across its eyes and a ringed tail, native to North America.

words.tr: n. 臼；研钵；灰浆；迫击炮
words.ex: The chef used a mortar to grind the spices.
words.ex_cn: 厨师用臼来研磨香料。
words.en: Mortar is a mixture of sand, water, and cement or lime that is used to hold bricks or stones together. It is also a type of gun that fires explosive shells at a high angle.

words.tr:
n. 灰熊（北美洲）
adj. 灰色的；头发灰白的
words.ex: A grizzly bear walked near the camp.
words.ex_cn: 一只灰熊走近了营地。
words.en: A grizzly or grizzly bear is a large, fierce, brownish-yellow bear found in North America.

words.tr: n. 一段时间；会议；会期；开庭；学年；
words.ex: We had a long session of studying together.
words.ex_cn: 我们一起学习了一段时间。
words.en: A session is a meeting of a court, parliament, or other official group, or a period of time used for a particular activity, especially by a group of people.

words.ex: The patient was under general narcosis during the surgery.
words.ex_cn: 病人在手术期间处于全身麻醉状态。
words.en: Narcosis is a state of stupor, drowsiness, or unconsciousness produced by drugs.

words.ex: The engagement between the teacher and students improved learning.
words.ex_cn: 老师与学生之间的密切关系提高了学习效果。
words.en: An engagement is a formal agreement to get married, or a period of time when two people are planning to get married.

words.ex: He uses compost to make his garden soil richer.
words.ex_cn: 他用堆肥来使花园的土壤更肥沃。
words.en: Compost is a mixture of decaying organic matter, such as leaves and food scraps, used to improve soil structure and provide nutrients for plants.

words.tr:
n. 烈火；火焰；闪耀
v. 闪耀；熊熊燃烧；发亮光
words.ex: The fire began to blaze in the woods.
words.ex_cn: 火在森林里开始猛烈燃烧。
words.en: A blaze is a very large or fiercely burning fire that is difficult to control.

words.ex: Gunpowder was used to make fireworks.
words.ex_cn: 火药被用来制作烟花。
words.en: A black or brown explosive substance consisting of a mixture of potassium nitrate, charcoal, and sulfur, used in gunnery and as a blasting agent in mining.

words.ex: The freighter was loaded with tons of cargo.
words.ex_cn: 这艘货船装载了数吨货物。
words.en: A freighter is a large ship or aircraft designed to carry goods.

words.ex: The genotype of the plant is green.
words.ex_cn: 这种植物的基因型是绿色的。
words.en: The genetic constitution of an individual organism.

words.ex: He is an activist who helps the poor.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位帮助穷人的积极分子。
words.en: An activist is a person who works to bring about political or social change by campaigning, public speaking, or demonstrating.

words.ex: He felt pain in the extremity of his finger.
words.ex_cn: 他手指的末端感到疼痛。
words.en: An extremity is the furthest point or limit of something, or a situation of extreme difficulty or danger.

words.ex: The polarity of the magnet is clear.
words.ex_cn: 这个磁铁的极性很清晰。
words.en: Polarity refers to the state of having two opposite or contradictory tendencies, opinions, or aspects.

words.ex: The numbers show convergence over time.
words.ex_cn: 这些数字随时间显示出收敛。
words.en: The process or state of converging; the coming together of two or more things to a common point or conclusion.

words.ex: He felt jealousy when his friend got a new bike.
words.ex_cn: 当他的朋友得到一辆新自行车时，他感到妒忌。
words.en: Jealousy is the feeling of anger or bitterness which someone has when they think that another person is trying to take a lover or friend, or a possession, away from them.

words.ex: He set the timer for ten minutes.
words.ex_cn: 他把计时器设为十分钟。
words.en: A timer is a device that measures time intervals and signals the end of a specified period.

words.ex: The technician fixed the broken machine.
words.ex_cn: 技术员修好了坏掉的机器。
words.en: A technician is a worker trained with special skills, especially in science or engineering.

words.ex: He was the continuator of his father's legacy.
words.ex_cn: 他是他父亲遗产的继续者。
words.en: A continuator is someone who continues or carries on a work, tradition, or legacy started by someone else.

words.ex: He is a cabinetmaker who makes wooden shelves.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名制作木架的木匠。
words.en: A cabinetmaker is a skilled craftsperson who makes fine furniture and other wooden objects.

words.ex: The patriarch leads his large family with wisdom.
words.ex_cn: 这位族长以智慧领导他的大家庭。
words.en: A patriarch is a man who is the head of a family or tribe, or a highly respected man in a particular field.

words.tr:
n. 甲壳动物
adj. 甲壳类的
words.ex: The crab is a crustacean.
words.ex_cn: 螃蟹是一种甲壳类动物。
words.en: A crustacean is a type of animal with a hard shell, such as a crab or lobster.

words.ex: His insistence on being on time annoyed everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他坚持准时让所有人都感到烦恼。
words.en: The act of demanding something forcefully, not accepting refusal.

words.ex: The teacher gave supervision to the students during the exam.
words.ex_cn: 老师在考试期间监督学生。
words.en: The act of overseeing or directing a project, activity, or person.

words.ex: He learned piano under his teacher's tutelage.
words.ex_cn: 他在老师的指导下学习钢琴。
words.en: The act of guarding, protecting, or guiding; the office or function of a guardian; guardianship; protection; as, the king's right of seigniory and tutelage.

words.ex: The subtraction of 5 from 10 gives 5.
words.ex_cn: 10减去5等于5。
words.en: Subtraction is the process of taking one number or amount away from another.

words.ex: The plant uses desalination to make seawater drinkable.
words.ex_cn: 该工厂使用脱盐作用将海水变为可饮用水。
words.en: The process of removing salt from seawater to make it suitable for drinking or irrigation.

words.ex: The knight held a sharp sword in his hand.
words.ex_cn: 骑士手里拿着一把锋利的剑。
words.en: A sword is a weapon with a long metal blade and a hilt with a handguard, used for thrusting or striking and now typically worn as part of ceremonial dress.

words.ex: The navy launched a large fleet to protect the coast.
words.ex_cn: 海军派出了一支大型舰队来保护海岸。
words.en: A fleet is a group of ships or vehicles that are controlled by one company or organization and are used for a particular purpose.

words.ex: He picked up the paddle and rowed the boat.
words.ex_cn: 他拿起桨划船。
words.en: A paddle is a short pole with a wide flat part at one end or both ends, used to move a small boat through water.

words.tr: n. 交叉；相交；十字路口；交叉路口；
words.ex: The intersection of two roads is busy.
words.ex_cn: 两条路的交叉口很繁忙。
words.en: An intersection is a place where roads or other lines meet or cross.

words.ex: He listened to a beautiful symphony last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚听了一首美妙的交响乐。
words.en: A symphony is a long piece of music that is usually in four parts and is performed by an orchestra.

words.ex: They live on the outskirts of the city.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在城市的郊区。
words.en: The outskirts of a city or town are the parts of it that are farthest away from its center.

words.ex: Collagen is a protein that provides structure to skin and connective tissues.
words.ex_cn: 胶原蛋白是一种为皮肤和结缔组织提供结构的蛋白质。
words.en: Collagen is a fibrous protein that is the main constituent of connective tissue in animals and the most abundant protein in mammals, making up about 25% to 35% of the whole-body protein content.

words.ex: The instructor explained the math problem clearly.
words.ex_cn: 教员清楚地讲解了这道数学题。
words.en: An instructor is someone who teaches a skill or subject, especially in a college or university, or in a specialized field such as driving or skiing.

words.tr:
n. 接力赛；轮换者；
v. 传达；传递；
words.ex: The boys ran in the 4x100 meter relay.
words.ex_cn: 男孩们参加了4x100米接力赛。
words.en: A relay is a race between teams in which each team member runs or swims one section of the race. In electronics, a relay is a device that allows a small electrical current to control a larger one.

words.ex: The teacher appreciated the students' receptiveness to new ideas.
words.ex_cn: 老师欣赏学生们对新思想的接受能力。
words.en: Receptiveness is the quality of being willing to consider or accept new suggestions and ideas.

words.ex: The node is connected to two wires.
words.ex_cn: 这个节点连接着两根电线。
words.en: A node is a point at which lines or pathways intersect or branch; a central or connecting point.

words.tr: n. 枯竭；耗尽；筋疲力尽；
words.ex: The long hike led to his exhaustion.
words.ex_cn: 长时间的徒步旅行导致他筋疲力尽。
words.en: A state of extreme physical or mental tiredness.

words.ex: He achieved mastery of the piano after ten years of practice.
words.ex_cn: 他经过十年的练习，熟练掌握了钢琴。
words.en: If you show mastery of a particular skill or language, you show that you have learned or understood it completely and have no difficulty using it.

words.ex: The old lamp burned sperm for light.
words.ex_cn: 这盏旧灯用鲸蜡油照明。
words.en: The male reproductive cell; spermatozoon.

words.ex: His virtuosity on the piano amazed everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他在钢琴上的精湛技艺让所有人惊叹。
words.en: Great skill in music or another artistic pursuit.

words.tr:
n. 抽筋；痉挛；夹钳
v. 束缚；使痉挛；用夹钳夹紧
words.ex: He got a cramp in his leg while running.
words.ex_cn: 他在跑步时腿抽筋了。
words.en: A cramp is a sudden, involuntary muscle contraction or over-shortening; while generally temporary and non-damaging, they can cause mild-to-severe pain, and a paralysis-like immobility of the affected muscle.

words.ex: The rivalry between the two teams is very strong.
words.ex_cn: 这两支队伍之间的竞争非常激烈。
words.en: Competition for the same objective or for superiority in the same field.

words.ex: He is a famous playwright who writes plays.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位著名的剧作家，写剧本。
words.en: A playwright is a person who writes plays.

words.ex: The hurricane destroyed many houses.
words.ex_cn: 飓风摧毁了许多房屋。
words.en: A hurricane is an extremely violent wind or storm.

words.ex: The bottle is made of a strong polymer.
words.ex_cn: 这个瓶子是由一种坚固的聚合物制成的。
words.en: A polymer is a chemical compound with molecules bonded together in long repeating chains. Because of their structure, polymers have unique properties that can be tailored for different uses.

words.ex: The university received a large endowment from a philanthropist.
words.ex_cn: 这所大学收到了一位慈善家的大量捐赠。
words.en: An endowment is a gift of money that is made to an institution or community in order to provide it with an annual income.

words.ex: The hospital received a donation of books.
words.ex_cn: 医院收到了一批书籍捐赠。
words.en: A donation is a gift which is given to a charity or other organization.

words.tr: n. 隔热（或绝缘、隔音等的）材料（或装置）；
words.ex: Glass is a good insulator for heat.
words.ex_cn: 玻璃是良好的隔热材料。
words.en: An insulator is a material or device that prevents or reduces the passage of heat, electricity, or sound.

words.ex: Uniformitarianism is a geological principle that states that the processes we observe today have acted in the same way over long periods of time.
words.ex_cn: 均变论是一种地质学原理，它认为我们今天观察到的过程在长时间内以相同的方式起作用。
words.en: The principle that the same natural laws and processes that operate in the universe now have always operated in the universe in the past and apply everywhere in the universe.

words.ex: The country still has a monarchy with a king as the head of state.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家仍然实行君主制，国王是国家元首。
words.en: A monarchy is a form of government in which a country is ruled by a monarch, such as a king or queen.

words.ex: The project began at its inception.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目从开始时就启动了。
words.en: The inception of something is the start or beginning of it.

words.tr: n. 开心果；阿月浑子；淡绿色
words.ex: He eats a pistachio every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 他每天下午吃一颗开心果。
words.en: A pistachio is a small, green nut that is often eaten as a snack or used in cooking and baking.

words.ex: The caiman lurked in the murky waters of the Amazon River.
words.ex_cn: 凯门鳄潜伏在亚马逊河的浑浊水域中。
words.en: A caiman is a reptile similar to an alligator that lives in Central and South America.

words.ex: The book is in the bag.
words.ex_cn: 书在包里。
words.en: Used to indicate location or position within something.

words.tr:
n. 带扣；皮带扣
v. （使）搭扣扣住
words.ex: The belt has a shiny buckle.
words.ex_cn: 这条皮带有一个闪亮的带扣。
words.en: A buckle is a piece of metal or plastic attached to one end of a belt or strap, which is used to fasten it. As a verb, to buckle means to fasten something with a buckle or to bend or collapse under pressure.

words.ex: We went to the carnival last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我们上周末去了嘉年华。
words.en: A carnival is a public festival, typically one held annually in a particular place, involving processions, music, and dancing.

words.ex: The miner works deep underground.
words.ex_cn: 矿工在地下深处工作。
words.en: A miner is a person who works in a mine, extracting coal, gold, or other minerals.

words.ex: He faced a dilemma: stay home or go to work.
words.ex_cn: 他面临一个困境：是待在家里还是去上班。
words.en: A situation in which a difficult choice has to be made between two or more alternatives, especially equally undesirable ones.

words.ex: He found himself in a predicament when he lost his wallet.
words.ex_cn: 当他丢掉钱包时，他陷入了困境。
words.en: A predicament is a difficult, perplexing, or trying situation.

words.ex: The conflict led to an escalation of violence.
words.ex_cn: 冲突导致了暴力的升级。
words.en: An escalation is an increase or growth, especially one that makes a situation worse or more dangerous.

words.ex: He threw his trash into the ashcan.
words.ex_cn: 他把垃圾扔进了垃圾桶。
words.en: A container for the disposal of waste materials, especially one kept outdoors.

words.ex: He is a strong comer in the talent show.
words.ex_cn: 他在才艺比赛中是个有成功希望的人。
words.en: A comer is someone who arrives somewhere or someone who is likely to be successful in the future.

words.ex: Cyanobacteria are ancient microorganisms that play a crucial role in the Earth's ecosystem.
words.ex_cn: 蓝藻细菌是古老的微生物，在地球生态系统中起着至关重要的作用。
words.en: Cyanobacteria, also known as blue-green algae, are a phylum of bacteria that obtain their energy through photosynthesis.

words.ex: The child gave a recital of poems at school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在学校进行了诗歌朗诵。
words.en: A recital is a performance of music or poetry, usually given by a soloist or a small group.

words.tr:
n. 刻板印象；陈规老套
v. 对…存有成见；把…模式化
words.ex: He broke the stereotype that boys cannot cry.
words.ex_cn: 他打破了男孩不能哭的刻板印象。
words.en: A stereotype is a fixed general image or set of characteristics that a lot of people believe represent a particular type of person or thing.

words.ex: His willingness to help made everyone happy.
words.ex_cn: 他乐于帮忙，让每个人都感到开心。
words.en: The quality or state of being prepared to do something; readiness.

words.ex: She played a melody on her concertina.
words.ex_cn: 她在她的六角形乐器上演奏了一首曲子。
words.en: A concertina is a musical instrument resembling an accordion but smaller and hexagonal in shape, played by pressing buttons on both ends.

words.ex: The quasar is very far away and very bright.
words.ex_cn: 这个类星体非常遥远且非常明亮。
words.en: A quasar is a massive and extremely remote celestial object, emitting exceptionally large amounts of energy, and typically having a star-like image in a telescope.

words.ex: This movie is a horror genre film.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影是一部恐怖类型影片。
words.en: A genre is a particular type of literature, painting, music, film, or other art form which people consider as a class because it has special characteristics.

words.ex: The fridge uses refrigeration to keep food cold.
words.ex_cn: 冰箱使用制冷来保持食物冰凉。
words.en: The process of cooling or freezing (e.g., food) for preservation.

words.tr: n. 分离器；分离装置；分隔符
words.ex: The knife is a separator for the cake.
words.ex_cn: 这把刀是蛋糕的分隔工具。
words.en: A separator is a device or substance that is used to separate one thing from another.

words.tr: n. 做礼拜的人；崇拜者；信徒
words.ex: The worshipper knelt before the statue.
words.ex_cn: 信徒在雕像前跪下。
words.en: A worshipper is someone who worships a god or deity, often in a religious context.

words.ex: The invention of the wheel was a landmark in human history.
words.ex_cn: 轮子的发明是人类历史上的一个里程碑。
words.en: A landmark is a building or feature of a landscape that is easily seen and recognized from a distance, especially one that enables someone to establish their location.

words.ex: The theorist wrote a simple book about stars.
words.ex_cn: 这位理论家写了一本关于恒星的简单书籍。
words.en: A theorist is someone who develops or studies theories, especially in science or philosophy.

words.tr: n. 理想化；理想化的事物
words.ex: He loves the idealization of his childhood.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢对童年的理想化。
words.en: The act of regarding or representing something as perfect or better than in reality.

words.ex: He checks the almanac for the next full moon.
words.ex_cn: 他查阅历书以查找下一个满月的日期。
words.en: An almanac is a book published every year which contains information about events connected with a particular subject or activity, and facts and statistics about that subject or activity.

words.ex: The utilization of solar energy is increasing.
words.ex_cn: 太阳能的利用正在增加。
words.en: Utilization is the act of using something effectively.

words.ex: The colors from red to violet form a continuum.
words.ex_cn: 从红色到紫色的颜色构成一个连续体。
words.en: A continuum is a continuous sequence in which adjacent elements are not perceptibly different from each other, although the extremes are quite distinct.

words.tr: n. 加入工会；组织工会
words.ex: The workers are seeking unionization to get better pay.
words.ex_cn: 工人们正在寻求工会化以获得更好的工资。
words.en: The process of organizing workers into a labor union to protect their rights and interests.

words.ex: She wore sandals to the beach.
words.ex_cn: 她穿着凉鞋去海滩。
words.en: A sandal is a type of light shoe that you wear in warm weather, which has straps that go over your foot and around your ankle.

words.ex: The forester walks through the forest to check the trees.
words.ex_cn: 林务员在森林中行走以检查树木。
words.en: A forester is a person who is in charge of the management and conservation of a forest.

words.ex: The plant needs phosphate to grow well.
words.ex_cn: 植物需要磷酸盐才能良好生长。
words.en: A phosphate is a salt or ester of phosphoric acid, containing the anion PO₄³⁻ or the group —PO₄.

words.ex: He plays the bongo at the beach party.
words.ex_cn: 他在海滩派对上打邦戈鼓。
words.en: A bongo is a type of drum that is played with the hands, originating from Africa. It consists of two small drums of different sizes that are joined together.

words.ex: He is a songwriter who writes happy songs.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位创作快乐歌曲的作曲家。
words.en: A songwriter is a person who writes the words or the music, or both, for songs.

words.ex: The volcano erupted and produced rhyolite lava.
words.ex_cn: 火山喷发并产生了流纹岩熔岩。
words.en: Rhyolite is a volcanic rock, rich in silica, which is the extrusive equivalent of granite.

words.ex: He bought a fresh lobster at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场上买了一只新鲜的龙虾。
words.en: A lobster is a sea creature with a hard shell, two large claws, and eight legs, or the flesh of this animal eaten as food.

words.tr: n. 壁炉地面；炉床；炉边
words.ex: She sat by the hearth to keep warm.
words.ex_cn: 她坐在壁炉旁取暖。
words.en: The floor of a fireplace, often extending into a room and paved with brick, stone, or cement, used as a place to build fires or for sitting in front of a fire.

words.ex: He wore a buckskin jacket to the festival.
words.ex_cn: 他穿着一件鹿皮夹克去参加节日。
words.en: Buckskin is a type of soft, strong leather made from the skin of a deer.

words.ex: The dirt pathway led to the small house.
words.ex_cn: 这条土路通向那座小房子。
words.en: A pathway is a track that is made by or for people walking, especially one through a countryside or a park.

words.ex: The workers repaired the roadbed after the storm.
words.ex_cn: 工人们在风暴后修复了路基。
words.en: The foundation or base on which a road is built.

words.tr: n. 露出地面的岩层；露头
words.ex: The rock outcrop is visible near the trail.
words.ex_cn: 岩石露头在小径附近可见。
words.en: An outcrop is a rock formation that is visible on the surface of the Earth.

words.tr: n. 异于一般情况的人（或事物）
words.ex: The number 100 is an outlier in this data set.
words.ex_cn: 在这个数据集中，数字100是一个异常值。
words.en: An outlier is a person or thing that is atypical within a particular group, class, or category.

words.ex: The despoiler ruined the forest with trash.
words.ex_cn: 这个破坏者用垃圾毁坏了森林。
words.en: A despoiler is someone who steals or destroys things, especially in a violent or careless way.

words.tr: n. 道德规范；伦理标准；
words.ex: The company follows a strong ethic of honesty.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司遵循诚实的道德规范。
words.en: An ethic is a moral principle or set of moral principles that guides the behavior of a person or group, especially in a professional context.

words.tr:
n. 螺丝钉；
v. 拧紧；
words.ex: He tightened the screw with a screwdriver.
words.ex_cn: 他用螺丝刀拧紧了螺丝钉。
words.en: A screw is a metal object similar to a nail, with a raised spiral line around it. Screws are used to fasten things together.

words.ex: The hotelkeeper welcomed us with a smile.
words.ex_cn: 酒店老板微笑着欢迎我们。
words.en: A hotelkeeper is a person who owns or manages a hotel.

words.ex: He used a Baedeker guide to find the old castle.
words.ex_cn: 他用一本贝德克尔指南找到了那座古堡。
words.en: A Baedeker is a guidebook for travelers, especially one providing detailed information about a city or region.

words.ex: The travelers found an oasis with water and trees.
words.ex_cn: 旅行者们发现了一个有水和树木的绿洲。
words.en: An oasis is a small area in a desert where water and plants are found, making it a place of relief and beauty in an otherwise barren landscape.

words.tr:
n. 麻醉药；镇定剂；致幻毒品
adj. 麻醉的；催眠的
words.ex: He took a narcotic for his pain.
words.ex_cn: 他服了一种麻醉药来缓解疼痛。
words.en: A narcotic is a drug that dulls the senses, relieves pain, and induces sleep. It can also refer to something that has a soothing or numbing effect.

words.ex: He used a yardstick to measure the length of the cloth.
words.ex_cn: 他用码尺测量布料的长度。
words.en: A yardstick is a standard used for comparison or measurement.

words.ex: Scientists study neurospora to understand genes.
words.ex_cn: 科学家研究脉孢菌以了解基因。
words.en: Neurospora is a genus of fungi that includes the species Neurospora crassa, widely used in genetic and biochemical research.

words.ex: The doctor checked his pulse with his fingers.
words.ex_cn: 医生用手指检查了他的脉搏。
words.en: A pulse is the regular beating of the heart, especially when it is felt at the wrist or neck. It can also refer to a single vibration or short burst of sound, electric current, light, etc.

words.ex: The fox has a thick pelage for winter.
words.ex_cn: 狐狸冬天有厚厚的皮毛。
words.en: The coat of a mammal, consisting of hair, wool, fur, etc.

words.tr: n. 磨床；磨工；碾磨器械
words.ex: The worker uses a grinder to shape the metal.
words.ex_cn: 工人使用磨床来加工金属。
words.en: A grinder is a machine or tool used for grinding something, such as coffee beans or metal.

words.ex: He gave a thumbs-up with his thumb.
words.ex_cn: 他用大拇指比了个赞。
words.en: The thick short digit on the hand that is opposite to the fingers and can be moved to be opposite any of the other fingers.

words.ex: He plays the flute, a woodwind instrument.
words.ex_cn: 他吹奏长笛，一种木管乐器。
words.en: Woodwind instruments are a family of musical instruments within the more general category of wind instruments. Common examples include flute, clarinet, oboe, bassoon, and saxophone.

words.ex: The eyewitness saw the accident happen.
words.ex_cn: 目击者看到了事故的发生。
words.en: An eyewitness is a person who has seen something happen and can give a first-hand description of it.

words.tr: phrase. 卡片目录（用于图书馆中按卡片索引图书的系统）
words.ex: He found the book using the card catalogue.
words.ex_cn: 他通过卡片目录找到了这本书。
words.en: A card catalogue is a system for organizing information about the books and other materials in a library, consisting of cards with information on them that are arranged in a particular order.

words.tr: n. 神职人员；教士；牧师
words.ex: The clergyman preached to the small church on Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 牧师在星期天向小教堂的会众布道。
words.en: A clergyman is a male priest, minister, or religious leader, especially in the Christian Church.

words.ex: He is an alumnus of Harvard University.
words.ex_cn: 他是哈佛大学的男毕业生。
words.en: An alumnus is a former student of a particular school, college, or university.

words.ex: The butler served tea in the living room.
words.ex_cn: 管家在客厅端上了茶。
words.en: A butler is the most important male servant in a wealthy house.

words.ex: He is studying endocrinology at medical school.
words.ex_cn: 他在医学院学习内分泌学。
words.en: The branch of physiology and medicine concerned with endocrine glands and hormones.

words.ex: Farmers use peat to improve soil quality.
words.ex_cn: 农民用泥炭来改善土壤质量。
words.en: Peat is a brown, soil-like material consisting of partly decomposed vegetable matter forming in wet conditions in bogs and fens, and used for fuel and as a mulch.

words.ex: The rock layer is made of mudstone.
words.ex_cn: 这层岩石是由泥岩组成的。
words.en: A fine-grained sedimentary rock whose original constituents were clays or muds.

words.tr: n. 扭曲；歪曲；失真；畸变；
words.ex: The photo showed distortion in the lines.
words.ex_cn: 这张照片中的线条出现了扭曲。
words.en: A distortion is a change, twist, or exaggeration that makes something appear different from the way it really is.

words.ex: He learned husbandry from his father on the farm.
words.ex_cn: 他从父亲那里学会了畜牧业。
words.en: Husbandry is the careful management of resources, especially in agriculture or farming, to ensure their efficient use and conservation.

words.ex: The priestess led the ancient ritual at the temple.
words.ex_cn: 女祭司在神庙里主持了古代仪式。
words.en: A priestess is a woman who performs religious ceremonies and duties in some religions.

words.ex: She dresses like a goddess on Halloween.
words.ex_cn: 她在万圣节打扮得像一位女神。
words.en: A goddess is a female deity. In many cultures, goddesses are associated with Earth, motherhood, love, and the household.

words.ex: The jury decided the man was innocent.
words.ex_cn: 陪审团裁定这个人无罪。
words.en: A jury is a group of people who are chosen to decide whether someone is guilty or not guilty of a crime in a court of law.

words.ex: The discovery of a gusher revolutionized the local economy.
words.ex_cn: 一口喷油井的发现彻底改变了当地经济。
words.en: A gusher is a well from which oil or water flows out strongly and suddenly without being pumped.

words.ex: After running for an hour, he felt fatigue.
words.ex_cn: 跑了一个小时后，他感到疲乏。
words.en: A feeling of extreme physical or mental tiredness.

words.ex: He gave a fuller explanation than before.
words.ex_cn: 他给出了比之前更充分的解释。
words.en: More complete or containing more information.

words.ex: He paddled a flatboat down the river.
words.ex_cn: 他划着一艘平底船顺流而下。
words.en: A flatboat is a large flat-bottomed boat used, especially in the past, for carrying goods along rivers.

words.ex: The reviewer checked the paper carefully.
words.ex_cn: 审稿人仔细检查了这篇论文。
words.en: A reviewer is a person who writes reviews, especially of books, films, or music.

words.ex: He has high expectancy for the future.
words.ex_cn: 他对未来有很高的预期。
words.en: The feeling of excitement about something that is going to happen.

words.ex: He noticed the discrimination between the two prices.
words.ex_cn: 他注意到了两个价格之间的区别。
words.en: The unjust or prejudicial treatment of different categories of people, especially on the grounds of race, age, or sex.

words.ex: He said a prayer before bed.
words.ex_cn: 他睡前做了一次祈祷。
words.en: A prayer is a form of religious practice in which people communicate with a deity or spirit, often to ask for help or to give thanks.

words.tr: n. 骑士精神；骑士制度；
words.ex: He showed chivalry by helping the lady carry her bags.
words.ex_cn: 他帮助那位女士提包，展现了骑士精神。
words.en: Chivalry is a set of qualities such as bravery, courtesy, honor, and gallantry toward women, associated with the medieval institution of knighthood.

words.ex: The oil derrick stands tall on the desert.
words.ex_cn: 油井架矗立在沙漠上。
words.en: A derrick is a large machine used in the oil industry for drilling wells, consisting of a tall framework over a borehole, used to support the drilling equipment.

words.ex: He picked up a spoon, a common utensil.
words.ex_cn: 他拿起了一把勺子，一种常见的餐具。
words.en: An utensil is a tool that you use in your home, especially in the kitchen, for example, a knife, fork, or spoon.

words.ex: The lab has a new apparatus for measuring temperature.
words.ex_cn: 实验室有一台新的温度测量装置。
words.en: The complex structure of a particular system or organization, or the equipment used for a specific purpose.

words.ex: The apple plummeted from the tree.
words.ex_cn: 苹果从树上垂直落下。
words.en: If an amount, rate, or price plummets, it decreases quickly by a large amount.

words.ex: He signed his name with a clear signature.
words.ex_cn: 他用清晰的签名签了名字。
words.en: A signature is a person's name written in a distinctive way as a form of identification in authorizing a document or letter.

words.ex: The forebrain controls thinking and memory.
words.ex_cn: 前脑控制思考和记忆。
words.en: The forebrain is the anterior part of the brain, including the cerebral hemispheres, the thalamus, and the hypothalamus.

words.tr: n. 一个特殊日子的前夕或前夜
words.ex: The eve of Christmas is very special.
words.ex_cn: 圣诞节前夜非常特别。
words.en: The period of time immediately before an event or occasion, especially the day before a holiday or festival.

words.tr: n. （新法律或体系的）实施；不合理要求；麻烦
words.ex: The tax imposition made life harder for poor families.
words.ex_cn: 征税让贫困家庭的生活更加艰难。
words.en: The act of imposing something, such as a tax, duty, or law, especially in a way that is considered to be unfair or burdensome.

words.ex: He quit his job because of coercion from his boss.
words.ex_cn: 他因为老板的强迫而辞了工作。
words.en: The act of persuading someone to do something by using force or threats.

words.ex: The logger recorded the data every hour.
words.ex_cn: 日志记录器每小时记录一次数据。
words.en: A logger is a person whose job is to cut down trees.

words.ex: He used a crowbar to open the wooden box.
words.ex_cn: 他用撬棍打开了木箱。
words.en: A crowbar is a heavy iron bar with a flattened end, used as a lever.

words.ex: The doctor made a small incision to remove the tumor.
words.ex_cn: 医生做了一个小切口来切除肿瘤。
words.en: An incision is a cut that is made in someone's body during surgery.

words.ex: The leafcutter ants carry leaves to their nest.
words.ex_cn: 切叶蚁把叶子运回巢穴。
words.en: A leafcutter is a type of ant that is known for its unique behavior of cutting leaves to cultivate a fungus that serves as its primary food source.

words.ex: He felt admiration for his teacher's patience.
words.ex_cn: 他对他老师的耐心感到钦佩。
words.en: Admiration is a feeling of great liking and respect for someone or something.

words.ex: Salt water causes corrosion on metal.
words.ex_cn: 盐水会导致金属腐蚀。
words.en: Corrosion is the process in which a metal is gradually destroyed by a chemical reaction, usually with oxygen or water.

words.ex: They share intimacy through quiet talks at night.
words.ex_cn: 他们通过夜晚的安静交谈建立亲密感。
words.en: A close, familiar, and usually affectionate or loving personal relationship with another person or group.

words.ex: The guitarist played a C major chord.
words.ex_cn: 吉他手弹了一个C大和弦。
words.en: A chord is a group of three or more musical notes played together.

words.ex: He was shy during his adolescence.
words.ex_cn: 他在青春期时很害羞。
words.en: Adolescence is the period in a person's life when they develop from a child into an adult.

words.ex: The child's innocence showed in his honest smile.
words.ex_cn: 孩子的无罪体现在他诚实的微笑中。
words.en: the state or quality of being innocent, especially freedom from sin, moral wrong, or guilt through lack of knowledge of evil

words.ex: The country is working on regionalization to improve local services.
words.ex_cn: 该国正在推进区域化以改善地方服务。
words.en: The process of dividing an area into regions or of becoming divided into regions.

words.ex: The dog had distemper and could not play.
words.ex_cn: 这只狗得了犬瘟热，不能玩耍。
words.en: Distemper is a viral disease that affects dogs, causing fever, coughing, and neurological symptoms. It can also refer to a state of disorder or agitation.

words.ex: There is no certainty that it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 明天是否会下雨还没有确定。
words.en: Something that is certain is sure to happen or is definitely true.

words.ex: The factory uses dyestuff to color fabrics.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂使用染料来给织物上色。
words.en: A dyestuff is a substance used to impart color to textiles, paper, leather, and other materials.

words.ex: The coloration of the butterfly's wings is quite striking.
words.ex_cn: 这只蝴蝶翅膀的颜色非常醒目。
words.en: The appearance of something with regard to color.

words.ex: The trainer helped the athlete improve his speed.
words.ex_cn: 训练者帮助运动员提高了他的速度。
words.en: A trainer is someone who teaches skills to people or animals and prepares them for a job, activity, or sport.

words.ex: He is studying anthropology at university.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大学里学习人类学。
words.en: Anthropology is the study of human societies and cultures and their development.

words.ex: The story shows the humanness of the hero.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事展现了英雄的人性。
words.en: The quality or condition of being human; human nature.

words.ex: The boy rides a red tricycle in the park.
words.ex_cn: 男孩在公园里骑一辆红色的三轮车。
words.en: A tricycle is a vehicle with three wheels, especially one for children to ride on.

words.ex: The chromosphere glows red during a solar eclipse.
words.ex_cn: 在日食期间，色球层呈现红色。
words.en: The chromosphere is a layer of the sun's atmosphere, lying just above the photosphere and below the corona. It is primarily composed of hydrogen and is characterized by its reddish color, visible during a total solar eclipse.

words.ex: The farmer sprayed fungicide on the crops.
words.ex_cn: 农民在作物上喷了杀菌剂。
words.en: A fungicide is a chemical that is used to kill or prevent fungi and fungal spores.

words.ex: The children played on the big dune near the sea.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在海边的大沙丘上玩耍。
words.en: A dune is a hill of sand near the sea or in a desert, formed by the wind.

words.ex: The desert is covered with sagebrush.
words.ex_cn: 沙漠上长满了灌木蒿。
words.en: A shrubby plant of the daisy family, Artemisia tridentata, which is native to the arid regions of western North America and is noted for its aromatic foliage and its ability to thrive in poor soils.

words.ex: She picked hawthorn berries from the bush.
words.ex_cn: 她从灌木上摘了山楂果。
words.en: A hawthorn is a type of small tree or shrub that is native to temperate regions of the Northern Hemisphere. It is known for its thorny branches, white or pink flowers, and red berries.

words.ex: The puffin flies over the sea.
words.ex_cn: 海鹦飞过大海。
words.en: A puffin is a seabird with a large, brightly colored beak, found in the North Atlantic and the Arctic Ocean.

words.ex: The tradespeople fixed the pipe quickly.
words.ex_cn: 技工们很快修好了水管。
words.en: People who are skilled in a particular trade, especially those who own and manage a business in that trade.

words.ex: The colonel gave orders to the soldiers.
words.ex_cn: 上校向士兵下达了命令。
words.en: A colonel is a senior officer in the army, air force, or marines, ranking above a lieutenant colonel and below a brigadier or brigadier general.

words.ex: He scooped soup with a spoon.
words.ex_cn: 他用勺子舀汤。
words.en: A scoop is a tool like a large spoon which is used for picking up substances such as ice cream or an amount of a substance that is held in a scoop. It can also refer to an important or exciting news story that is reported in a newspaper, magazine, or news broadcast before anyone else reports it.

words.ex: There is a paucity of water in the desert.
words.ex_cn: 沙漠里水很少。
words.en: If you say that there is a paucity of something, you mean that there is not enough of it.

words.ex: The minority group voted for change.
words.ex_cn: 少数群体投票支持变革。
words.en: A minority is a group of people within a community or country who are different from the majority of the people there in race, religion, or political beliefs.

words.ex: He uses photogrammetry to map the old building.
words.ex_cn: 他使用摄影测量法来绘制这座老建筑的地图。
words.en: Photogrammetry is the science of making measurements from photographs, especially for recovering the exact positions of surface points.

words.ex: Arsenic is a poisonous element found in some water.
words.ex_cn: 砷是一种存在于某些水源中的有毒元素。
words.en: A very poisonous metallic element that has three allotropic forms; arsenic and arsenic compounds are used as herbicides and insecticides and various alloys; found in arsenopyrite and orpiment and realgar

words.tr: adj. 深红色的；绯红色的；
words.ex: The sky turned crimson at sunset.
words.ex_cn: 日落时，天空变成了深红色。
words.en: A deep red color that is slightly purplish, often associated with blood or a blush.

words.ex: The spy used infiltration to get into the building.
words.ex_cn: 间谍通过渗透进入了那栋大楼。
words.en: The process of secretly entering or gaining access to an organization, place, etc., especially in order to acquire secret information or cause damage.

words.ex: The survivorship of the species depends on its ability to adapt.
words.ex_cn: 该物种的生存取决于其适应能力。
words.en: Survivorship refers to the state or condition of being a survivor, especially in a legal context where it pertains to the rights or status of a survivor.

words.ex: The viability of the new business depends on customer demand.
words.ex_cn: 这个新企业的生存能力取决于客户需求。
words.en: The capacity of something to maintain its existence or to be successful.

words.ex: His lifeway includes early rising and daily exercise.
words.ex_cn: 他的生活方式包括早起和每天锻炼。
words.en: A way of life; the customs, practices, and habits that define the daily existence of an individual or group.

words.ex: Fertilization happens when the sperm meets the egg.
words.ex_cn: 当精子与卵子结合时，受精就发生了。
words.en: The process by which male and female gametes (sperm and egg) fuse to initiate the development of a new individual organism.

words.ex: He joined a crusade for clean water.
words.ex_cn: 他参加了一场为清洁用水而发起的运动。
words.en: A crusade is a long and determined attempt to achieve something that you strongly believe in, especially to bring about social or political change.

words.tr: n. （建筑物的）石制部份；石雕工艺
words.ex: The old church has beautiful stonework on its walls.
words.ex_cn: 这座古老的教堂墙壁上有精美的石雕。
words.en: Stonework refers to the parts of a building that are made of stone, or the work of cutting and shaping stone for building.

words.ex: He paints on canvas with gesso.
words.ex_cn: 他用石膏底料在画布上绘画。
words.en: A white preparation of plaster of Paris or whiting in glue, used in painting or sculpture as a base for tempera or oil painting or as a surface for gilding or painting on.

words.ex: The coal deposits in this region are from the Carboniferous period.
words.ex_cn: 这个地区的煤炭沉积来自石炭纪。
words.en: Relating to or denoting the fifth period of the Paleozoic era, between the Devonian and Permian periods, or the system of rocks deposited during it.

words.ex: The experimenter recorded the results carefully.
words.ex_cn: 实验者仔细记录了结果。
words.en: A person who conducts experiments, especially in a scientific context.

words.ex: The teacher gave a demonstration of how to solve the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 老师演示了如何解这道数学题。
words.en: A demonstration is a public meeting or march in which people show their opposition to something or their support for something.

words.tr: n. 全体市民；公民；市民
words.ex: The citizenry voted for new leaders.
words.ex_cn: 市民们投票选举了新领导人。
words.en: The citizenry refers to the body of citizens of a state or country.

words.ex: The car stopped at the tollgate to pay money.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在收费站停下来付钱。
words.en: A tollgate is a barrier across a road where drivers have to stop and pay a toll before they can continue their journey.

words.ex: The cloth shows shrinkage after washing.
words.ex_cn: 这块布在洗涤后出现了缩水。
words.en: The process, fact, or amount of shrinking.

words.tr:
n. 哑剧；（英）圣诞童话剧
v. 打手势；演哑剧
words.ex: The children laughed at the clown's pantomime.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们笑了，因为小丑的哑剧表演。
words.en: Pantomime is a type of entertainment where performers express a story or represent characters through gestures and body movements without using speech.

words.ex: He is the beneficiary of his father's will.
words.ex_cn: 他是他父亲遗嘱的受益人。
words.en: A beneficiary is someone who receives money or other benefits as a result of something, especially a will or insurance policy.

words.ex: He needs authorization to enter the room.
words.ex_cn: 他需要获得授权才能进入房间。
words.en: Authorization is the act of giving someone the power or right to do something.

words.ex: He wrote an epistle to his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他给朋友写了一封信。
words.en: A letter, especially a long, formal one.

words.ex: The desert has tall saguaro cacti.
words.ex_cn: 沙漠里有高大的仙人掌。
words.en: A saguaro is a large cactus that grows in the deserts of the southwestern United States and Mexico.

words.tr:
n. 树液；
v. 使逐渐耗竭；使削弱；
words.ex: The tree releases sap in spring.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树在春天流出树液。
words.en: Sap is the watery fluid that circulates in the vascular system of a plant, carrying nutrients and sugars. It can also refer to the vitality or energy of a person or thing.

words.tr:
n. 水滴
v. 滴落
words.ex: The tap is dripping slowly.
words.ex_cn: 水龙头在慢慢滴水。
words.en: If a liquid drips, it falls in small drops. A drip is also a small amount of liquid that falls in this way.

words.ex: Drinking water helps with hydration.
words.ex_cn: 喝水有助于水合。
words.en: The process of causing something to absorb water.

words.ex: The town uses hydropower to make electricity.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇用水力发电来产生电力。
words.en: Hydropower is the power generated by the force of moving water, used as a source of electricity.

words.ex: The faucet is dripping.
words.ex_cn: 水龙头在滴水。
words.en: A faucet is a device that controls the flow of a liquid or gas from a pipe or container, especially one that you turn to start or stop the flow of water.

words.ex: He showed deference to his teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他对老师表示尊敬。
words.en: Deference is a polite and respectful attitude towards someone, often because they are older or more experienced than you.

words.ex: He ate a small mors of food.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一小口食物。
words.en: Death, especially as a personified force.

words.tr: n. 寻求者；追求者；搜索者
words.ex: The seeker found a hidden path in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 这位寻找者在森林里发现了一条隐蔽的小路。
words.en: Someone who is trying to find or obtain something.

words.tr: n. 岩屑；碎石；沙砾；风化物；残余物
words.ex: The garden is full of dry leaves and detritus.
words.ex_cn: 花园里到处都是枯叶和碎屑。
words.en: Detritus refers to the debris or waste material that results from the disintegration or wearing away of something, such as rock or organic matter.

words.ex: The spoilage of milk happens when it is left out too long.
words.ex_cn: 牛奶放太久就会腐败。
words.en: The process of becoming spoiled, especially the decay or decomposition of food.

words.ex: He pressed the pedal to speed up the bike.
words.ex_cn: 他踩下踏板让自行车加速。
words.en: A pedal is a lever that you press with your foot in order to control a vehicle or machine.

words.tr: n. 探测器；检测器；发现者；
words.ex: The detector found a hidden metal object.
words.ex_cn: 探测器发现了一个隐藏的金属物体。
words.en: A detector is a device that is used to discover the presence of something, such as smoke, metal, or radiation.

words.ex: The wood undergoes carbonization when heated without air.
words.ex_cn: 木材在无空气条件下加热时会碳化。
words.en: The process of converting organic substances into carbon or a carbon-containing residue through pyrolysis or destructive distillation.

words.ex: The gannet dives into the sea to catch fish.
words.ex_cn: 鸬鹚 dive 进海里抓鱼。
words.en: A gannet is a large seabird that is known for its spectacular diving into the sea to catch fish.

words.ex: He brushed his teeth to protect the enamel.
words.ex_cn: 他刷牙以保护牙釉质。
words.en: A hard, glossy substance that is applied to metal, glass, or pottery for decoration or protection.

words.ex: The cell has a glycoprotein on its surface.
words.ex_cn: 这个细胞表面有一种糖蛋白。
words.en: A glycoprotein is a protein that has carbohydrate groups attached to the polypeptide chain.

words.ex: The dog has a tapeworm in its stomach.
words.ex_cn: 这只狗的胃里有绦虫。
words.en: A tapeworm is a long, flat worm that lives in the intestines of humans and animals.

words.tr: n. 令人讨厌的或繁重的工作；
words.ex: Washing dishes is a boring chore.
words.ex_cn: 洗碗是一件烦人的琐事。
words.en: A chore is a task or piece of work that is often boring or unpleasant but needs to be done regularly.

words.tr: n. 增强；改善；增加；增进；
words.ex: The new software brings an enhancement to the system.
words.ex_cn: 新软件带来了系统的增强。
words.en: An enhancement is an improvement or addition that makes something better or more effective.

words.ex: They found paradise on a small island.
words.ex_cn: 他们在一个小岛上找到了天堂。
words.en: Paradise is a place of ideal beauty or loveliness, or a state of supreme happiness.

words.ex: Scientists work at the observatory to study stars.
words.ex_cn: 科学家在天文台工作以研究恒星。
words.en: A building or place equipped for observation of natural phenomena (as in astronomy); also : an institution whose primary purpose is making such observations.

words.ex: He has a streak of kindness that makes everyone like him.
words.ex_cn: 他有一种善良的性情，让每个人都喜欢他。
words.en: A streak is a long thin mark that is a different colour from the surfaces next to it. It can also refer to a period of time during which a particular kind of behaviour or activity is consistently shown.

words.ex: Two countries signed a treaty to stop the war.
words.ex_cn: 两个国家签署了一项条约以停止战争。
words.en: A treaty is a formal agreement between two or more countries or groups, especially one that is written down and signed by their leaders.

words.ex: The baby cried until she gave him the pacifier.
words.ex_cn: 宝宝哭了，直到她给了他安抚奶嘴。
words.en: A pacifier is an object that a baby sucks on to calm down or stop crying.

words.tr: n. 调整器；调节器；监管者
words.ex: The regulator controls the water pressure in the pipe.
words.ex_cn: 这个调整器控制管道中的水压。
words.en: A regulator is a person or organization appointed by a government to regulate an area of activity such as banking or industry.

words.ex: This project is a springboard for his future career.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目是他未来职业的出发点。
words.en: A springboard is a flexible board from which someone may jump into water or onto a mat in gymnastics. It can also refer to something that provides an opportunity to achieve something.

words.ex: The teacher gave a dictation of five sentences.
words.ex_cn: 老师进行了一次五句话的听写。
words.en: Dictation is the speaking or reading aloud of words for someone else to write down.

words.tr:
n. 同辈；同等的人；
v. 凝视；
words.ex: He feels comfortable talking to his peers.
words.ex_cn: 他觉得和同辈交谈很自在。
words.en: A peer is someone who is equal to another in abilities, qualifications, age, background, or social status. As a verb, to peer means to look keenly or with difficulty at someone or something.

words.ex: Scientists use a synchrotron to study tiny particles.
words.ex_cn: 科学家使用同步加速器来研究微小粒子。
words.en: A synchrotron is a type of particle accelerator that accelerates charged particles to very high speeds and keeps them moving in a circular path using magnetic fields and electric fields.

words.ex: The two countries formed a confederate alliance to defend their borders.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家结成了同盟联盟以保卫它们的边界。
words.en: A confederate is someone who works with others to achieve a common goal, often in a political or military context. It can also refer to a member of a confederation, which is a union of states or groups united for a common purpose.

words.ex: The synonym of 'happy' is 'glad'.
words.ex_cn: ‘happy’的同义词是‘glad’。
words.en: A synonym is a word or phrase that means exactly or nearly the same as another word or phrase in the same language.

words.ex: The batter bunt the ball softly to reach first base.
words.ex_cn: 击球手轻击球，以到达一垒。
words.en: To bunt means to push or touch something gently with the head or horns, especially in the context of animals. It can also refer to a gentle push or nudge in a more general sense.

words.ex: He had a setback when he failed the test.
words.ex_cn: 他考试没及格，遇到了挫折。
words.en: A setback is an event that delays your progress or reverses some of the progress that you have made.

words.tr:
n. （驼）峰；驼背；小土丘
v. 背负（重物）；弓起
words.ex: The camel has a big hump on its back.
words.ex_cn: 骆驼的背上有一个大驼峰。
words.en: A hump is a rounded protuberance or bulge, especially on the back of a camel or other animal, or on a person's back. As a verb, it means to form into a hump or to carry something with difficulty.

words.ex: The ostrich runs very fast on the grassland.
words.ex_cn: 鸵鸟在草原上跑得很快。
words.en: An ostrich is a large African bird that cannot fly and has long legs and a long neck.

words.ex: The surgeon fixed the broken bone.
words.ex_cn: 外科医生修复了断裂的骨头。
words.en: A surgeon is a medical doctor who performs operations.

words.ex: The wood underwent permineralization over millions of years.
words.ex_cn: 木材在数百万年中经历了矿化作用。
words.en: Permineralization is a process of fossilization where minerals carried by water fill the pores and cavities of an organism, leading to the formation of a fossil.

words.tr: n. 作秀的人；表演者（家）
words.ex: The showman made the crowd laugh with his tricks.
words.ex_cn: 这位表演者用他的魔术让观众笑了。
words.en: A showman is a man who is skilled at entertaining people, especially by performing or presenting things in an attractive and exciting way.

words.ex: The net is made of a fine mesh.
words.ex_cn: 这个网是由细密的网状物制成的。
words.en: A mesh is a material made of a network of wire or thread to catch or hold things, or to allow things to pass through it.

words.ex: The subtlety of her smile made everyone curious.
words.ex_cn: 她微笑的微妙之处让所有人都感到好奇。
words.en: The quality of being subtle, especially in a way that is difficult to notice or understand.

words.ex: The microbe causes sickness.
words.ex_cn: 这种微生物会引起疾病。
words.en: A microbe is a very small living thing, which you can only see if you use a microscope. Some microbes can cause diseases.

words.ex: The scientist found a microfossil in the rock.
words.ex_cn: 科学家在岩石中发现了一种微体化石。
words.en: A microfossil is a very small fossil, typically one that is less than a millimeter in size and can only be seen with a microscope. Microfossils are used by scientists to study the history of life on Earth, including ancient climates and environments.

words.ex: The weft threads run horizontally in the fabric.
words.ex_cn: 纬线在织物中水平排列。
words.en: The weft is the threads that run horizontally across the loom in weaving, interlaced with the warp.

words.ex: He filed a grievance about the unfair treatment.
words.ex_cn: 他因不公平的对待提出了不满。
words.en: A grievance is a feeling of resentment over something believed to be wrong or unfair.

words.ex: He checked the thermometer to see the temperature.
words.ex_cn: 他看了温度计来查看温度。
words.en: A thermometer is an instrument for measuring and indicating temperature.

words.ex: The literalness of his words made me confused.
words.ex_cn: 他话语的字面意思让我感到困惑。
words.en: The quality or state of being literal; adherence to the explicit meaning of a text or words.

words.ex: The priest used the catechism to teach the children about the faith.
words.ex_cn: 牧师使用教义问答书来教导孩子们关于信仰的知识。
words.en: A catechism is a summary of the principles of Christian religion in the form of questions and answers, used for the instruction of Christians.

words.ex: The car has a turbo to go faster.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车有一个涡轮增压器来开得更快。
words.en: A turbo is a device that increases the power of an engine by forcing extra air into the combustion chamber.

words.ex: The river suffered from contamination after the factory dumped waste.
words.ex_cn: 工厂倾倒废物后，这条河受到了污染。
words.en: The process of making something dirty or polluted, or the state of being dirty or polluted.

words.ex: The children are playing on the rooftop.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们正在屋顶上玩耍。
words.en: The top covering of a building, including the material or construction of which it is made.

words.tr: n. 编舞艺术；舞蹈编排；
words.ex: The dancer praised the choreography of the ballet.
words.ex_cn: 这位舞者称赞了这部芭蕾舞的编舞艺术。
words.en: Choreography is the art of designing sequences of movements in which motion, form, or both are specified. Choreography may also refer to the design itself. A choreographer is one who creates choreographies by practicing the art of choreography.

words.tr: n. 误解；误会； v. “misunderstand”的现在分词；
words.ex: There was a misunderstanding between them about the time.
words.ex_cn: 他们之间对时间产生了误解。
words.en: A misunderstanding is a failure to understand something correctly, often leading to confusion or disagreement.

words.ex: The car drove slowly through the fog.
words.ex_cn: 汽车缓缓驶过浓雾。
words.en: Fog is a thick cloud of tiny water droplets suspended in the atmosphere at or near the earth's surface which obscures or restricts visibility (to a greater extent than mist; strictly, reducing visibility to below 1 km).

words.ex: Her smile has a special charm.
words.ex_cn: 她的微笑有一种特别的魅力。
words.en: If you say that someone has charm, you mean that they behave in a friendly and pleasant way that makes people like them. A charm is also a small ornament that is fixed to a bracelet or necklace.

words.ex: The hornbill flies high above the forest.
words.ex_cn: 犀鸟在森林上方高高飞翔。
words.en: A hornbill is a tropical bird known for its large, often brightly colored bill, which is sometimes topped with a casque. Hornbills are found in Africa, Asia, and Melanesia, and they are notable for their unique nesting behavior, where the female seals herself inside a tree cavity with mud, leaving only a small slit through which the male passes food.

words.ex: The rhinoceros walks slowly in the grass.
words.ex_cn: 犀牛在草地上慢慢行走。
words.en: A rhinoceros is a large, thick-skinned animal with one or two horns on its nose, native to Africa and southern Asia.

words.ex: He plays cricket every weekend with his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末都和朋友们打板球。
words.en: Cricket is a sport played between two teams of eleven players each, using a bat and ball, on a field with a wicket at each end.

words.tr: n. 要洗的衣物；洗衣店；
words.ex: I put the dirty laundry in the washing machine.
words.ex_cn: 我把脏衣服放进洗衣机里。
words.en: Laundry refers to the clothes and linens that need to be washed or that have just been washed. It can also refer to the place or business where clothes and linens are washed and ironed.

words.ex: The dog bit with its mandible.
words.ex_cn: 狗用下颌咬了。
words.en: The mandible is the lower jawbone in vertebrates.

words.tr:
adj. 先锋的；前卫的
n. 先锋派；前卫
words.ex: The artist uses avant-garde styles in her paintings.
words.ex_cn: 这位艺术家在她的画作中使用前卫的风格。
words.en: Avant-garde is used to describe people or works that are experimental or innovative, particularly in the arts.

words.tr: v. 完成；“do”的过去分词； adj. 已完成的；
words.ex: I done my homework.
words.ex_cn: 我完成了我的作业。
words.en: If something is done, it has been completed or finished.

words.ex: He uses microscopy to see tiny bacteria.
words.ex_cn: 他使用显微镜技术来观察微小的细菌。
words.en: Microscopy is the technical field of using microscopes to view objects and areas of objects that cannot be seen with the naked eye.

words.ex: His devotion to his family is obvious.
words.ex_cn: 他对家庭的献身显而易见。
words.en: Devotion is great love, affection, or admiration for someone or something.

words.ex: The equation is easy to solve.
words.ex_cn: 这个方程式很容易解。
words.en: An equation is a mathematical statement that asserts the equality of two expressions.

words.ex: I met him at a party, but he is only an acquaintance.
words.ex_cn: 我在聚会上认识了他，但他只是个熟人。
words.en: An acquaintance is someone you know a little, who is not a close friend.

words.ex: The ancient Egyptians used hieroglyph to write messages.
words.ex_cn: 古埃及人用象形文字来书写信息。
words.en: A hieroglyph is a character of the ancient Egyptian writing system, which consists of pictures or symbols representing words or sounds.

words.tr: n. 象牙；象牙色 adj. 象牙色的
words.ex: The old piano has ivory keys.
words.ex_cn: 这架旧钢琴有象牙键。
words.en: Ivory is a hard, white material from the tusks and teeth of animals, which is used to make or decorate objects.

words.ex: The dove is an emblem of peace.
words.ex_cn: 鸽子是和平的象征。
words.en: An emblem is a design that represents a country, organization, or family.

words.ex: A small flotilla sailed across the bay.
words.ex_cn: 一支小型船队驶过了海湾。
words.en: A flotilla is a group of small ships, especially military ships.

words.ex: The medicine comes in small granules.
words.ex_cn: 这种药是小颗粒状的。
words.en: A granule is a small compact particle of a substance.

words.tr: n. 小片；小部分；零星片段
words.ex: He shared a snippet of his new song.
words.ex_cn: 他分享了他新歌的一小段。
words.en: A snippet is a small piece of something, especially a piece of information or a short extract from a piece of writing or music.

words.ex: She shook the tambourine to the rhythm of the music.
words.ex_cn: 她随着音乐的节奏摇动手鼓。
words.en: A tambourine is a musical instrument which you shake or hit with your hand. It consists of a drum skin on a circular frame with pairs of small round pieces of metal all around the edge.

words.ex: A small branchlet grew from the tree.
words.ex_cn: 一棵小枝条从树上长了出来。
words.en: A small branch or subdivision of a branch.

words.ex: The kinglet sings loudly in the tree.
words.ex_cn: 小王鸟在树上大声歌唱。
words.en: A kinglet is a small bird, especially a member of the genus Regulus, known for its tiny size and active behavior. It can also refer to a minor or petty king.

words.tr:
n. 污点；小斑；蝇粪留下的污点
v. 弄脏
words.ex: A flyspeck on the window barely caught his eye.
words.ex_cn: 窗户上的一点蝇屎几乎没引起他的注意。
words.en: A flyspeck is a tiny spot or stain, especially one made by a fly.

words.ex: The rain washed soil into the gully.
words.ex_cn: 雨水把泥土冲进了沟渠。
words.en: A gully is a long, narrow valley with steep sides that is formed by the action of water.

words.ex: The miniaturization of phones makes them easier to carry.
words.ex_cn: 手机的小型化使它们更容易携带。
words.en: The process of making something much smaller than its original size, especially in the context of technology and electronics.

words.ex: The teachers use correctors to fix spelling mistakes.
words.ex_cn: 老师们使用修正工具来纠正拼写错误。
words.en: A corrector is someone or something that corrects, especially a person who proofreads and corrects errors in text.

words.tr: n. 忠诚支持者；拥护现政权者
words.ex: The loyalist supported the king during the war.
words.ex_cn: 这位保皇派在战争期间支持国王。
words.en: A loyalist is someone who remains loyal to the established ruler or government, especially in the face of a revolt.

words.ex: The mother grooms her puppy every morning.
words.ex_cn: 妈妈每天早上给她的小狗梳理毛发。
words.en: A groom is a man who is getting married. Also, to groom means to clean and brush an animal, or to prepare someone for a particular job or position.

words.ex: The journalist wrote a story about the earthquake.
words.ex_cn: 记者写了一篇关于地震的文章。
words.en: A journalist is a person whose job is to collect news and write about it for newspapers, magazines, television, or radio.

words.tr: n. 星盘（古代星位观侧仪）
words.ex: Ancient sailors used an astrolabe to find their position.
words.ex_cn: 古代的水手用星盘来确定他们的位置。
words.en: An astrolabe is an ancient astronomical instrument that was used to make measurements in the sky, such as the altitudes of celestial bodies. It was a key tool for astronomers and navigators before the invention of the sextant.

words.tr: n. 补缀的性质；斑状性
words.ex: The patchiness of the paint made the wall look uneven.
words.ex_cn: 油漆的补缀性质让墙壁看起来不平整。
words.en: The quality or state of being patchy; inconsistency or lack of uniformity.

words.ex: The narration of the story was very clear.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事的叙述非常清晰。
words.en: The act or process of telling a story or describing a series of events.

words.ex: The drug blocks angiotensin to lower blood pressure.
words.ex_cn: 这种药物通过阻断血管紧张素来降低血压。
words.en: A peptide hormone that causes blood vessels to constrict, leading to increased blood pressure.

words.ex: He had a pulmonary embolism after surgery.
words.ex_cn: 他手术后发生了肺栓塞。
words.en: An embolism is a blockage in a blood vessel caused by a blood clot or other foreign material that gets stuck while traveling through the bloodstream.

words.ex: He traced his lineage back to ancient kings.
words.ex_cn: 他追溯了自己的家系到古代的国王。
words.en: Your lineage is the series of families from which you are directly descended.

words.ex: They felt a strong kinship because they grew up in the same village.
words.ex_cn: 他们因为从小在同一个村庄长大，感到有很强的亲属关系。
words.en: Kinship is the relationship between members of the same family.

words.ex: Gold has high malleability and can be shaped easily.
words.ex_cn: 金具有很高的延展性，容易塑形。
words.en: Malleability is the quality of something that can be shaped or stretched without breaking, especially referring to metals.

words.tr:
n. 盐水；卤水；咸水；海水
v. 用盐水处理
words.ex: She put the fish in brine to preserve it.
words.ex_cn: 她把鱼放在盐水中腌制以保存它。
words.en: Brine is water that contains a high concentration of salt, used especially for preserving food.

words.ex: The butterfly has a small eyespot on its wing.
words.ex_cn: 这只蝴蝶的翅膀上有一个小眼斑。
words.en: An eyespot is a light-sensitive organelle found in some unicellular organisms and in the cells of some multicellular animals, functioning to detect light intensity and direction.

words.ex: They had a feast on New Year's Day.
words.ex_cn: 他们在元旦举办了一场盛宴。
words.en: A feast is a large and special meal, often to celebrate something.

words.tr:
n. 谣言
v. 谣传
words.ex: The rumor spread quickly that the school would close.
words.ex_cn: 学校即将关闭的谣言迅速传播开来。
words.en: A rumor is a story or piece of information that may or may not be true, but that people are talking about.

words.ex: The bison walks slowly across the grassland.
words.ex_cn: 野牛慢慢地走过草原。
words.en: A bison is a large, wild animal that is related to the cow and is native to North America and Europe. Bison have a large head, a humped back, and are covered with thick, shaggy hair.

words.ex: The ibex climbs steep rocks in the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 羱羊在山中攀爬陡峭的岩石。
words.en: An ibex is a type of wild goat with large, backward-curving horns, found in the mountains of Europe, Asia, and northeastern Africa.

words.ex: They are monogamous and have been married for 20 years.
words.ex_cn: 他们是专一的，已经结婚20年了。
words.en: Being monogamous means having only one sexual partner at a time.

words.ex: Carbon monoxide is a dangerous gas.
words.ex_cn: 一氧化碳是一种危险的气体。
words.en: A compound containing one atom of oxygen combined with one atom of another element.

words.ex: She bought a new garment for the party.
words.ex_cn: 她为派对买了一件新衣服。
words.en: A garment is a piece of clothing; used especially in contexts where you are talking about the manufacture or sale of clothes.

words.ex: He fixed his collar before the interview.
words.ex_cn: 他在面试前整理了衣领。
words.en: The part of a piece of clothing that fits around the neck and is usually folded over; a band of material around the neck of an animal.

words.ex: The pancreas makes insulin to control blood sugar.
words.ex_cn: 胰腺分泌胰岛素来控制血糖。
words.en: The pancreas is a large gland behind the stomach which secretes digestive enzymes into the duodenum. Embedded in the pancreas are the islets of Langerhans, which secrete into the blood the hormones insulin and glucagon.

words.ex: He inherited his family's heritage.
words.ex_cn: 他继承了家族的遗产。
words.en: Heritage refers to the traditions, achievements, beliefs, etc., that are part of the history of a group or nation.

words.ex: He throws the boule to win the game.
words.ex_cn: 他投出滚石以赢得比赛。
words.en: A boule is a round loaf of bread, traditionally French. It can also refer to a spherical object.

words.tr: v. 孵出；出壳；“hatch”的现在分词；
words.ex: The eggs are hatching after three weeks.
words.ex_cn: 这些蛋在三周后孵出了。
words.en: The process by which eggs are hatched; the emergence of young from eggs.

words.tr: n. 隐士；隐居者；遁世者
words.ex: The hermit lives alone in a small cave.
words.ex_cn: 这位隐士独自住在一个小山洞里。
words.en: A hermit is someone who lives alone and apart from society, often for religious reasons.

words.ex: The farm has an acreage of 50 acres.
words.ex_cn: 这个农场的土地面积是50英亩。
words.en: Acreage is the area of land measured in acres.

words.ex: The child showed signs of talent in infancy.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子在婴儿期就表现出天赋。
words.en: The earliest period of childhood, especially before the ability to walk has been acquired.

words.ex: The computer needs new hardware to run faster.
words.ex_cn: 这台电脑需要新的硬件来运行得更快。
words.en: In computing, hardware refers to the physical parts of a computer and related devices. In general, hardware can be any equipment, especially tools, used for a particular purpose.

words.ex: He put the milk in a carton.
words.ex_cn: 他把牛奶倒进了硬纸盒里。
words.en: A carton is a box or container usually made of cardboard or plastic, used for holding goods.

words.tr: n. 阐述者；拥护者；代表者；指数
words.ex: He is the exponent of modern education reform.
words.ex_cn: 他是现代教育改革的阐述者。
words.en: An exponent is someone who supports and explains a particular idea, theory, or system, or a symbol that shows how many times a number is to be multiplied by itself.

words.tr: n. 极漫长的时期；永世；千万年
words.ex: This rock has been here for an eon.
words.ex_cn: 这块岩石已经在这里存在了亿万年。
words.en: An eon is an extremely long period of time.

words.tr:
v. 摘；拔；猛拉；拨弹
n. 胆识；胆量；快而猛地拉
words.ex: He plucked a flower from the garden.
words.ex_cn: 他从花园里摘了一朵花。
words.en: To pluck means to pull something quickly to remove it or to play a musical instrument by pulling the strings with your fingers. As a noun, it refers to the quality of being brave and determined.

words.ex: He hurled the ball across the field.
words.ex_cn: 他猛地把球投过球场。
words.en: To throw something with great force; to shout something loudly.

words.ex: The preponderance of evidence shows he is guilty.
words.ex_cn: 大多数证据表明他有罪。
words.en: If there is a preponderance of one type of thing or person in a group, there are more of that type than of any other.

words.ex: The teacher gave precedence to students who arrived early.
words.ex_cn: 老师给早到的学生优先权。
words.en: If one thing takes precedence over another, it is regarded as more important than the other thing and is dealt with first.

words.ex: The postmaster delivered the letter yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 邮局局长昨天送来了这封信。
words.en: A postmaster is the person in charge of a post office, responsible for its operation and the management of its staff.

words.ex: The fish contains healthy lipid.
words.ex_cn: 这种鱼含有健康的脂质。
words.en: Lipids are a broad group of naturally occurring molecules which include fats, waxes, sterols, fat-soluble vitamins, monoglycerides, diglycerides, triglycerides, and phospholipids. The main biological functions of lipids include storing energy, signaling, and acting as structural components of cell membranes.

words.ex: His dog gave him constant companionship.
words.ex_cn: 他的狗给了他不断的陪伴。
words.en: the state of being with someone or having someone to spend time with

words.tr: n. 伙伴关系；情谊；团体；联谊会；研究生奖学金
words.ex: They formed a fellowship to work on the project together.
words.ex_cn: 他们建立了伙伴关系一起来做这个项目。
words.en: A fellowship is a group of people who join together for a common purpose or interest, or a financial grant given to a scholar to allow them to study or research at an advanced level.

words.ex: The angularity of the sculpture gave it a modern feel.
words.ex_cn: 雕塑的棱角分明赋予了它一种现代感。
words.en: The quality of having angles or sharp corners; the state of being angular.

words.ex: The validity of the test results is important.
words.ex_cn: 测试结果的有效性很重要。
words.en: The quality of being logically or factually sound; soundness or cogency.

words.ex: The usefulness of this tool helps us finish work faster.
words.ex_cn: 这个工具的有用性帮助我们更快地完成工作。
words.en: The quality or state of being useful.

words.ex: He accepted the job because of the financial inducement.
words.ex_cn: 他因为经济诱因接受了这份工作。
words.en: Something that is offered to someone to persuade them to do something.

words.ex: The fishery near the coast provides fresh seafood.
words.ex_cn: 沿海的渔场提供新鲜海产。
words.en: A fishery is an area where fish are caught for commercial purposes, or the industry of catching and selling fish.

words.ex: He wrote the letter with a quill.
words.ex_cn: 他用翎管写了这封信。
words.en: A quill is a pen made from a bird's feather, used in the past for writing with ink.

words.ex: His intonation made the sentence sound friendly.
words.ex_cn: 他的语调让这句话听起来很友好。
words.en: Intonation is the way the voice rises and falls in speech, especially the pitch pattern in a sentence.

words.ex: He grows maize on his farm.
words.ex_cn: 他在农场种植玉米。
words.en: Maize is a tall plant which produces long objects covered with yellow seeds called sweetcorn. It is often grown as a food crop.

words.tr:
n. 东西；原料；
v. 塞；填充；
words.ex: I need to clean up all this stuff.
words.ex_cn: 我需要清理这些东西。
words.en: If you stuff something somewhere, you push it there quickly and roughly. If you stuff a container or space with something, you fill it completely with that thing.

words.ex: The protozoan moves in water with tiny hairs.
words.ex_cn: 这个原生动物用细小的毛发在水中移动。
words.en: A protozoan is a single-celled organism that is considered to be an animal, typically microscopic and found in water.

words.tr: n. 原始细胞； 始原细胞； 原细胞
words.ex: Archaeocytes are primitive cells found in certain microorganisms.
words.ex_cn: 原细胞是在某些微生物中发现的原始细胞。
words.en: An archaeocyte is a type of cell found in sponges that is capable of transforming into other types of cells and plays a key role in the sponge's regeneration process.

words.ex: Honesty is the main tenet of his life.
words.ex_cn: 诚实是他生活的宗旨。
words.en: A tenet is a principle or belief, especially one that is part of a larger system of beliefs.

words.ex: The children set up a teepee in the backyard for their camping adventure.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在后院搭起了一个圆锥形帐篷，准备他们的露营冒险。
words.en: A teepee is a tent in the shape of a cone, traditionally used by Native Americans.

words.ex: He did it for her sake.
words.ex_cn: 他为了她的缘故做了这件事。
words.en: If you do something for the sake of something, you do it for that purpose or in order to achieve that result. You can also say that you do it for something's sake.

words.ex: The ape climbed slowly up the tree.
words.ex_cn: 这只猿慢慢爬上了树。
words.en: An ape is a large primate that does not have a tail, for example a chimpanzee or gorilla.

words.tr: n. 先见；预见；先见之明
words.ex: He showed foresight by saving money for the future.
words.ex_cn: 他通过为未来存钱展现了远见。
words.en: The ability to predict or the action of predicting what will happen or be needed in the future.

words.ex: He is an academician at the national academy.
words.ex_cn: 他是国家科学院的院士。
words.en: An academician is a member of an academy, especially of an academy of arts or sciences.

words.ex: The budget is a constraint on our project.
words.ex_cn: 预算是我们项目的限制。
words.en: A constraint is something that limits or controls what you can do.

words.tr:
v. 使有杂色；使斑驳
n. 斑点；杂色；斑驳
words.ex: The leaves mottle with brown spots in autumn.
words.ex_cn: 秋天时，树叶上出现了褐色斑点。
words.en: To mark with spots or blotches of different shades or colors.

words.ex: He learned multiplication in second grade.
words.ex_cn: 他在二年级学习了乘法。
words.en: Multiplication is the process of calculating the total of one number multiplied by another.

words.ex: The temperature increases by one increment every hour.
words.ex_cn: 温度每小时增加一个单位。
words.en: An increment is an amount by which something increases or is increased.

words.tr: n. 印花大围巾；鲜艳的大头巾
words.ex: He wears a red bandanna on his head.
words.ex_cn: 他头上戴着一条红色的头巾。
words.en: A bandanna is a large, usually colorful handkerchief, typically with a pattern, worn tied around the head or neck.

words.ex: The creditor asked for the money back.
words.ex_cn: 债权人要求把钱还回来。
words.en: A creditor is a person or organization to whom money is owed.

words.ex: The debtor paid back the money last week.
words.ex_cn: 债务人上周还了钱。
words.en: A debtor is a person, organization, or country that owes money.

words.ex: A myxoma is a type of benign tumor that arises from the connective tissues.
words.ex_cn: 粘液瘤是一种起源于结缔组织的良性肿瘤。
words.en: A myxoma is a benign tumor of connective tissue that contains mucous or gelatinous material.

words.ex: The occupant of the room is sleeping.
words.ex_cn: 房间里的住户正在睡觉。
words.en: An occupant is someone who lives in or uses a particular room, building, or area of land.

words.ex: The battleship was a formidable presence in the naval fleet.
words.ex_cn: 这艘战舰在海军舰队中是一个强大的存在。
words.en: A battleship is a large, heavily armored warship with a main battery consisting of large caliber guns.

words.ex: He changed his stance on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他改变了对气候变化的立场。
words.en: A stance is a particular way of standing, especially in sports such as golf or baseball, or a person's attitude or opinion about something, especially when it is stated publicly.

words.ex: The butterfly uses its proboscis to drink nectar.
words.ex_cn: 蝴蝶用它的口器吸食花蜜。
words.en: A proboscis is an elongated appendage from the head of an animal, either a vertebrate or an invertebrate. In invertebrates, the term usually refers to tubular mouthparts used for feeding and sucking. In vertebrates, a proboscis is an elongated nose or snout.

words.tr: n. 长出物；副产物；自然发展（或结果）
words.ex: The new park is an outgrowth of the community's love for nature.
words.ex_cn: 这个新公园是社区热爱自然的产物。
words.en: An outgrowth is something that develops naturally from something else, often as a result of it.

words.ex: The birds live in the marshland near the river.
words.ex_cn: 这些鸟住在河边的沼泽地里。
words.en: Marshland refers to an area of low-lying land which is flooded in wet seasons or at high tide, and typically remains waterlogged at all times.

words.ex: The camera uses a tiny pinhole to focus light onto the film.
words.ex_cn: 这台相机使用一个小针孔将光线聚焦在胶片上。
words.en: A pinhole is a very small hole, especially one made by a pin or similar object.

words.ex: The phone shows a small vibration when it rings.
words.ex_cn: 手机响时会轻微震动。
words.en: A vibration is a continuous slight shaking movement.

words.tr: n. 翻新；整修；去皱整容手术；面部拉皮手术
words.ex: The old house got a facelift with new paint and windows.
words.ex_cn: 这所老房子通过刷漆和更换窗户进行了翻新。
words.en: A facelift is a surgical operation to tighten the skin of the face in order to make someone look younger. It can also refer to the process of improving the appearance of something, such as a building or a piece of software.

words.ex: We eat lunch at midday.
words.ex_cn: 我们在中午吃午饭。
words.en: Midday is the middle part of the day, from noon until early afternoon.

words.ex: The handler takes care of the dog during training.
words.ex_cn: 处理者在训练期间照看这只狗。
words.en: A handler is a person who trains or controls animals, especially in a circus or zoo, or someone who deals with something as part of their job.

words.tr: n. 支柱；中坚；中流砥柱
words.ex: His support has been the mainstay of the project.
words.ex_cn: 他的支持一直是这个项目的支柱。
words.en: If you describe something as the mainstay of a particular thing, you mean that it is the most basic part of it.

words.ex: He used a tourniquet to stop the bleeding.
words.ex_cn: 他用止血带止住了出血。
words.en: A tourniquet is a device, typically a tightly wrapped bandage, that is used to stop severe bleeding by applying pressure to a limb.

words.ex: The teacher gave me guidance on how to write the essay.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我写论文的指导。
words.en: Guidance is help and advice that is given to someone about their work, education, or personal life.

words.tr: n. 至高无上；最大权力；最高地位；
words.ex: The king claimed supremacy over all other rulers.
words.ex_cn: 国王宣称自己对所有其他统治者拥有至高无上的权力。
words.en: Supremacy is the state or condition of being superior to all others in authority, power, or status.

words.ex: The enactment of the new law took effect last month.
words.ex_cn: 新法律的颁布上个月生效了。
words.en: The process of passing legislation or the state of being enacted.

words.ex: He is a man of great wit.
words.ex_cn: 他是个极具机智的人。
words.en: Wit is the ability to use words or ideas in a quick, clever, and amusing way.

words.ex: He kept neutrality during the argument.
words.ex_cn: 他在争论中保持中立。
words.en: The state of not supporting or helping either side in a conflict, disagreement, etc.; impartiality.

words.ex: Beijing is a transport hub in China.
words.ex_cn: 北京是中国的交通中心。
words.en: A hub is the central part of a wheel, rotating on or with the axle, and from which the spokes radiate. It can also refer to a central point of activity or interest.

words.ex: His fidelity to his friend never changed.
words.ex_cn: 他对朋友的忠诚从未改变。
words.en: Fidelity is loyalty to a person, organization, or set of beliefs.

words.ex: The lion belongs to the genus Panthera.
words.ex_cn: 狮子属于豹属。
words.en: A genus is a class of things which have common characteristics and which can be divided into subordinate kinds.

words.ex: The room was illuminated by candlelight.
words.ex_cn: 房间被烛光照亮。
words.en: The light produced by a candle.

words.ex: She is a homemaker who takes care of her children.
words.ex_cn: 她是一位照顾孩子的家庭主妇。
words.en: A homemaker is a person, especially a housewife, who manages a home.

words.ex: The nurse is the doctor's aide.
words.ex_cn: 护士是医生的助手。
words.en: An aide is someone whose job is to help another person in their work.

words.tr: n. 仓库；贮藏室；存放处；智囊
words.ex: He saves his code in a GitHub repository.
words.ex_cn: 他把代码保存在 GitHub 仓库中。
words.en: A repository is a place where something is stored or can be found.

words.tr: n. 解说词；评论；实况报道；
words.ex: The commentator gave live commentary during the soccer match.
words.ex_cn: 解说员在足球比赛期间进行了现场解说。
words.en: A commentary is a spoken or written description of an event or situation that is broadcast or published as it occurs.

words.ex: The smelter poured the molten metal into ingot molds.
words.ex_cn: 冶炼工将熔化的金属倒入锭模中。
words.en: An ingot is a mass of metal cast into a shape that is easy to handle, store, and transport.

words.tr: n. 传播者；发射机；送话机
words.ex: The radio transmitter sends signals to the receiver.
words.ex_cn: 无线电发射器将信号发送给接收器。
words.en: A transmitter is a device that sends out signals in the form of radio waves, or someone who sends or passes on something.

words.ex: The learner practices English every day.
words.ex_cn: 这位学习者每天练习英语。
words.en: A learner is someone who is learning a particular subject or skill.

words.ex: The dress has gold adornment on the hem.
words.ex_cn: 这条裙子的裙边有金色装饰。
words.en: An adornment is something that is used to make a person or thing more beautiful or attractive.

words.tr: n. 有价值的人或物；长处；
words.ex: He is an asset to the team because he works hard.
words.ex_cn: 他是个有价值的人，因为他工作努力。
words.en: An asset is something valuable that an individual, corporation, or country owns or controls with the expectation that it will provide a future benefit.

words.ex: The ancient yew tree in the churchyard is believed to be over 500 years old.
words.ex_cn: 教堂墓地里的古紫杉树据说已有500多年的历史。
words.en: A yew is an evergreen tree with flat leaves like needles and small red berries. Yews are often planted in churchyards and are associated with longevity and immortality.

words.ex: He wrote his autobiography when he was 70.
words.ex_cn: 他70岁时写了自传。
words.en: An autobiography is a book about the life of a person, written by that person.

words.ex: He bought a new auto last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周买了一辆新车。
words.en: A car; something that operates automatically.

words.tr: n. 自命不凡；自称；标榜；虚荣
words.ex: His pretension made others think he was better than them.
words.ex_cn: 他的自命不凡让别人觉得他比他们强。
words.en: If you say that someone has pretensions, you mean that they claim or pretend that they are more important, intelligent, or skilled than they really are.

words.ex: His selfishness made his friends leave him.
words.ex_cn: 他的自私使他的朋友们离开了他。
words.en: If you say that someone is selfish, you mean that they care only about themselves, and not about other people.

words.tr: n. 说明或对白的字幕；副标题；
words.ex: The movie has English subtitles for the dialogue.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影为对白提供了英文字幕。
