words.en: Diplomacy is the activity of managing relations between the governments of different countries, especially in the context of international relations, negotiations, and treaties.

words.ex: The two countries signed a protocol to stop the war.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家签署了一项停止战争的协议。
words.en: A protocol is a set of rules or a system of rules about the correct way to act in formal situations.

words.ex: The corn has a dry husk around it.
words.ex_cn: 玉米外面有一层干外壳。
words.en: The outer covering of some fruits and seeds, especially when it is dry and hard.

words.tr: n. 舷外支架；突出的梁
words.ex: The outrigger provided additional stability to the boat.
words.ex_cn: 舷外支架为船只提供了额外的稳定性。
words.en: An outrigger is a projecting structure on a boat or ship, typically one of a pair, used to stabilize the vessel.

words.ex: The curvature of the road makes driving slow.
words.ex_cn: 道路的弯曲使驾驶变慢。
words.en: The curvature of something is the fact that it is curved or the degree to which it is curved.

words.ex: She seeks perfection in everything she does.
words.ex_cn: 她在所做的每件事中都追求完美。
words.en: The state of being perfect; the highest degree of excellence or quality.

words.tr: n. 顽童；淘气鬼；小乞丐；海胆
words.ex: The little urchin stole an apple from the market.
words.ex_cn: 那个顽童从市场上偷了一个苹果。
words.en: An urchin is a small child who is dirty and poorly dressed, or a sea creature with a round shell covered with sharp points.

words.tr: n. 长生不老药；仙丹妙药；
words.ex: The old wizard searched for an elixir to live forever.
words.ex_cn: 这位老巫师寻找一种能让人长生不老的药水。
words.en: An elixir is a magical or medicinal potion, especially one that is supposed to prolong life indefinitely.

words.ex: The glacier was formed from centuries of firn accumulation.
words.ex_cn: 这座冰川是由数百年的粒雪积累形成的。
words.en: Firn is granular snow, especially on the upper part of a glacier, where it has been partially compacted but not yet turned into ice.

words.ex: The apple fell because of gravitation.
words.ex_cn: 苹果掉下来是因为重力。
words.en: Gravitation is the force of attraction that exists between any two masses, any two bodies, any two particles. It is the force that pulls objects towards each other.

words.ex: The garden has rich loam for growing vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 这个花园有肥沃的壤土，适合种蔬菜。
words.en: Loam is a type of soil that is a mixture of sand, silt, and clay, and is known for its fertility and good drainage properties.

words.tr:
n. 污染；腐坏；玷污
v. 污染；使腐坏；玷污
words.ex: The water has a taint from the factory waste.
words.ex_cn: 这种水因工厂废料而受到污染。
words.en: If something is tainted, it is affected by something bad or undesirable.

words.tr: n. 无依无靠；茫然若失；无可奈何的处境
words.ex: The old man felt helplessness after losing his family.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人在失去家人后感到无依无靠。
words.en: The state of being unable to help oneself; the feeling or condition of being powerless or unable to act.

words.ex: He is an atheist who does not believe in God.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名不信神的无神论者。
words.en: An atheist is a person who believes that there is no God or gods.

words.tr:
n. 无兴趣；不关心
v. 使不关心；使失去兴趣
words.ex: He showed disinterest in the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他对这部电影毫无兴趣。
words.en: If you have a disinterest in something, you are not interested in it or concerned about it.

words.ex: He eats a turnip for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚餐吃一个萝卜。
words.en: A turnip is a round root vegetable with a white or purple skin and white flesh.

words.ex: He was considered a beau in his social circle for his impeccable fashion sense.
words.ex_cn: 由于他无可挑剔的时尚感，他在社交圈中被视为花花公子。
words.en: A beau is a man who is courting a woman or who is her lover.

words.tr: n. 亚麻毛织品；棉毛织品
words.ex: She wore a linsey-woolsey dress to the old-fashioned fair.
words.ex_cn: 她穿着一件林赛-伍尔西面料的裙子去参加复古集市。
words.en: A coarse fabric made from a mix of linen and wool.

words.tr:
v. 疏浚；挖掘
n. 挖泥船；疏浚机
words.ex: They dredge the river to remove mud.
words.ex_cn: 他们疏浚河流以清除淤泥。
words.en: To dredge means to remove mud, sand, or other material from the bottom of a river, lake, etc., in order to make it deeper or to search for something.

words.ex: He bemoans the loss of his old car.
words.ex_cn: 他抱怨失去了他的旧车。
words.en: If you bemoan something, you express sorrow or dissatisfaction about it.

words.tr: v. 暗指；（间接）提到；影射
words.ex: He alluded to the problem without naming it.
words.ex_cn: 他暗示了这个问题，但没有点明。
words.en: To allude to something means to mention it in an indirect way.

words.ex: The government decided to codify the old laws.
words.ex_cn: 政府决定将旧法律编纂成典。
words.en: To codify means to arrange laws, rules, etc. into a systematic code.

words.ex: He poured wine into a large vat.
words.ex_cn: 他把葡萄酒倒进一个大桶里。
words.en: A vat is a large container used for holding liquids, especially in industrial processes.

words.ex: He likens his job to a puzzle.
words.ex_cn: 他把他的工作比作一个拼图。
words.en: To liken something to something else is to say that they are similar in some way.

words.ex: He postdated the check to next month.
words.ex_cn: 他把支票的日期写成下个月。
words.en: To write a date on a document that is later than the actual date.

words.tr:
v. 抱怨；发牢骚；绞痛
n. 抱怨；肠绞痛
words.ex: He always gripes about the weather.
words.ex_cn: 他总是抱怨天气。
words.en: If you gripe, you complain about something in a persistent, irritating way.

words.ex: The new model outclasses all its competitors.
words.ex_cn: 这款新车型远胜于所有竞争对手。
words.en: If someone or something outclasses another person or thing, they are a lot better than them.

words.ex: He will outlast his rivals in the race.
words.ex_cn: 他将在比赛中胜过他的对手。
words.en: To continue to exist or be effective for a longer time than someone or something else.

words.tr:
n. 鞭子
v. 鞭打；抽打；突然移动
words.ex: The farmer used a whip to guide the horse.
words.ex_cn: 农夫用鞭子赶马。
words.en: To whip means to hit a person or animal with a whip, or to move something quickly and suddenly.

words.ex: The soil degrades over time without proper care.
words.ex_cn: 如果没有适当照料，土壤会逐渐退化。
words.en: If something degrades or is degraded, it becomes worse in quality, or weaker in power or status.

words.tr: v. （使）变厚；变稠；使（情节等）复杂
words.ex: The soup will thicken if you cook it longer.
words.ex_cn: 如果你多煮一会儿，汤会变稠。
words.en: To make or become thick or thicker.

words.ex: Music can lighten your stress.
words.ex_cn: 音乐可以减轻你的压力。
words.en: To make or become lighter or less dark; to make or become less heavy or serious.

words.ex: The virus can mutate quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这种病毒可以迅速变异。
words.en: If an animal or plant mutates, or something mutates it, it develops different characteristics as the result of a change in its genes.

words.ex: The storm denuded the trees of their leaves.
words.ex_cn: 风暴把树上的叶子都刮掉了。
words.en: To strip something of its covering, possessions, or assets; to make bare.

words.tr:
v. 剥...的皮；投掷；急降；急跑
n. 毛皮；投掷；猛落；疾行
words.ex: The hunter pelted the fox after catching it.
words.ex_cn: 猎人抓到狐狸后剥了它的皮。
words.en: The skin of an animal with the fur or hair still on it, or to attack someone by throwing a lot of things at them.

words.tr:
v. 踩；踏；践踏
n. 脚步声；胎面
words.ex: He tread carefully on the icy path.
words.ex_cn: 他小心地走在结冰的小路上。
words.en: If you tread on something, you put your foot on it when you are walking. The tread of a tyre is the pattern of lines on its surface that prevent it from slipping.

words.ex: He interjected during the meeting to ask a question.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议中插话问了一个问题。
words.en: To say something that interrupts someone who is speaking.

words.ex: They will dismantle the old bridge next week.
words.ex_cn: 他们下周将拆除这座旧桥。
words.en: To dismantle something means to take it to pieces.

words.tr: v. 解开；朝反方向扭开
words.ex: She carefully untwisted the tangled yarn.
words.ex_cn: 她小心翼翼地解开了缠在一起的纱线。
words.en: To untwist something means to make it straight or to separate it from being twisted.

words.ex: Poverty can engender crime.
words.ex_cn: 贫困会引起犯罪。
words.en: To cause a feeling, situation, or condition to exist.

words.ex: The new phone outcompete the old model in speed.
words.ex_cn: 这款新手机在速度上超过了旧型号。
words.en: To outcompete means to surpass others in competition, especially in business or sports, by being more effective or successful.

words.tr:
v. 使装载过多；使负担过重
n. 过重的负担
words.ex: The project overburdened the team with too many tasks.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目给团队分配了过多的任务，让他们负担过重。
words.en: To load someone or something with too much of something, such as work, responsibility, or debt.

words.tr:
v. 嘲讽；嘲弄；相匹配
n. 嘲弄；挖苦
words.ex: His story doesn't jibe with the facts.
words.ex_cn: 他的故事与事实不符。
words.en: If one thing jibes with another, they agree or are very similar.

words.ex: He immersed the cloth in water.
words.ex_cn: 他把布浸在水里。
words.en: To immerse something or someone means to put them into a liquid so that they are completely covered by it. It can also mean to involve oneself deeply in a particular activity or interest.

words.tr: v. 沉思；闷闷不乐地想；n. 一窝幼崽；沉思的状态
words.ex: He sits by the window and broods over his failures.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在窗边，为自己的失败而忧思。
words.en: If someone broods over something, they think about it a lot, seriously and often unhappily. A brood is a group of young birds all born at the same time to the same mother.

words.ex: He finally acknowledged his mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他终于承认了自己的错误。
words.en: If you acknowledge a fact or a situation, you accept or admit that it is true or that it exists.

words.tr: v. 背叛；出卖；泄露；暴露
words.ex: He betrays his friend by telling the secret.
words.ex_cn: 他通过泄露秘密背叛了朋友。
words.en: If you betray someone who loves or trusts you, your actions hurt and disappoint them.

words.tr:
n. 纹身；刺青
v. 给…纹身
words.ex: He has a tattoo on his arm.
words.ex_cn: 他的手臂上有一个纹身。
words.en: A tattoo is a design that is drawn on someone's skin using needles to put little holes in the skin and filling them with coloured ink.

words.tr: v. 刺绣；绣（花）；加以渲染（或润色）
words.ex: She embroiders flowers on the pillow.
words.ex_cn: 她在枕头上刺绣花朵。
words.en: To embroider means to decorate cloth or other material by sewing patterns or pictures on it with colored threads.

words.ex: The enzyme helps to catalyze the reaction.
words.ex_cn: 这种酶有助于催化反应。
words.en: To cause or accelerate a reaction, process, or change.

words.tr:
v. 拍（屁股）
n. 拍打
words.ex: The parent will spank the child for lying.
words.ex_cn: 父母会因为孩子撒谎而打他。
words.en: To spank someone means to hit them on their bottom with your hand as a punishment.

words.ex: The police arrested the thief last night.
words.ex_cn: 警察昨晚逮捕了那个小偷。
words.en: If the police arrest you, they take charge of you and take you to a police station, because they believe you may have committed a crime.

words.ex: Running a business entails hard work.
words.ex_cn: 经营企业必然需要努力工作。
words.en: If one thing entails another, it involves it or causes it.

words.ex: The flowers wither in the hot sun.
words.ex_cn: 花朵在烈日下枯萎。
words.en: If a plant withers, it dries up and dies. If something withers, it becomes weaker or less important until it disappears completely.

words.ex: He contends that education is the key to success.
words.ex_cn: 他主张教育是成功的关键。
words.en: If you contend with someone or contend with something, you have to deal with a difficult situation or problem. If you contend that something is true, you state or argue that it is true.

words.ex: He tried to gild the old box with gold paint.
words.ex_cn: 他试图用金漆把旧盒子镀金。
words.en: To cover something with a thin layer of gold or to make something seem more attractive or valuable than it really is.

words.ex: He affirm that the plan will work.
words.ex_cn: 他断言这个计划会成功。
words.en: If you affirm that something is true or that something exists, you state firmly and publicly that it is true or that it exists.

words.tr:
v. 蹲伏；蜷缩
n. 蹲伏；蜷缩
words.ex: The cat crouched low to catch the mouse.
words.ex_cn: 猫蹲伏下来抓老鼠。
words.en: If you crouch, you bend your legs so that you are close to the ground and leaning forward slightly.

words.tr:
n. 隆隆声；辘辘声
v. 隆隆作响；辘辘行驶
words.ex: The dog let out a low rumble.
words.ex_cn: 狗发出了一声低沉的咆哮。
words.en: To make a continuous deep, resonant sound; to speak in a low, deep voice.

words.ex: He hums a tune while walking.
words.ex_cn: 他走路时哼着曲子。
words.en: To make a low, steady, continuous sound like that of a bee.

words.ex: The teacher asked us to reexamine our answers before submitting the test.
words.ex_cn: 老师让我们在交卷前重新审视我们的答案。
words.en: To examine something again, especially in order to check for mistakes or to consider new information.

words.tr: v. 浸入水中；泼上水；熄灭
words.ex: He doused the burning log in water.
words.ex_cn: 他把燃烧的木头浸入水中。
words.en: To douse something means to quickly throw water over it in order to put out a fire, or to pour a lot of liquid over it.

words.tr:
v. 剧烈搅动；（使）猛烈翻腾
n. 搅乳器
words.ex: The machine churns the butter in the cream.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器剧烈搅动奶油来制作黄油。
words.en: To churn means to stir or shake milk or cream in order to make butter, or to move something around violently in water or air.

words.ex: He chopped the carrots into small pieces.
words.ex_cn: 他把胡萝卜剁成了小块。
words.en: To chop something means to cut it into pieces with a sharp tool such as a knife or axe. It can also refer to the act of reducing something in amount or size.

words.tr:
v. 烤焦；烧灼
adj. 烧焦的；枯萎的
n. 烙印；焦痕
words.ex: He sears the steak on the grill.
words.ex_cn: 他在烤架上把牛排煎至表面焦黄。
words.en: To burn or scorch the surface of something with a sudden, intense heat.

words.ex: The mouse is gnawing on the wood.
words.ex_cn: 老鼠正在啃木头。
words.en: To gnaw means to bite or chew something persistently, especially something hard, or to cause persistent worry or discomfort.

words.ex: Please vacate the room by noon.
words.ex_cn: 请在中午前腾出房间。
words.en: To vacate a place or position means to leave it or give it up, making it available for other people.

words.tr: v. 膨胀；肿大；使扩张；使膨胀；
words.ex: The balloon distend when filled with air.
words.ex_cn: 气球充满空气时会膨胀。
words.en: If a part of your body distends or if you distend it, it becomes larger or swollen, often because of pressure from inside.

words.tr: v. 使浪漫化；使传奇化；使夸张化
words.ex: She tends to romanticize the past.
words.ex_cn: 她倾向于将过去浪漫化。
words.en: To romanticize something means to make it seem more exciting or attractive than it really is.

words.ex: The house abuts the park.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子紧邻公园。
words.en: If one thing abuts another, it is next to it or touches it at one end.

words.tr:
adj. 砾岩的；成球状的；结成团块的
n. 砾岩；企业集团；联合大公司；合成物
v. （使）结聚成一团
words.ex: The rock layer is conglomerate, made of small stones stuck together.
words.ex_cn: 这层岩石是砾岩，由小石头粘合而成。
words.en: A conglomerate is a large business firm consisting of several different companies.

words.ex: They ostracize him for being different.
words.ex_cn: 他们因为他与众不同而排斥他。
words.en: To ostracize someone means to exclude them from a society or group.

words.ex: He lingered by the door, not wanting to leave.
words.ex_cn: 他逗留在门口，不想离开。
words.en: If you linger somewhere, you stay there for a longer time than is necessary, for example because you are enjoying yourself.

words.ex: He puffed after running up the stairs.
words.ex_cn: 他跑上楼梯后喘着气。
words.en: If you puff, you breathe in and out quickly and with force, for example because you have been running or because you are out of breath. A puff of something such as air or smoke is a small amount of it that is blown out from somewhere.

words.ex: The child squirted water from the hose.
words.ex_cn: 孩子从软管里喷出水。
words.en: To squirt means to force out liquid in a thin fast stream or to be forced out in this way.

words.tr: v. 砰地关上；猛地一动；抨击
words.ex: He slammed the door angrily.
words.ex_cn: 他生气地把门砰地关上。
words.en: If you slam a door or window, or if it slams, it shuts noisily and with great force.

words.ex: He bullies his little brother every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都欺负他的弟弟。
words.en: To bully someone means to use your strength or power to hurt or frighten them, often forcing them to do something they do not want to do.

words.ex: He got a blister on his foot from new shoes.
words.ex_cn: 他新鞋磨出了一个水泡。
words.en: A blister is a small pocket of fluid within the upper layers of the skin, typically caused by forceful rubbing, burning, freezing, chemical exposure or infection. As a verb, it means to form such a pocket of fluid.

words.tr: v. 大批出没于；成群滋扰；遍布于；寄生
words.ex: The bugs infest the old house.
words.ex_cn: 这些虫子侵袭了这栋老房子。
words.en: If creatures such as insects or rats infest a place, they are present in large numbers and usually cause damage or disease.

words.ex: He harkened to the distant sound of the approaching train.
words.ex_cn: 他倾听着远处驶来的火车的声音。
words.en: To listen or pay attention to something.

words.ex: Rinse the dishes with water before drying them.
words.ex_cn: 在晾干盘子之前用清水冲洗。
words.en: To rinse something means to wash it in clean water in order to remove soap or dirt.

words.tr: v. 驱散；消散；浪费；挥霍
words.ex: The fog will dissipate by noon.
words.ex_cn: 雾将在中午前消散。
words.en: If something dissipates or is dissipated, it becomes less or becomes less strong until it disappears or goes away completely.

words.ex: The team will oust the coach after the loss.
words.ex_cn: 球队在输球后将撤换教练。
words.en: If someone is ousted from a position of power, job, or place, they are forced to leave it.

words.ex: He used a stick to dislodge the rock from the path.
words.ex_cn: 他用一根棍子把石头从路上移出。
words.en: To dislodge something means to remove it from a place where it is fixed or held.

words.tr: v. 取出内脏；重伤元气
words.ex: The cat eviscerated the mouse.
words.ex_cn: 这只猫掏出了老鼠的内脏。
words.en: To eviscerate means to remove the internal organs of a person or animal, or to remove the most important parts of something, leaving it weak or ineffective.

words.ex: She gently uncrumpled the paper and read the message.
words.ex_cn: 她轻轻地弄平纸张，阅读上面的信息。
words.en: To make something smooth or flat again after it has been crumpled.

words.ex: He tried to dissuade her from quitting her job.
words.ex_cn: 他试图劝她不要辞掉工作。
words.en: If you dissuade someone from doing something, you persuade them not to do it.

words.ex: She tinted the glass blue.
words.ex_cn: 她把玻璃染成了蓝色。
words.en: A tint is a small amount of a particular color, especially when it is used to make the main color lighter or darker.

words.tr: v. 绕行；设法避开；智胜；围住
words.ex: He circumvented the traffic by taking a small road.
words.ex_cn: 他通过走一条小路绕过了交通拥堵。
words.en: If someone circumvents a rule or restriction, they avoid having to obey it, usually in a clever and dishonest way.

words.ex: They deem this plan too risky.
words.ex_cn: 他们认为这个计划太冒险了。
words.en: If you deem something to be the case, you consider that it is the case.

words.ex: He kneads dough every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上揉面团。
words.en: To knead is to press and stretch dough or another substance with your hands in order to make it smooth and ready to use.

words.ex: Oil helps to lubricate the engine parts.
words.ex_cn: 油有助于润滑发动机部件。
words.en: To apply a substance such as oil or grease to (something) in order to minimize friction and allow smooth movement.

words.ex: Her kindness emanates from her smile.
words.ex_cn: 她的善良表现在她的微笑中。
words.en: To emanate means to come out from a source.

words.tr: v. 杀死；杀害；残害；宰杀
words.ex: He slayed the monster in the dark forest.
words.ex_cn: 他在黑暗的森林里杀死了怪物。
words.en: To kill someone or something in a violent way.

words.ex: She sifts flour through a fine mesh.
words.ex_cn: 她用细网筛面粉。
words.en: To sift means to put a fine, loose, or powdery substance through a sieve so as to remove lumps or large particles. It can also mean to examine something thoroughly so as to isolate that which is most important or useful.

words.ex: He tries to foment trouble between the neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 他试图在邻居之间挑起纠纷。
words.en: If someone foments trouble or violent opposition, they cause it to develop.

words.ex: The cold weather ails his old bones.
words.ex_cn: 寒冷的天气使他的老骨头疼痛。
words.en: If something ails a group or area of activity, it causes problems or difficulties for it.

words.ex: The ewe yeaned a healthy lamb.
words.ex_cn: 这只母羊产下了一只健康的小羊。
words.en: To give birth to a lamb or lambs.

words.ex: The old woman gleaned wheat from the field after the harvest.
words.ex_cn: 这位老妇人在收割后从田里拾落穗。
words.en: To gather information or material bit by bit.

words.ex: There was a lull in the rain before the storm came back.
words.ex_cn: 暴风雨再次来临前，雨下了一阵间歇。
words.en: A lull is a short period of quiet or calm in an otherwise noisy or hectic situation. To lull means to cause someone to feel calm or to fall asleep.

words.ex: The news saddened her.
words.ex_cn: 这个消息让她感到悲伤。
words.en: If something saddens you, it makes you feel sad.

words.ex: The fire blackened the pot.
words.ex_cn: 火把锅烧黑了。
words.en: To make or become black or dark, especially by the action of fire, smoke, or dirt; to defame someone's character.

words.ex: The sun brightens the room in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 太阳在早上使房间变亮。
words.en: To make something lighter or more colorful, or to make someone feel happier or more hopeful.

words.tr: v. 使心神不宁；使不安；扰乱
words.ex: The loud noise unsettled the baby.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的噪音让婴儿不安。
words.en: To make someone feel anxious or uncertain.

words.tr: v. 使不活跃；阻止活动
words.ex: The virus was inactivated by heat.
words.ex_cn: 病毒被高温灭活了。
words.en: To make something inactive or to cause it to lose its activity, especially in the context of biological or chemical processes.

words.ex: They communicate well with each other.
words.ex_cn: 他们彼此沟通得很好。
words.en: To communicate means to share or exchange information, news, or ideas, especially by speaking or writing.

words.ex: The ancient Egyptians believed in mummifying their dead to preserve them for the afterlife.
words.ex_cn: 古埃及人相信通过制作木乃伊可以为死者保存尸体，以备来世之用。
words.en: To preserve a dead body by treating it with special substances and wrapping it in cloth, as was done in ancient Egypt.

words.tr: v. 使带电；使电气化；使激动不已
words.ex: The new train system will electrify the entire region.
words.ex_cn: 新的火车系统将使整个地区电气化。
words.en: To electrify something means to make it operate using electricity or to make it more exciting or interesting.

words.ex: It took several months to dishabituate him from his bad habits.
words.ex_cn: 花了好几个月的时间才让他改掉了坏习惯。
words.en: To cause someone to lose a habit or to become unaccustomed to something.

words.tr: v. 使充满；灌注；使怀孕
words.ex: The rain impregnates the soil quickly.
words.ex_cn: 雨水迅速浸透了土壤。
words.en: To make a woman or female animal pregnant; to saturate or fill something with a substance.

words.tr:
v. 使不再抱幻想；使理想破灭
n. 幻灭；理想破灭
words.ex: The bad experience disillusioned him about politics.
words.ex_cn: 这次糟糕的经历让他对政治不再抱幻想。
words.en: If a person or thing disillusions you, they make you realize that something is not as good as you thought it was.

words.tr: v. 感到极度焦虑；折磨；苦苦思索
words.ex: He agonizes over his decision every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上都为自己的决定而痛苦挣扎。
words.en: To agonize over something means to spend a lot of time worrying and being anxious about it.

words.ex: The issue polarized the community into two opposing groups.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题使社区分裂成了两个对立的群体。
words.en: To polarize means to cause something, especially a group or an issue, to divide into two sharply contrasting groups or sets of opinions or beliefs.

words.tr: v. 使正式就任；给予职位
words.ex: They inducted the new mayor with a ceremony.
words.ex_cn: 他们通过一场仪式使新市长正式就任。
words.en: To induct someone into a position or organization means to formally install them in that position or officially introduce them into that organization.

words.tr: v. 使客观化；使具体化；物化
words.ex: He tries to objectify his feelings to understand them better.
words.ex_cn: 他试图使自己的感受客观化，以便更好地理解它们。
words.en: To represent something abstract as a concrete object; to treat someone as a mere object.

words.ex: The loud thunder terrified the child.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的雷声吓坏了那个孩子。
words.en: If something terrifies you, it makes you feel extremely frightened.

words.ex: The farmer used a harrow to break up the soil.
words.ex_cn: 农夫用耙来松土。
words.en: A harrow is a piece of farm equipment that is used to break up and smooth out the surface of the soil.

words.ex: The local company is an affiliate of the big global brand.
words.ex_cn: 这家本地公司是这个全球大品牌的分公司。
words.en: If an organization is affiliated with another larger organization, it is officially connected with the larger organization or is a member of it.

words.tr: v. 使罗马化；使用罗马字母拼写或印刷
words.ex: The ancient texts were romanized to make them more accessible to modern readers.
words.ex_cn: 这些古代文本被罗马化，以便现代读者更容易理解。
words.en: To romanize means to write or print a language in the Latin alphabet, or to bring something under Roman influence or control.

words.ex: He gratifies his parents by getting good grades.
words.ex_cn: 他通过取得好成绩来让父母感到欣慰。
words.en: If you are gratified by something, it gives you pleasure or satisfaction.

words.tr: v. 使迷惑；使...不知所措
words.ex: The strange signs bewilder the children.
words.ex_cn: 这些奇怪的符号让孩子们感到迷惑。
words.en: If something bewilders you, it is so confusing or difficult that you cannot understand it.

words.ex: The mirror deflects the light to the wall.
words.ex_cn: 镜子把光线反射到墙上。
words.en: If you deflect something such as criticism or attention, you act in a way that prevents it from being directed towards you or affecting you.

words.tr:
v. 抵消；使平衡
n. 衡重体；平衡力
words.ex: The weight acts as a counterbalance to the arm.
words.ex_cn: 这个重量作为手臂的平衡物。
words.en: A counterbalance is a weight or force that balances or counteracts another.

words.ex: He uses soap to cleanse his hands.
words.ex_cn: 他用肥皂洗手。
words.en: To cleanse something means to make it extremely clean, especially by using a special substance or process.

words.tr: v. 使社会化；进行社交活动；与人交往
words.ex: The school helps children socialize with others.
words.ex_cn: 学校帮助孩子们与他人社会化。
words.en: If you socialize, you meet other people socially, for example at parties.

words.tr: v. 增添活力；振奋；使活跃
words.ex: The fresh air invigorates me every morning.
words.ex_cn: 每天早晨的新鲜空气让我精神焕发。
words.en: If something invigorates you, it makes you feel more energetic and alive.

words.tr:
v. 使湿透；浸透
n. 弄湿；浸液
words.ex: The rain drenched his clothes.
words.ex_cn: 雨把他的衣服淋湿了。
words.en: To drench something or someone means to make them completely wet.

words.ex: Her kindness endears her to everyone.
words.ex_cn: 她的善良让她讨所有人喜欢。
words.en: To make someone loved or liked by others.

words.ex: I acquaint him with the new rules.
words.ex_cn: 我让他熟悉新规则。
words.en: If you acquaint someone with something, you tell them about it so that they know it.

words.ex: The disease afflicted many people in the village.
words.ex_cn: 这种疾病使村子里许多人遭受痛苦。
words.en: If you are afflicted by pain, illness, or misfortune, it causes you great suffering and distress.

words.ex: He was victimized by a scammer last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年被骗子欺骗了。
words.en: To victimize someone means to make them suffer as a result of your actions, especially by treating them unfairly.

words.ex: The air rarefies at high altitudes.
words.ex_cn: 在高海拔地区，空气会变稀薄。
words.en: To make or become less dense or solid; to purify or refine.

words.ex: The rigorous training enured the soldiers to the hardships of war.
words.ex_cn: 艰苦的训练使士兵们适应了战争的艰辛。
words.en: To accustom or habituate someone to something, especially something difficult or unpleasant.

words.tr: v. 使系统化；使成体系；使条理化
words.ex: He tries to systematize his notes before the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试前试图系统化他的笔记。
words.en: To systematize means to arrange according to an organized system; make systematic.

words.ex: The jury was sequestered during the trial.
words.ex_cn: 陪审团在审判期间被隔离。
words.en: To sequester means to isolate or hide away; it can also refer to the legal process of seizing property until a debt is paid or a dispute is resolved.

words.ex: The metal was heated to recrystallize it.
words.ex_cn: 金属被加热以使其再结晶。
words.en: To cause (a substance) to crystallize again.

words.ex: The smoke began to stifle her breathing.
words.ex_cn: 烟雾开始让她窒息。
words.en: To stifle something means to prevent it from happening, continuing, or developing.

words.ex: This color befits the room.
words.ex_cn: 这个颜色适合这个房间。
words.en: To be suitable or appropriate for someone or something.

words.ex: This rule pertains to all students.
words.ex_cn: 这条规则适用于所有学生。
words.en: If one thing pertains to another, it relates, belongs, or applies to it.

words.ex: The law will emancipate slaves.
words.ex_cn: 法律将解放奴隶。
words.en: To emancipate someone means to set them free from something that restricts their freedom to do what they want.

words.ex: He tried to retract his words after the argument.
words.ex_cn: 他在争吵后试图收回他的话。
words.en: If you retract something that you have said or written, you say that you did not mean it.

words.ex: Bees pollinate flowers in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂给花园里的花授粉。
words.en: To pollinate means to transfer pollen from the male part of a flower to the female part, enabling fertilization and the production of seeds.

words.tr:
n. 系绳；系链；界限
v. 用绳拴住
words.ex: The horse was tied to the post with a tether.
words.ex_cn: 这匹马被用拴绳系在了柱子上。
words.en: A tether is a rope or chain used to tie an animal to a post or other fixed point so that it cannot move away.

words.ex: The baby babbles when she is happy.
words.ex_cn: 当宝宝开心时，她会含糊不清地说话。
words.en: To babble means to talk rapidly and continuously in a foolish, excited, or incomprehensible way.

words.tr:
conj. 那（引导从句）；
pron. 那儿；那里；
adj. 那；那个；那样的；
adv. 那个；那么；那样；
words.ex: I know that he is coming tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我知道他明天会来。
words.en: Used to identify a specific person or thing observed or heard by the speaker.

words.tr: v. 一概而论；过分概括
words.ex: It's easy to overgeneralize when discussing broad topics.
words.ex_cn: 在讨论广泛话题时，很容易过于笼统地概括。
words.en: To overgeneralize means to make a general statement or form a general opinion that is not based on all the facts or details, especially in a way that is not accurate or fair.

words.tr:
v. 提高；振奋
n. 上升；振作
words.ex: The music uplifts her mood.
words.ex_cn: 音乐提升了她的心情。
words.en: To uplift means to raise something to a higher position or level, or to improve a person's spirits or morale.

words.ex: They will nominate her for the award.
words.ex_cn: 他们将提名她获得这个奖项。
words.en: If someone is nominated for a job or position, their name is formally suggested as a candidate for it.

words.ex: He modulates his voice to sound calm.
words.ex_cn: 他调节自己的声音以显得平静。
words.en: To modulate means to change or adjust something, such as your voice or a piece of equipment, to achieve a desired effect or to make it suitable for a particular situation.

words.ex: The factory galvanize iron sheets to prevent rust.
words.ex_cn: 工厂对铁片进行镀锌以防止生锈。
words.en: To galvanize someone means to cause them to take action, for example by making them feel very excited, afraid, or angry.

words.ex: He flung his hat on the chair.
words.ex_cn: 他把帽子扔在椅子上。
words.en: To throw something quickly and carelessly; to move or do something suddenly and energetically.

words.ex: They decided to postpone the meeting until next week.
words.ex_cn: 他们决定把会议推迟到下周。
words.en: To postpone something means to arrange for it to take place at a later time than was originally planned.

words.ex: He recoiled when he saw the snake.
words.ex_cn: 当他看到蛇时，他退缩了。
words.en: If something makes you recoil, you move your body quickly away from it because it frightens, offends, or hurts you.

words.ex: The engine needs to be degased before starting.
words.ex_cn: 发动机在启动前需要排气。
words.en: To remove gas from a substance or a container.

words.tr:
v. 缓慢而弯曲地流动；漫步；闲聊
n. 河流的曲折；漫步；迂回曲折的进程
words.ex: The river meanders through the forest.
words.ex_cn: 这条河蜿蜒穿过森林。
words.en: To meander means to follow a winding and turning course, often used to describe the way a river flows or the way a person walks without a clear direction.

words.tr: v. 铲平；推倒；清除；强迫
words.ex: The company tried to bulldoze the residents into selling their homes.
words.ex_cn: 公司试图强迫居民卖掉他们的房子。
words.en: To bulldoze means to use a bulldozer to clear or level an area, or to force or threaten someone into doing something.

words.ex: He infringes the rules by arriving late.
words.ex_cn: 他因迟到而违反了规则。
words.en: To infringe means to violate or break a law, agreement, or right.

words.ex: The mob broke the windows and shouted loudly.
words.ex_cn: 乌合之众砸了窗户并大声喊叫。
words.en: A mob is a large crowd of people, especially one that is disorderly and intent on causing trouble or violence.

words.ex: The bees made a loud buzz near the flowers.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂在花附近发出嗡嗡声。
words.en: To make a low, continuous, humming or sibilant sound, like that made by bees or flies.

words.ex: He misunderstands the instructions.
words.ex_cn: 他误解了这些说明。
words.en: If you misunderstand someone or something, you do not understand them properly.

words.ex: The belief preexisted the scientific discovery.
words.ex_cn: 这种信念在科学发现之前就已存在。
words.en: To exist before something else.

words.ex: The cave paintings predate written history.
words.ex_cn: 这些洞穴壁画早于文字历史。
words.en: To exist or occur at a date earlier than something else.

words.ex: The data points correlate with each other.
words.ex_cn: 这些数据点相互关联。
words.en: If one thing correlates with another, there is a close similarity or connection between them, often because one thing causes the other.

words.ex: She hankers after a simpler life.
words.ex_cn: 她向往一种更简单的生活。
words.en: If you hanker after something, you have a strong desire for it.

words.ex: He will rectify the mistake tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会纠正这个错误。
words.en: If you rectify something that is wrong, you change it so that it becomes correct or satisfactory.

words.ex: The scientist calibrates the scale every morning.
words.ex_cn: 科学家每天早上标定秤。
words.en: To calibrate something means to mark or adjust it so that it can be used for measuring accurately.

words.ex: The workers unload the boxes from the truck.
words.ex_cn: 工人们从卡车上卸下箱子。
words.en: To remove goods from a vehicle, ship, container, etc.

words.ex: They tried to desecrate the holy church.
words.ex_cn: 他们试图亵渎那座神圣的教堂。
words.en: To desecrate something means to spoil or damage something that is considered to be holy or very important.

words.ex: She ate a prune for a healthy snack.
words.ex_cn: 她吃了一颗梅干作为健康零食。
words.en: To prune means to cut off some of the branches of a tree or bush to make it grow better. It can also mean to reduce the extent of something by removing superfluous or unwanted parts.

words.ex: She embellished the dress with flowers.
words.ex_cn: 她用花朵装饰了这条裙子。
words.en: To embellish something means to make it more attractive by adding decorative details or features.

words.tr: v. 使屈辱；使丢脸；使蒙羞
words.ex: He tried to humiliate her in front of the class.
words.ex_cn: 他试图在全班面前羞辱她。
words.en: To humiliate someone means to make them feel ashamed or stupid, especially in front of other people.

words.ex: He wants to inquire about the bus schedule.
words.ex_cn: 他想询问公交车的时刻表。
words.en: If you inquire about something, you ask for information about it.

words.ex: The heavy rain drowned the small village.
words.ex_cn: 大雨淹没了这个小村庄。
words.en: To die by being underwater too long and unable to breathe, or to kill someone in this way.

words.ex: He tries to protract the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他试图延长会议。
words.en: To protract something means to make it last longer than usual or necessary, often in a way that is annoying or inconvenient.

words.ex: His smile belieed his true feelings.
words.ex_cn: 他的微笑掩饰了他真实的情感。
words.en: If one thing belies another, it hides the true situation and so creates a false idea or image of someone or something.

words.tr:
v. 对…要价（或收费）过高；装填过量
n. 要价过高；装填过量
words.ex: The shop overcharged me for the water bottle.
words.ex_cn: 商店多收了我买水瓶的钱。
words.en: If someone overcharges you, they charge you too much money for goods or a service.

words.ex: The patient is learning to locomote with the aid of a walker.
words.ex_cn: 这位患者正在借助助行器学习移动。
words.en: To move or travel from one place to another.

words.tr: v. 熏蒸；（为灭虫或消毒而）熏烟
words.ex: They fumigate the house to kill bugs.
words.ex_cn: 他们对房子进行熏蒸以杀死害虫。
words.en: To disinfect or purify an area by exposing it to the fumes of certain chemicals.

words.ex: He tries to restrain his anger.
words.ex_cn: 他努力克制自己的愤怒。
words.en: If you restrain someone, you stop them from doing what they intended or wanted to do, usually by using your physical strength.

words.ex: He imbibes coffee every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都喝咖啡。
words.en: To imbibe means to drink, especially alcohol, or to absorb or take in something, such as knowledge or ideas.

words.tr:
v. 藏匿；隐藏
n. 一批贮藏物
words.ex: He stashes his money under the bed.
words.ex_cn: 他把钱藏在床底下。
words.en: If you stash something valuable in a secret place, you store it there to keep it safe.

words.tr:
v. 喷涌；滔滔不绝地说
n. 涌出；喷出
words.ex: Water gushed from the broken pipe.
words.ex_cn: 水从破裂的管道中喷涌而出。
words.en: If someone gushes, they express their admiration or pleasure in an exaggerated way.

words.ex: He excels in math.
words.ex_cn: 他擅长数学。
words.en: To be exceptionally good at or proficient in an activity or subject.

words.ex: He hesitates to ask for help.
words.ex_cn: 他犹豫着是否要寻求帮助。
words.en: If you hesitate, you pause slightly while you are doing something or just before you do it, usually because you are uncertain, embarrassed, or worried.

words.ex: His rude words detract from the beauty of the speech.
words.ex_cn: 他粗鲁的话贬损了演讲的优美。
words.en: If one thing detracts from another, it makes it seem less good or impressive.

words.ex: The shop tries to entice customers with cheap prices.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店试图以低价吸引顾客。
words.en: If you entice someone, you attract them to a particular place or activity by making it seem attractive or interesting.

words.ex: You need to prepay for the service before using it.
words.ex_cn: 在使用服务之前，你需要预先付款。
words.en: To pay for something before it is received or before it is due.

words.ex: The dark clouds bode a storm.
words.ex_cn: 乌云预示着一场风暴。
words.en: If something bodes ill, it makes you think that something bad will happen in the future. If something bodes well, it makes you think that something good will happen.

words.ex: Dark clouds portend a storm.
words.ex_cn: 乌云预示着一场风暴。
words.en: If something portends something else, it indicates that it is likely to happen in the future.

words.ex: The dark clouds foreshadow a storm.
words.ex_cn: 乌云预示着一场风暴。
words.en: If something foreshadows an event or situation, it suggests that it will happen.

words.ex: They had prearranged the meeting for next Monday.
words.ex_cn: 他们预先安排了下周一的会议。
words.en: To arrange or plan something in advance.

words.ex: He predetermines the outcome before the game starts.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛开始前就决定了结果。
words.en: To decide or settle (something) in advance.

words.ex: He republishes the article on his blog.
words.ex_cn: 他把这篇文章重新发布在他的博客上。
words.en: To publish something again, especially in a different format or with new material.

words.tr: v. 再结合；再统一；重聚
words.ex: The family will reunite next summer.
words.ex_cn: 这家人将在明年夏天重聚。
words.en: If people are reunited, or if someone reunites them, they meet each other again after they have been separated for some time.

words.ex: He rejoin the team after his injury healed.
words.ex_cn: 他伤愈后重新加入了队伍。
words.en: To become a member of a group again after leaving it; to reply to a remark or accusation.

words.ex: Lizards can regenerate their tails.
words.ex_cn: 蜥蜴可以再生尾巴。
words.en: To regenerate means to grow or form again, especially after being damaged or lost, or to improve a place or system by making it more active or successful.

words.ex: After a long run, it's important to rehydrate your body.
words.ex_cn: 长跑后，给身体补水很重要。
words.en: To rehydrate means to restore lost water or moisture to something, especially to the body.

words.ex: The government announced a major reform in education.
words.ex_cn: 政府宣布了教育方面的重大改革。
words.en: If someone reforms a system, they change or improve it.

words.ex: The mountains glaciated during the last ice age.
words.ex_cn: 这些山脉在上一个冰河时期被冰川覆盖。
words.en: To cover with ice or a glacier; to freeze over.

words.ex: Interest will accrue over time.
words.ex_cn: 利息会随着时间积累。
words.en: If money or interest accrues, it gradually increases in amount over a period of time.

words.ex: They pressurize him to quit his job.
words.ex_cn: 他们逼迫他辞职。
words.en: To pressurize means to apply pressure to something or someone, often in order to force them to do something or to make something operate in a certain way.

words.tr: v. 作…的摘要；成为…的缩影；概括；集中体现
words.ex: This painting epitomizes the beauty of nature.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画概括了自然的美。
words.en: If you say that something or someone epitomizes a particular thing, you mean that they are a perfect example of it.

words.ex: He unfolded the map on the table.
words.ex_cn: 他把地图在桌子上展开。
words.en: To open or spread out something that is folded; to develop or be revealed.

words.ex: The committee will convene tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 委员会明天将召开会议。
words.en: If someone convenes a meeting or conference, they arrange for it to take place. They can also be said to convene when they meet.

words.tr: v. 珍爱；爱惜；怀念；怀有（感情）；抱有（希望）
words.ex: I cherish the time I spend with my family.
words.ex_cn: 我珍惜与家人共度的时光。
words.en: If you cherish something, you care for it lovingly and protect it carefully.

words.ex: The brawl started over a simple misunderstanding.
words.ex_cn: 这场争吵源于一个简单的误解。
words.en: A brawl is a rough or noisy fight or quarrel.

words.tr: v. 蒸馏；用蒸馏法提取；蒸馏出；提炼
words.ex: They distill water to remove impurities.
words.ex_cn: 他们通过蒸馏去除水中的杂质。
words.en: To distill a liquid means to purify it by heating it until it becomes a gas and then cooling it so that it becomes a liquid again. This process can also be used to extract the essential elements or meanings from something.

words.tr: v. 重新定位；使适应；改变方针；调整
words.ex: He had to reorient his goals after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他在失业后不得不重新调整自己的目标。
words.en: To change the focus or direction of something.

words.tr: v. 重新定位；使适应；改变方针；调整
words.ex: He had to reorient his goals after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他在失业后不得不重新调整自己的目标。
words.en: To change the focus or direction of something.

words.ex: We had a short conversation about the weather.
words.ex_cn: 我们简短地聊了聊天气。
words.en: A conversation is a talk between two or more people, in which news and ideas are exchanged.

words.ex: It is important to eat healthy food.
words.ex_cn: 吃健康的食物很重要。
words.en: Something that is important is very significant, is highly valued, or is necessary.

words.ex: He goes to university to study engineering.
words.ex_cn: 他上大学学习工程。
words.en: A university is an institution where students study for degrees and where academic research is done.

words.ex: This forest has many different species of birds.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林有多种不同的鸟类物种。
words.en: A species is a class of plants or animals whose members have the same main characteristics and are able to breed with each other.

words.tr:
v. 增加；增多；
n. 增加；增长；
words.ex: The company increased its profits last year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司去年增加了利润。
words.en: To increase something means to make it larger in size, amount, or degree.

words.tr:
adv. 很；相当；
adj. 漂亮的；
words.ex: The movie was pretty good.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影很好。
words.en: If you describe someone, especially a girl, as pretty, you mean that they are attractive in a delicate way without being truly beautiful.

words.ex: The teacher gave us important information about the test.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我们关于考试的重要信息。
words.en: Information is facts or details about a subject, event, or situation.

words.ex: He wrote an article about climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一篇关于气候变化的文章。
words.en: An article is a piece of writing on a particular subject in a newspaper, magazine, or online. It can also refer to a particular item or object, or a clause in a legal document.

words.ex: The employee arrived at work early.
words.ex_cn: 这位雇员早早到达了工作地点。
words.en: An employee is a person who is paid to work for an organization or for another person.

words.ex: I remember my first day at school.
words.ex_cn: 我记得我上学的第一天。
words.en: If you remember people or events from the past, you still have an idea of them in your mind and you are able to think about them.

words.ex: The theory of gravity explains why things fall down.
words.ex_cn: 重力理论解释了为什么东西会往下掉。
words.en: A theory is a formal idea or set of ideas that is intended to explain something.

words.ex: He creates beautiful paintings with colors.
words.ex_cn: 他用色彩创造美丽的画作。
words.en: To create means to bring something into existence or to cause something to happen as a result of one's actions.

words.tr:
v. 猜测；猜想；
n. 猜测；猜想；
words.ex: I guess it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我猜明天会下雨。
words.en: If you guess something, you give an answer or provide an opinion which may not be true because you do not have definite knowledge about the matter concerned.

words.tr:
n. 材料；原料；
adj. 物质的；
words.ex: The table is made of wood material.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子是由木头材料制成的。
words.en: Material refers to the substance or substances from which a thing is made or can be made, or information or ideas for use in creating a book or other work.

words.ex: He starts his new class in the fall semester.
words.ex_cn: 他在秋季学期开始他的新课程。
words.en: A semester is one of the two periods that the school or college year is divided into, especially in the United States and Canada.

words.ex: I checked the class schedule for tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我查看了明天的课程时间表。
words.en: A schedule is a plan that gives a list of events or tasks and the times at which each one should happen or be done.

words.ex: The boy found a fossil in the rock.
words.ex_cn: 男孩在岩石中发现了一块化石。
words.en: A fossil is the remains or impression of a prehistoric organism preserved in petrified form or as a mold or cast in rock.

words.ex: He likes biology because it teaches about animals and plants.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢生物学，因为它教关于动物和植物的知识。
words.en: Biology is the science which is concerned with the study of living things.

words.tr:
v. 检查；核对；
n. 检查；支票；阻止；
words.ex: Please check your homework before class.
words.ex_cn: 请在上课前检查你的作业。
words.en: To examine something in order to determine its accuracy, quality, or condition, or to make sure that something is correct or safe.

words.ex: The topic of our talk is climate change.
words.ex_cn: 我们谈话的话题是气候变化。
words.en: A topic is a particular subject that you discuss or write about.

words.ex: The temperature today is very high.
words.ex_cn: 今天的温度很高。
words.en: The degree or intensity of heat present in a substance or object, especially as expressed according to a comparative scale and shown by a thermometer or perceived by touch.

words.ex: He speaks English as his first language.
words.ex_cn: 他说英语作为他的第一语言。
words.en: Language is the system of communication in speech and writing that is used by people of a particular country or area.

words.tr: n. 音乐会；演奏会；一致；和谐；
words.ex: We went to a concert last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚去听了音乐会。
words.en: A concert is a performance of music by one or more musicians or singers, which usually takes place in the evening.

words.tr: v. 出席；参加；注意；照料；
words.ex: He will attend the meeting tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会出席会议。
words.en: To be present at an event, meeting, or function; to take care of or look after someone or something.

words.ex: I forget where I put my keys.
words.ex_cn: 我忘记把钥匙放在哪儿了。
words.en: If you forget something, you fail to remember it.

words.ex: You can eat anything you like.
words.ex_cn: 你可以吃任何你喜欢的东西。
words.en: Any object, event, fact, etc., that is not specified or known.

words.ex: The country is developing its economy.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家正在发展它的经济。
words.en: To develop means to grow or cause to grow and become more mature, advanced, or elaborate.

words.ex: I consider going to the park tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我考虑明天去公园。
words.en: If you consider something, you think about it carefully.

words.tr:
v. 引导；领导；带头；
n. 主导地位；铅；领先；
words.ex: The teacher leads the students to the library.
words.ex_cn: 老师带领学生去图书馆。
words.en: To be in charge of a group, country, or situation; to guide or direct in a course; a position of advantage in a contest or competition; a heavy, malleable, ductile, bluish-white, dense metallic element.

words.ex: The phone is expensive.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机很贵。
words.en: Costing a lot of money; having a high price.

words.ex: The school has a new grading system.
words.ex_cn: 学校有一个新的评分系统。
words.en: A system is a group of interacting or interrelated entities that form a unified whole.

words.ex: The teacher gave us a math assignment.
words.ex_cn: 老师给我们布置了一份数学作业。
words.en: An assignment is a task or piece of work that you are given to do, especially as part of your job or studies.

words.tr:
n. 表面；
v. 显露；
words.ex: The surface of the table is smooth.
words.ex_cn: 桌子的表面很光滑。
words.en: The outer or top part of something; to rise to the surface of water or to become known after being hidden or secret.

words.tr: v. 较喜欢；更喜欢；宁愿；
words.ex: I prefer tea to coffee.
words.ex_cn: 我更喜欢茶而不是咖啡。
words.en: If you prefer someone or something, you like that person or thing better than another, and so you are more likely to choose them if there is a choice.

words.tr: n. 通过；通道；段落；短文；
words.ex: The passage of the train through the tunnel was quick.
words.ex_cn: 火车通过隧道的速度很快。
words.en: A passage is a long narrow space with walls or fences on both sides, which connects one place or room with another.

words.ex: It is possible to learn English quickly.
words.ex_cn: 快速学会英语是可能的。
words.en: If something is possible, it can be done or achieved.

words.tr: n. 单元住宅；公寓住宅；
words.ex: He lives in a small apartment near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他住在公园附近的一间小公寓里。
words.en: An apartment is a set of rooms for living in, usually on one floor of a large building.

words.tr:
v. 支持；支撑；
n. 拥护；帮助；
words.ex: My friends support me when I feel sad.
words.ex_cn: 当我感到难过时，我的朋友们支持我。
words.en: If you support someone or their ideas or aims, you agree with them, and perhaps help them because you want them to succeed.

words.tr:
v. 生产；制造；导致；引起；生育；出示；
n. 农产品；
words.ex: The farm produces fresh vegetables every day.
words.ex_cn: 这个农场每天生产新鲜蔬菜。
words.en: To produce something means to make, create, or manufacture it, often in large quantities. It can also refer to the act of causing something to happen or exist.

words.tr:
adj. 特指的；特殊的；挑剔的；
n. 细节；详情；
words.ex: He wants a particular book, not any other.
words.ex_cn: 他想要一本特指的书，不是别的。
words.en: You use particular to emphasize that you are talking about one thing or one kind of thing rather than other similar ones.

words.tr:
n. 经验；阅历；
v. 经历；体验；
words.ex: He has a lot of experience in teaching English.
words.ex_cn: 他有丰富的英语教学经验。
words.en: Experience is knowledge or skill in a particular job or activity that you have gained because you have done that job or activity for a long time.

words.ex: The population of this city is growing fast.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市的人口正在快速增长。
words.en: The number of people living in a particular area, city, or country; the total number of people who live in a place.

words.tr: adj. 可获得的；有空的；可用的；
words.ex: The books are available in the library.
words.ex_cn: 这些书在图书馆里可以借到。
words.en: If something is available, it is able to be used or obtained.

words.ex: The researcher studies how plants grow.
words.ex_cn: 这位研究人员研究植物是如何生长的。
words.en: A researcher is someone who conducts research, especially as a job.

words.ex: The whale swims deep in the ocean.
words.ex_cn: 鲸在海洋深处游动。
words.en: A whale is a very large mammal that lives in the sea.

words.ex: His condition improved after the treatment.
words.ex_cn: 他的状况在接受治疗后好转了。
words.en: A condition is a state of affairs that must exist or be brought about before something else can happen or be done.

words.ex: Water is made of two elements: hydrogen and oxygen.
words.ex_cn: 水由两种要素组成：氢和氧。
words.en: An element is a substance that cannot be separated into simpler substances by chemical means and is composed of atoms having the same number of protons.

words.ex: The package includes a free book.
words.ex_cn: 这个套餐包括一本免费的书。
words.en: If one thing includes another, it has the other thing as one of its parts.

words.tr:
n. 头脑；意向；心；智力；
v. 介意；注意；
words.ex: He lost his mind after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在事故后失去了理智。
words.en: Your mind is your ability to think and reason. If you mind something, you are bothered by it or you object to it.

words.ex: I will borrow a book from the library.
words.ex_cn: 我将从图书馆借一本书。
words.en: To take and use something that belongs to someone else with the intention of returning it.

words.tr: n. 来源；出处；源泉；源头；提供资料者；
words.ex: The river's source is in the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 这条河的源头在山里。
words.en: The place, person, or thing from which something comes or can be obtained.

words.ex: The school provides free lunch for students.
words.ex_cn: 学校为学生提供免费午餐。
words.en: If you provide something that someone needs or wants, or if you provide them with it, you give it to them or make it available to them.

words.ex: He will continue walking after the break.
words.ex_cn: 休息后他会继续走路。
words.en: If someone or something continues to do something, they keep doing it and do not stop.

words.ex: The two teams decide to unite for the competition.
words.ex_cn: 这两个队伍决定在比赛中联合起来。
words.en: If a group of people or things unite or if someone unites them, they join together and act as a group.

words.tr:
n. 惊讶；意外；惊喜；
v. 使惊奇；使感到意外；
words.ex: She felt a surprise when she saw the gift.
words.ex_cn: 当她看到礼物时，感到很惊讶。
words.en: If something surprises you, it happens unexpectedly and causes you to feel surprise.

words.tr: n. 栖息地；居留地；产地；
words.ex: The panda's habitat is in the mountains of China.
words.ex_cn: 熊猫的栖息地在中国的山区。
words.en: The natural environment in which a species or group of species lives.

words.tr:
n. 实验；试验；
v. 做试验；进行实验；
words.ex: The boy did a science experiment in class.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩在课堂上做了一个科学实验。
words.en: An experiment is a scientific procedure undertaken to make a discovery, test a hypothesis, or demonstrate a known fact.

words.ex: I recently bought a new book.
words.ex_cn: 我最近买了一本新书。
words.en: If something happened recently, it happened only a short time ago.

words.tr:
n. 副本；(书，报纸等的) 一本；复制品；
v. 复制；
words.ex: Please give me a copy of the report.
words.ex_cn: 请给我一份报告的副本。
words.en: A copy is a thing made to be similar or identical to another. As a verb, to copy means to make a similar or identical version of something.

words.tr:
n. 修理；修补；
v. 修理；修补；
words.ex: The repair of the car took two days.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车的修理花了两天时间。
words.en: To repair something that is damaged or not working properly means to fix it.

words.ex: The police found evidence at the crime scene.
words.ex_cn: 警察在犯罪现场找到了证据。
words.en: Evidence is anything that you see, experience, read, or are told that causes you to believe that something is true or has really happened.

words.ex: The growth of the plant is slow in winter.
words.ex_cn: 这植物在冬天生长缓慢。
words.en: The process of increasing in physical size, number, value, or strength.

words.ex: The dinosaur lived in a long period ago.
words.ex_cn: 恐龙生活在很久以前的一个时期。
words.en: A period is a length of time in which something happens, or a stretch of time with a particular quality or characteristic.

words.tr:
n. 种类；类别；
v. 理清；解决；把…分类；拣选；
words.ex: This store sells all sorts of fruits.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店出售各种各样的水果。
words.en: A sort is a kind or category of things or people which have similar characteristics.

words.ex: My roommate likes to listen to music at night.
words.ex_cn: 我的室友喜欢晚上听音乐。
words.en: A roommate is a person with whom one shares a room or rooms, especially in a college or university dormitory or a shared apartment.

words.ex: He works in the sales department.
words.ex_cn: 他在销售部工作。
words.en: A department is one of the sections in an organization such as a government, business, or university.

words.ex: He can describe the picture in one sentence.
words.ex_cn: 他能用一句话描述这幅画。
words.en: If you describe a person, object, event, or situation, you say what they are like or what happened.

words.ex: He asked his advisor for help with his project.
words.ex_cn: 他向他的顾问寻求项目帮助。
words.en: An advisor is a person whose job is to give advice to people who need it, especially advice on their financial affairs or about their education.

words.ex: The child loves to watch dinosaurs on TV.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子喜欢在电视上看恐龙。
words.en: A dinosaur is a type of reptile that lived millions of years ago, known for its large size and often extinct species.

words.ex: The customer bought a new phone.
words.ex_cn: 这位客户买了一部新手机。
words.en: A customer is someone who buys goods or services from a shop or business.

words.ex: The librarian helps students find books.
words.ex_cn: 图书管理员帮助学生找书。
words.en: A librarian is a person who is in charge of a library or who has been trained to do this work.

words.ex: I suppose he is late because of the traffic.
words.ex_cn: 我认为他因为交通堵塞而迟到了。
words.en: If you suppose that something is true, you believe or imagine that it is true, although you may not have any proof.

words.tr:
n. 事情；物质；
v. 要紧；
words.ex: What's the matter with you?
words.ex_cn: 你怎么了？
words.en: Matter is a physical substance in general, as distinct from mind and spirit; (in physics) that which occupies space and possesses rest mass, especially as distinct from energy. It can also refer to a subject or situation under consideration.

words.ex: He discovered a new planet last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年发现了一颗新行星。
words.en: If you discover something that you did not know about before, you become aware of it or find it.

words.ex: I saw a couple of birds flying in the sky.
words.ex_cn: 我看见几只鸟在天上飞。
words.en: A couple is two people who are married, living together, or having a sexual relationship. It can also refer to a small number of things or people.

words.tr: adv. 不管怎样；无论如何；
words.ex: I don't like the weather, but anyway, we will go for a walk.
words.ex_cn: 我不喜欢这天气，但不管怎样，我们会去散步。
words.en: You use anyway or anyhow to indicate that a statement explains or supports a previous point.

words.ex: We visited a museum last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我们上周末参观了一个博物馆。
words.en: A museum is a building where a large number of interesting and valuable objects, such as works of art or historical items, are kept, studied, and displayed to the public.

words.ex: New technology helps farmers grow more food.
words.ex_cn: 新技术帮助农民种植更多的粮食。
words.en: Technology refers to the application of scientific knowledge for practical purposes, especially in industry.

words.tr: n. 性格；人物角色；特点；
words.ex: His character is kind and patient.
words.ex_cn: 他的性格善良且有耐心。
words.en: The combination of qualities or features that distinguishes one person, group, or thing from another.

words.ex: He wants to study psychology at university.
words.ex_cn: 他想在大学学习心理学。
words.en: Psychology is the scientific study of the human mind and the reasons for people's behaviour.

words.tr:
n. 大学毕业生；
v. 毕业；
words.ex: He is a graduate of Harvard University.
words.ex_cn: 他是哈佛大学的毕业生。
words.en: A graduate is a person who has successfully completed a degree at a university or college and has received a certificate or diploma stating this. To graduate means to successfully complete a degree at a university or college.

words.ex: The solution to the problem is simple.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题的解决办法很简单。
words.en: A solution to a problem is a way of dealing with it so that the difficulty is removed.

words.ex: He bought a ticket for the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一张电影票。
words.en: A ticket is a small, official piece of paper or card which shows that you have paid to enter a place such as a theatre or a sports ground, or shows that you have paid for a journey.

words.ex: The location of the store is near the park.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店的位置在公园附近。
words.en: A location is the place where something happens or is situated.

words.tr:
n. 术语；学期；期限；措辞；
v. 把…称作；把…叫做；
words.ex: The word 'algorithm' is a technical term in computer science.
words.ex_cn: ‘算法’是计算机科学中的一个术语。
words.en: A term is a word or expression used in relation to a particular subject, especially one that has a specific meaning, or a fixed period of time during which something lasts or is intended to happen.

words.ex: This house has a modern design.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子具有现代的设计。
words.en: Modern means relating to the present time, for example the present decade or present century.

words.tr: n. 掠夺者；捕食性动物；食肉动物；
words.ex: The lion is a predator that hunts deer.
words.ex_cn: 狮子是一种捕食鹿的掠夺者。
words.en: A predator is an animal that naturally preys on others.

words.ex: He loves reading English literature.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢阅读英语文学。
words.en: Literature consists of written works, especially those considered to have artistic or intellectual value.

words.ex: He basically just wants to be left alone.
words.ex_cn: 他基本上只是想一个人待着。
words.en: You use basically to indicate that you are stating a fact or opinion in a simple, clear, or definite way.

words.tr:
adj. 目前的；在场的；
n. 目前；礼物；
v. 呈现；提出；
words.ex: The present situation is very difficult.
words.ex_cn: 目前的形势非常困难。
words.en: If you say that someone is present at an event, you mean that they are there.

words.ex: The audience clapped loudly after the show.
words.ex_cn: 演出结束后，观众热烈鼓掌。
words.en: The group of spectators at a public event; listeners or viewers collectively, especially those attending a performance or reading a particular work.

words.ex: He works at a small college.
words.ex_cn: 他在一所小型学院工作。
words.en: A college is an institution where students study after they have left school, in order to get a degree or qualification.

words.tr:
v. 提到；说到；
n. 提及；说起；
words.ex: He didn't mention the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他没有提到那场事故。
words.en: If you mention something, you say something about it, usually briefly.

words.ex: This book has five sections.
words.ex_cn: 这本书有五个部分。
words.en: A section of something is one of the parts into which it is divided or from which it is formed.

words.ex: He learned a new technique to paint better.
words.ex_cn: 他学了一种新的绘画技术。
words.en: A technique is a particular method of doing an activity, usually a method that involves practical skills.

words.ex: The government provides free education.
words.ex_cn: 政府提供免费教育。
words.en: The group of people who officially control a country or the system used for controlling a country.

words.ex: I will visit you this weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我这周末去看你。
words.en: The weekend is Saturday and Sunday, the two days in the week when many people do not work.

words.ex: I like all fruits, especially apples.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢所有的水果，尤其是苹果。
words.en: You use especially to emphasize that what you are saying applies more to one thing or situation than to others.

words.ex: I pick the red shirt for the party.
words.ex_cn: 我为派对选择红色衬衫。
words.en: To choose something from a group of things or people, or to remove something from a place using your fingers or a tool.

words.ex: The box contains five apples.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子包含五个苹果。
words.en: If something such as a box, bag, room, or place contains things, those things are inside it.

words.ex: He will cancel the meeting tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会取消会议。
words.en: If you cancel something that has been arranged, you stop it from happening. If you cancel an order for goods or services, you tell the person or organization supplying them that you no longer wish to receive them.

words.tr:
n. 影响（力）；
v. 影响；
words.ex: The teacher had a big influence on her students.
words.ex_cn: 老师对学生们有很大的影响。
words.en: The power to affect, control, or manipulate someone or something.

words.tr:
n. 记录；唱片；
v. 记录；录制；
words.ex: The school keeps a record of all student grades.
words.ex_cn: 学校保存所有学生成绩的记录。
words.en: A record is a piece of information or an account of something that is written down or stored on a computer or other device so that it can be referred to later.

words.tr:
n. 结构；建筑物；
v. 组织；
words.ex: The structure of the bridge is very strong.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥的结构非常坚固。
words.en: The arrangement of and relations between the parts or elements of something complex.

words.ex: A hammer is a useful instrument for building.
words.ex_cn: 锤子是建造时有用的工具。
words.en: An instrument is a tool or device used for a particular task, especially for scientific, medical, or technical work. It can also refer to a musical instrument.

words.ex: The company will advertise its new phone on TV.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司将在电视上为新手机登广告。
words.en: If you advertise something such as a product, an event, or a job, you tell people about it in newspapers, on television, or on posters in order to encourage them to buy the product, go to the event, or apply for the job.

words.ex: The museum will exhibit ancient coins next month.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆下个月将展览古钱币。
words.en: To exhibit something means to show it in a public place so that people can go to see it. It can also mean to show a particular quality, ability, or type of behavior.

words.tr: adj. 特定的；明确的；具体的；
words.ex: He gave a specific reason for being late.
words.ex_cn: 他给出了一个迟到的具体原因。
words.en: If someone is specific, they give a description that is precise and exact.

words.tr:
n. 回顾；复习；审查；评论；
v. 回顾；复习；审核；评论；
words.ex: We had a quick review of last week's lesson.
words.ex_cn: 我们对上周的课程做了一个简短的回顾。
words.en: If you review something, you consider it again, especially in order to make changes to it or to give your opinion about it.

words.tr:
n. 控制；管制；
v. 控制；操纵；
words.ex: The teacher has good control of the class.
words.ex_cn: 老师对课堂有很好的控制。
words.en: To control something means to have power over it and to be able to make it do what you want.

words.tr:
n. 损害；破损；
v. 损害；破坏；
words.ex: The storm caused serious damage to the house.
words.ex_cn: 风暴对房屋造成了严重损害。
words.en: Damage is physical harm that is caused to something which makes it less attractive, useful, or valuable.

words.tr: adj. 环境的；有关环境的；
words.ex: The government is protecting the environmental balance.
words.ex_cn: 政府正在保护环境平衡。
words.en: Relating to the natural world and the impact of human activity on its condition.

words.tr:
v. 想知道；
n. 惊奇；奇迹；
words.ex: I wonder why he is late.
words.ex_cn: 我想知道他为什么迟到了。
words.en: To feel curiosity or doubt about something; a feeling of surprise mingled with admiration, caused by something beautiful, unexpected, unfamiliar, or inexplicable.

words.tr:
n. 锻炼；行使；练习；
v. 运用；使用；锻炼；
words.ex: He does exercise every morning to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上锻炼以保持健康。
words.en: Physical activity that you do to make your body strong and healthy.

words.ex: The manager approved the new project.
words.ex_cn: 经理批准了新项目。
words.en: A manager is a person who is responsible for running part of or the whole of a business organization.

words.tr:
n. 注意；通知；
v. 注意；留心；通知；
words.ex: He gave a notice about the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他发布了关于会议的通知。
words.en: If you notice something or someone, you become aware of them.

words.tr:
n. 特征；报刊特写；
v. 以…为特色；是…的重要组成；
words.ex: The main feature of this phone is its long battery life.
words.ex_cn: 这款手机的主要特征是续航时间长。
words.en: A feature of something is an interesting or important part or characteristic of it.

words.ex: He loves watching stars and learning astronomy.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢看星星并学习天文学。
words.en: Astronomy is the scientific study of celestial objects, space, and the physical universe as a whole.

words.ex: The child needs attention when he does homework.
words.ex_cn: 孩子做作业时需要被关注。
words.en: Attention is the act of focusing your mind on something and taking notice of it.

words.ex: He made a quick decision to leave.
words.ex_cn: 他迅速做出了离开的决定。
words.en: A decision is a choice that you make about something after thinking about it.

words.tr: v. 幸存；生存；存活；艰难挺过；
words.ex: He survived the accident with minor injuries.
words.ex_cn: 他在事故中幸存下来，只有轻微受伤。
words.en: If you survive in a dangerous situation, you continue to live or exist in spite of it.

words.ex: The students do experiments in the lab.
words.ex_cn: 学生们在实验室做实验。
words.en: A lab is a place where scientific experiments and research are conducted.

words.ex: The director of the school gave a speech.
words.ex_cn: 学校的主任发表了一次演讲。
words.en: A director is a person who is in charge of something, especially a film, play, or organization.

words.ex: She invited her friend to dinner.
words.ex_cn: 她邀请她的朋友吃晚饭。
words.en: To invite someone means to ask them to come to a social event or to spend time with you socially.

words.ex: He briefly explained the plan.
words.ex_cn: 他简要地解释了这个计划。
words.en: For a short time; in few words.

words.tr:
v. 有益于；有助于；
n. 利益；好处；
words.ex: Exercise benefits your health.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼有益于你的健康。
words.en: A benefit is something that helps you or improves your life in some way.

words.ex: I recommend this book to you.
words.ex_cn: 我向你推荐这本书。
words.en: If someone recommends a person or thing to you, they suggest that you would find them good or useful.

words.tr:
adj. 额外的；
n. 额外的事物；
adv. 额外地；
words.ex: He did extra work to earn more money.
words.ex_cn: 他做了额外的工作来赚更多的钱。
words.en: If something is extra, it is added to an existing amount or number.

words.ex: The cake has three layers of chocolate.
words.ex_cn: 这个蛋糕有三层巧克力。
words.en: A layer of a substance or material is a quantity or piece of it that covers a surface or that is between two other things.

words.ex: The atmosphere keeps the Earth warm.
words.ex_cn: 大气使地球保持温暖。
words.en: The atmosphere is the layer of gases surrounding a planet or other material body, held in place by the gravity of the body.

words.tr: n. 气体；气态；汽油；天然气；煤气；
words.ex: Oxygen is a gas that we need to breathe.
words.ex_cn: 氧气是一种我们呼吸所需的气体。
words.en: Gas is a substance like air that is neither liquid nor solid and burns easily. It is used as a fuel for cooking and heating.

words.tr: n. 运动；动作；活动；乐章；
words.ex: The movement of the sun changes the shadow.
words.ex_cn: 太阳的运动改变了影子。
words.en: The act or process of moving or being moved; a change of position or place.

words.tr:
v. 传播；扩散；散布；
n. 传播；蔓延；范围；
words.ex: The virus spread quickly through the city.
words.ex_cn: 病毒在城市中迅速传播。
words.en: To spread something means to open it out or arrange it over a place or surface, so that all of it can be seen or used easily.

words.ex: He wants to apply for a job at the bank.
words.ex_cn: 他想申请银行的工作。
words.en: To make a formal request, usually in writing, for something such as a job, a place at a university, or permission to do something.

words.tr:
adj. 完整的；完成的；
v. 完成；
words.ex: The book is complete with all chapters.
words.ex_cn: 这本书有所有章节，是完整的。
words.en: If you complete something, you finish doing, making, or producing it.

words.ex: The solar panel collects energy from the sun.
words.ex_cn: 太阳能板从太阳收集能量。
words.en: Solar means relating to the sun or using the energy from the sun to produce electricity.

words.tr:
n. 下降；衰退；
v. 下降；衰退；
words.ex: There was a sharp decline in sales last month.
words.ex_cn: 上个月销售额大幅下降。
words.en: If something declines, it becomes less in quantity, importance, or strength.

words.ex: There is a big difference between apples and oranges.
words.ex_cn: 苹果和橙子之间有很大的差异。
words.en: A difference is a way in which two or more things are not the same.

words.ex: He likes chemistry because it is fun.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢化学，因为它很有趣。
words.en: Chemistry is the scientific study of the structure of substances and how they react with each other.

words.ex: He gave a presentation about climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他做了一个关于气候变化的报告。
words.en: The act of showing or explaining something to an audience.

words.ex: The accident occurred yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 事故昨天发生了。
words.en: If something occurs, it happens.

words.ex: I have an appointment with my doctor at 3 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 我下午三点有个医生的约会。
words.en: An appointment is a formal arrangement to meet or visit someone at a particular time, especially for a purpose connected with their work or official position.

words.ex: Can you summarize the story in one sentence?
words.ex_cn: 你能用一句话总结这个故事吗？
words.en: If you summarize something, you give a brief description of its main points.

words.ex: The factory increases its production every year.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂每年都在增加生产。
words.en: Production refers to the process of manufacturing or growing something in large quantities, or the amount of something that is manufactured or grown.

words.ex: He made a proposal to improve the school lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他提出了一个改善学校午餐的提案。
words.en: A proposal is a plan or suggestion, especially a formal one that is put forward for people to think about and decide upon.

words.tr:
n. 循环；周期；自行车；
v. 骑自行车；循环；
words.ex: The water cycle is important for nature.
words.ex_cn: 水循环对自然界很重要。
words.en: A cycle is a series of events that are regularly repeated in the same order or a bicycle.

words.ex: The glacier moves slowly down the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 冰川缓慢地沿着山向下移动。
words.en: A glacier is a large, persistent body of ice that forms where the accumulation of snow exceeds its ablation over many years, often centuries.

words.ex: The boy found a dark cave near the hill.
words.ex_cn: 男孩在山附近发现了一个黑暗的洞穴。
words.en: A cave is a large hole in the side of a cliff or hill, or one that is under the ground.

words.ex: Carbon dioxide makes the air warm.
words.ex_cn: 二氧化碳使空气变暖。
words.en: A compound containing two atoms of oxygen combined with another element or group.

words.ex: The committee meets every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 委员会每周一开会。
words.en: A committee is a group of people who are chosen to do a particular job or make decisions on behalf of a larger group.

words.ex: I deposited money at the bank.
words.ex_cn: 我到银行存了钱。
words.en: A bank is an institution where people or businesses can keep their money or borrow money. It can also refer to the land alongside a river or lake.

words.tr: n. 生物体；有机体；有机组织；
words.ex: A bacterium is a simple organism.
words.ex_cn: 细菌是一种简单的生物体。
words.en: An organism is a living thing that has an organized structure, can react to stimuli, reproduce, grow, adapt, and maintain homeostasis.

words.tr:
v. 表达；表示；
adj. 明确的；
n. 特快列车；快件服务；
words.ex: He can express his feelings clearly.
words.ex_cn: 他能清楚地表达自己的感受。
words.en: If you express an idea or feeling, or express yourself, you show what you think or feel.

words.ex: He finally finished his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他终于完成了作业。
words.en: You use finally to suggest that something happens after a long period of time, usually later than you wanted or expected.

words.tr:
n. 东西；原料；
v. 塞；填充；
words.ex: I need to clean up all this stuff.
words.ex_cn: 我需要清理这些东西。
words.en: If you stuff something somewhere, you push it there quickly and roughly. If you stuff a container or space with something, you fill it completely with that thing.

words.ex: He found a piece of metal in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 他在花园里发现了一块金属。
words.en: Metal is a hard, shiny substance such as iron, gold, or steel.

words.tr: n. 意思；意义； v. 表示…的意思；意思；“mean”的现在分词；
words.ex: What is the meaning of this word?
words.ex_cn: 这个词的意思是什么？
words.en: The meaning of something is what it expresses or represents.

words.ex: He will fix the broken chair tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会修理那把坏掉的椅子。
words.en: To fix something means to repair it, to make it firm or stable, or to arrange or decide it.

words.ex: He solved the math problem quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快解决了这道数学题。
words.en: If you solve a problem or a question, you find a solution or an answer to it.

words.ex: I will definitely come to the party.
words.ex_cn: 我肯定会来参加派对。
words.en: without any doubt; certainly

words.ex: She generally wakes up at 7 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 她通常在早上七点起床。
words.en: In most cases; usually.

words.tr:
n. 地点；场所；斑点；
v. 发现；识别；
words.ex: This is the spot where we met for the first time.
words.ex_cn: 这是我们第一次见面的地方。
words.en: A spot is a particular place or point. It can also refer to a small mark or stain, or a small amount of something. As a verb, it means to see, notice, or recognize someone or something.

words.tr:
n. 个人；
adj. 个别的；单独的；
words.ex: Each individual has the right to speak freely.
words.ex_cn: 每个人都有权自由发言。
words.en: An individual is a person considered separately from their society or community. As an adjective, it describes something that is single, separate, or unique to a person or thing.

words.ex: There is a chance it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 明天可能会下雨。
words.en: A chance is a possibility of something happening, often something that you want to happen.

words.ex: The gym has new exercise equipment.
words.ex_cn: 健身房有新的健身设备。
words.en: The necessary items for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The president signed the new contract.
words.ex_cn: 总裁签署了新合同。
words.en: The president is the elected head of a republic or the head of a company or organization.

words.ex: He will introduce his friend to the class.
words.ex_cn: 他将向全班介绍他的朋友。
words.en: If you introduce someone, you tell someone else their name so that they can know each other.

words.ex: We went to the beach during our vacation.
words.ex_cn: 我们在假期去了海滩。
words.en: A vacation is a period of time devoted to pleasure, rest, or relaxation, especially one with pay granted to an employee.

words.tr: n. 少许；小块；片刻； v. “bite”的过去式；
words.ex: Can you give me a bit of sugar?
words.ex_cn: 你能给我一点点糖吗？
words.en: A bit is a small piece or quantity of something.

words.ex: He waited for hours, and eventually got his turn.
words.ex_cn: 他等了几个小时，终于轮到他了。
words.en: At an unspecified later time; in the end.

words.tr: n. （同一事物）不同种类；多样性；（动植物的）品种；变化；
words.ex: The store sells a variety of apples.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店出售各种各样的苹果。
words.en: If something has variety, it consists of things which are different from each other.

words.ex: The construction of the new bridge took two years.
words.ex_cn: 新桥的建筑花了两年时间。
words.en: The process or method of building or making something, especially buildings, bridges, etc.

words.ex: Good food and sleep help maintain health.
words.ex_cn: 良好的饮食和睡眠有助于保持健康。
words.en: The condition of a person's body or mind, especially in terms of the presence or absence of illnesses, injuries, or impairments.

words.ex: He painted a portrait of his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他画了一幅他母亲的肖像。
words.en: A portrait is a painting, drawing, or photograph of a particular person.

words.tr:
n. 样品；样本；
v. 抽样；
words.ex: The scientist tested the sample from the river.
words.ex_cn: 科学家测试了来自河流的样品。
words.en: A sample is a small quantity of a product, especially food, given to customers so that they can try it before buying it.

words.tr: n. 优势；有利条件；好处；
words.ex: His height gives him an advantage in basketball.
words.ex_cn: 他的身高在篮球中给了他优势。
words.en: An advantage is a factor or circumstance that puts you in a favorable or superior position.

words.ex: He finally realize his mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他终于意识到自己的错误。
words.en: If you realize that something is true, you become aware of that fact or understand it.

words.ex: The speaker told a funny story.
words.ex_cn: 说话者讲了一个有趣的故事。
words.en: A speaker is someone who speaks, especially someone who gives a speech or makes a presentation.

words.ex: We had a quick meal at noon.
words.ex_cn: 我们在中午吃了一顿简单的饭。
words.en: A meal is an occasion when people sit down to eat food, especially breakfast, lunch, or dinner.

words.tr: n. 知识；了解；学问；学识；
words.ex: He gained knowledge from reading books.
words.ex_cn: 他通过读书获得了知识。
words.en: Knowledge is information and understanding about a subject which a person has, or which all people have.

words.tr: n. 自助餐厅；自助食堂；
words.ex: We ate lunch in the school cafeteria.
words.ex_cn: 我们在学校自助餐厅吃午饭。
words.en: A cafeteria is a type of food service location within an institution in which there is little or no waiting staff table service, whether a restaurant or within an institution such as a large office building or school; a school dining location is also referred to as a dining hall or canteen (in British English).

words.ex: The teacher will determine the winner of the contest.
words.ex_cn: 老师将确定比赛的获胜者。
words.en: If you determine something, you decide it or settle it.

words.tr: v. 有关；把…联系起来；认同；叙述；理解；
words.ex: This story relates to your childhood.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事与你的童年有关。
words.en: If you relate a story, you tell it. If two things relate, they are connected in some way.

words.tr:
adj. 音乐的；擅长音乐的；
n. 音乐剧；音乐歌舞片；
words.ex: He loves musical songs.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢音乐的歌曲。
words.en: Relating to music; having the pleasant sound of music.

words.tr:
v. 测量；衡量；度量；
n. 衡量；量度；措施；
words.ex: He uses a ruler to measure the length of the table.
words.ex_cn: 他用尺子测量桌子的长度。
words.en: To measure something means to determine its size, amount, or degree, often by using a tool or device designed for this purpose.

words.ex: He made a mistake in his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他在作业中犯了一个错误。
words.en: If you make a mistake, you do something which you did not intend to do, or which produces a result that you do not want.
