words.ex: The test results confirm he has the disease.
words.ex_cn: 检测结果证实他患有这种疾病。
words.en: To confirm something means to establish its truth or validity by providing evidence or proof.

words.ex: He had to rewrite his essay after the teacher gave feedback.
words.ex_cn: 他在老师给出反馈后不得不重写他的作文。
words.en: If someone rewrites a piece of writing such as a book, an article, or a law, they write it in a different way in order to improve it or because circumstances have changed.

words.ex: The water begins to boil at 100 degrees.
words.ex_cn: 水在100度时开始沸腾。
words.en: When a liquid boils or when you boil it, it reaches the temperature at which it starts to turn into a gas.

words.tr:
n. 藏物处；隐藏物；
v. 匿藏；
words.ex: The hunters found a cache of food under the rocks.
words.ex_cn: 猎人们在石头下发现了一个食物藏匿处。
words.en: A cache is a hidden store of things such as weapons or a supply of food.

words.ex: The baker used a metal mold to shape the cake.
words.ex_cn: 面包师用一个金属模具来塑造蛋糕。
words.en: A mold is a hollow container used to give shape to molten or hot liquid material when it cools and hardens. It can also refer to a fungus that grows on food or damp surfaces.

words.ex: This portable charger works well on trips.
words.ex_cn: 这个便携式充电器在旅行时很好用。
words.en: Capable of being carried or moved about with ease.

words.ex: The glacial landscape was covered in snow.
words.ex_cn: 冰河地貌被雪覆盖着。
words.en: relating to, resulting from, or denoting the presence or agency of ice, especially in the form of glaciers.

words.ex: Her icy smile made him feel cold.
words.ex_cn: 她冰冷的微笑让他感到寒意。
words.en: If you describe something as icy, you mean that it is extremely cold.

words.ex: The village is still undeveloped with no roads or electricity.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄仍然不发达，没有道路和电力。
words.en: An undeveloped area of land is one that has not been used for building or farming.

words.tr: adj. 精致的；微妙的；易碎的；脆弱的；
words.ex: She wore a delicate lace dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一条精致的蕾丝连衣裙去参加派对。
words.en: Something that is delicate is small and beautifully shaped. It can also be easily broken or damaged.

words.tr: adj. 有竞争力的；竞争的；
words.ex: She is a competitive runner who wins many races.
words.ex_cn: 她是一个有竞争力的跑步者，赢得了许多比赛。
words.en: Competitive is used to describe situations or activities in which people or firms compete with each other.

words.ex: The earthquake caused tremendous damage.
words.ex_cn: 地震造成了巨大的破坏。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as tremendous, you mean that they are very great in amount, extent, or intensity.

words.ex: The ghost is invisible to the human eye.
words.ex_cn: 这个鬼魂肉眼看不见。
words.en: If something is invisible, you cannot see it because it is hidden or because it is very difficult to see.

words.tr: adj. 明智的；有判断力的；恰当的；合理的；
words.ex: It is sensible to wear a coat in cold weather.
words.ex_cn: 在寒冷的天气里穿外套是明智的。
words.en: A sensible person is able to make good judgments and decisions based on reason rather than emotion.

words.ex: The soup is tasty and hot.
words.ex_cn: 这汤美味又热。
words.en: If you describe food as tasty, you mean that it has a pleasant and attractive flavour.

words.ex: He is a trustworthy friend who always keeps his promises.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个值得信赖的朋友，总是信守承诺。
words.en: If you describe someone as trustworthy, you mean they are reliable, honest, and truthful.

words.ex: The weather was predictable today, just like yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 今天的天气和昨天一样，是可以预见的。
words.en: If you say that an event or a situation is predictable, you mean that it is obvious in advance that it will happen or what it will be like.

words.ex: He is optimistic about the future.
words.ex_cn: 他对未来持乐观态度。
words.en: Someone who is optimistic is hopeful about the future or the success of something in particular.

words.ex: The rain was continuous all day.
words.ex_cn: 雨一整天都在下个不停。
words.en: Something that is continuous happens or exists without stopping or being interrupted.

words.ex: He has a facial scar from an accident.
words.ex_cn: 他脸上有一道因事故留下的疤痕。
words.en: Facial means relating to the face or designed for use on the face.

words.ex: The lion is a predatory animal.
words.ex_cn: 狮子是一种食肉动物。
words.en: Predatory animals live by killing and eating other animals. Predatory people or organizations are eager to gain something out of someone else's weakness or suffering.

words.ex: He gave an explicit answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了明确的答案。
words.en: Something that is explicit is expressed or shown clearly and openly, without any attempt to hide anything.

words.tr: adj. 一年一次的；每年的；
words.ex: The school holds an annual sports day.
words.ex_cn: 学校每年举行一次运动会。
words.en: An annual event happens once every year.

words.ex: The movie was fantastic!
words.ex_cn: 这部电影极好！
words.en: If you describe something as fantastic, you are emphasizing that you think it is very good or that you like it a lot.

words.tr: adj. 不多的；适度的；谦虚的；
words.ex: He made a modest profit last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年的利润不多。
words.en: If you say that someone is modest, you approve of them because they do not talk much about their abilities or achievements.

words.tr: adj. 强制性的；义务的；必须的；
words.ex: Wearing a helmet is obligatory for cyclists.
words.ex_cn: 骑自行车时戴头盔是强制性的。
words.en: If something is obligatory, you must do it because of a rule or law.

words.ex: The invasive plant spreads quickly and kills other plants.
words.ex_cn: 这种侵入性植物生长迅速，会杀死其他植物。
words.en: If you describe something as invasive, you mean that it spreads very quickly and is difficult to stop.

words.tr: n. 大量同时出现的事件；
words.ex: There was a rash of burglaries last month.
words.ex_cn: 上个月发生了一连串的盗窃案。
words.en: If someone is rash or does rash things, they act without thinking carefully first, and therefore make mistakes or behave foolishly.

words.ex: The story had a graphic description of the battle.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事对战斗的描述非常生动。
words.en: A graphic is a visual representation of data or information, such as a chart, diagram, or picture.

words.tr: adj. 发声的；嗓音的；直言不讳的；
words.ex: He made a vocal sound to get attention.
words.ex_cn: 他发出声音来引起注意。
words.en: If you are vocal about something, you express your opinions or feelings about it in a strong and public way.

words.tr: adj. 青少年的；十来岁的；
words.ex: Teenage boys often like playing basketball.
words.ex_cn: 青少年男孩通常喜欢打篮球。
words.en: Teenage is used to describe someone who is between the ages of 13 and 19, or something that is related to or typical of this age group.

words.ex: The apple is ripe and ready to eat.
words.ex_cn: 这个苹果熟了，可以吃了。
words.en: When fruit or crops are ripe, they are ready to be eaten or harvested because they have developed to the right stage.

words.ex: The test has only numerical answers.
words.ex_cn: 这个测试只有数字答案。
words.en: Numerical means relating to numbers or consisting of numbers.

words.ex: The instructions were straightforward and easy to follow.
words.ex_cn: 这些说明很简单，容易遵循。
words.en: If you describe something as straightforward, you approve of it because it is easy to do or understand.

words.ex: My throat is sore after singing.
words.ex_cn: 我唱歌后喉咙疼。
words.en: If part of your body is sore, it causes you pain and discomfort.

words.ex: The cut on his finger is painful.
words.ex_cn: 他手指上的伤口很疼。
words.en: If something is painful, it causes you a lot of physical or emotional pain.

words.ex: The child gave a naive smile when he believed the story.
words.ex_cn: 当孩子相信这个故事时，他露出了天真的微笑。
words.en: If you describe someone as naïve, you think they lack experience and so expect things to be easy or people to be honest or kind.

words.ex: He made an abrupt stop at the red light.
words.ex_cn: 他在红灯前突然停了下来。
words.en: If something happens abruptly, it happens suddenly and unexpectedly.

words.ex: The track is elliptical in shape.
words.ex_cn: 这个跑道是椭圆形的。
words.en: Something that is elliptical has the shape of an ellipse or is characterized by the omission of words that are understood to be obvious.

words.tr: adj. 外来的；外国来的；奇异的；
words.ex: The market sells exotic fruits from other countries.
words.ex_cn: 这个市场出售来自其他国家的外来水果。
words.en: Something that is exotic is unusual and interesting because it comes from or is related to a distant country.

words.ex: The outward force pushed the door open.
words.ex_cn: 向外的力把门推开了。
words.en: An outward movement or position is one that is directed towards the outside or away from the centre.

words.ex: He has a slight cold.
words.ex_cn: 他有点轻微的感冒。
words.en: A slight change, difference, or action is not very great or important.

words.tr: adj. 全知的；无所不知的
words.ex: The omniscient narrator knows everything about the characters.
words.ex_cn: 全知的叙述者了解角色的一切。
words.en: Knowing everything; having infinite awareness, understanding, and insight.

words.ex: The child felt helpless when he lost his mother.
words.ex_cn: 当孩子失去妈妈时，他感到无助。
words.en: Unable to defend oneself or to act without help.

words.ex: He follows a systematic approach to solve math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他用一种系统的方法来解决数学问题。
words.en: A systematic approach or method is one that is done according to a fixed plan, in a thorough and efficient way.

words.ex: The soup is too salty.
words.ex_cn: 这汤太咸了。
words.en: Something that is salty contains salt or tastes of salt.

words.ex: The graph shows a linear relationship between time and distance.
words.ex_cn: 这张图显示了时间与距离之间的线性关系。
words.en: Linear means involving or relating to a straight line or lines.

words.ex: His words were contradictory.
words.ex_cn: 他的话是矛盾的。
words.en: If two or more facts, ideas, or statements are contradictory, they state or imply that opposite things are true.

words.tr:
adv. 向下地；
adj. 向下的；
words.ex: The leaves fell downward slowly.
words.ex_cn: 树叶慢慢向下飘落。
words.en: Moving or leading towards a lower place or level

words.tr: adj. 像海绵的；松软多孔的
words.ex: The bread is spongy and soft.
words.ex_cn: 这种面包松软有弹性。
words.en: Something that is spongy is soft and full of holes, like a sponge.

words.tr: adj. 选择性的；精挑细选的；
words.ex: He is selective about what he eats.
words.ex_cn: 他对吃的东西很挑剔。
words.en: If you are selective, you choose things carefully, for example, the things that you buy or do.

words.ex: He wrote a scholarly article about ancient history.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一篇关于古代历史的学术性文章。
words.en: A scholarly person or activity is serious and academic, and involves a lot of reading and studying.

words.ex: He wore a ceremonial robe for the wedding.
words.ex_cn: 他为婚礼穿了一件仪式性的长袍。
words.en: relating to or used in a ceremony; formal

words.tr: adj. 值得…的；值得尊敬的；
words.ex: This book is worthy of reading.
words.ex_cn: 这本书值得读。
words.en: If something or someone is worthy of something, they deserve it because they have the qualities or abilities required.

words.ex: His speech was persuasive and made everyone agree.
words.ex_cn: 他的演讲很有说服力，让所有人都同意了。
words.en: A persuasive argument or reason is one that makes you believe that something is true or right.

words.ex: The morning was foggy, so I could not see the road.
words.ex_cn: 早晨有雾，所以我看不到路。
words.en: If it is foggy, there is fog.

words.ex: This coupon is valid until next month.
words.ex_cn: 这张优惠券到下个月都有效。
words.en: If something such as a document or agreement is valid, it is legally acceptable or officially recognized.

words.ex: He is an ambitious student who wants to become a doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个有雄心的学生，想成为一名医生。
words.en: Having or showing a strong desire and determination to succeed.

words.ex: He is an influential teacher in our school.
words.ex_cn: 他是我们学校一位有影响力的老师。
words.en: Having great influence on someone or something.

words.ex: She greeted us with a cheery smile.
words.ex_cn: 她用愉快的微笑迎接我们。
words.en: If you describe a person or their behaviour as cheery, you mean that they are cheerful and happy.

words.ex: His silly hat made everyone laugh.
words.ex_cn: 他那可笑的帽子让大家都笑了。
words.en: If you say that someone or something is silly, you mean that they are foolish, childish, or ridiculous.

words.ex: He made a stupid mistake on the test.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试中犯了一个愚蠢的错误。
words.en: If you say that someone or something is stupid, you mean that they show a lack of good judgment or intelligence and they are not at all sensible.

words.ex: The teacher used phonetic symbols to help students pronounce words correctly.
words.ex_cn: 老师使用语音符号帮助学生正确发音。
words.en: Phonetic means relating to the sounds of speech or the study of these sounds.

words.ex: The atomic structure of hydrogen is simple.
words.ex_cn: 氢的原子结构很简单。
words.en: relating to atoms or the energy that comes from splitting atoms

words.tr: adj. 整洁的；整齐的；有条理的
words.ex: He keeps his desk neat.
words.ex_cn: 他保持书桌整洁。
words.en: Neat things are tidy, smart, or carefully arranged.

words.ex: He is knowledgeable about history and science.
words.ex_cn: 他对历史和科学都很博学。
words.en: Someone who is knowledgeable has or shows a clear understanding of many different facts about the world or about a particular subject.

words.ex: The gravitational force pulls the apple to the ground.
words.ex_cn: 引力把苹果拉向地面。
words.en: relating to or resulting from the force of gravity

words.ex: His opinion is subjective and not based on facts.
words.ex_cn: 他的观点是主观的，不是基于事实的。
words.en: Based on or influenced by personal feelings, tastes, or opinions.

words.tr: adj. 笛卡尔的；笛卡尔哲学的; n. 笛卡尔信徒
words.ex: He plotted the point on a cartesian plane.
words.ex_cn: 他在这个笛卡尔平面上标出了这个点。
words.en: Relating to the French philosopher René Descartes or his philosophy.

words.ex: He is confident when he speaks in front of the class.
words.ex_cn: 他在全班面前说话时很自信。
words.en: If you are confident, you are certain of your abilities or of your beliefs.

words.ex: The organizational structure is clear and simple.
words.ex_cn: 组织结构清晰而简单。
words.en: Relating to the way in which the different parts of something are arranged or organized.

words.tr:
adj. 在头顶上的；
adv. 在空中；
words.ex: The overhead light is too bright.
words.ex_cn: 头顶上的灯太亮了。
words.en: You use overhead to indicate that something is above you or above the place that you are talking about.

words.tr: adv. 花费不多地；廉价地
words.ex: She furnished her apartment inexpensively but stylishly.
words.ex_cn: 她以不贵的价格但时尚地布置了她的公寓。
words.en: If something is done inexpensively, it is done in a way that does not cost much money.

words.ex: The pollution affected the fish adversely.
words.ex_cn: 污染对鱼类造成了不利影响。
words.en: In a way that prevents success or development; harmfully or unfavorably.

words.ex: It rained heavily last night.
words.ex_cn: 昨晚雨下得很大。
words.en: To a great degree; in large amounts.

words.tr: adv. 意外地；出乎意料地；
words.ex: He arrived unexpectedly at my house.
words.ex_cn: 他意外地来到我家。
words.en: In a way that was not expected; surprisingly.

words.ex: He refused the money purely because it was wrong.
words.ex_cn: 他纯粹是因为觉得不对才拒绝了那笔钱。
words.en: In a pure manner; without admixture or adulteration.

words.ex: They live ecologically to protect the environment.
words.ex_cn: 他们以环保的方式生活以保护环境。
words.en: In a way that relates to ecology or the environment.

words.ex: The trip takes approximately 30 minutes.
words.ex_cn: 这段旅程大约需要30分钟。
words.en: Used to indicate that something is close to the actual, but not completely accurate or exact.

words.ex: He solved the math problem independently.
words.ex_cn: 他独立地解决了这道数学题。
words.en: In a way that is free from outside control; not depending on another's authority.

words.ex: He responded negatively to the proposal.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个提议持消极态度。
words.en: In a manner that is negative or pessimistic.

words.tr: adv. 逻辑上；合乎逻辑地；
words.ex: He solved the problem logically.
words.ex_cn: 他逻辑上解决了这个问题。
words.en: In a way that is reasonable and based on good judgment.

words.ex: He helped indirectly by giving advice.
words.ex_cn: 他通过提供建议间接地帮忙了。
words.en: In a way that is not direct; not in a straight line or course.

words.ex: He positively believes in his dream.
words.ex_cn: 他积极地相信自己的梦想。
words.en: In a positive manner; with certainty.

words.ex: The new phone is technologically advanced.
words.ex_cn: 这部新手机在技术上很先进。
words.en: In a way that relates to technology or the use of technology.

words.ex: She readily agreed to help me.
words.ex_cn: 她很容易就同意帮我了。
words.en: If you do something readily, you do it in a way which shows that you are very willing to do it.

words.ex: Historically, people used abacus for counting.
words.ex_cn: 历史上，人们用算盘进行计算。
words.en: In a way that relates to the study of past events.

words.ex: He will arrive shortly.
words.ex_cn: 他不久就会到。
words.en: In a short time; soon.

words.ex: The machine works internally without noise.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器内部运行时没有噪音。
words.en: Inside a particular place, organization, or thing.

words.tr: adv. 随意地；偶然地；漫不经心地
words.ex: He casually waved at his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他随意地向朋友挥了挥手。
words.en: In a way that suggests a lack of concern or seriousness.

words.ex: Paint the wall evenly.
words.ex_cn: 均匀地刷墙。
words.en: In a manner that is equal, uniform, or balanced.

words.ex: He smiled strangely when I asked him the question.
words.ex_cn: 当我问他问题时，他奇怪地笑了。
words.en: In a manner that is unusual or surprising; difficult to understand or explain.

words.ex: He is practically always late for class.
words.ex_cn: 他几乎总是上课迟到。
words.en: In a way that is almost true or almost the case; virtually.

words.ex: He dressed appropriately for the interview.
words.ex_cn: 他穿着得体地去参加了面试。
words.en: In a way that is suitable or proper in the circumstances.

words.ex: He picked a number randomly from the hat.
words.ex_cn: 他从帽子里随机抽了一个数字。
words.en: If something is done randomly, it is done without any definite plan, pattern, or purpose.

words.tr: adv. 无意地；不知不觉地
words.ex: He unconsciously tapped his foot while waiting.
words.ex_cn: 他等的时候无意识地敲着脚。
words.en: If you do something unconsciously, you do it without being aware of it.

words.tr: adv. 马上；迅速地；准时地；
words.ex: He answered the call promptly.
words.ex_cn: 他马上接了电话。
words.en: If you do something promptly, you do it immediately.

words.ex: He was late, so he left accordingly.
words.ex_cn: 他迟到了，于是相应地提前出发了。
words.en: In a way that is appropriate to the particular circumstances.

words.ex: Hopefully, it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 但愿明天会下雨。
words.en: If you say that something will happen hopefully, you mean that you wish it to happen or you think it is likely to happen.

words.ex: He cooked dinner; meantime, the kids did their homework.
words.ex_cn: 他做晚饭；与此同时，孩子们在做作业。
words.en: The time between one event and another; meanwhile.

words.ex: He folded his clothes neatly.
words.ex_cn: 他利索地叠好了衣服。
words.en: In a tidy and orderly manner.

words.ex: He was officially appointed as the new manager.
words.ex_cn: 他被正式任命为新经理。
words.en: In a formal or authoritative manner; according to the rules or laws.

words.ex: He formally accepted the award at the ceremony.
words.ex_cn: 他在仪式上正式接受了奖项。
words.en: in a formal manner

words.ex: He is politically active in his community.
words.ex_cn: 他在社区中积极参与政治事务。
words.en: In a way that relates to the government or public affairs of a country.

words.ex: He repeatedly asked for help.
words.ex_cn: 他再三地请求帮助。
words.en: If something is done repeatedly, it is done again and again.

words.ex: The children laughed spontaneously when they saw the puppy.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们看到小狗时自发地笑了。
words.en: If something happens spontaneously, it happens without being planned or organized, or without any external influence.

words.ex: Initially, he didn't like the job.
words.ex_cn: 最初，他不喜欢这份工作。
words.en: At the beginning; at first.

words.ex: He wiped the table with a cloth.
words.ex_cn: 他用一块布擦了桌子。
words.en: To wipe something means to clean or dry it by rubbing its surface with a cloth, a piece of paper, or your hand.

words.ex: The loud noise startle the bird.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的噪音惊动了那只鸟。
words.en: If something or someone startles you, they surprise and frighten you slightly.

words.ex: She sweeps the floor every morning.
words.ex_cn: 她每天早上扫地。
words.en: To clean an area by brushing away dirt or litter.

words.ex: He has a high fever and stays in bed.
words.ex_cn: 他发烧了，躺在床上休息。
words.en: A fever is a condition in which the body's temperature is higher than usual, often as a response to infection.

words.ex: He abandoned his car in the snow.
words.ex_cn: 他把车抛弃在雪地里。
words.en: If you abandon a place, thing, or person, you leave the place, thing, or person permanently or for a long time, especially when you should not do so.

words.tr:
n. 根；根源；
v. 生根；
words.ex: The root of 9 is 3.
words.ex_cn: 9的平方根是3。
words.en: The root of a plant is the part that grows underground and absorbs water and minerals. It can also refer to the origin or cause of something.

words.tr:
n. 更新；
v. 更新；升级；
words.ex: The app sent me a new update.
words.ex_cn: 应用程序给我发送了一个新更新。
words.en: To make something more modern or up to date, especially by adding new information or changing its design or style.

words.ex: They went on a long voyage across the ocean.
words.ex_cn: 他们进行了一次横跨海洋的长途航行。
words.en: A voyage is a long journey, especially by sea or in space.

words.ex: The bird glide smoothly over the lake.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿在湖面上滑行。
words.en: To move smoothly and continuously along, as if without effort or resistance.

words.tr:
v. 答复；回答；
n. 答复；回答；
words.ex: He replied to my message quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快回复了我的消息。
words.en: To reply means to say or write something as an answer to something that someone has said or written.

words.ex: He tried to bribe the officer with money.
words.ex_cn: 他试图用钱贿赂官员。
words.en: A bribe is a sum of money or something valuable that one person offers or gives to another in order to persuade them to do something, usually something dishonest.

words.ex: He burst into rage when he heard the news.
words.ex_cn: 当他听到这个消息时，他勃然大怒。
words.en: Rage is a feeling of intense anger that is difficult to control.

words.tr:
n. 犁；犁形器具
v. 犁；耕；艰苦前进
words.ex: The farmer uses a plow to turn the soil.
words.ex_cn: 农夫用犁翻土。
words.en: A plow is a farm tool with one or more heavy blades that breaks the soil and cuts a furrow for sowing seeds.

words.ex: I felt pity for the lonely child.
words.ex_cn: 我对那个孤独的孩子感到怜悯。
words.en: If you feel pity for someone, you feel very sorry for them.

words.tr:
n. 喷雾；
v. 喷洒；
words.ex: She used a spray to clean the window.
words.ex_cn: 她用喷雾清洁了窗户。
words.en: Spray can refer to a liquid that is blown or driven through the air in the form of tiny drops, or to the act of applying such a liquid.

words.tr:
v. 击；撞；
n. 撞击；敲击；
words.ex: He knock on the door.
words.ex_cn: 他敲了敲门。
words.en: To strike a surface noisily to attract attention, especially when waiting to be let in through a door.

words.tr:
adj. 精瘦的；精简的；不景气的；
v. 倾斜；倚靠；
words.ex: The dog is lean and fast.
words.ex_cn: 这只狗精瘦而敏捷。
words.en: If you lean in a particular direction, you bend your body in that direction. If you lean on or against someone or something, you rest against them so that they partly support your weight. If you describe someone as lean, you mean that they are thin but look strong and healthy. If you describe a period of time as lean, you mean that it is a time when people have very little of something, especially money.

words.ex: The sweater shrinks in hot water.
words.ex_cn: 这件毛衣在热水中会收缩。
words.en: If something shrinks or you shrink it, it becomes smaller.

words.tr:
n. 度假胜地；手段；
v. 求助于；
words.ex: They went to a beach resort for their vacation.
words.ex_cn: 他们去一个海滨度假胜地度假。
words.en: If you resort to a particular course of action, you do it because you cannot see any other way of achieving what you want.

words.tr:
n. 妥协；
v. 危及；
words.ex: They reached a compromise after hours of talk.
words.ex_cn: 经过数小时的讨论，他们达成了妥协。
words.en: A compromise is an agreement between two people or groups in which each side gives up some of the things they want so that both sides are happy at the end.

words.tr:
v. 牺牲；
n. 牺牲（品）；
words.ex: He sacrificed his time to help his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他牺牲了自己的时间来帮助朋友。
words.en: If you sacrifice something that is valuable or important, you give it up, usually to obtain something else for yourself or for other people.

words.tr:
v. 笑；发笑；
n. 笑；笑声；
words.ex: He laugh when he saw the funny cat.
words.ex_cn: 他看到那只滑稽的猫时笑了。
words.en: To laugh means to make the spontaneous sounds and movements of the face and body that are the instinctive expressions of lively amusement and sometimes also of derision.

words.tr:
n. 摇动；颤动；
v. 摇动；颤动；
words.ex: The shake of the car made me feel sick.
words.ex_cn: 汽车的摇动让我感到恶心。
words.en: To move or cause to move with quick, short movements from side to side or up and down.

words.tr:
v. 移栽；移植；
n. 移植；
words.ex: He will transplant the flowers to the garden tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天要把这些花移栽到花园里。
words.en: To transplant something means to move it from one place to another. In medicine, to transplant an organ, piece of skin, etc. means to use it to replace a damaged part in someone's body.

words.tr:
v. 拖；拉；拖运；
n. 拖；拉；拖运；
words.ex: He hauled the heavy box across the room.
words.ex_cn: 他把沉重的箱子拖过了房间。
words.en: To haul something means to pull it or carry it with a lot of effort.

words.ex: The roller coaster gave her a thrill.
words.ex_cn: 过山车让她感到兴奋。
words.en: A thrill is a sudden feeling of great excitement, pleasure, or fear.

words.tr:
n. 制造；
v. （用机器大量）制造；虚构；捏造；
words.ex: The manufacture of cars needs many workers.
words.ex_cn: 汽车的制造需要很多工人。
words.en: To manufacture something means to make it in a factory, usually in large quantities.

words.tr: v. 重获；夺回；收复；回想
words.ex: He tried to recapture his childhood joy.
words.ex_cn: 他试图重新捕捉童年的快乐。
words.en: To recapture something means to catch it again after it has escaped or been lost, or to experience again a feeling or situation that you had in the past.

words.tr:
n. 索具装备；钻探设备；装备
v. 配备索具；操纵；舞弊
words.ex: He uses a rig to hold the camera steady.
words.ex_cn: 他用一个支架来固定相机。
words.en: To rig something means to arrange or set it up in a particular way, often in a temporary or makeshift manner. It can also refer to the equipment used in drilling for oil or gas, or the sails and ropes on a ship.

words.tr:
n. 之字形；锯齿形；
adj. 之字形的；曲折的；锯齿形的；
words.ex: The road makes a zigzag up the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 这条路沿着山呈之字形向上延伸。
words.en: A zigzag is a line that has a series of angles in it, like a continuous series of 'W's. It can also describe a path or route that proceeds by sharp turns in alternating directions.

words.tr: n. 安全；保障；防护措施；
words.ex: The school improved security to protect students.
words.ex_cn: 学校加强了安全措施以保护学生。
words.en: Security refers to the state of being free from danger or threat, or measures taken to ensure safety.

words.tr:
n. 安逸；轻松；
v. 缓解；减轻；
words.ex: He enjoys the ease of living in a quiet village.
words.ex_cn: 他享受住在安静村庄里的安逸。
words.en: If you talk about the ease of a particular activity, you are referring to the way that it has been made easier to do, or to the fact that it is already easy to do. Ease is also a state of being comfortable and without worry or anxiety.

words.ex: The ring is made of platinum.
words.ex_cn: 这个戒指是铂金做的。
words.en: Platinum is a precious metal, silver-white in color, that is used especially in jewelry and in industry.

words.ex: This book has three editions.
words.ex_cn: 这本书有三个版次。
words.en: An edition is a particular version of a book, magazine, or newspaper that is printed at one time.

words.ex: The peninsula is surrounded by water on three sides.
words.ex_cn: 这个半岛三面环水。
words.en: A peninsula is a piece of land that is almost entirely surrounded by water but is connected to the mainland on one side.

words.ex: The singer sang with piano accompaniment.
words.ex_cn: 歌手在钢琴伴奏下演唱。
words.en: An accompaniment is a musical part which supports or partners a solo instrument, voice, or group.

words.ex: He used a long rod to reach the top shelf.
words.ex_cn: 他用一根长杆够到顶层架子。
words.en: A rod is a long, thin, straight bar, especially one made of wood or metal.

words.ex: He filed a complaint about the noisy neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 他投诉了吵闹的邻居。
words.en: A complaint is a statement in which you express your dissatisfaction with a particular situation.

words.ex: The runner won the race quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这位跑步者很快赢得了比赛。
words.en: A runner is a person who runs, especially in a race or as a sport.

words.tr:
n. 壁画
v. 作壁画
words.ex: The artist painted a fresco on the church wall.
words.ex_cn: 这位艺术家在教堂的墙上画了一幅湿壁画。
words.en: A fresco is a picture that is painted on a plastered wall when the plaster is still wet.

words.ex: He sits by the fireplace in winter.
words.ex_cn: 冬天他坐在壁炉旁。
words.en: A fireplace is a place built into a wall where you can have a fire, especially in a house.

words.ex: The fence marks the boundary between the two gardens.
words.ex_cn: 这道围栏标志着两个花园的分界线。
words.en: A boundary is a real or imagined line that marks the edge or limit of something.

words.ex: The main criterion for winning is fairness.
words.ex_cn: 获胜的主要标准是公平。
words.en: A criterion is a principle or standard by which something may be judged or decided.

words.ex: The stock market shows daily fluctuation.
words.ex_cn: 股票市场每天都有波动。
words.en: A fluctuation is a change in something, especially in a continuous process such as temperature, prices, or levels of activity.

words.ex: The lion's predation helps control the deer population.
words.ex_cn: 狮子的捕食有助于控制鹿群的数量。
words.en: The act of preying by a predator, especially the killing and eating of an animal by another animal.

words.ex: He ate a bowl of chocolate pudding after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后吃了一碗巧克力布丁。
words.en: A pudding is a cooked sweet dish made with flour, fat, and eggs, and usually served hot.

words.ex: The layout of the room makes it feel bigger.
words.ex_cn: 房间的布局让它显得更大。
words.en: The way in which the parts of something are arranged or laid out.

words.tr:
n. 珍宝；宝物；财富；
v. 珍惜；
words.ex: The old map showed where the treasure was buried.
words.ex_cn: 那张旧地图显示了珍宝埋藏的地方。
words.en: If you treasure something that you have, you keep it or care for it carefully because it gives you great pleasure and you think it is very special.

words.ex: The tailor made a new suit for the man.
words.ex_cn: 裁缝为这位男士做了一套新西装。
words.en: A tailor is a person whose job is to make men's clothes, especially suits, jackets, and trousers, that fit individual customers. As a verb, to tailor means to make or adapt something for a particular purpose or person.

words.ex: The rainbow appears after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 雨后出现了彩虹。
words.en: A rainbow is an arch of different colors that appears in the sky when the sun shines through rain.

words.ex: The boxes are stored in the warehouse.
words.ex_cn: 这些箱子存放在仓库里。
words.en: A warehouse is a large building where raw materials or manufactured goods may be stored before their export or distribution for sale.

words.ex: He worked overtime to finish the project.
words.ex_cn: 他加班完成了这个项目。
words.en: Overtime refers to the time worked beyond one's regular working hours, often with additional pay.

words.ex: The tide comes in every twelve hours.
words.ex_cn: 潮汐每十二小时涨一次。
words.en: The tide is the regular change in the level of the sea on the shore.

words.ex: The king lives in a big castle.
words.ex_cn: 国王住在一座大城堡里。
words.en: A castle is a large building or group of buildings fortified against attack with thick walls, battlements, towers, and in many cases a moat.

words.ex: Follow the procedure step by step.
words.ex_cn: 一步一步地按照步骤进行。
words.en: A procedure is a way of doing something, especially the usual or correct way.

words.ex: The dimension of the box is 10 cm by 5 cm.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子的尺寸是10厘米乘5厘米。
words.en: A dimension is a measurement of something in a particular direction, or the scope or scale of something.

words.ex: The publisher released a new book last month.
words.ex_cn: 出版者上个月发布了一本新书。
words.en: A publisher is a person or company that prepares and issues books, journals, or music for sale.

words.ex: He read a biography of Nelson Mandela.
words.ex_cn: 他读了一本关于纳尔逊·曼德拉的传记。
words.en: A biography is a detailed description of a person's life. It involves more than just the basic facts like education, work, relationships, and death; it portrays a person's experience of these life events.

words.ex: The legend says a dragon lives in the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 传说有一条龙住在山里。
words.en: A legend is a very old and popular story that may be true or may be imaginary.

words.ex: The painting is a beautiful creation of the artist.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画是艺术家的一个美丽作品。
words.en: The act or process of bringing something into existence.

words.ex: The constrictor controls the flow of blood in the artery.
words.ex_cn: 这个括约肌控制动脉中的血流。
words.en: A constrictor is a snake that kills its prey by coiling around it and squeezing it until it cannot breathe.

words.ex: The gorilla sits quietly in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 大猩猩静静地坐在森林里。
words.en: A gorilla is a large, powerful ape that is native to the forests of central Africa. Gorillas are the largest living primates and are closely related to humans.

words.ex: The islander fishes every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这个岛民每天早上捕鱼。
words.en: An islander is a person who lives on an island.

words.ex: The arrival of the train was delayed by 20 minutes.
words.ex_cn: 火车的到达晚了20分钟。
words.en: The act of coming to a place or the moment when something or someone arrives.

words.ex: He gave her a sincere apology.
words.ex_cn: 他向她真诚地道歉了。
words.en: An apology is something that you say or write in order to tell someone that you are sorry that you have hurt them or caused trouble for them.

words.tr:
n. 等级；
v. 分等级；
words.ex: He earned a high rank in the army.
words.ex_cn: 他在军队中获得了很高的等级。
words.en: If you rank things or people, you arrange them in order of importance or quality. If someone or something ranks in a particular position, they are in that position on a scale that measures something such as importance or quality.

words.ex: The mantle lies below the Earth's crust.
words.ex_cn: 地幔位于地球地壳之下。
words.en: The mantle is the part of the earth between the crust and the core. It can also refer to a cloak or covering.

words.ex: The map shows the topography of the mountain area.
words.ex_cn: 这张地图显示了山区的地形。
words.en: The topography of an area is the physical features of its surface, such as hills, valleys, and rivers, especially the representation of these features on maps.

words.ex: The earthquake shook the houses last night.
words.ex_cn: 昨晚地震震动了房屋。
words.en: An earthquake is a sudden shaking of the ground caused by the passage of seismic waves through Earth's rocks.

words.tr:
n. 地中海；
adj. 地中海的；
words.ex: He sailed across the Mediterranean last summer.
words.ex_cn: 他去年夏天横渡了地中海。
words.en: relating to the Mediterranean Sea or the countries around it

words.ex: The landowner rented his fields to farmers.
words.ex_cn: 地主把他的田地租给了农民。
words.en: A landowner is a person who owns land, especially a large amount of land.

words.ex: The sculptor carved a statue from stone.
words.ex_cn: 这位雕刻家从石头中雕刻出一座雕像。
words.en: A sculptor is an artist who creates sculptures.

words.ex: The angler sits by the river and waits for fish.
words.ex_cn: 钓鱼的人坐在河边等待鱼上钩。
words.en: An angler is someone who fishes with a fishing rod as a hobby or sport.

words.ex: The sun is at its zenith at noon.
words.ex_cn: 太阳在正午时分达到最高点。
words.en: The zenith is the time at which something is most powerful or successful.

words.ex: In the sentence 'She runs', 'runs' is a verb.
words.ex_cn: 在句子 'She runs' 中，'runs' 是一个动词。
words.en: A word that is used to describe an action, state, or occurrence, and forming the main part of the predicate of a sentence, such as 'run', 'become', or 'happen'.

words.ex: His motive was to help his family.
words.ex_cn: 他的动机是帮助家人。
words.en: Your motive for doing something is your reason for doing it.

words.tr: n. 蝰蛇；毒蛇；阴险恶毒的人
words.ex: The viper's venom is highly toxic.
words.ex_cn: 这种毒蛇的毒液有极高的毒性。
words.en: A viper is a type of snake that has long, hollow fangs through which it injects venom into its prey or enemies.

words.tr:
n. 毒药；毒物；
v. 毒害；
words.ex: The snake's poison can kill quickly.
words.ex_cn: 蛇的毒药能迅速致死。
words.en: A poison is a substance that causes harm or death if it is swallowed, absorbed, or breathed in. It can also refer to something that has a very harmful effect on something else.

words.ex: He changed his hairstyle last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周换了发型。
words.en: A hairstyle is the way in which someone's hair is cut and arranged.

words.tr: adj. 一定会；密切相关的；有义务的； v. “bind”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He is bound to win the race.
words.ex_cn: 他一定会赢得比赛。
words.en: If one person, thing, or situation is bound to another, they are closely connected with each other, and it is difficult for them to be separated or to escape from each other. If you say that something is bound to happen, you mean that you are sure it will happen, because it is a natural consequence of something that is already known or exists.

words.ex: The scope of this project includes three cities.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目的范围包括三个城市。
words.en: The range of one's perceptions, thoughts, or actions.

words.ex: The mode of transportation is a bike.
words.ex_cn: 出行的方式是骑自行车。
words.en: A mode is a particular way or style in which something is done or experienced.

words.ex: The store offers an assortment of snacks.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店提供各种各样的零食。
words.en: An assortment is a group of similar things that are of different types or sizes.

words.ex: The software includes a sophisticated syntax analyzer.
words.ex_cn: 该软件包含一个复杂的语法分析器。
words.en: An analyzer is a person or device that analyzes something, especially in order to determine its nature or to examine it systematically.

words.ex: The ancient tomb was filled with artifacts.
words.ex_cn: 这座古老的坟墓里充满了文物。
words.en: A tomb is a place where a dead person is buried, especially a large, impressive structure.

words.ex: He made the payment online.
words.ex_cn: 他在线支付了。
words.en: A payment is an amount of money that is paid to someone, or the act of paying this money.

words.tr: phrase. 覆盖范围的文字说明；用于描述某项服务或产品覆盖区域的标注文字
words.ex: The map includes a coverage lettering that explains the service areas.
words.ex_cn: 这张地图包含了一段文字说明，解释了服务范围。
words.en: Text or lettering used to describe or provide information about an insurance policy's coverage.

words.ex: The company values innovation in its products.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司重视产品的创新。
words.en: Innovation is the introduction of new ideas, methods, or things.

words.ex: The plant grows from a rhizome under the soil.
words.ex_cn: 这种植物从土壤下的根茎生长。
words.en: A rhizome is a horizontal, usually underground stem of a plant that often sends out roots and shoots from its nodes.

words.ex: The country's industrialization began in the 1950s.
words.ex_cn: 该国的工业化始于20世纪50年代。
words.en: The process by which an economy is transformed from primarily agricultural to one based on the manufacturing of goods. Individual manual labor is often replaced by mechanized mass production, and craftsmen are replaced by assembly lines.

words.tr: n. 公告；布告；公报；新闻简报；
words.ex: The school posted a bulletin about the holiday schedule.
words.ex_cn: 学校张贴了一份关于假期安排的公告。
words.en: A bulletin is a short news report on the radio or television. A bulletin is also a short printed newspaper or leaflet that gives information about a particular group or organization.

words.tr: n. 投稿人；贡献者；因素；
words.ex: He is a contributor to the local newspaper.
words.ex_cn: 他是当地报纸的投稿人。
words.en: A contributor is someone who gives something, such as money, time, or ideas, to help achieve or provide something.

words.ex: The nail fits into the groove.
words.ex_cn: 钉子卡在槽里。
words.en: A groove is a long, narrow space or cut in a surface, often made to guide the movement of something or to hold something in place. It can also refer to a settled routine or way of doing things that is hard to change.

words.ex: The ancient Romans built an aqueduct to bring water to the city.
words.ex_cn: 古罗马人建造了一条渡槽来为城市供水。
words.en: An aqueduct is a structure designed to carry water from a remote source to a desired location, often using gravity as the driving force. It is a critical component of urban water supply systems, especially in ancient civilizations.

words.ex: He eats cereal with milk every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃谷类食品配牛奶。
words.en: A cereal is a grass that is cultivated for the edible components of its grain, composed of the endosperm, germ, and bran.

words.ex: He plays the drum in a band.
words.ex_cn: 他在乐队里打鼓。
words.en: A drum is a musical instrument consisting of a skin stretched tightly over a round frame. You play it by hitting it with sticks or with your hands.

words.ex: The employer gave her a raise.
words.ex_cn: 雇主给她加了薪。
words.en: An employer is a person or organization that employs people, paying them for their work.

words.ex: His viewpoint is different from mine.
words.ex_cn: 他的观点与我的不同。
words.en: A viewpoint is a particular way of thinking about something, especially one that is influenced by your experiences or beliefs.

words.ex: Farmers use irrigation to water their crops.
words.ex_cn: 农民使用灌溉来浇灌庄稼。
words.en: Irrigation is the process of supplying water to land or crops to help growth, typically by means of channels.

words.ex: The expanse of the desert stretched far beyond the horizon.
words.ex_cn: 沙漠的辽阔延伸到了地平线之外。
words.en: An expanse is a wide and open area or surface.

words.ex: The town is near the frontier of the country.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇靠近国家的边境。
words.en: A frontier is a border between two countries or the area close to it. It can also refer to the limit of knowledge or the most advanced or recent stage in the development of something.

words.ex: The orange was squeezed into a sweet pulp.
words.ex_cn: 橙子被榨成了甜美的浆状物。
words.en: The soft, wet, shapeless mass of material that is left after the juice has been removed from fruit or vegetables, or the soft inner part of a tooth.

words.ex: The children ran down the hallway.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在走廊里奔跑。
words.en: A hallway is a long passage inside a building with doors leading off to rooms on either side.

words.tr:
adj. 海滨的；靠海的
n. 海滩
words.ex: They own a beautiful beachfront property.
words.ex_cn: 他们拥有一处美丽的海滨房产。
words.en: The area of land next to a beach, often considered desirable for residential or commercial development.

words.ex: The fish swim above the seabed.
words.ex_cn: 鱼在海床上方游动。
words.en: The seabed is the bottom of the ocean, consisting of various sediments and rocks.

words.ex: He carried his baggage to the airport.
words.ex_cn: 他把行李带到了机场。
words.en: Baggage refers to the suitcases and bags that you take with you when you travel, or it can refer to emotional issues that someone carries with them from past experiences.

words.tr: n. 航空邮件；航空邮政
words.ex: He sent the letter by airmail.
words.ex_cn: 他通过航空邮件寄出了这封信。
words.en: Airmail is the system of sending letters, parcels, and other items by air, which is faster than sending them by land or sea.

words.tr:
v. 合唱；异口同声地说
n. 合唱团；合唱
words.ex: They chorus when the song reaches the bridge.
words.ex_cn: 当歌曲进行到桥段时，他们一起合唱。
words.en: A chorus is a part of a song which is repeated after each verse, or a group of people who sing together.

words.ex: The birds live in the mangrove near the sea.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿生活在海边的红树林里。
words.en: A mangrove is a tropical maritime tree or shrub of the genus Rhizophora, characterized by its tangled roots that grow above ground and form dense thickets.

words.tr:
adj. 红外线的
n. 红外线
words.ex: The remote uses infrared to change the TV channel.
words.ex_cn: 遥控器使用红外线来切换电视频道。
words.en: Infrared refers to the region of the electromagnetic spectrum with wavelengths longer than visible light but shorter than microwaves, often used in technology for night vision and heat sensing.

words.ex: The thickness of the ice is dangerous.
words.ex_cn: 冰的厚度很危险。
words.en: The quality or state of being thick, especially the distance between opposite surfaces of an object.

words.ex: He took a deep breath before jumping.
words.ex_cn: 他跳之前深吸了一口气。
words.en: The air taken into or expelled from the lungs.

words.ex: The roses are in bloom in spring.
words.ex_cn: 玫瑰在春天开花。
words.en: When a plant or tree blooms, it produces flowers. The period during which a plant or tree produces flowers is also known as its bloom.

words.ex: He drew a loop with the pencil.
words.ex_cn: 他用铅笔画了一个圈。
words.en: A loop is a shape produced by a curve that bends round and crosses itself, or a piece of wire, string, etc. that has this shape. It can also refer to a repeated sequence of operations or events in a computer program or in a process.

words.ex: The restoration of the old house took two years.
words.ex_cn: 这座老房子的修复花了两年时间。
words.en: The act of returning something to its original condition, or the state of being returned to its original condition.

words.ex: He works as an accountant in a small company.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家小公司当会计师。
words.en: An accountant is a person whose job is to keep, inspect, and analyze financial accounts.

words.ex: He used a torch to find his keys in the dark.
words.ex_cn: 他用手电筒在黑暗中找钥匙。
words.en: A torch is a stick with a flame on one end that is used as a source of light, or a portable battery-powered electric lamp.

words.ex: The accumulation of snow made the road dangerous.
words.ex_cn: 积雪使道路变得危险。
words.en: The process by which something increases in amount or is collected together over time.

words.ex: The police discovered a scheme to steal money.
words.ex_cn: 警方发现了一个偷钱的阴谋。
words.en: A scheme is a plan or arrangement, especially one produced by a government or other organization, or a secret plan to do something, especially something illegal or dishonest.

words.ex: I use a planner to write down my daily tasks.
words.ex_cn: 我用计划表记录每天的任务。
words.en: A planner is someone who makes plans, especially someone whose job is to do this.

words.tr:
n. 柜台；
v. 抵消；反驳；
adv. 相反地；
words.ex: The customer paid at the counter.
words.ex_cn: 顾客在柜台付款。
words.en: A counter is a long flat surface in a shop or bank on which customers are served. It can also refer to a device that counts something, or an action taken to oppose something.

words.tr:
n. 记数；
v. 合计；
words.ex: He kept a tally of how many goals he scored.
words.ex_cn: 他记录了自己进了多少球。
words.en: A tally is a record of amounts or numbers which you keep changing and adding to as the activity which affects it progresses.

words.ex: The doctor gave him a small dose of medicine.
words.ex_cn: 医生给了他一小剂量的药。
words.en: A dose of a medicine or a drug is the amount of it that you take at one time, or the amount that is recommended for you to take.

words.tr: n. 减缓；宽慰；解脱；救济；
words.ex: The medicine brought relief to his pain.
words.ex_cn: 这种药缓解了他的疼痛。
words.en: Relief is a feeling of reassurance and relaxation following release from anxiety or distress.

words.ex: The hunter shot an arrow at the target.
words.ex_cn: 猎人向目标射了一支箭。
words.en: An arrow is a long thin weapon which is sharp and pointed at one end and which often has feathers at the other end. Arrows are shot from a bow.

words.ex: He listened to a beautiful symphony last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚听了一首美妙的交响乐。
words.en: A symphony is a long piece of music that is usually in four parts and is performed by an orchestra.

words.ex: I found a great bargain at the market.
words.ex_cn: 我在市场上找到了一件便宜货。
words.en: A bargain is an agreement between two people or groups in which each promises to do something in exchange for something else. It can also refer to something bought or offered for sale much more cheaply than is usual or expected.

words.ex: The teacher gave us the syllabus for the course.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我们这门课的教学大纲。
words.en: A syllabus is an outline or summary of the main points of a text, lecture, or course of study.

words.ex: The receptor detects the signal from the hormone.
words.ex_cn: 受体检测激素的信号。
words.en: A receptor is a cell or a group of cells that receives stimuli.

words.ex: The students learned the anatomy of the human heart.
words.ex_cn: 学生们学习了人类心脏的解剖组织构造。
words.en: Anatomy is the study of the structure of the bodies of people or animals.

words.ex: He put mustard on his sandwich.
words.ex_cn: 他在三明治上加了芥末。
words.en: A pungent yellow or brown paste made from the ground seeds of certain plants, used as a condiment.

words.tr: n. 紧张；紧张局势；紧张关系；
words.ex: There was tension between the two friends after the argument.
words.ex_cn: 两人争吵后，彼此之间出现了紧张。
words.en: Tension is a feeling of worry and anxiety which makes it difficult for you to relax. It can also refer to the state of being stretched tight or the degree of tightness of a stretched string, wire, etc.

words.tr: n. 锦标赛；冠军赛；冠军的身份；
words.ex: He won the championship last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年赢得了锦标赛。
words.en: A championship is a competition to find the best player or team in a particular sport or game.

words.tr: n. 进入；入口；条目；参与；参赛作品；
words.ex: The entry to the building is locked after 10 PM.
words.ex_cn: 建筑物在晚上10点后进入通道会被锁上。
words.en: An entry is the act of going into a place or the right to go into it. It can also refer to a door, gate, or passage by which you enter a place. Additionally, an entry can be a piece of information recorded in a book, list, or computer, or the act of recording it.

words.ex: The refinement of the machine made it faster.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器的改进使它更快了。
words.en: Refinement is the process of making a substance pure or the quality of being polite, well-educated, and able to judge the quality of things.

words.ex: The inhabitant lives in a small house.
words.ex_cn: 这位居民住在一所小房子里。
words.en: An inhabitant of a place is one of the people who live there.

words.ex: He felt deep depression after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后感到深深的抑郁。
words.en: A period during which business, employment, and stock-market values decline severely or remain at a very low level of activity.

words.tr: n. 可能发生的情况；设想；
words.ex: It's a possible scenario that it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 明天会下雨是一个可能发生的情况。
words.en: A scenario is a description of a possible course of action or events.

words.ex: He is a famous playwright who writes plays.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位著名的剧作家，写剧本。
words.en: A playwright is a person who writes plays.

words.ex: He drinks coffee to get caffeine.
words.ex_cn: 他喝咖啡来获取咖啡因。
words.en: A bitter alkaloid found in coffee and tea that is responsible for their stimulating effects.

words.ex: Bread and rice are rich in carbohydrate.
words.ex_cn: 面包和米饭富含碳水化合物。
words.en: A carbohydrate is a substance found in foods such as bread, potatoes, and rice which provides your body with heat and energy and which consists of carbon, hydrogen, and oxygen.

words.ex: The doctor gave me an antibiotic for my infection.
words.ex_cn: 医生给我开了抗菌素治疗感染。
words.en: A substance that can kill or inhibit the growth of bacteria and other microorganisms.

words.ex: She ate a slice of toast for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 她早餐吃了一片烤面包。
words.en: Toast is bread which has been cut into slices and made brown and crisp by cooking at a high temperature. Toast is also a drink in which you wish someone happiness or success.

words.ex: The room has air-conditioning to keep it cool.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间有空调来保持凉爽。
words.en: a system that keeps the air in a building cool and dry

words.ex: The width of the table is one meter.
words.ex_cn: 桌子的宽度是一米。
words.en: The width of something is the distance it measures from one side to the other.

words.ex: The miners dug deep to find iron ore.
words.ex_cn: 矿工们深入地下寻找铁矿石。
words.en: Ore is rock or earth from which metal can be obtained.

words.ex: The eagle's cere turned a bright yellow during the mating season.
words.ex_cn: 鹰的蜡膜在繁殖季节变成了鲜黄色。
words.en: The cere is a soft, waxy swelling at the base of the upper beak in certain birds, such as parrots, pigeons, and raptors, which helps in the sense of smell.

words.ex: We heard thunder during the storm.
words.ex_cn: 风暴期间我们听到了雷声。
words.en: the loud noise that you hear during a storm, usually after a flash of lightning

words.ex: The prism splits sunlight into seven colors.
words.ex_cn: 棱镜将阳光分解成七种颜色。
words.en: A prism is a transparent optical element with flat, polished surfaces that refract light. At least two of the flat surfaces must have an angle between them. The exact angles between the surfaces depend on the application. The traditional geometrical shape is that of a triangular prism with a triangular base and rectangular sides, and in colloquial use 'prism' usually refers to this type.

words.ex: The departure of the train was at 8 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 火车的出发时间是晚上8点。
words.en: The act of leaving a place, especially at the start of a journey.

words.ex: The invention of the wheel was a landmark in human history.
words.ex_cn: 轮子的发明是人类历史上的一个里程碑。
words.en: A landmark is a building or feature of a landscape that is easily seen and recognized from a distance, especially one that enables someone to establish their location.

words.ex: The two countries formed a union to strengthen trade.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家组成了一个联盟以加强贸易。
words.en: An organization of workers formed to protect their rights and interests; the act of joining two or more things together.

words.ex: The park is in the vicinity of my house.
words.ex_cn: 公园在我家附近。
words.en: The area or region near or about a place; the surrounding district.

words.tr: n. 录音；录制； v. 记录；录制；“record”的现在分词；
words.ex: I listened to the recording of the lecture.
words.ex_cn: 我听了讲座的录音。
words.en: A recording is a piece of music or speech that has been recorded, or the process of making such a record.

words.ex: The camel walks slowly across the desert.
words.ex_cn: 骆驼缓慢地走过沙漠。
words.en: A camel is a large animal that lives in the desert and has one or two humps on its back.

words.ex: The traveler walked through the forest.
words.ex_cn: 这位旅行者穿过森林。
words.en: A traveler is a person who is traveling or who often travels.

words.ex: He bought a guidebook for his trip to Paris.
words.ex_cn: 他为去巴黎旅行买了一本旅游指南。
words.en: A guidebook is a book that gives tourists information about a town, area, or country.

words.ex: The ship dropped its anchor in the harbor.
words.ex_cn: 船在港口放下了锚。
words.en: An anchor is a heavy object that is dropped from a boat or a ship into the water to prevent the vessel from moving.

words.ex: The cat sat in the doorway.
words.ex_cn: 猫坐在门口。
words.en: A doorway is the space in a wall where a door opens and closes, or the covered area just outside a door.

words.ex: An elk walked near the forest edge.
words.ex_cn: 一只驼鹿在森林边缘走动。
words.en: An elk is a large deer with big antlers that lives in the forests of North America and parts of Europe and Asia.

words.tr: n. 民族主义；国家主义；
words.ex: Nationalism made people proud of their own country.
words.ex_cn: 民族主义让人们为自己的国家感到自豪。
words.en: Nationalism is a political, social, and economic ideology and movement characterized by the promotion of the interests of a particular nation, especially with the aim of gaining and maintaining the nation's sovereignty over its homeland.

words.ex: Noun is a word for a person, place, or thing.
words.ex_cn: 名词是表示人、地方或事物的词。
words.en: A noun is a word that refers to a person, place, thing, event, substance, or quality.

words.ex: There is friction between the two neighbors over the fence.
words.ex_cn: 两个邻居因为篱笆问题产生了不和。
words.en: The resistance that one surface or object encounters when moving over another.

words.ex: The factory buys lumber to make furniture.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂购买木材来制造家具。
words.en: Lumber refers to wood that has been processed into beams and planks, a stage in the process of wood production. It is also used to describe the action of moving in a slow, heavy, awkward way.

words.ex: He eats a papaya every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃一个木瓜。
words.en: A papaya is a large oval fruit with green skin, sweet orange flesh, and small black seeds.

words.ex: The Woodhouse was filled with stacks of firewood.
words.ex_cn: 木柴间堆满了木柴。
words.en: A surname, possibly referring to a person or place, such as Woodhouse in the UK.

words.ex: The rodent ran quickly across the floor.
words.ex_cn: 这只啮齿动物迅速跑过地板。
words.en: A rodent is a small mammal which has sharp front teeth that it uses for gnawing. Rodents include rats, mice, and squirrels.

words.tr: n. 下水道；排水沟；缝纫者
words.ex: The sewer smells bad after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 下雨后，下水道闻起来很难闻。
words.en: A sewer is a large underground channel that carries off waste water and refuse.

words.ex: He said a prayer before bed.
words.ex_cn: 他睡前做了一次祈祷。
words.en: A prayer is a form of religious practice in which people communicate with a deity or spirit, often to ask for help or to give thanks.

words.ex: He works in meteorology and predicts the weather.
words.ex_cn: 他从事气象学工作，预测天气。
words.en: Meteorology is the scientific study of the atmosphere and of atmospheric conditions, especially as they relate to weather and weather forecasting.

words.ex: The prospect of a better job makes him happy.
words.ex_cn: 更好工作的前景让他感到高兴。
words.en: A prospect is the possibility that something will happen, or a view of a wide area.

words.ex: The invasion of privacy is a serious problem.
words.ex_cn: 侵犯隐私是一个严重的问题。
words.en: An invasion is an instance of invading a country or region with an armed force.

words.ex: He misses his youth when he played football every day.
words.ex_cn: 他怀念每天踢足球的青春时光。
words.en: The period of your life when you are young, or the state of being young.

words.tr:
adj. 青少年的；幼稚的；
n. 少年；
words.ex: The book is written for juvenile readers.
words.ex_cn: 这本书是为青少年读者撰写的。
words.en: A juvenile is a child or young person who is not yet old enough to be considered an adult.

words.tr: n. 洗涤剂；洗衣粉；去垢剂；
words.ex: She uses detergent to wash the clothes.
words.ex_cn: 她用洗涤剂洗衣服。
words.en: A detergent is a substance that is used for cleaning things, especially clothes and dishes.

words.ex: The drawback of this phone is its short battery life.
words.ex_cn: 这款手机的缺点是电池续航时间短。
words.en: A drawback is a feature of something that makes it less useful or desirable than it could be.

words.ex: We took a detour to avoid the traffic.
words.ex_cn: 我们绕道以避开交通拥堵。
words.en: A detour is a longer, less direct way to go somewhere, used to avoid a problem or to visit something along the way.

words.tr: n. 人性；人类；人道；仁慈；
words.ex: Kindness shows the best of humanity.
words.ex_cn: 善良展现了人性中最美好的一面。
words.en: Humanity refers to all human beings collectively or the qualities that make us human, such as kindness, compassion, and the ability to reason.

words.ex: The birds sing at daylight.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿在日光下歌唱。
words.en: Daylight is the natural light that comes from the sun during the day.

words.ex: The rabbit ate a green clover in the field.
words.ex_cn: 兔子在田野里吃了一株三叶草。
words.en: Clover is a small plant with leaves that have three rounded parts, often used as food for animals.

words.ex: The businessman sold his products to many countries.
words.ex_cn: 这位商人把他的产品卖到了许多国家。
words.en: A businessman is a man who works in business, especially at a high level.

words.ex: The trader sells fruits every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这位商人每天早上卖水果。
words.en: A trader is a person who buys and sells goods, currencies, or shares.

words.tr: n. 渗透；渗透作用；潜移默化
words.ex: Water moves by osmosis through a thin membrane.
words.ex_cn: 水通过半透膜以渗透的方式移动。
words.en: Osmosis is the process by which a liquid passes through a membrane from a less concentrated solution into a more concentrated one.

words.ex: The university has great prestige for its research.
words.ex_cn: 这所大学因其研究而享有很高的声望。
words.en: The widespread respect and admiration felt for someone or something on the basis of a perception of their achievements or quality.

words.ex: He tied the box with a red cord.
words.ex_cn: 他用一根红绳把盒子绑了起来。
words.en: A cord is a thick string or thin rope made of twisted strands, or something resembling such a string or rope in appearance or function.

words.tr:
n. 圣歌；赞美诗；喊叫
v. 吟唱；诵扬；反复叫喊
words.ex: The monks sang a traditional chant during the morning prayer.
words.ex_cn: 修道士们在晨祷时唱了一首传统圣歌。
words.en: A chant is a word or group of words that is repeated over and over again. It can also refer to a simple song, especially one that is sung in a religious service.

words.tr:
adj. 剩余的；
n. 残留物；
words.ex: We ate the leftover food for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 我们早餐吃了剩下的食物。
words.en: Remaining after the rest has been used, consumed, or dealt with.

words.ex: The humidity in the room made the air feel heavy.
words.ex_cn: 房间里的湿度让空气感觉很闷。
words.en: Humidity is the amount of water vapor in the air. High humidity makes the air feel wet and sticky.

words.ex: He did an internship at a hospital last summer.
words.ex_cn: 去年夏天，他在一家医院实习。
words.en: An internship is a period of work experience offered by an organization for a limited period of time. It is typically undertaken by students and graduates looking to gain relevant skills and experience in a particular field.

words.ex: The captain sailed the ship across the ocean.
words.ex_cn: 船长驾驶船穿越了海洋。
words.en: A captain is the person in charge of a ship or an aircraft, or a leader of a team or group.

words.ex: He put his books on the bookshelf.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放在书架上。
words.en: A piece of furniture with shelves for storing books.

words.tr: n. 树干；大衣箱；象鼻子；
words.ex: The elephant held the branch with its trunk.
words.ex_cn: 大象用它的鼻子抓住树枝。
words.en: The main stem of a tree, below the branches, and above the ground; the main part of the body, excluding the head, arms, and legs; the long, flexible nose of an elephant; a large, strong box used for transporting or storing clothes and other personal possessions.

words.ex: He bought a stake in the new company.
words.ex_cn: 他购买了这家新公司的股份。
words.en: A stake is a pointed stick or post that is pushed into the ground, for example to support a young tree. It can also refer to a share or interest in a business, situation, or system.

words.ex: He is a famous mathematician.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位著名的数学家。
words.en: A mathematician is a person who is an expert in mathematics, a field that uses numbers, formulas, and logical reasoning to solve problems.

words.ex: He filled the bucket with water from the well.
words.ex_cn: 他从井里打了一桶水。
words.en: A bucket is a round container with a handle, used for carrying liquids or other substances.

words.tr:
n. 服务人员
adj. 随之而来的
words.ex: The attendant helped me find my seat.
words.ex_cn: 服务员帮我找到了座位。
words.en: An attendant is someone whose job is to serve or help people in a public place.

words.ex: Scientists work at the observatory to study stars.
words.ex_cn: 科学家在天文台工作以研究恒星。
words.en: A building or place equipped for observation of natural phenomena (as in astronomy); also : an institution whose primary purpose is making such observations.

words.ex: He put ketchup on his fries.
words.ex_cn: 他在薯条上放了番茄酱。
words.en: A thick, smooth sauce made from tomatoes, vinegar, sugar, and spices, used as a condiment.

words.ex: The parker skillfully maneuvered the car into the tight spot.
words.ex_cn: 停车员熟练地将车停进了狭小的车位。
words.en: A person who is employed to park cars or manage a parking area.

words.ex: My co-worker helped me with the report.
words.ex_cn: 我的同事帮我完成了报告。
words.en: A person with whom one works, typically in a professional context.

words.ex: He wears a helmet when he rides a bike.
words.ex_cn: 他骑自行车时戴头盔。
words.en: A helmet is a strong, hard hat which is worn to protect your head.

words.ex: The ostrich runs very fast on the grassland.
words.ex_cn: 鸵鸟在草原上跑得很快。
words.en: An ostrich is a large African bird that cannot fly and has long legs and a long neck.

words.tr: n. 外交官；会耍手腕儿的人
words.ex: The diplomat met the president yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 这位外交官昨天会见了总统。
words.en: A diplomat is a person who represents their country in a foreign country, managing political relations and negotiations.

words.ex: The brachiopod is a type of marine invertebrate with a distinctive shell.
words.ex_cn: 腕足类动物是一种具有独特壳体的海洋无脊椎动物。
words.en: A marine invertebrate of the phylum Brachiopoda, which has a lophophore for feeding and a bivalve shell.

words.tr: n. 微积分学；（人体内的）结石
words.ex: He is learning calculus at school.
words.ex_cn: 他正在学校学习微积分。
words.en: Calculus is a branch of mathematics that deals with the finding and properties of derivatives and integrals of functions, by methods originally based on the summation of infinitesimal differences.

words.ex: The renaissance brought new art and ideas to Europe.
words.ex_cn: 文艺复兴为欧洲带来了新的艺术和思想。
words.en: The Renaissance was a period in European history marking the transition from the Middle Ages to modernity and covering the 15th and 16th centuries, characterized by an effort to revive and surpass ideas and achievements of classical antiquity.

words.ex: The stability of the table prevents it from wobbling.
words.ex_cn: 桌子的固定防止它摇晃。
words.en: The state of being stable; the quality of being unchanging.

words.ex: Wolfram is a strong, dense, and brittle metal used in various industrial applications.
words.ex_cn: 钨是一种坚固、致密且易碎的金属，用于各种工业应用。
words.en: Wolfram is a chemical element with the symbol W and atomic number 74. It is a hard, rare metal under standard conditions when uncombined.

words.ex: The coin fell into the slot.
words.ex_cn: 硬币掉进了狭槽里。
words.en: A slot is a narrow opening in a machine or container, for example a hole that you put coins in to make a machine work.

words.ex: The precession of the equinoxes is a slow movement of the Earth's axis.
words.ex_cn: 春分点的岁差是地球自转轴的缓慢移动。
words.en: The slow movement of the axis of a spinning body around another axis due to a torque (such as gravitational influence) acting to change the direction of the first axis.

words.ex: There is a restriction on smoking in this building.
words.ex_cn: 这栋楼里禁止吸烟。
words.en: A restriction is an official rule that limits what you can do or that limits the amount or size of something.

words.ex: She picked up the coil of rope from the ground.
words.ex_cn: 她从地上捡起了那卷绳子。
words.en: A coil is a length of something wound in a joined sequence of loops, or the act of winding something into loops.

words.ex: The constitution protects the rights of all citizens.
words.ex_cn: 宪法保护所有公民的权利。
words.en: The constitution of a country or organization is the system of laws which formally states people's rights and duties.

words.tr: n. 对应物；相当之物；副本；
words.ex: The CEO's counterpart in China signed the agreement.
words.ex_cn: 中国方面的对应人物签署了协议。
words.en: Someone's or something's counterpart is another person or thing that has a similar function or position in a different place.

words.ex: She wears a gold necklace every day.
words.ex_cn: 她每天都戴一条金项链。
words.en: A necklace is a piece of jewellery such as a chain or a string of beads which someone, usually a woman, wears around their neck.

words.ex: The seller gave me a receipt.
words.ex_cn: 卖方给了我一张收据。
words.en: A seller is a person or organization that sells something.

words.ex: He works in a small cubicle at the office.
words.ex_cn: 他在办公室的一个小隔间里工作。
words.en: A cubicle is a small space or compartment that is partitioned off, especially one in which someone works or studies.

words.ex: The sailors slept in the cabin during the storm.
words.ex_cn: 水手们在风暴期间睡在船舱里。
words.en: A cabin is a small room or compartment, especially one on a ship or an aircraft.

words.ex: The newcomer joined our class last week.
words.ex_cn: 这个新来的人上周加入了我们的班级。
words.en: A newcomer is a person who has recently arrived in a place or started an activity.

words.tr: n. 付薪水的支票；薪水
words.ex: He gets his paycheck every Friday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周五领工资。
words.en: A paycheck is a check that an employee receives from their employer as payment for their work.

words.tr:
adj. 与安息日有关的
n. （大学教师每七年一次的）公休假
words.ex: He took a sabbatical from university to write a book.
words.ex_cn: 他从大学请假一年去写书。
words.en: A sabbatical is a period of paid leave granted to a university teacher or other worker for study or travel, traditionally one year for every seven years worked.

words.ex: He felt shame for lying to his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他因为对母亲撒谎而感到羞愧。
words.en: A painful feeling of humiliation or distress caused by the consciousness of wrong or foolish behavior.

words.ex: His weakness made him unable to fight back.
words.ex_cn: 他的软弱使他无法反击。
words.en: A weakness is a fault or lack of strength in someone's character or in a system, plan, or design.

words.ex: Water is a basic necessity for life.
words.ex_cn: 水是生命的基本必需品。
words.en: Something that is necessary or indispensable.

words.ex: The baby smiled at the sweet melody.
words.ex_cn: 宝宝听到了甜美的旋律，笑了。
words.en: A melody is a sequence of single notes that is musically satisfying.

words.ex: The turner fixed the metal part on the lathe.
words.ex_cn: 车床工人把金属零件固定在车床上。
words.en: A turner is someone who operates a lathe or is skilled in turning wood or metal on a lathe.

words.tr:
n. 研究所；学院；协会；
v. 建立；制定；
words.ex: He works at a research institute.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家研究所工作。
words.en: An institute is an organization set up to do a particular type of work, especially research or teaching. It can also refer to the act of starting something such as a system or an official process.

words.ex: He goes to a music academy every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末去音乐学院。
words.en: An academy is a type of school for special training or a society for the advancement of art, science, or literature.

words.ex: The children rode a sled down the snowy hill.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们坐着雪橇从积雪的山坡滑下。
words.en: A sled is a vehicle used for traveling over snow and ice, typically consisting of a light frame mounted on runners and often used for recreation or transporting goods.

words.ex: The patroller was responsible for monitoring the perimeter of the base.
words.ex_cn: 巡逻员负责监控基地周边。
words.en: A person who patrols an area to ensure its security or to enforce laws.

words.ex: The ship took on ballast to stay stable in rough water.
words.ex_cn: 船为了在恶劣水域中保持稳定，装载了压舱物。
words.en: Ballast is heavy material that is carried in a ship or hot-air balloon to make it more stable.

words.ex: The cobra hissed at the man.
words.ex_cn: 眼镜蛇向那个人嘶嘶作响。
words.en: A cobra is a highly venomous snake known for its hood and its ability to spit venom.

words.ex: The aspen tree leaves rustle gently in the breeze.
words.ex_cn: 山杨树的叶子在微风中轻轻沙沙作响。
words.en: An aspen is a type of tree that is known for its leaves that flutter in the breeze.

words.ex: He chopped an onion for the soup.
words.ex_cn: 他为汤切了一个洋葱。
words.en: An onion is a round vegetable with a light brown skin. It has many layers and a strong, sharp smell and taste.

words.ex: Rust is an oxide of iron.
words.ex_cn: 铁锈是铁的氧化物。
words.en: An oxide is a chemical compound that contains at least one oxygen atom and one other element in its chemical formula.

words.tr: n. 平板电脑；（刻有文字的）匾；
words.ex: He uses a tablet to read books.
words.ex_cn: 他用平板电脑读书。
words.en: A tablet is a small, flat computer that is controlled by touching the screen. It can also refer to a small, solid piece of medicine that you swallow.

words.tr:
n. 杂草；野草；
v. 除草；铲除；
words.ex: The garden is full of weeds.
words.ex_cn: 花园里长满了杂草。
words.en: A weed is a wild plant that grows in gardens or fields of crops and is not wanted because it harms the plants that are being grown.

words.ex: The millennium began in the year 2000.
words.ex_cn: 一千年始于2000年。
words.en: A millennium is a period of one thousand years.

words.ex: He showed conformity with the group's rules.
words.ex_cn: 他遵守了小组的规定。
words.en: Conformity is the act of matching attitudes, beliefs, and behaviors to group norms or standards.

words.ex: The settler built a house near the river.
words.ex_cn: 这位定居者在河边建了一所房子。
words.en: A settler is a person who moves to a new place with the intention of staying there, especially in a previously uninhabited or sparsely inhabited area.

words.ex: He got a vaccine last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周打了疫苗。
words.en: A vaccine is a substance containing a virus or bacterium in a form that is not harmful, given to a person or animal to prevent them from getting the disease that the virus or bacterium causes.

words.ex: He eats spaghetti for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚餐吃意大利面。
words.en: Spaghetti is a type of pasta that is long, thin, and solid, originally from Italy.

words.ex: His intention was to help his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他的意图是帮助他的朋友。
words.en: An intention is an idea or plan of what you are going to do.

words.ex: He values his privacy and doesn't share personal info online.
words.ex_cn: 他重视自己的隐私，不在网上分享个人信息。
words.en: The state or condition of being free from being observed or disturbed by other people.

words.ex: He loves impressionism in painting.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢绘画中的印象派。
words.en: Impressionism is a style or movement in painting originating in France in the 1860s, characterized by a concern with depicting the visual impression of the moment, especially in terms of the shifting effect of light and color.

words.ex: He owns five acres of farmland.
words.ex_cn: 他拥有五英亩的农田。
words.en: A unit of area used in the US Customary and the British Imperial systems, equal to 4,840 square yards or 4,046.86 square meters.

words.ex: He has possession of the keys.
words.ex_cn: 他拥有这些钥匙。
words.en: The state of having, owning, or controlling something.

words.ex: The postage for this letter is one dollar.
words.ex_cn: 这封信的邮资是一美元。
words.en: The cost of sending a letter or package by post.

words.ex: The river deposited silt on the banks.
words.ex_cn: 河流在河岸上沉积了淤泥。
words.en: Silt is fine sand, soil, or mud which is carried along by a river and then left on the land.

words.ex: He collects rainwater in a barrel.
words.ex_cn: 他用桶收集雨水。
words.en: Rainwater is water that has fallen as rain and is often collected and used for various purposes, such as watering plants.

words.ex: He is learning English grammar every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都在学习英语语法。
words.en: Grammar is the system and structure of a language. The rules of grammar help us decide the order we put words in and which form of a word to use.

words.ex: The team went on an expedition to the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 这支队伍去山上探险了。
words.en: An expedition is an organized journey that is made for a particular purpose such as exploration.

words.ex: The budget is a constraint on our project.
words.ex_cn: 预算是我们项目的限制。
words.en: A constraint is something that limits or controls what you can do.

words.tr:
n. 云杉；云杉木
adj. 整洁漂亮的
v. 弄整洁；打扮漂亮
words.ex: The forest is full of tall spruce trees.
words.ex_cn: 森林里长满了高大的云杉树。
words.en: A spruce is a type of evergreen tree with needle-like leaves. As an adjective, it describes something neat and trim in appearance. As a verb, it means to make someone or something neat and smart in appearance.

words.tr: n. 运动员；田径运动员；
words.ex: The athlete ran fast and won the race.
words.ex_cn: 这位运动员跑得很快，赢得了比赛。
words.en: An athlete is a person who is proficient in sports and other forms of physical exercise.

words.tr:
n. 赞助商；
v. 赞助；
words.ex: The company is a sponsor of the football match.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司是这场足球赛的赞助商。
words.en: A sponsor is a person or organization that pays for or contributes to the costs involved in staging a sporting or artistic event in return for advertising. A sponsor can also be someone who introduces and supports a proposal for a new law.

words.tr: n. 赞助人；资助人；老主顾
words.ex: The patron gave money to support the art exhibition.
words.ex_cn: 赞助人捐钱支持了这场艺术展览。
words.en: A patron is a person who supports with money, gifts, efforts, or endorsement an artist, musician, writer, form of art, or charitable cause.

words.ex: The rebellion against the king failed.
words.ex_cn: 反对国王的叛乱失败了。
words.en: A rebellion is an organized attempt to overthrow a government or authority by a group of people.

words.tr:
n. 粘附物；胶粘物；不干胶标签；贴纸；不屈不挠的人
v. 给…贴上标签价
words.ex: He put a sticker on his notebook.
words.ex_cn: 他在笔记本上贴了一个粘附物。
words.en: A sticker is a small piece of paper or plastic with a picture or writing on one side and glue on the other side, which you can stick onto a surface.

words.ex: The warrior fought bravely to protect his village.
words.ex_cn: 这位战士勇敢地战斗以保护他的村庄。
words.en: A warrior is a person who is engaged in or experienced in battle, or who shows or has shown great vigor, courage, or aggressiveness, as in politics or athletics.

words.ex: They slept in a tent during the camping trip.
words.ex_cn: 他们在露营时睡在帐篷里。
words.en: A tent is a portable shelter made of fabric or other material stretched over a supporting framework of poles and usually stabilized or secured to the ground with cords and stakes.

words.tr:
n. 折扣；
v. 不全信；不重视；
words.ex: The store gave a 20% discount on all shoes.
words.ex_cn: 商店对所有鞋子提供了20%的折扣。
words.en: A reduction in the usual price of something, or the act of reducing the price.

words.ex: The judge made a fair decision to show justice.
words.ex_cn: 法官做出了公正的裁决以体现公正。
words.en: Justice is fairness in the way that people are treated.

words.ex: He received a confirmation email for his flight.
words.ex_cn: 他收到了航班的确认邮件。
words.en: Confirmation is the act of confirming something or making it more definite.

words.ex: He went to a tutorial to understand math better.
words.ex_cn: 他去参加辅导以更好地理解数学。
words.en: A tutorial is a period of teaching and discussion with a tutor, especially in a British university or college.

words.ex: His loyalty to his friends never changed.
words.ex_cn: 他对朋友的忠诚从未改变。
words.en: The quality of being loyal to someone or something.

words.ex: They celebrate midsummer with fireworks and dancing.
words.ex_cn: 他们用烟花和舞蹈庆祝仲夏。
words.en: Midsummer is the period in the middle of summer, typically around the summer solstice, the longest day of the year.

words.ex: The nurse is the doctor's aide.
words.ex_cn: 护士是医生的助手。
words.en: An aide is someone whose job is to help another person in their work.

words.tr: n. 住处；膳宿；(交通工具内的)空间；
words.ex: The hotel provided cheap accommodation for travelers.
words.ex_cn: 酒店为旅客提供了便宜的住处。
words.en: Accommodation is a place where someone lives or stays, or the act of providing someone with a place to live or stay.

words.ex: My housemate cooks dinner every night.
words.ex_cn: 我的室友每天晚上做晚饭。
words.en: A person who shares a house or apartment with others but is not necessarily related to them.

words.tr: n. 专门知识；专门技能；
words.ex: His expertise in computers helps the team solve problems.
words.ex_cn: 他在计算机方面的专门知识帮助团队解决问题。
words.en: Expertise is special skill or knowledge that is acquired by training, study, or practice.

words.ex: Her speciality is cooking Italian food.
words.ex_cn: 她的专长是做意大利菜。
words.en: A speciality is a particular field of work or study that someone specializes in, or a product that is particularly associated with a specific place or producer.

words.ex: He is a descendant of the first king.
words.ex_cn: 他是第一位国王的后裔。
words.en: A person, plant, or animal that is descended from a particular ancestor.

words.ex: She picked a violet from the garden.
words.ex_cn: 她从花园里摘了一朵紫罗兰。
words.en: A violet is a small plant that has purple or white flowers in the spring.

words.tr: n. 自立；依靠自己；自力更生
words.ex: He learns self-reliance from living alone.
words.ex_cn: 他通过独自生活学会自立。
words.en: Self-reliance is the ability to do things and make decisions by yourself, without needing other people to help you.

words.ex: The rental of the apartment costs $800 per month.
words.ex_cn: 这套公寓的租赁费用是每月800美元。
words.en: The act of paying for the use of something, such as property, a vehicle, or equipment, or the amount paid for such use.

words.ex: He learned about his ancestry from his grandmother.
words.ex_cn: 他从祖母那里了解了自己的血统。
words.en: Your ancestry is the series of ancestors from whom you are descended.

words.tr:
n. 最大限度；最大量；
adj. 最大极限的；最多的；
words.ex: The maximum of the crowd is 100 people.
words.ex_cn: 人群的上限是100人。
words.en: The greatest or highest amount possible or attained.

words.ex: Whoever wants to join can sign up.
words.ex_cn: 任何想加入的人都可以报名。
words.en: used to refer to any person or people, when it does not matter who

words.ex: She knit a warm scarf for her brother.
words.ex_cn: 她为她的弟弟织了一条暖和的围巾。
words.en: If you knit something, especially an article of clothing, you make it from wool or a similar thread by using two knitting needles or a machine.

words.ex: The soil degrades over time without proper care.
words.ex_cn: 如果没有适当照料，土壤会逐渐退化。
words.en: If something degrades or is degraded, it becomes worse in quality, or weaker in power or status.

words.ex: The price of oil fluctuates every day.
words.ex_cn: 油价每天都在波动。
words.en: To fluctuate means to change or vary frequently and unpredictably.

words.ex: He withdrew $100 from the ATM.
words.ex_cn: 他从自动取款机里提取了100美元。
words.en: If you withdraw something from a place, you remove it or take it away.

words.ex: Can you clarify your answer?
words.ex_cn: 你能澄清一下你的答案吗？
