words.en: A developer is a person or a company that develops software, websites, or applications, or that builds houses or other structures on land.

words.tr: n. 新来者；陌生人； adj. “strange”的比较级；
words.ex: He is a stranger in this town.
words.ex_cn: 他是这个镇上的新来者。
words.en: A stranger is someone you have never met before.

words.ex: The team celebrated their victory after the match.
words.ex_cn: 比赛结束后，球队庆祝了他们的胜利。
words.en: A victory is a success in a struggle, war, or competition.

words.ex: He is a good listener when his friend talks.
words.ex_cn: 当他的朋友说话时，他是一个好的听者。
words.en: A listener is someone who listens to something, especially to the radio or to someone who is speaking.

words.ex: He has faith in his ability to win.
words.ex_cn: 他对自己赢得比赛有信心。
words.en: Strong belief in the doctrines of a religion, based on spiritual conviction rather than proof.

words.tr: n. 运动员；田径运动员；
words.ex: The athlete ran fast and won the race.
words.ex_cn: 这位运动员跑得很快，赢得了比赛。
words.en: An athlete is a person who is proficient in sports and other forms of physical exercise.

words.ex: The sky will darken before the storm.
words.ex_cn: 风暴来临前，天空会变暗。
words.en: To make or become dark or darker.

words.ex: He dare not speak up in class.
words.ex_cn: 他不敢在课堂上发言。
words.en: If you dare to do something, you are brave enough to do it, even though it may be dangerous or shocking or may cause trouble for you.

words.ex: He injured his leg while playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他在踢足球时伤了腿。
words.en: To injure someone means to cause them physical harm, for example in an accident or an attack.

words.ex: He will fasten his seatbelt before driving.
words.ex_cn: 他开车前会系好安全带。
words.en: To close or attach something firmly so that it will not open or come loose.

words.ex: He grabbed the ball quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他迅速抓住了球。
words.en: If you grab something, you take it or pick it up suddenly and roughly.

words.tr: adj. 焦虑的；渴望的；担忧的；
words.ex: He feels anxious before every test.
words.ex_cn: 他每次考试前都感到焦虑。
words.en: If you are anxious to do something or anxious that something should happen, you very much want to do it or very much want it to happen.

words.ex: It's risky to walk alone at night.
words.ex_cn: 晚上独自走路是危险的。
words.en: If an activity or action is risky, it is dangerous or likely to fail.

words.ex: He is fortunate to have a good job.
words.ex_cn: 他很幸运拥有一份好工作。
words.en: If you say that someone or something is fortunate, you mean that they are lucky.

words.ex: The picnic was an enjoyable day with friends.
words.ex_cn: 野餐是和朋友一起度过的愉快一天。
words.en: Something that is enjoyable gives you pleasure.

words.ex: He is overly careful with his money.
words.ex_cn: 他花钱过于谨慎。
words.en: To an excessive degree.

words.ex: He will surely come tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天一定会来。
words.en: without doubt; certainly

words.ex: He skipped the hard question and moved to the next one.
words.ex_cn: 他略过了难题，继续做下一题。
words.en: To move lightly and quickly, making a small jump after each step.

words.ex: He stole a book from the store.
words.ex_cn: 他从商店偷了一本书。
words.en: To take something that belongs to someone else without their permission and without intending to return it.

words.tr:
n. 遗憾；
v. 懊悔；
words.ex: He felt a deep regret after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失去工作后感到深深的遗憾。
words.en: If you regret something that you have done, you wish that you had not done it.

words.ex: The scope of this project includes three cities.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目的范围包括三个城市。
words.en: The range of one's perceptions, thoughts, or actions.

words.ex: The aircraft landed safely at the airport.
words.ex_cn: 这架航空器在机场安全着陆。
words.en: An aircraft is a vehicle which can fly, for example an aeroplane or a helicopter.

words.ex: We watched a play at the theatre last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚在剧场看了一场戏。
words.en: A theatre is a building with a stage in it, on which plays, shows, and other performances take place.

words.ex: My brother watches cartoon every evening.
words.ex_cn: 我弟弟每天晚上看卡通片。
words.en: A cartoon is a humorous drawing or series of drawings in a newspaper or magazine, or a film made using animation techniques.

words.ex: She sewed a button on her coat.
words.ex_cn: 她把一颗纽扣缝在了外套上。
words.en: A button is a small, usually round object that you press to operate a device or a machine, or a small, round object that you fasten to clothing to keep it closed.

words.tr: n. 清洁工人；清洁工具； adj. 更洁净的；更干净的；“clean”的比较级；
words.ex: The cleaner sweeps the floor every morning.
words.ex_cn: 清洁工人每天早上扫地。
words.en: A cleaner is a person whose job is to clean a place or a substance used for cleaning.

words.ex: The winner got a gold medal.
words.ex_cn: 优胜者获得了一枚金牌。
words.en: A winner is a person or thing that wins something.

words.ex: He got a driver's license last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周拿到了驾照。
words.en: A license is an official document which gives you permission to do, use, or own something.

words.ex: The CD is a type of disc.
words.ex_cn: CD是一种圆盘。
words.en: A disc is a flat, circular object or a device used to store information in a form that can be read by a computer.

words.ex: He paid off his debt last month.
words.ex_cn: 他上个月还清了债务。
words.en: A debt is a sum of money that you owe someone.

words.ex: He sat on the bench in the park.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在公园的长凳上。
words.en: A bench is a long seat for several people, typically made of wood or metal.

words.ex: The tabletop was cluttered with various items.
words.ex_cn: 桌面上堆满了各种物品。
words.en: A tabletop is the flat surface of a table.

words.ex: The teacher instructed the students to open their books.
words.ex_cn: 老师指示学生打开书。
words.en: To instruct someone means to tell or teach them to do something, especially in a formal or official way.

words.ex: He dismissed her advice and walked away.
words.ex_cn: 他不理会她的建议，走开了。
words.en: If you dismiss someone, you send them away or allow them to leave.

words.tr:
adv. 向后地；
adj. 向后的；
words.ex: He walked backward to see the sign.
words.ex_cn: 他向后走以便看清楚那个标志。
words.en: If you move or look backward, you move or look in the direction that your back is facing.

words.ex: The stormy sea crashed against the rocks.
words.ex_cn: 暴风雨的海浪拍打着岩石。
words.en: Characterized by strong winds and usually rain, thunder, lightning, or snow.

words.ex: Her icy smile made him feel cold.
words.ex_cn: 她冰冷的微笑让他感到寒意。
words.en: If you describe something as icy, you mean that it is extremely cold.

words.tr: adj. 无色的；苍白的；乏味的
words.ex: The water looked colorless in the glass.
words.ex_cn: 水在玻璃杯里看起来是无色的。
words.en: Lacking color; dull or uninteresting.

words.ex: It was foolish to walk on the ice.
words.ex_cn: 在冰上走是愚蠢的。
words.en: If you say that someone or something is foolish, you mean that they are not sensible or show a lack of good judgment.

words.tr:
v. 答复；回答；
n. 答复；回答；
words.ex: He replied to my message quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快回复了我的消息。
words.en: To reply means to say or write something as an answer to something that someone has said or written.

words.tr:
v. 击；撞；
n. 撞击；敲击；
words.ex: He knock on the door.
words.ex_cn: 他敲了敲门。
words.en: To strike a surface noisily to attract attention, especially when waiting to be let in through a door.

words.ex: I buy milk and bread at the supermarket.
words.ex_cn: 我在超市买牛奶和面包。
words.en: A large self-service store selling foods and household goods.

words.ex: The police caught the man for a serious crime.
words.ex_cn: 警察抓住了那个犯下严重罪行的人。
words.en: A crime is an illegal action or activity for which a person can be punished by law.

words.ex: I use a planner to write down my daily tasks.
words.ex_cn: 我用计划表记录每天的任务。
words.en: A planner is someone who makes plans, especially someone whose job is to do this.

words.ex: The troop marched into the town at dawn.
words.ex_cn: 部队在黎明时分进入城镇。
words.en: A troop is a group of soldiers or a large group of people or animals.

words.ex: The trader sells fruits every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这位商人每天早上卖水果。
words.en: A trader is a person who buys and sells goods, currencies, or shares.

words.ex: The snail moves slowly across the garden.
words.ex_cn: 蜗牛慢慢地爬过花园。
words.en: A snail is a small creature with a soft, wet body and a spiral shell. It moves very slowly.

words.ex: She wears a gold necklace every day.
words.ex_cn: 她每天都戴一条金项链。
words.en: A necklace is a piece of jewellery such as a chain or a string of beads which someone, usually a woman, wears around their neck.

words.tr:
n. 熊；
v. 承受；忍受；带有；生（孩子）；
words.ex: A bear walked near the campsite.
words.ex_cn: 一只熊在露营地附近走动。
words.en: If you bear something, you accept it and are able to deal with it, even though it is unpleasant or painful. A bear is a large, strong wild animal with thick fur and sharp claws.

words.ex: He edits the school newspaper every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周编辑校报。
words.en: To prepare written material for publication by correcting, condensing, or otherwise modifying it.

words.ex: He greet his friend with a smile.
words.ex_cn: 他微笑着向朋友问好。
words.en: To greet someone means to say hello to them or to welcome them.

words.ex: This portable charger works well on trips.
words.ex_cn: 这个便携式充电器在旅行时很好用。
words.en: Capable of being carried or moved about with ease.

words.tr: adj. 不确定的；不肯定的；无把握的；
words.ex: I am unsure about the answer.
words.ex_cn: 我对这个答案不确定。
words.en: If you are unsure about something, you are not certain about it.

words.ex: He hired a legal lawyer to help him.
words.ex_cn: 他请了一位法律律师来帮助他。
words.en: Relating to the law or to lawyers, or permitted or required by law.

words.tr: adj. 即将发生（或来临）的
words.ex: The upcoming meeting is on Friday.
words.ex_cn: 即将到来的会议在周五。
words.en: An upcoming event is one that is going to happen soon.

words.ex: This phone is outdated and doesn't work well.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机过时了，用起来不好。
words.en: If you describe something as outdated, you mean that you think it is old-fashioned and no longer useful or relevant to modern life.

words.ex: The book was dusty on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 书在架子上积满了灰尘。
words.en: Covered with or resembling dust; dry and powdery.

words.tr: adj. 充满智慧的；明智的；英明的；
words.ex: The wise old man gave good advice.
words.ex_cn: 这位充满智慧的老人给出了很好的建议。
words.en: If you describe someone as wise, you mean that they have experience, knowledge, and good judgment.

words.ex: The child screamed when she saw the dog.
words.ex_cn: 当那个孩子看到狗时，她尖叫了起来。
words.en: If you scream, you shout or cry in a loud high-pitched voice, usually because you are in pain or are very frightened.

words.ex: The snowstorm stopped all traffic yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 昨天暴风雪让所有交通都停了。
words.en: A snowstorm is a very heavy fall of snow, usually with strong winds.

words.ex: He used a red marker to mark the important words.
words.ex_cn: 他用红色记号笔标出重要的单词。
words.en: A marker is an object which is used to show the position of something, or is used to make a mark on something.

words.ex: He had a sore throat after singing all night.
words.ex_cn: 他唱了一整晚后喉咙疼。
words.en: Your throat is the back part of your mouth, where it connects to your neck. It includes the passage that leads from your mouth to your stomach and lungs.

words.ex: He touched his cheek gently.
words.ex_cn: 他轻轻摸了摸脸颊。
words.en: The soft part of a person's face below the eye and between the nose and ear.

words.tr: n. 美容院；美发厅；沙龙
words.ex: She goes to the salon to get her hair cut.
words.ex_cn: 她去理发店剪头发。
words.en: A salon is a gathering of people under the roof of an inspiring host, held partly to amuse one another and partly to refine the taste and increase the knowledge of the participants through conversation.

words.ex: He made a gesture of welcome with his hands.
words.ex_cn: 他用手做了一个欢迎的姿态。
words.en: A gesture is a movement that you make with a part of your body, especially your hands, to express emotion or information.

words.ex: He believes he will go to heaven after death.
words.ex_cn: 他相信自己死后会去天堂。
words.en: In some religions, heaven is the place where God or the gods live and where good people go after they die.

words.ex: He is a famous novelist who writes stories about love.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位著名的作家，写关于爱情的故事。
words.en: A novelist is a person who writes novels.

words.ex: The bride walked slowly down the aisle.
words.ex_cn: 新娘缓缓走过过道。
words.en: A bride is a woman who is getting married or who has just got married.

words.ex: The lecturer explains math clearly.
words.ex_cn: 这位授课老师讲解数学很清晰。
words.en: A lecturer is a person who gives lectures, especially as a profession.

words.ex: The physician checked the patient's temperature.
words.ex_cn: 医生检查了病人的体温。
words.en: A physician is a medical doctor who is trained in the diagnosis and treatment of diseases and injuries.

words.ex: He put his head on the pillow and fell asleep.
words.ex_cn: 他把头放在枕头上，睡着了。
words.en: A pillow is a cushion that you rest your head on when you are in bed.

words.ex: I take a shower every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上都洗淋浴。
words.en: A shower is a device that sprays water over you so that you can wash yourself. It is also a short period of rain or snow.

words.ex: The shipment arrived on time.
words.ex_cn: 运输按时到达了。
words.en: The act of sending goods from one place to another, especially by ship.

words.ex: He ate a super big pizza.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一块超大的披萨。
words.en: If you describe something as super, you mean that it is very good indeed.

words.ex: The little girl has a lovely smile.
words.ex_cn: 这个小女孩有一个可爱的笑容。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as lovely, you mean that they are very beautiful and therefore pleasing to look at or be with.

words.ex: This coupon is valid until next month.
words.ex_cn: 这张优惠券到下个月都有效。
words.en: If something such as a document or agreement is valid, it is legally acceptable or officially recognized.

words.tr: adj. 整洁的；整齐的；有条理的
words.ex: He keeps his desk neat.
words.ex_cn: 他保持书桌整洁。
words.en: Neat things are tidy, smart, or carefully arranged.

words.ex: He is loyal to his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他对朋友忠诚。
words.en: Someone who is loyal remains firm in their friendship or support for a person or thing.

words.tr:
v. 领会；抓紧；
n. 领会；
words.ex: I couldn't grasp the meaning of the poem.
words.ex_cn: 我没能领会这首诗的含义。
words.en: To grasp something means to take it in your hand and hold it firmly.

words.ex: The ancient tomb was filled with artifacts.
words.ex_cn: 这座古老的坟墓里充满了文物。
words.en: A tomb is a place where a dead person is buried, especially a large, impressive structure.

words.ex: The government provides welfare to poor families.
words.ex_cn: 政府向贫困家庭提供福利。
words.en: The welfare of a person or group is their health, comfort, and happiness.

words.ex: The fish swim above the seabed.
words.ex_cn: 鱼在海床上方游动。
words.en: The seabed is the bottom of the ocean, consisting of various sediments and rocks.

words.tr: n. 标记；斑纹；打分； v. 做标记；（使）留痕迹；评分；“mark”的现在分词；
words.ex: The marking on the map shows the route.
words.ex_cn: 地图上的标记显示了路线。
words.en: A marking is a pattern or area of color on an animal's body, or a sign or symbol that is used to indicate something.

words.ex: He bought a recorder to record his lessons.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一台录音机来录课程。
words.en: A recorder is a device or a person that records something, especially sounds or events.

words.ex: He lit a candle to see in the dark.
words.ex_cn: 他点燃了一支蜡烛以便在黑暗中看见。
words.en: A candle is a stick of wax with a wick through the middle which is lit to give light as it burns.

words.ex: He lost his fortune in the stock market.
words.ex_cn: 他在股市中失去了他的财产。
words.en: A large amount of money or assets; chance or luck as an external force in human affairs.

words.ex: The ground is damp after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 雨后地面是潮湿的。
words.en: Something that is damp is slightly wet, often in a way that is unpleasant.

words.ex: His loyalty to his friends never changed.
words.ex_cn: 他对朋友的忠诚从未改变。
words.en: The quality of being loyal to someone or something.

words.ex: I misplace my keys every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上都把钥匙弄丢。
words.en: If you misplace something, you lose it, usually only temporarily.

words.ex: They widened the road to fit more cars.
words.ex_cn: 他们加宽了这条路，以便容纳更多汽车。
words.en: To make or become wider.

words.tr: adj. 寒冷的；冷淡的；冷漠的；
words.ex: The morning air was chilly.
words.ex_cn: 早晨的空气很寒冷。
words.en: Something that is chilly is unpleasantly cold.

words.tr: adj. 有技巧的；熟练的；灵巧的；
words.ex: He is a skillful painter who draws beautiful landscapes.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位有技巧的画家，能画出美丽的风景。
words.en: Someone who is skillful at something does it very well.

words.ex: Her room is always tidy.
words.ex_cn: 她的房间总是很整洁。
words.en: If you describe something as tidy, you mean that it is neat and arranged in an orderly way.

words.ex: Nowadays, many children use tablets to learn.
words.ex_cn: 现在，许多孩子用平板电脑学习。
words.en: At the present time, in contrast with the past.

words.ex: He cooked dinner; meantime, the kids did their homework.
words.ex_cn: 他做晚饭；与此同时，孩子们在做作业。
words.en: The time between one event and another; meanwhile.

words.ex: The passengers are aboard the plane.
words.ex_cn: 乘客们在飞机上。
words.en: On or onto a ship, aircraft, bus, or train.

words.ex: I felt pity for the lonely child.
words.ex_cn: 我对那个孤独的孩子感到怜悯。
words.en: If you feel pity for someone, you feel very sorry for them.

words.tr:
n. 损害；破损；
v. 损害；破坏；
words.ex: The storm caused serious damage to the house.
words.ex_cn: 风暴对房屋造成了严重损害。
words.en: Damage is physical harm that is caused to something which makes it less attractive, useful, or valuable.

words.tr:
n. 暂停；停顿；
v. 暂停；停顿；
words.ex: There was a short pause before he answered.
words.ex_cn: 他回答之前停顿了一下。
words.en: To pause means to stop what you are doing for a short time before continuing.

words.ex: I hate waking up early.
words.ex_cn: 我讨厌早起。
words.en: To hate someone or something means to feel intense or passionate dislike for them.

words.tr:
n. 标准；
adj. 标准的；规范的；
words.ex: The school has a high standard for homework.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校对作业有很高的标准。
words.en: A standard is a level of quality or achievement, especially a level that is thought to be acceptable.

words.ex: The chef cooked a delicious dinner for the guests.
words.ex_cn: 主厨为客人做了一顿美味的晚餐。
words.en: A chef is a professional cook, typically the chief cook in a restaurant or hotel.

words.ex: He moved from the island to the mainland for work.
words.ex_cn: 他从岛屿搬到大陆工作。
words.en: The mainland is the main part of a country or continent, as opposed to islands or peninsulas.

words.ex: He is tired, and indeed he fell asleep quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很累，的确很快就睡着了。
words.en: You use indeed to confirm or agree with something that has just been said.

words.ex: Their marriage lasted for twenty years.
words.ex_cn: 他们的婚姻持续了二十年。
words.en: The legally or formally recognized union of two people as partners in a personal relationship.

words.ex: The country's economy is growing fast.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家的经济正在快速增长。
words.en: The economy of a country or region is the system by which money, industry, and trade are organized.

words.ex: There is a high likelihood of rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 明天很大可能会下雨。
words.en: The likelihood of something happening is how likely it is to happen.

words.ex: The theory of gravity explains why things fall down.
words.ex_cn: 重力理论解释了为什么东西会往下掉。
words.en: A theory is a formal idea or set of ideas that is intended to explain something.

words.tr:
n. 力量；力；兵力；武力；
v. 强迫；促使；推动；
words.ex: The force of the wind broke the tree.
words.ex_cn: 风的力量折断了那棵树。
words.en: Force is a physical power or strength possessed by a living being; it is also an influence that can change the motion of an object.

words.ex: The music touched his soul.
words.ex_cn: 这音乐触动了他的灵魂。
words.en: A person's soul is the spiritual part of them which some people believe continues existing after their body is dead.

words.tr: n. 栖息地；居留地；产地；
words.ex: The panda's habitat is in the mountains of China.
words.ex_cn: 熊猫的栖息地在中国的山区。
words.en: The natural environment in which a species or group of species lives.

words.ex: My grandfather loves his grandson very much.
words.ex_cn: 我的祖父非常爱他的孙子。
words.en: A grandson is the son of your son or daughter.

words.ex: The children play in the courtyard after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在庭院里玩耍。
words.en: An open area surrounded by buildings or walls, often found in the center of a complex or building.

words.ex: The dark passageway led to the basement.
words.ex_cn: 这条黑暗的通道通向地下室。
words.en: A passageway is a long narrow space with walls or fences on both sides, which connects one place or room with another.

words.ex: The pupil writes with a pencil in class.
words.ex_cn: 这个小学生在课堂上用铅笔写字。
words.en: A pupil is a child or young person who is being taught in a school or by a private tutor.

words.ex: His ambition is to become a president.
words.ex_cn: 他的野心是成为总统。
words.en: An ambition is a strong desire to achieve something, typically requiring determination and hard work.

words.ex: The book is 10 inches long.
words.ex_cn: 这本书长10英寸。
words.en: An inch is a unit of length equal to one twelfth of a foot.

words.ex: I went to the bathroom after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 晚饭后我去了一趟浴室。
words.en: A room containing a bath or shower and typically also a washbasin and a toilet.

words.tr: n. 运动；动作；活动；乐章；
words.ex: The movement of the sun changes the shadow.
words.ex_cn: 太阳的运动改变了影子。
words.en: The act or process of moving or being moved; a change of position or place.

words.ex: He sat on the couch and watched TV.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在沙发上看电视。
words.en: A couch is a long, comfortable seat for two or more people to sit on. It is also used to refer to a piece of furniture designed for lying down or sleeping.

words.tr:
n. 照片；相片；
v. 拍照；
words.ex: He showed me a photograph of his dog.
words.ex_cn: 他给我看了他狗的照片。
words.en: A photograph is a picture that is made using a camera.

words.ex: The clerk at the store helped me find the book.
words.ex_cn: 商店里的职员帮我找到了那本书。
words.en: A clerk is a person whose job is to keep records or accounts in an office, shop, or bank.

words.ex: She put a cushion on the chair to make it comfortable.
words.ex_cn: 她在椅子上放了一个靠垫，让它更舒服。
words.en: A cushion is a soft bag of some ornamental material, stuffed with wool, hair, feathers, polyester staple fiber, non-woven material, or even paper torn into fragments. It may be used for sitting or kneeling upon, or to soften the hardness or angularity of a chair or couch.

words.ex: He denies taking the money.
words.ex_cn: 他否认拿了钱。
words.en: To deny means to declare that something is not true, or to refuse to give or grant something.

words.ex: Her story inspires me to work harder.
words.ex_cn: 她的故事激励我更加努力。
words.en: If someone or something inspires you to do something new or unusual, they make you want to do it.

words.ex: The teacher gave extra praise to satisfy the students.
words.ex_cn: 老师给予额外的表扬来使学生满意。
words.en: If someone or something satisfies you, they give you enough of what you want or need to make you pleased or contented.

words.tr: v. 取代；迫使…离开家园；
words.ex: The new robot will displace the workers on the assembly line.
words.ex_cn: 这个新机器人将取代装配线上的工人。
words.en: To displace something or someone means to take their place or to force them to leave their usual place or role.

words.ex: He conform to the rules of the school.
words.ex_cn: 他遵守学校的规章制度。
words.en: To conform means to behave in a way that is accepted by most people or to obey a rule, law, or custom.

words.tr:
v. 喷吐；吐痰；吐口水
n. 唾沫；一块陆地；烤肉叉
words.ex: He likes to spit watermelon seeds.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢吐西瓜籽。
words.en: To spit means to force out the contents of the mouth, especially saliva, through the lips. It can also refer to the act of ejecting saliva or phlegm from the mouth, often as a gesture of contempt or disrespect.

words.tr:
n. 限制；
v. 限制；
words.ex: The teacher set a limit on homework time.
words.ex_cn: 老师对作业时间设定了限制。
words.en: A limit is the greatest amount, extent, or degree of something that is possible.

words.tr:
n. 折痕；褶；
v. 折叠；
words.ex: The paper has a deep fold in the middle.
words.ex_cn: 这张纸中间有一道深深的折痕。
words.en: To bend something, especially paper or cloth, so that one part of it lies flat on top of another part; to be able to be bent in this way.

words.tr: adj. 不快乐的；不高兴的；
words.ex: He looked unhappy after losing the game.
words.ex_cn: 他输掉比赛后看起来不快乐。
words.en: If you are unhappy, you are sad and depressed.

words.tr: adj. 可怕的；极坏的；糟糕的；
words.ex: The storm caused a terrible flood.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴引发了一场可怕的洪水。
words.en: If something is terrible, it is very bad or of very poor quality.

words.ex: This tool is usable for beginners.
words.ex_cn: 这个工具初学者可以用。
words.en: If something is usable, it is in a good enough state or condition to be used.

words.ex: The small spider is harmless.
words.ex_cn: 这只小蜘蛛是无害的。
words.en: If someone or something is harmless, they are not dangerous and do not cause any harm.

words.ex: She gave a cheerful smile.
words.ex_cn: 她露出了快乐的微笑。
words.en: Someone who is cheerful is happy and shows this in their behavior.

words.tr: adj. 著名的；有名的；闻名的
words.ex: He is a famed painter in his country.
words.ex_cn: 他是他国家里著名的画家。
words.en: Known about by many people; renowned.

words.ex: He read the story aloud to his little sister.
words.ex_cn: 他大声给小妹妹读这个故事。
words.en: If you say something aloud, you say it in a normal speaking voice, rather than whispering or thinking it.

words.ex: I looked everywhere, but my keys are nowhere.
words.ex_cn: 我到处找了，但我的钥匙无处可寻。
words.en: In no place or state; not anywhere.

words.tr:
n. 更新；
v. 更新；升级；
words.ex: The app sent me a new update.
words.ex_cn: 应用程序给我发送了一个新更新。
words.en: To make something more modern or up to date, especially by adding new information or changing its design or style.

words.tr:
n. 烤肉；烘烤；
adj. 烤的；焙的；
v. 烤；烘烤；
words.ex: We had roast for dinner last night.
words.ex_cn: 昨晚我们吃了烤肉。
words.en: To cook food, such as meat, in an oven or over a fire.

words.tr:
n. 恐慌；
v. 感到恐慌；
words.ex: A panic spread through the crowd when the fire alarm rang.
words.ex_cn: 当火警响起时，人群陷入了恐慌。
words.en: Panic is a very strong feeling of anxiety or fear, which makes you act without thinking carefully.

words.tr: n. 雕刻品；雕刻图案； v. 雕刻；“carve”的现在分词；
words.ex: The museum displayed a beautiful wooden carving.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆展示了一件精美的木雕品。
words.en: A carving is an object or design that has been cut out of a material such as wood or stone.

words.ex: The boat travels along the coastline.
words.ex_cn: 船沿着海岸线航行。
words.en: The coastline is the outline of a coast, especially its shape and appearance.

words.ex: The trainer helped the athlete improve his speed.
words.ex_cn: 训练者帮助运动员提高了他的速度。
words.en: A trainer is someone who teaches skills to people or animals and prepares them for a job, activity, or sport.

words.ex: The actress sings in the movie.
words.ex_cn: 这位女演员在电影中唱歌。
words.en: An actress is a woman whose profession is acting on the stage, in films, or on television.

words.tr: n. 享受；乐趣；乐事；享有；
words.ex: She finds enjoyment in reading books.
words.ex_cn: 她从读书中获得享受。
words.en: The pleasure that you get from something.

words.ex: The grower sells fresh vegetables at the market.
words.ex_cn: 这位种植者在市场出售新鲜蔬菜。
words.en: A grower is someone who grows plants or crops as a business or for personal use.

words.ex: Try to lessen your sugar intake.
words.ex_cn: 试着减少你的糖摄入量。
words.en: If something lessens or you lessen it, it becomes smaller in size, amount, degree, or importance.

words.ex: The sun softened the ice on the road.
words.ex_cn: 太阳使路上的冰变软了。
words.en: To make or become soft or softer.

words.ex: He had to rewrite his essay after the teacher gave feedback.
words.ex_cn: 他在老师给出反馈后不得不重写他的作文。
words.en: If someone rewrites a piece of writing such as a book, an article, or a law, they write it in a different way in order to improve it or because circumstances have changed.

words.ex: He decided to reheat the leftovers for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他决定把剩菜重新加热作为晚餐。
words.en: To heat something again, especially food that has already been cooked.

words.ex: The playful puppy chased its tail.
words.ex_cn: 那只爱玩耍的小狗追着自己的尾巴跑。
words.en: Someone who is playful is full of fun and likes to play.

words.tr:
v. 抽出；节省；
adj. 备用的；多余的；空闲的；
words.ex: Can you spare a few minutes to help me?
words.ex_cn: 你能抽出几分钟帮我吗？
words.en: If you have something such as time, money, or space to spare, you have some extra time, money, or space that you have not used or which you do not need.

words.ex: The rules of the game are unchanging.
words.ex_cn: 这个游戏的规则是不变的。
words.en: Something that is unchanging always stays the same.

words.ex: He made a careless mistake on the test.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试中犯了一个粗心的错误。
words.en: If you are careless, you do not pay enough attention to what you are doing, and so you make mistakes, or cause harm or damage.

words.ex: He danced wildly at the party.
words.ex_cn: 他在派对上疯狂地跳舞。
words.en: In a very uncontrolled or enthusiastic way.

words.ex: He publicly apologized for his mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他公开为自己的错误道歉。
words.en: In a way that is open or visible to the public; not privately.

words.ex: She stood proudly after winning the race.
words.ex_cn: 她赢得比赛后自豪地站了起来。
words.en: In a way that shows you are very pleased about something you have done or something you possess.

words.ex: She cleaned the room nicely.
words.ex_cn: 她把房间打扫得很好。
words.en: In a pleasant or agreeable manner.

words.tr: adv. 严重地；批评地；危急地；
words.ex: The patient is critically ill.
words.ex_cn: 病人病情严重。
words.en: In a way that involves the objective analysis and judgment of the merits and faults of a work of literature, music, or art.

words.ex: Luckily, the bus came just in time.
words.ex_cn: 幸运的是，公交车正好及时到了。
words.en: You use luckily to indicate that something good has happened because of chance or luck, rather than because of someone's skill or planning.

words.tr:
v. 聊天；
n. 聊天；
words.ex: They chat every evening after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天晚饭后聊天。
words.en: To talk in a friendly and informal way.

words.ex: The movie got a high rating from viewers.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影获得了观众的高评分。
words.en: A rating is a classification or ranking of someone or something based on a comparative assessment of their quality, standard, or performance.

words.tr: n. 海产食物（如海鱼、贝类等）；
words.ex: We ate fresh seafood at the seaside restaurant.
words.ex_cn: 我们在海边的餐厅吃了新鲜的海产食物。
words.en: Seafood refers to fish and shellfish from the sea that are eaten as food.

words.tr: n. 废旧杂物；无价值的东西；
words.ex: He cleaned up the junk in his garage.
words.ex_cn: 他清理了车库里那些废旧杂物。
words.en: Old or discarded articles that are considered useless or of little value.

words.tr: n. 看见； v. “sight”的现在分词；
words.ex: The sighting of a rare bird excited the birdwatchers.
words.ex_cn: 看到一只稀有鸟类让观鸟者兴奋不已。
words.en: The act of seeing or noticing someone or something, especially something unusual or unexpected.

words.ex: He sent a postcard from Paris.
words.ex_cn: 他从巴黎寄了一张明信片。
words.en: A postcard is a piece of thick paper or thin cardboard, typically rectangular, intended for writing and mailing without an envelope and at a lower rate than a letter.

words.ex: He learned about slavery in history class.
words.ex_cn: 他在历史课上学到了奴隶制。
words.en: Slavery is the system by which people are owned by other people as slaves.

words.ex: He felt tiredness after running for an hour.
words.ex_cn: 他跑了一小时后感到疲惫。
words.en: The state of feeling tired or weary.

words.ex: He is a fast eater.
words.ex_cn: 他是个吃饭很快的人。
words.en: A person or animal that consumes food.

words.ex: The accident was a serious incident.
words.ex_cn: 那场事故是一起严重事件。
words.en: An incident is an event that is either unpleasant or unusual.

words.ex: He visits the website every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天访问这个网站。
words.en: A website is a set of related web pages located under a single domain name, typically produced by a single person or organization.

words.ex: He measured his waist with a tape.
words.ex_cn: 他用卷尺测量了自己的腰围。
words.en: Your waist is the middle part of your body where it narrows slightly above your hips.

words.ex: He ate a cherry from the bowl.
words.ex_cn: 他从碗里吃了一颗樱桃。
words.en: A cherry is a small, round fruit that is typically bright or dark red. It is often eaten fresh or used in cooking and baking.

words.ex: He is learning English grammar every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都在学习英语语法。
words.en: Grammar is the system and structure of a language. The rules of grammar help us decide the order we put words in and which form of a word to use.

words.ex: I am awaiting the bus.
words.ex_cn: 我正在等公交车。
words.en: If you await someone or something, you wait for them.

words.ex: He likes to skate on the ice every winter.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢每年冬天在冰上溜冰。
words.en: To move over a surface on skates, or to perform a sport that involves moving on skates.

words.tr: adj. 未破的；不间断的；未驯服的（马）
words.ex: The unbroken chain of events led to the accident.
words.ex_cn: 这一连串未被打断的事件导致了事故。
words.en: If something is unbroken, it is continuous or complete and has not been interrupted or damaged.

words.ex: The child was naked in the bathtub.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在浴缸里是裸体的。
words.en: If something is naked, it is not covered by anything such as clothes or paint.

words.ex: He has a lifelong love for reading.
words.ex_cn: 他对阅读有着终身的热爱。
words.en: Lasting or continuing through all or much of one's life.

words.ex: He has three hobbies, namely reading, swimming, and painting.
words.ex_cn: 他有三个爱好，即阅读、游泳和绘画。
words.en: You use namely to introduce detailed information about the subject you are discussing, or a particular aspect of it.

words.ex: She ate the freshly baked bread.
words.ex_cn: 她吃了刚烤好的面包。
words.en: Recently; just now.

words.tr:
n. 大学一年级新生；新鲜人
adj. 新鲜的；“fresh”的比较级
words.ex: He is a fresher at Oxford University.
words.ex_cn: 他是牛津大学的一年级新生。
words.en: A fresher is a student in their first year at a university or college.

words.ex: The heavy workload became a burden for her.
words.ex_cn: 繁重的工作量成了她的负担。
words.en: A burden is a heavy load that is difficult to carry, or a duty or responsibility that is hard to bear.

words.ex: We had a barbecue in the park last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 上周末我们在公园举行了户外烧烤。
words.en: A barbecue is a meal or gathering at which meat, fish, or other food is cooked out of doors on a rack over an open fire or on a special appliance.

words.ex: We heard thunder during the storm.
words.ex_cn: 风暴期间我们听到了雷声。
words.en: the loud noise that you hear during a storm, usually after a flash of lightning

words.ex: He showed patience while waiting for the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他在等公交车时表现出了耐心。
words.en: The ability to stay calm and not get angry, especially when there is a difficulty or you have to wait a long time.

words.ex: The waterfall makes a loud sound.
words.ex_cn: 瀑布发出很大的声音。
words.en: A waterfall is a place where water flows over the edge of a steep, high cliff in hills or mountains, and falls into a pool below.

words.ex: He picked up a spoon to eat the soup.
words.ex_cn: 他拿起一把勺子喝汤。
words.en: A spoon is an object used for eating, stirring, and serving food. It has a small shallow bowl on a handle.

words.ex: The usage of this machine is very simple.
words.ex_cn: 这个机器的使用非常简单。
words.en: The way in which something is used or the fact of being used.

words.tr:
v. 熔炼；冶炼
v. 嗅；闻；散发气味；察觉；“smell”的过去式和过去分词
n. 胡瓜鱼
words.ex: They smelt iron ore to make steel.
words.ex_cn: 他们熔炼铁矿石来制造钢铁。
words.en: To smelt means to extract metal from ore by a process involving heating and melting.

words.ex: The children starve without food.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们没有食物就会挨饿。
words.en: To suffer or die from lack of food.

words.ex: The old bridge is unsafe to cross.
words.ex_cn: 这座旧桥过桥不安全。
words.en: If a place, situation, or activity is unsafe, it is dangerous.

words.ex: The village is still undeveloped with no roads or electricity.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄仍然不发达，没有道路和电力。
words.en: An undeveloped area of land is one that has not been used for building or farming.

words.ex: The climber reached the top of the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 这位登山者登上了山顶。
words.en: A climber is someone who climbs mountains or rocks as a sport or hobby, or a plant that grows upwards by clinging to a support.

words.ex: The dryness of the desert makes it hard for plants to grow.
words.ex_cn: 沙漠的干燥使植物难以生长。
words.en: The state or quality of being dry.

words.ex: He felt loneliness after moving to a new city.
words.ex_cn: 他搬到新城市后感到孤独。
words.en: Loneliness is the unhappiness that is felt by someone because they do not have any friends or do not have anyone to talk to.

words.tr: v. 抓住；持有；举行；容纳；保存；“hold”的现在分词； n. 土地；
words.ex: He is holding the rope tightly.
words.ex_cn: 他正紧紧地抓住绳子。
words.en: A holding is a piece of land that is owned by someone or the shares that someone owns in a company.

words.ex: The tester checked the software for bugs.
words.ex_cn: 测试员检查了软件中的错误。
words.en: A tester is someone whose job is to test something, especially new products or equipment, to make sure it works correctly.

words.ex: The teacher used a loudspeaker to talk to the students.
words.ex_cn: 老师用扬声器对学生们讲话。
words.en: A loudspeaker is a piece of electronic equipment that makes sounds louder so that they can be heard at a greater distance.

words.ex: He plays volleyball every Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 他每个星期六打排球。
words.en: A game played by two teams of six players in which a large ball is hit by hand over a high net, the aim being to score points by making the ball reach the ground on the opponent's side of the court.

words.ex: The walkway was crowded with tourists.
words.ex_cn: 走道上挤满了游客。
words.en: A walkway is a passage or path for walking, especially one that is raised above the ground or connects different parts of a building.

words.ex: He put the letter in an envelope.
words.ex_cn: 他把信装进了一个信封。
words.en: An envelope is a flat, usually rectangular or square, paper container for a letter, which you seal before you send it by post.

words.ex: He walked sideways to avoid the puddle.
words.ex_cn: 他斜着走以避开水坑。
words.en: Moving or directed toward one side.

words.ex: He is a successful businessman.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位成功的商人。
words.en: Achieving the results wanted or hoped for.

words.ex: He jogs every morning to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上慢跑以保持健康。
words.en: To run at a slow, steady pace, especially as a form of exercise.

words.ex: The movie shows too much violence.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影展示了太多的暴力。
words.en: Violence is behavior which is intended to hurt, injure, or kill people.

words.ex: He walks on the carpet every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都走在地毯上。
words.en: A carpet is a thick covering of soft material which is laid over a floor or a staircase.

words.ex: He loves studying geology in high school.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在高中学习地质学。
words.en: The science which deals with the physical structure and substance of the earth, their history, and the processes which act on them.

words.ex: He made the payment online.
words.ex_cn: 他在线支付了。
words.en: A payment is an amount of money that is paid to someone, or the act of paying this money.

words.ex: She eats olive every day with bread.
words.ex_cn: 她每天和面包一起吃橄榄。
words.en: An olive is a small oval fruit with a hard stone and bitter flesh, green when unripe and bluish black when ripe, used as food and as a source of oil.

words.ex: The farmer tried to kill the pest with a spray.
words.ex_cn: 农民试图用喷雾杀死害虫。
words.en: A pest is an animal or insect that damages crops, food, or livestock, or is generally troublesome. It can also refer to a person or thing that causes annoyance or trouble.

words.ex: He won a scholarship to study at Harvard.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了一项去哈佛学习的奖学金。
words.en: A scholarship is a grant or payment made to support a student's education, awarded on the basis of academic or other achievement.

words.ex: She adds flour to make bread.
words.ex_cn: 她加面粉来做面包。
words.en: Flour is a powder made by grinding raw grains, roots, beans, nuts, or seeds. It is used to make many different foods.

words.ex: The doctor ran a trial to test the new medicine.
words.ex_cn: 医生进行了试验来测试这种新药。
words.en: A trial is a formal meeting in a law court, at which a judge and jury listen to evidence and decide whether a person is guilty of a crime.

words.ex: The audience clapped loudly after the show.
words.ex_cn: 演出结束后，观众热烈鼓掌。
words.en: The group of spectators at a public event; listeners or viewers collectively, especially those attending a performance or reading a particular work.

words.ex: A mosquito bit my arm last night.
words.ex_cn: 一只蚊子昨晚咬了我的胳膊。
words.en: A mosquito is a small flying insect that bites people and animals in order to feed on their blood. Some mosquitoes can transmit diseases.

words.ex: The can is made of tin.
words.ex_cn: 这个罐子是锡做的。
words.en: Tin is a soft, silvery-white metal that is often used to coat other metals to prevent them from rusting. It is also used in the production of tin cans and other containers.

words.ex: He gets a salary of 3000 dollars each month.
words.ex_cn: 他每个月赚3000美元的工资。
words.en: A salary is the money that someone is paid each month by their employer, especially when they are in a profession such as teaching, law, or medicine.

words.ex: The teacher will punish the student for cheating.
words.ex_cn: 老师会因为作弊而惩罚那个学生。
words.en: To punish someone means to make them suffer in some way because they have done something wrong.

words.tr:
n. 努力争取；出价；投标；
v. 出价；投标；
words.ex: His bid for the championship inspired everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他为冠军所做的努力鼓舞了所有人。
words.en: To bid means to offer a particular amount of money for something that is being sold, especially at an auction, or to offer to do work or provide services for a particular price.

words.tr:
v. 沐浴；用水洗；沉浸
n. 游泳
words.ex: He bathes every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上洗澡。
words.en: To bathe means to wash oneself or someone else, especially in a bath or the sea, or to spend time in water for pleasure.

words.ex: The factory pollutes the river.
words.ex_cn: 工厂污染了这条河。
words.en: To pollute water, air, or land means to make it dirty and dangerous to live in or to use, especially with poisonous chemicals or waste.

words.tr: n. 着陆；降落；楼梯平台； v. “land”的现在分词；
words.ex: The plane made a smooth landing at the airport.
words.ex_cn: 飞机在机场平稳着陆。
words.en: The act of coming to or bringing something to land, especially an aircraft.

words.tr: n. 路由；路径选择；（材料或产品的）加工路线安排
words.ex: The router uses routing to send data to the right place.
words.ex_cn: 路由器使用路由将数据发送到正确的地方。
words.en: Routing refers to the process of selecting paths in a network along which to send network traffic, or the act of directing or sending something along a particular path.

words.tr: v. 追溯到；“date”的现在分词； n. 约会；
words.ex: This artifact is dating back to 500 BC.
words.ex_cn: 这件文物可追溯到公元前500年。
words.en: The act of going out regularly with somebody as a romantic or sexual partner.

words.ex: The results according to the data are surprising.
words.ex_cn: 根据数据，结果令人惊讶。
words.en: In a manner corresponding to something stated or understood.

words.tr:
conj. 那（引导从句）；
pron. 那儿；那里；
adj. 那；那个；那样的；
adv. 那个；那么；那样；
words.ex: I know that he is coming tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我知道他明天会来。
words.en: Used to identify a specific person or thing observed or heard by the speaker.

words.tr: phrase. 查阅；提到；涉及；指的是
words.ex: Please refer to the dictionary for the meaning.
words.ex_cn: 请查阅字典以了解这个词的意思。
words.en: If you refer to a particular subject or person, you talk about them or mention them.

words.ex: He likes fruits such as apples and bananas.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢苹果和香蕉这样的水果。
words.en: Used to introduce examples of something that has been mentioned.

words.ex: He likes apples, for example.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢苹果，例如。
words.en: Used when you want to give a specific instance or illustration of what you are talking about.

words.tr: phrase. 在某一方面的变化
words.ex: There has been a significant change in the weather.
words.ex_cn: 天气发生了显著的变化。
words.en: A phrase indicating a shift or development in a situation, condition, or argument.

words.ex: He used to play soccer every day.
words.ex_cn: 他过去每天踢足球。
words.en: If something used to be done or used to be the case, it was done regularly in the past or was the case in the past.

words.ex: I kind of like pizza.
words.ex_cn: 我有点喜欢披萨。
words.en: To some extent; somewhat.

words.ex: He is able to swim very well.
words.ex_cn: 他能游得很好。
words.en: To have the power, skill, means, or opportunity to do something.

words.ex: I have to go to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天必须去上学。
words.en: If you have to do something, it is necessary for you to do it.

words.tr: phrase. 按次序的；合乎程序的；井然有序
words.ex: Please line up in order.
words.ex_cn: 请按次序排队。
words.en: In the correct sequence or arrangement; appropriate or required by the circumstances.

words.ex: I have a few apples on the table.
words.ex_cn: 我桌上有一些苹果。
words.en: A small number of things or people.

words.ex: He likes coffee, and he likes tea as well.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢咖啡，也喜欢茶。
words.en: In addition to something else; also.

words.tr: phrase. 宁可 ... 也不愿；与其 ... 倒不如；而不是
words.ex: He chose to walk rather than take the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他宁愿走路也不愿坐公交车。
words.en: used to say that one thing is preferred to another or happens instead of another

words.ex: He wakes up early in order to catch the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他早起是为了赶上公交车。
words.en: with the purpose of achieving something

words.ex: The new rules add to the cost.
words.ex_cn: 新规定增加了成本。
words.en: To increase or enhance something by adding more to it.

words.ex: They live in a small house near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在公园附近的一栋小房子里。
words.en: To reside or exist within a particular place or environment.

words.ex: The path will lead to the park.
words.ex_cn: 这条路会把人带到公园。
words.en: If an action or event leads to a particular situation or event, it causes that situation or event to happen.

words.ex: He can play the guitar as well as sing.
words.ex_cn: 他既能弹吉他也能唱歌。
words.en: In addition to; and also; equally with.

words.ex: He was late because of the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他因为公交车而迟到了。
words.en: You use 'because of' to introduce the reason or explanation for something.

words.ex: He looks at the picture carefully.
words.ex_cn: 他仔细地看着这幅画。
words.en: To direct your eyes towards someone or something so that you can see them.

words.tr: phrase. 在...外；从里面；出于；在...范围外；离开
words.ex: The ball rolled out of the box.
words.ex_cn: 球滚到了盒子外面。
words.en: used to indicate movement or direction from the inside to the outside of a place or thing; used to indicate the cause or reason for something; used to indicate a lack or absence of something

words.ex: He comes from a small village.
words.ex_cn: 他来自一个小村庄。
words.en: To originate or hail from a particular place or background.

words.tr: phrase. 及时到达；达到预定目标
words.ex: We need to leave now to make it to the train on time.
words.ex_cn: 我们现在必须出发，才能及时赶到火车。
words.en: To succeed in arriving at a place or achieving a goal.

words.ex: He likes apples. In addition, he likes oranges.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢苹果。另外，他喜欢橙子。
words.en: You use in addition when you want to mention another item connected with the subject you are discussing.

words.ex: He depends on his brother for help.
words.ex_cn: 他依靠他哥哥帮忙。
words.en: To rely on someone or something for support, help, or supply; to be determined or influenced by something.

words.tr: phrase. 贡献；促成；导致；有助于
words.ex: Volunteers contribute to the clean-up of the park.
words.ex_cn: 志愿者们为公园的清洁做出了贡献。
words.en: If you contribute to something, you help to cause it or make it happen.

words.ex: He is known as a great teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他被称为一位优秀的老师。
words.en: If someone or something is known as a particular name, they are called by that name.

words.tr: phrase. 具有...特色的；为…所特有
words.ex: This noise is characteristic of a broken engine.
words.ex_cn: 这种噪音是发动机坏了的特征。
words.en: To be typical of a particular person or thing.

words.ex: He studied hard so that he could pass the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习以便通过考试。
words.en: Used to introduce a clause of purpose or result.

words.tr: phrase. 以…为基础；以…为根据
words.ex: The plan is based on simple rules.
words.ex_cn: 这个计划是基于简单规则的。
words.en: If something is based on something else, it uses it as the thing from which it develops.

words.tr: phrase. 省去； 遗漏； 不考虑
words.ex: Don't leave out the sugar in the recipe.
words.ex_cn: 别在食谱里漏掉糖。
words.en: To not include someone or something in an activity or discussion.

words.ex: I need at least three apples to make a pie.
words.ex_cn: 我至少需要三个苹果来做派。
words.en: You use at least to say that a number or amount is the smallest that is possible or likely and that the actual number or amount may be greater. The forms at the least and at the very least are also used.

words.ex: This book is related to science.
words.ex_cn: 这本书与科学有关。
words.en: Connected by blood or marriage; having a close relationship with someone or something.

words.ex: He no longer plays soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他不再踢足球了。
words.en: If something is no longer the case, it is not the case now, although it was the case in the past.

words.ex: The meeting will take place tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 会议将在明天举行。
words.en: When something takes place, it happens, especially in a controlled or organized way.

words.ex: The team consists of five players.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队由五名球员组成。
words.en: If something consists of particular things or people, it is made up of them.

words.tr:
v. 增加；增多；
n. 增加；增长；
words.ex: The company increased its profits last year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司去年增加了利润。
words.en: To increase something means to make it larger in size, amount, or degree.

words.ex: He says he likes sports, but in fact, he hates them.
words.ex_cn: 他说他喜欢运动，但事实上，他讨厌它们。
words.en: You use in fact to emphasize that something is true, especially when it contradicts what has just been said or might be expected.

words.ex: He failed the test because of lack of sleep.
words.ex_cn: 他因为缺乏睡眠而考试不及格。
words.en: The state of being without or not having enough of something.

words.ex: What on earth are you doing?
words.ex_cn: 你到底在干什么？
words.en: Used for emphasis in questions to express surprise or confusion.

words.tr: phrase. 类似于； 与 ... 相似
words.ex: This apple is similar to that one.
words.ex_cn: 这个苹果和那个很相似。
words.en: If one thing is similar to another, or if two things are similar, they have features that are the same.

words.tr: phrase. 涉及；专心； 卷入
words.ex: He is involved in the school play.
words.ex_cn: 他参与了学校的戏剧表演。
words.en: To be included or participate in something, especially something that requires a lot of time or effort.

words.ex: He got involved in the school play last month.
words.ex_cn: 他上个月参加了学校的戏剧表演。
words.en: To become a part of or participate in an activity or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 多种的；各种各样的
words.ex: He eats a variety of fruits every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天吃各种各样的水果。
words.en: A number or range of things of the same general class that are different or distinct in character or quality.

words.tr: 由……制成（表示材料，强调原材料未发生根本性变化）
words.ex: The table is made of wood.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子是木头做的。
words.en: If something is made of a particular material, that material was used to build it.

words.ex: I associate with him because we share the same hobbies.
words.ex_cn: 我跟他联系是因为我们有相同的爱好。
words.en: to spend time with someone, especially someone that other people disapprove of

words.tr: phrase. 和…联系在一起；与…有关
words.ex: He is associated with the local hospital.
words.ex_cn: 他与当地医院有关联。
words.en: If one thing is associated with another, the two things are connected because they happen together or one thing causes the other.

words.ex: He didn't study hard, as a result, he failed the test.
words.ex_cn: 他没有努力学习，结果考试不及格。
words.en: used to introduce the consequence or effect of a particular situation or event

words.ex: He was late, and that annoyed me.
words.ex_cn: 他迟到了，这让我很恼火。
words.en: A conjunction phrase used to introduce a clause that adds emphasis or a concluding point to a previous statement.

words.tr: phrase. 苏醒；到达；总计；突然想起
words.ex: He came to after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故后他醒了过来。
words.en: If someone comes to, they regain consciousness after being unconscious. It can also mean to reach a particular state or condition, or to be involved in something.

words.ex: He asks for help when he is stuck.
words.ex_cn: 当他遇到困难时，他会寻求帮助。
words.en: To request something; to express a desire for something.

words.ex: They help each other with homework.
words.ex_cn: 他们互相帮助做作业。
words.en: You use each other when you are saying that each member of a group does something to or for the other members.

words.ex: He has much more time than me.
words.ex_cn: 他比我有更多的时间。
words.en: Used to emphasize the degree or extent of something, indicating a significantly greater amount or degree.

words.ex: In addition to apples, he buys oranges.
words.ex_cn: 除了苹果，他还买橘子。
words.en: Besides; as well as.

words.ex: The reason for the delay was due to bad weather.
words.ex_cn: 延误的原因是由于恶劣的天气。
words.en: The cause or explanation for something that has happened or that someone has done.

words.ex: There is a high demand for clean water.
words.ex_cn: 对干净水的需求很高。
words.en: If there is a demand for something, people want to buy it or use it.

words.ex: He went out even though it was raining.
words.ex_cn: 尽管在下雨，他还是出去了。
words.en: You use even though to introduce a clause which gives the reason for something, but which makes the reason seem less important or significant.

words.ex: He has ten apples in all.
words.ex_cn: 他一共有十个苹果。
words.en: You use in all to emphasize that something is the total amount or number involved.

words.tr: phrase. 集中（精力；注意力等）于
words.ex: He focuses on his homework every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上专心做作业。
words.en: to direct your attention or effort towards something specific

words.tr: phrase. 由…决定；是…的职责；从事；胜任
words.ex_cn: 这个周末你打算做什么？
words.en: Used to ask or talk about what someone is doing or planning to do.

words.tr: phrase. 同时；但是；在相同的时间
words.ex: He sings and dances at the same time.
words.ex_cn: 他一边唱歌一边跳舞。
words.en: If two or more things exist, happen, or are true at the same time, they exist, happen, or are true together although they seem to contradict each other.

words.ex_cn: 学校离公园很近。
words.en: To be near in space, time, or relationship.

words.ex: This book is different from that one.
words.ex_cn: 这本书和那本书不一样。
words.en: To not be the same as something or someone else.

words.tr:
n. 结果；
v. 导致；
words.ex: The result of the test was good.
words.ex_cn: 这次测试的结果很好。
words.en: A consequence, outcome, or effect of an action or situation.

words.ex: Can you provide me with some information about the new project?
words.ex_cn: 你能提供一些关于新项目的信息吗？
words.en: Facts or details about a particular subject or situation.

words.ex: The rain had a big effect on the game.
words.ex_cn: 下雨对比赛产生了很大影响。
words.en: The way in which something acts upon or influences something else.

words.ex: He is late in that he missed the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他迟到了，因为他没赶上公交车。
words.en: Used to introduce a reason or explanation for something.

words.tr: phrase. 是…的原因；解释；负责；（数量或比例上）占
words.ex: The rain can account for the delay.
words.ex_cn: 下雨是延误的原因。
words.en: If a particular thing accounts for a part or proportion of something, that part or proportion consists of that thing, or is used or produced by it.

words.ex: He engages in sports after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后参加体育运动。
words.en: To participate or become involved in an activity.

words.tr: phrase. 依次；轮流；结果；反过来
words.ex: The students spoke in turn to answer the teacher's question.
words.ex_cn: 学生们依次回答老师的问题。
words.en: You use in turn to refer to actions or events that are in a sequence one after the other, especially because one causes the other.

words.ex: He left home prior to sunrise.
words.ex_cn: 他在日出前离开了家。
words.en: Before a particular time or event.

words.ex: He will point out the mistake in the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他将指出这道数学题中的错误。
words.en: To direct someone's attention to a particular fact or detail.

words.ex: The new policy had a significant impact on the economy.
words.ex_cn: 新政策对经济产生了重大影响。
words.en: To have an effect or influence on someone or something.

words.ex: He was tired, and so he went to bed early.
words.ex_cn: 他很累，所以早早就上床睡觉了。
words.en: used to introduce the logical result of something that has just been mentioned

words.tr: phrase. 在适当的位置；适当
words.ex: The books are in place on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 书整齐地放在书架上。
words.en: In the correct position or location; ready for use.

words.ex: He drank tea instead of coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他喝了茶，而不是咖啡。
words.en: In place of someone or something else.

words.tr: phrase. 由于…的结果；起因；经；因
words.ex: He was late as a result of the bus breaking down.
words.ex_cn: 由于公交车坏了，他迟到了。
words.en: Because of something that has happened.

words.ex: Of course, I will help you with your homework.
words.ex_cn: 当然，我会帮你做作业。
words.en: Used to express agreement or to indicate that something is expected or obvious.

words.ex: This apple differs from that one in color.
words.ex_cn: 这个苹果和那个苹果在颜色上不同。
words.en: to be not the same as something else

words.tr: phrase. 在某人不在的时候
words.ex: Please lock the door in my absence.
words.ex_cn: 我不在时，请锁好门。
words.en: During the time when someone is not present.

words.ex: He feels nervous in his teacher's presence.
words.ex_cn: 他在老师面前感到紧张。
words.en: When someone is in one's presence, they are in the same place as that person and are aware of them.

words.ex: He played soccer in the past.
words.ex_cn: 他过去踢足球。
words.en: At a time before the present; in earlier times.

words.ex: We had a discussion about homework.
words.ex_cn: 我们进行了一次关于作业的讨论。
words.en: A discussion is a conversation or debate about a specific topic.

words.ex: He gave a simple explanation for his mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他为自己的错误给出了一个简单的解释。
words.en: An explanation is a statement or account that makes something clear or provides a reason for something.

words.ex: He relies on his brother for help.
words.ex_cn: 他依靠弟弟帮忙。
words.en: To depend on with full trust or confidence.

words.ex: He is responsible for cleaning the room.
words.ex_cn: 他负责打扫房间。
words.en: To have the duty of taking care of something or someone, so that you may be blamed if something goes wrong.

words.tr: phrase. 不像……；不如……（用于比较结构中，表示“没有……那样”）
words.ex: He is not as tall as his brother.
words.ex_cn: 他不像他哥哥那么高。
words.en: Used to indicate that something is not the same as or does not meet the standard of something else.

words.ex: This room can serve as a meeting room.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间可以充当会议室。
words.en: To function or be used as something.

words.ex: The prices range from $5 to $50.
words.ex_cn: 价格范围自5美元到50美元。
words.en: If things range from one thing to another, they vary within these limits on a scale of measurement or quality.

words.tr:
n. 接触（的机会或权利）；进入；通道；
v. 获取；使用；接近；
words.ex: Students need access to the library.
words.ex_cn: 学生需要有接触图书馆的机会。
words.en: If you have access to a building or other place, you are able to enter it or use it.

words.tr: phrase. 至于； 关于；按着；根据
words.ex: I don't know as to when he will come.
words.ex_cn: 我不知道他什么时候来。
words.en: Used to indicate what something is about or concerns.

words.ex: I like coffee, on the other hand, my brother prefers tea.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢咖啡，另一方面，我弟弟更喜欢茶。
words.en: used to introduce a statement that contrasts with or seems to contradict something that has been said previously

words.ex: He eats as much as his brother.
words.ex_cn: 他吃得和他兄弟一样多。
words.en: You use 'as much as' to say that something is true to the same extent as something else.

words.ex: He fail to finish his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他未能完成家庭作业。
words.en: If you fail to do something that you were trying to do, you are unable to do it or you do not succeed in doing it.

words.ex: I don't like coffee at all.
words.ex_cn: 我一点也不喜欢咖啡。
words.en: Used to emphasize a negative statement, meaning 'in any way' or 'to any extent'.

words.tr: phrase. 就...而言；在...方面；根据
words.ex: In terms of cost, this phone is cheaper.
words.ex_cn: 从成本来看，这部手机更便宜。
words.en: used to indicate what aspect of a subject you are talking about

words.ex: He plays soccer together with his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他和朋友们一起踢足球。
words.en: In addition to someone or something else; alongside.

words.ex: He can eat one apple at a time.
words.ex_cn: 他一次只能吃一个苹果。
words.en: Indicates the number of items or actions that are involved in a single instance or occurrence.

words.ex: At first, he did not like math.
words.ex_cn: 起初，他不喜欢数学。
words.en: At the beginning; initially.

words.ex: I like fruits, for instance, apples and bananas.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢水果，例如苹果和香蕉。
words.en: Used to introduce an example that illustrates or supports a point being made.

words.ex: He is dependent on his parents for money.
words.ex_cn: 他靠父母给钱生活。
words.en: rely on something or someone for support or existence

words.tr: phrase. 另外一个人；彼此；相互
words.ex: The students helped one another with their homework.
words.ex_cn: 学生们互相帮助做作业。
words.en: used to indicate that each of two or more people or things does something to or with the other(s)

words.ex: This word derives from Latin.
words.ex_cn: 这个词源自拉丁语。
words.en: To obtain something from a specified source.

words.tr: phrase. 想到；想起；有...的看法
words.ex: I think of my mom when I eat cookies.
words.ex_cn: 当我吃饼干时，我想起我的妈妈。
words.en: To have a particular idea or opinion about something or someone; to consider something or someone in a particular way.

words.tr:
n. 减少；
v. 减少；降低；
words.ex: There was a decrease in rainfall last month.
words.ex_cn: 上个月降雨量减少了。
words.en: If something decreases or you decrease it, it becomes less in quantity, size, or intensity.

words.ex: He runs just as fast as his brother.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得和他哥哥一样快。
words.en: in the same way that; at the same time as

words.ex: This rule applies to all students.
words.ex_cn: 这条规则适用于所有学生。
words.en: To make a formal request, usually in writing, for something such as a job, a place at a university, or permission to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 继续生存； 以...为主食, 靠...生活
words.ex: The old man lives on small donations from neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人靠邻居们的小额捐款继续生存。
words.en: To continue to exist or be remembered; to have a particular type of food or income as one's main source of sustenance.

words.ex: He did not respond to the message yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天没有回复那条信息。
words.en: To react or answer to something, such as a question, request, or situation.

words.ex: He thought of a good idea for the project.
words.ex_cn: 他想到了一个关于这个项目的好主意。
words.en: To consider or remember something or someone.

words.tr:
v. 做；干；
n. 所作所为；活动；
words.ex: He is doing his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他正在做作业。
words.en: The act of performing or accomplishing something.

words.ex: He has a little money left.
words.ex_cn: 他剩下一点钱。
words.en: A small amount of something.

words.ex: The team is composed of five players.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队由五名队员组成。
words.en: If something is composed of particular things, people, or elements, it is made from those things, people, or elements.

words.tr: phrase. 在某种程度上；部分地
words.ex: He succeeded in part because he worked hard.
words.ex_cn: 他部分成功是因为他努力工作。
words.en: To some extent; not completely.

words.tr: phrase. 服从；容易遭受；受制于
words.ex: All students are subject to the school rules.
words.ex_cn: 所有学生都必须服从校规。
words.en: Likely to be affected by or to experience something.

words.tr: phrase. 与...相处；忍受；处理；与…有关；需要；想做
words.ex: I don't know how to do with him; he is always quiet.
words.ex_cn: 我不知道怎么和他相处；他总是很安静。
words.en: To have a connection or relevance to a particular subject or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 与...在一起；沿着；除此之外，还…
words.ex: He bought apples along with oranges.
words.ex_cn: 他买了苹果，还买了橙子。
words.en: in addition to someone or something else; together with someone or something else

words.ex: The robbers fell on the old man at night.
words.ex_cn: 抢劫者在夜里袭击了那位老人。
words.en: If a duty, responsibility, or opportunity falls on someone, it is their duty, responsibility, or opportunity to do something.

words.ex: The robbers fell upon the old man at night.
words.ex_cn: 抢劫者在夜里袭击了那位老人。
words.en: To happen to someone or something, especially something unpleasant, or to attack someone or something suddenly.

words.tr: phrase. 经过；通过；经历；经历并完成
words.ex: We pass through the park every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我们每天早上都穿过公园。
words.en: To move or travel through a place or area.

words.tr: phrase. 通常；大体上；一般而言
words.ex: In general, he likes to eat fruit.
words.ex_cn: 总的来说，他喜欢吃水果。
words.en: Usually; in most cases.

words.ex: The lesson begins with a simple question.
words.ex_cn: 这节课以一个简单的问题开始。
words.en: To start with something, especially as a first step or part of a process.

words.ex: Please remove from the table.
words.ex_cn: 请把东西从桌子上移开。
words.en: To take something away from a place or person.

words.ex: The sun comes into the room in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 太阳早上照进房间里。
words.en: To enter a place, state, or condition; to inherit something; to begin to be involved in something.

words.ex: The nurse poured cold water on his face to bring him to.
words.ex_cn: 护士往他脸上泼了冷水，让他苏醒过来。
words.en: To cause someone to regain consciousness or to become aware of something.

words.ex: He is capable of solving hard math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他能解决困难的数学问题。
words.en: To have the ability, power, or skill to do something.

words.ex: He is all over the place today.
words.ex_cn: 他今天到处跑。
words.en: In every part of a place; everywhere.

words.ex: Mix the flour combine with water to make dough.
words.ex_cn: 将面粉与水混合做成面团。
words.en: To join or merge two or more things together to form a single entity.

words.ex: I like fruits, in particular apples.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢水果，尤其是苹果。
words.en: Especially; more than other things or people.

words.tr: phrase. 建立；创立；设立；架起；提出
words.ex: He set up a small shop last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年开了一家小商店。
words.en: To set up something means to establish it or arrange it.

words.ex: His words have a big influence on her choices.
words.ex_cn: 他的话对她的选择有很大影响。
words.en: The effect that somebody/something has on the way a person thinks or behaves or on the way that something works or develops.

words.ex: This book belongs to me.
words.ex_cn: 这本书属于我。
words.en: If something belongs to you, you own it or it is yours.

words.ex: The work was done by him.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作是他做的。
words.en: To treat someone in a particular way.

words.ex: He is the best player in the world.
words.ex_cn: 他是世界上最好的球员。
words.en: Used to emphasize the question of what exists or happens in the world, or to emphasize a superlative.

words.tr: phrase. 撤退；让路；退让；屈服；垮塌
words.ex: The soldiers had to give way to the enemy.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们不得不向敌人撤退。
words.en: To yield or surrender; to collapse or fail under pressure.

words.ex: He took advantage of the free tickets.
words.ex_cn: 他利用了免费的票。
words.en: To use a particular situation to do or get what you want.

words.ex: The village is far from the city.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄远离城市。
words.en: If you say that something is far from a particular thing or far from being the case, you are emphasizing that it is not that particular thing or not at all the case, especially when people expect or assume that it is.

words.ex: Hard work can bring about success.
words.ex_cn: 努力工作可以带来成功。
words.en: To cause something to happen.

words.tr: phrase. 开始从事；喜欢；形成...的习惯
words.ex: He took to swimming every morning to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他开始每天早上游泳来保持健康。
words.en: To begin to like someone or something; to start doing something as a habit or regular activity.

words.ex: He tried to hold in his laughter.
words.ex_cn: 他试图忍住不笑。
words.en: To keep something inside or to prevent it from being expressed.

words.ex: His contribution to the project was very helpful.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个项目的贡献非常有帮助。
words.en: If you make a contribution to something, you do something to help make it successful or to produce it.

words.tr: phrase. 使（音乐、录音等）开始播放；在比赛中逐渐进入状态；在（某地）进行比赛
words.ex: Can you play in the song now?
words.ex_cn: 你现在能播放这首歌吗？
words.en: To have a role or function in a particular activity, process, or situation.

words.ex: He is known for his kindness.
words.ex_cn: 他以善良著称。
words.en: If someone or something is known for a particular quality or feature, they are famous or recognized because of it.

words.ex: The old rules give way to new ones.
words.ex_cn: 旧规则让位于新规则。
words.en: If something gives way to something else, it is replaced by it.

words.ex: He benefits from eating healthy food.
words.ex_cn: 他从吃健康食品中获益。
words.en: To gain an advantage or profit from something.

words.ex: He pays attention to his teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他专心听老师讲课。
words.en: Attention to refers to the act of focusing or concentrating on something or someone.

words.ex: He lies in bed on Sunday mornings.
words.ex_cn: 他在周日早上睡懒觉。
words.en: To be the main or most important part of something; to stay in bed longer than usual in the morning.

words.ex: More and more people use phones to learn English.
words.ex_cn: 越来越多的人用手机学英语。
words.en: Used to indicate that something is increasing in quantity or degree over time.

words.tr: phrase. 停止运转；出故障；分解；感情失控
words.ex: The machine broke down yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器昨天坏了。
words.en: If a machine or vehicle breaks down, it stops working. If a discussion, relationship, or system breaks down, it fails because of a problem or disagreement.

words.ex: Water is necessary for plants to grow.
words.ex_cn: 水对植物生长是必要的。
words.en: To be essential or required for something to happen or exist.

words.ex: He fell into the river by accident.
words.ex_cn: 他不小心掉进了河里。
words.en: To fall into something means to be classified or divided into it, or to start to be in a particular state or condition.

words.tr: phrase. 呼吁；有吸引力；使感兴趣
words.ex: The teacher appealed to the students to be quiet.
words.ex_cn: 老师呼吁学生们保持安静。
words.en: To make a serious or urgent request to the public for help or money; to attract or interest someone.

words.ex: He has a dependence on coffee to wake up.
words.ex_cn: 他依赖咖啡来提神。
words.en: The state of relying on or being controlled by someone or something else.

words.tr: phrase. 在空中；悬而未决；在流传中；可感觉到
words.ex: The kite is flying in the air.
words.ex_cn: 风筝在空中飞翔。
words.en: If something is in the air, you feel that it is happening or about to happen.

words.ex: Prices vary from one store to another.
words.ex_cn: 价格因商店而异。
words.en: To be different from something else in some way.

words.ex: They have nothing in common.
words.ex_cn: 他们没有什么共同点。
words.en: If two or more people have something in common, they share the same interests or experiences.

words.ex: He doesn't necessarily agree with you.
words.ex_cn: 他并不必然同意你。
words.en: If you say that something necessarily happens or is the case, you mean that it has to happen or be the case and cannot be any different.

words.ex: He can deal with difficult problems.
words.ex_cn: 他能处理困难的问题。
words.en: To deal with something means to take action in order to achieve something or in order to solve a problem.

words.ex: Children have reliance on their parents for love and care.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们依赖父母的爱与照顾。
words.en: The act of depending on or trusting in someone or something.

words.ex: The rain set in after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 午饭后雨开始下了。
words.en: If something sets in, especially something unpleasant, it begins and seems likely to continue or develop.

words.ex: This soil is rich in nutrients.
words.ex_cn: 这种土壤富含养分。
words.en: To contain a large amount of something beneficial or valuable.

words.tr: phrase. 以...为基础；根据；按照
words.ex: He made a decision on the basis of the facts.
words.ex_cn: 他基于事实做出了决定。
words.en: On the basis of means using something as the foundation or starting point for something else.

words.ex: This tool is in use right now.
words.ex_cn: 这个工具现在正在使用中。
words.en: Currently being used or occupied.

words.tr: phrase. 建立；逐步增长；加强
words.ex: He builds up his strength by running every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天跑步来增强体力。
words.en: To increase or develop something gradually; to accumulate or amass something over time.

words.ex: He makes use of old books to save money.
words.ex_cn: 他利用旧书来省钱。
words.en: To use something or someone in order to achieve a particular purpose.

words.ex: He begged money of his father.
words.ex_cn: 他向父亲乞讨钱。
words.en: To ask someone for something in a polite or humble way.

words.ex: This noise is typical of old cars.
words.ex_cn: 这种噪音是老车的典型特征。
words.en: If something is typical of a particular type of person or thing, it shows all the usual characteristics of that type.

words.ex: He explained the rule in relation to the example.
words.ex_cn: 他结合例子解释了这个规则。
words.en: Concerning or in connection with something.

words.ex: The team is made up of five players.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队由五名球员组成。
words.en: Composed or formed by combining various elements or parts.

words.tr: phrase. 一连串的；一系列；一套
words.ex: He made a series of mistakes on the test.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试中犯了一连串的错误。
words.en: A number of things or events that are arranged or happen one after the other.

words.ex: We need to decide with respect to the weather.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要考虑到天气来做出决定。
words.en: Regarding or concerning something.

words.ex: She gave birth to a healthy baby last night.
words.ex_cn: 她昨晚生了一个健康的宝宝。
words.en: To produce a baby or young animal from your body.

words.ex_cn: 他碰巧丢了钥匙。
words.en: If something happens to someone or something, it takes place and affects them.

words.tr: phrase. 发生在...人身上；碰巧
words.ex: What will happen to the dog if we go on vacation?
words.ex_cn: 如果我们去度假，那只狗会怎么样？
words.en: If something happens to someone or something, it occurs or takes place, often by chance.

words.ex: The car collided with a tree.
words.ex_cn: 汽车撞上了一棵树。
words.en: To collide with something means to crash into it or come into conflict with it.

words.tr: adj. 必需的；必要的；必然的；
words.ex: Water is necessary for life.
words.ex_cn: 水是生命所必需的。
words.en: If something is necessary, it is needed in order for something else to happen or be done.

words.tr:
n. 上升；提高；
v. 上升；提高；
words.ex: There was a rise in temperature yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 昨天温度上升了。
words.en: If an amount or level rises, it increases; if something rises, it moves upwards; if you rise, you stand up; if you rise, you get out of bed.

words.ex: He is a representative of the student council.
words.ex_cn: 他是学生会的代表。
words.en: Typical of or characteristic of a particular group, class, or type.

words.tr: phrase. 中断；突然停止；断绝（关系）；休息一会
words.ex: He broke off the conversation when the phone rang.
words.ex_cn: 电话响时，他中断了对话。
words.en: To suddenly stop doing something, especially speaking.

words.ex: The story ends in a happy surprise.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事结果是一个快乐的惊喜。
words.en: To have a particular result or conclusion.

words.ex: In some ways, he is better at math than his brother.
words.ex_cn: 在某些方面，他比他哥哥更擅长数学。
words.en: In certain aspects or to a certain extent.

words.ex: He will assist in cleaning the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 他将协助打扫教室。
words.en: To help someone to do something, especially by doing part of the work yourself.

words.tr: adj. 必需的；基本的；本质的；
words.ex: Water is essential for life.
words.ex_cn: 水对生命是必需的。
words.en: Something that is essential is extremely important or absolutely necessary to a particular subject, situation, or activity.

words.ex: He goes on talking even when no one listens.
words.ex_cn: 即使没人听，他还是继续说。
words.en: To continue an activity or process, especially after a pause or interruption.

words.tr:
n. 方法；接近；靠近；路径；
v. 接近；靠近；临近；处理；
words.ex: He used a new approach to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他用了一种新方法来解决问题。
words.en: To come near or nearer to something or someone in distance or time.

words.ex: He will return to school next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周将返回学校。
words.en: To go back to a previous state, place, or topic.

words.ex: Poor hygiene can give rise to infections.
words.ex_cn: 不良的卫生习惯可能导致感染。
words.en: To cause something to happen or exist.

words.ex: He will call me as soon as he arrives.
words.ex_cn: 他一到就会给我打电话。
words.en: At the moment that; immediately after.

words.tr: phrase. 捡起；获得；接人；恢复精神；偶然学到；加速；逮住
words.ex: He picked up the pen from the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他从地上捡起了钢笔。
words.en: If you pick something up, you lift it up from a surface. If you pick someone up, you go to the place where they are and take them away, often in a car. If you pick up a skill or an idea, you acquire it without formal teaching or training. If something picks up, it improves or increases after a period of inactivity or decline.

words.tr: phrase. 对…负责；对…作出解释
words.ex: The manager must answer to the board for the budget mistake.
words.ex_cn: 经理必须对预算错误向董事会负责。
words.en: To be responsible for something or to explain your actions to someone in authority.

words.ex: Don't interfere with my work.
words.ex_cn: 不要干涉我的工作。
words.en: To interfere with something means to prevent it from happening or developing as it should, often by causing a problem or difficulty.

words.ex: They will move in next week.
words.ex_cn: 他们下周搬进来。
words.en: To begin living in a new home or place.

words.ex: The dog sleeps in the open under the tree.
words.ex_cn: 狗在树下露天睡觉。
words.en: In a place that is not enclosed or hidden; outdoors or publicly.

words.ex: I know about cats and dogs.
words.ex_cn: 我知道关于猫和狗的事情。
words.en: To have information or understanding about something.

words.ex: He is known to help his classmates with math.
words.ex_cn: 他以帮助同学学数学而闻名。
words.en: If someone or something is known to you, you are familiar with them because you have heard about them or seen them before.

words.ex: He compares his score with his friend's score.
words.ex_cn: 他把自己的分数和朋友的分数做比较。
words.en: To examine or look for the difference between two or more things.

words.ex: Her hard work led to success.
words.ex_cn: 她的努力带来了成功。
words.en: The achievement of something desired, planned, or attempted.

words.ex: This shoe is suitable for walking.
words.ex_cn: 这双鞋适合走路。
words.en: If something is suitable for a particular purpose or person, it is right or acceptable for that purpose or person.

words.ex: He went for a walk regardless of the rain.
words.ex_cn: 尽管下雨，他还是去散步了。
words.en: Without taking into account; without being affected by.

words.ex: He sleeps at night.
words.ex_cn: 他晚上睡觉。
words.en: During the night; in the nighttime.

words.tr: phrase. 好像...似的； 仿佛...一样
words.ex: He talks as if he knows everything.
words.ex_cn: 他说话的样子好像什么都知道。
words.en: used to describe how someone or something appears or behaves, suggesting that the appearance or behavior is not real or true

words.ex: They will carry out the experiment tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他们明天将进行这个实验。
words.en: To perform or complete a task, duty, or project.

words.tr: phrase.  进入；干涉；介入；作短时访问
words.ex: He will step in to help when needed.
words.ex_cn: 当需要时，他会介入帮忙。
words.en: To become involved in a situation in order to help deal with a problem.

words.tr: phrase. 对...达成协议；对...取得一致意见
words.ex: They agree on the plan for the trip.
words.ex_cn: 他们对旅行的计划达成一致。
words.en: To reach a mutual understanding or consensus about something.

words.tr: phrase. 照料；关怀；喜欢；想要
words.ex: She cares for her sick mother every day.
words.ex_cn: 她每天照顾她生病的母亲。
words.en: To like or love someone or something; to look after someone or something.

words.ex: He is familiar with basic math.
words.ex_cn: 他熟悉基础数学。
words.en: If you are familiar with something, you know or understand it well.

words.ex: The temperature fell to zero last night.
words.ex_cn: 昨晚温度降到了零度。
words.en: If someone falls to doing something, they start doing it.

words.tr: phrase. 拿起；开始从事；接受（提议）；占用
words.ex: He took up the book from the table.
words.ex_cn: 他从桌子上拿起了书。
words.en: To begin to do or deal with something; to occupy or fill a particular amount of time or space; to accept an offer or challenge.

words.tr:
n. 下降；衰退；
v. 下降；衰退；
words.ex: There was a sharp decline in sales last month.
words.ex_cn: 上个月销售额大幅下降。
words.en: If something declines, it becomes less in quantity, importance, or strength.

words.ex: He removed the book from the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 他把书从架子上拿走了。
words.en: To take something away from a particular place or position.

words.ex: The teacher removed him from the class for breaking rules.
words.ex_cn: 老师因为他违反规则而把他从班级中除名。
words.en: To take someone away from a particular place or position.

words.ex: He tries to cope with stress by walking every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天散步来应对压力。
words.en: To deal effectively with something difficult.

words.ex: The class, as a whole, did well on the test.
words.ex_cn: 整个班级在考试中表现不错。
words.en: Considering all parts or elements together; as a single unit.

words.ex: There are lots of books on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 书架上有许多书。
words.en: A large number or amount of something.

words.ex: The cat is sitting in front of the house.
words.ex_cn: 猫坐在房子前面。
words.en: If someone or something is in front of a particular thing, they are facing it, ahead of it, or close to the front part of it.

words.ex: He has control over the machine.
words.ex_cn: 他控制着这台机器。
