words.en: The power to influence or direct people's behavior or the course of events.

words.ex: He went to school in spite of the rain.
words.ex_cn: 尽管下雨，他还是去上学了。
words.en: You use in spite of to introduce a fact which makes the rest of the statement you are making seem surprising.

words.ex: He sings in public every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末都在公共场合唱歌。
words.en: In a way that can be seen or heard by other people; openly.

words.ex: He listens to music every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天听音乐。
words.en: To pay attention to someone or something in order to hear what is being said, sung, played, etc.

words.tr: phrase. 出现；生产；结果是；关闭；朝外
words.ex: The weather turned out to be sunny.
words.ex_cn: 天气结果是晴朗的。
words.en: If something turns out a particular way, it happens in that way or has the result or degree of success indicated. If you turn out something, you produce or create it. If you turn out a light, you switch it off.

words.ex: The police found a clue at the crime scene.
words.ex_cn: 警察在犯罪现场找到了一条线索。
words.en: A clue is an object or piece of information that helps to solve a problem or mystery.

words.ex: He has the right to speak freely.
words.ex_cn: 他有自由发言的权利。
words.en: The entitlement or permission to have or do something.

words.ex: I'm tired; in other words, I need to rest.
words.ex_cn: 我累了；换句话说，我需要休息。
words.en: Used to introduce a different way of saying the same thing, often to make it clearer or more understandable.

words.ex: I will go to college in the future.
words.ex_cn: 我将来会去上大学。
words.en: at a time after the present

words.ex: He wrote the letter by hand.
words.ex_cn: 他亲手写了这封信。
words.en: If something is done by hand, it is done using someone's hands rather than a machine.

words.ex: He looks for his keys every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都找他的钥匙。
words.en: To search for something or someone.

words.ex: As for homework, I finished it yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 至于作业，我昨天就完成了。
words.en: used to start talking about someone or something

words.ex: He cleaned the floor by means of a mop.
words.ex_cn: 他用拖把打扫了地板。
words.en: If you do something by means of a particular method, instrument, or process, you do it using that method, instrument, or process.

words.ex: I will go for a walk even if it rains.
words.ex_cn: 即使下雨，我也会去散步。
words.en: You use 'even if' to say that something is true or happens although something else might prevent it.

words.ex: He points to the door when he wants to leave.
words.ex_cn: 当他想离开时，他指向门。
words.en: To suggest or indicate something as being likely or true.

words.ex: He is watching TV at home.
words.ex_cn: 他正在家里看电视。
words.en: In or at one's own home.

words.tr: phrase. 比…优越；比…高级；胜过
words.ex: This phone is superior to the old one.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机比旧的更好。
words.en: If one thing or person is superior to another, the first is better than the second.

words.tr: phrase. 呼吁；号召；要求；接（人）
words.ex: The situation calls for immediate action.
words.ex_cn: 这种情况需要立即采取行动。
words.en: If you call for something, you demand that it should happen.

words.tr: phrase. 穿着；戴着；计划要做
words.ex: She has on a red dress.
words.ex_cn: 她穿着一件红裙子。
words.en: To wear something; to be wearing something. Also, to deceive someone or to have something arranged.

words.ex: He will take over the business next month.
words.ex_cn: 他下个月将接管这家企业。
words.en: To take control of something, especially a company, by buying a majority of its shares or by getting a position of power within it.

words.ex: He moves back and forth between two chairs.
words.ex_cn: 他在两把椅子之间来回移动。
words.en: Moving in one direction and then in the opposite direction repeatedly.

words.ex: Contrary to his words, he did not help.
words.ex_cn: 与他的话相反，他并没有帮忙。
words.en: In opposition to what is expected or believed.

words.ex: The children spread out on the grass to play.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在草地上铺开玩耍。
words.en: To extend over a large or increasing area.

words.tr: phrase. 意识到；觉察到；知道
words.ex: He is aware of the rules.
words.ex_cn: 他aware of规则。
words.en: If you are aware of something, you know about it.

words.ex: He waited for long before the bus came.
words.ex_cn: 他等了很长时间，公交车才来。
words.en: If you say that something will not happen or continue for long, you mean that it will only happen or continue for a short time.

words.ex: He has a lot of books.
words.ex_cn: 他有很多书。
words.en: A large number or amount of something.

words.tr: phrase. 考虑到；体谅；允许有；留出
words.ex: The plan allows for extra time if needed.
words.ex_cn: 这个计划为需要时留出了额外的时间。
words.en: To make provision or plans for something; to take into consideration.

words.ex: He separates the apples from the oranges.
words.ex_cn: 他把苹果和橙子分开。
words.en: To divide or keep apart things or people that are connected or together.

words.ex: He can't run a mile, much less a marathon.
words.ex_cn: 他连一英里都跑不了，更不用说马拉松了。
words.en: Used to emphasize the improbability of something by suggesting that something else is even more improbable.

words.ex: He succeeded at the expense of his health.
words.ex_cn: 他成功了，但牺牲了自己的健康。
words.en: If something is done at the expense of someone or something else, it is done in a way that harms them or is unfair to them.

words.ex: The teacher puts emphasis on reading every day.
words.ex_cn: 老师强调每天都要阅读。
words.en: Special importance, value, or prominence given to something.

words.tr:
adj. 分开的；分离的；单独的；
v. 分离；隔离；
words.ex: They live in separate houses.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在分开的房子里。
words.en: To cause to move or be apart; to divide or keep apart.

words.ex: There is pressure on him to finish the project early.
words.ex_cn: 他面临着提前完成项目的压力。
words.en: The influence or force exerted on someone or something.

words.ex: He shared his opinion about the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他分享了他对这部电影的意见。
words.en: Your ideas or beliefs about a particular subject.

words.ex: He lives in a room separate from the others.
words.ex_cn: 他住在一个与其他房间分开的房间里。
words.en: To move or be moved apart so as to leave a space between; to stop living together as a couple.

words.ex: The town changed over from coal to solar power.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇从煤炭转向了太阳能。
words.en: To change over means to switch from one method, system, or product to another.

words.tr: adj. 角的；有角的；尖角的；
words.ex: The angular shape of the triangle is clear.
words.ex_cn: 三角形的角形很清晰。
words.en: having angles or sharp corners; lean and bony

words.ex: He trades in old cars for new ones.
words.ex_cn: 他用旧车换新车。
words.en: To exchange a used item as part of the payment for a new one.

words.tr: phrase. 集中于； 专心于
words.ex: He must concentrate on his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他必须专心做作业。
words.en: To direct all your attention and effort towards a particular activity, subject, or problem.

words.ex: Thanks to his help, I passed the test.
words.ex_cn: 多亏了他的帮助，我通过了考试。
words.en: used to say that something good has happened because of someone or something

words.tr: phrase. 放进；插入；提出；提交；使就职；进港
words.ex: Put in the keys before you leave.
words.ex_cn: 离开前把钥匙放进去。
words.en: To place something inside or into a particular position or location.

words.ex: I have no more apples.
words.ex_cn: 我再也没有苹果了。
words.en: used to say that something will not continue or happen again

words.tr: v. 买得起；担负得起；有时间做；
words.ex: I can't afford a new car.
words.ex_cn: 我买不起一辆新车。
words.en: If you cannot afford something, you do not have enough money to pay for it.

words.ex: He spends a great deal of time on homework.
words.ex_cn: 他花大量时间做作业。
words.en: A large amount or quantity of something.

words.ex: The river may dry up in the summer.
words.ex_cn: 这条河在夏天可能会干涸。
words.en: If something dries up or if something dries it up, it loses all its moisture and becomes completely dry.

words.ex: He will pay for the coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他将为这杯咖啡付款。
words.en: To give money in exchange for goods or services; to suffer the consequences of one's actions.

words.ex: To date, no one has solved the problem.
words.ex_cn: 到此为止，还没有人解决这个问题。
words.en: Up to the present time.

words.ex: He has a preference for tea over coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他更喜欢茶而不是咖啡。
words.en: A preference is a greater liking for one alternative over another or others.

words.ex: The worker had long exposure to loud noise.
words.ex_cn: 这名工人长期暴露在噪音中。
words.en: The condition of being exposed to something, especially to something harmful or unpleasant.

words.ex: He left home long before the sun rose.
words.ex_cn: 太阳升起之前很久，他就离开了家。
words.en: At a time earlier than a specified event or period.

words.ex: The problem originates in a lack of communication.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题源于缺乏沟通。
words.en: To have a specified beginning or source.

words.ex: This plant is resistant to drought.
words.ex_cn: 这种植物对干旱有抵抗力。
words.en: If someone is resistant to something, they are opposed to it and want to prevent it.

words.ex: He wants to grow up and be a doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他想长大后当一名医生。
words.en: To grow up means to gradually change from being a child to being an adult. This process involves physical, emotional, and intellectual development.

words.ex: At one time, he played soccer every day.
words.ex_cn: 曾经，他每天踢足球。
words.en: If something was the case at one time, it was the case during a particular period in the past.

words.tr: phrase. 只要；长达；和 ... 一样长
words.ex: You can stay out as long as you come home before midnight.
words.ex_cn: 只要你午夜前回家，你就可以在外面待着。
words.en: used to say that one thing is true or will happen only if another thing is true or happens

words.ex: He lives apart from the city noise.
words.ex_cn: 他住在远离城市喧嚣的地方。
words.en: You use apart from when you are making an exception to a general statement.

words.ex: He is tired, so he is bound to fall asleep soon.
words.ex_cn: 他很累，所以很快就会睡着。
words.en: Certain or destined to happen; inevitably going to occur.

words.ex: He is attached to his old phone.
words.ex_cn: 他依恋他的旧手机。
words.en: To be connected or joined to something, either physically or emotionally.

words.tr: phrase. 畅所欲言；打开；开放
words.ex: Please open up and tell me how you really feel.
words.ex_cn: 请畅所欲言，告诉我你真正的感受。
words.en: To make something available or accessible; to start or begin something.

words.ex: He used honey in place of sugar.
words.ex_cn: 他用蜂蜜代替了糖。
words.en: Instead of someone or something else.

words.ex: He bought apples, bananas, and so on.
words.ex_cn: 他买了苹果、香蕉等等。
words.en: Used at the end of a list to indicate that there are other items that could also be mentioned.

words.ex: I see him as a friend.
words.ex_cn: 我把他当作朋友。
words.en: To consider or regard someone in a particular way.

words.ex: I see this book as very helpful.
words.ex_cn: 我觉得这本书非常有帮助。
words.en: To consider or regard something in a particular way.

words.ex: The helmet gives protection against head injuries.
words.ex_cn: 头盔提供对头部伤害的保护。
words.en: Measures or actions taken to safeguard against harm or damage from a specific threat or danger.

words.ex: The box is in the way.
words.ex_cn: 这个箱子挡路了。
words.en: If something or someone is in the way, they prevent you from moving or from doing something.

words.ex: He is open to new ideas.
words.ex_cn: 他愿意接受新想法。
words.en: Willing to consider or accept new suggestions and ideas.

words.tr: phrase. 动身； 出发；着手；陈述
words.ex: They set out early to catch the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他们早早出发去赶公交车。
words.en: To begin a journey or to start doing something with a particular aim.

words.ex_cn: 他赞成多吃蔬菜。
words.en: To support or agree with a particular idea, plan, or person.

words.tr: phrase. 很长一段时间；很久
words.ex: He has been sick for a long time.
words.ex_cn: 他病了很久。
words.en: For a long time refers to a period that is lengthy or extended, often implying that the duration is significant or noteworthy.

words.ex: In a way, he is right about the problem.
words.ex_cn: 在某种程度上，他对这个问题的看法是正确的。
words.en: To some extent; from a certain point of view.

words.ex: He gave up smoking last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年戒烟了。
words.en: If you give up something, you stop doing it or having it.

words.tr: phrase. 把…拿进来；介绍引进；赚（钱）
words.ex: Can you bring in the books from the car?
words.ex_cn: 你能把车里的书拿进来吗？
words.en: To introduce something new or to cause something to happen.

words.tr: phrase. 打碎；分裂；解体；结束；期终放假
words.ex: He broke up the ice with a hammer.
words.ex_cn: 他用锤子把冰打碎了。
words.en: To end a relationship or to disintegrate into pieces.

words.ex: The guide will show in the new visitors.
words.ex_cn: 导游将领入新来的访客。
words.en: To lead someone into a place or room.

words.ex: In a sense, he is right.
words.ex_cn: 在某种意义上，他是对的。
words.en: You say in a sense to indicate that a statement is true in one way, but not in others.

words.ex: He will pass on the message to his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他会把消息转告给他的朋友。
words.en: To give something to someone else, especially after receiving it or using it; to continue moving forward; to die.

words.ex: The team is made up of five players.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队由五名球员组成。
words.en: If something is made up of particular things or people, it consists of those things or people.

words.tr: phrase. 切题；切中要害；中肯；扼要
words.ex: His answer was to the point.
words.ex_cn: 他的回答切中要点。
words.en: If you describe something that someone says or writes as to the point, you approve of it because it is relevant to the subject and does not contain anything unnecessary.

words.ex: The park is east of the school.
words.ex_cn: 公园在学校东边。
words.en: To the east of a particular place or thing.

words.ex: In short, he likes pizza.
words.ex_cn: 简而言之，他喜欢披萨。
words.en: used to introduce a summary of something that has just been said or to give a brief statement of the main points.

words.ex: I didn't like the song at first, but it grew on me.
words.ex_cn: 我一开始不喜欢这首歌，但后来渐渐喜欢上了。
words.en: If someone or something grows on you, you gradually start to like them or it more.

words.tr: phrase. 公正地；正当地；法律上的
words.ex: By right, the property should go to the eldest son.
words.ex_cn: 按理说，财产应该归长子所有。
words.en: If something is done by right, it is done in a way that is morally or legally correct.

words.tr:
conj. 但是；然而；
prep. 除…以外；
adv. 只能；仅仅；
words.ex: I like apples, but I don't like oranges.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢苹果，但是我不喜欢橙子。
words.en: used to introduce a phrase or clause contrasting with what has already been mentioned

words.ex: He is at best a beginner in cooking.
words.ex_cn: 他在烹饪方面最多是个初学者。
words.en: At best is used to indicate the most positive or optimistic scenario or outcome, often implying that the actual situation may be worse.

words.tr: phrase. 每隔一定时间；定期
words.ex: He checks his temperature at regular intervals.
words.ex_cn: 他每隔一段时间测量一次体温。
words.en: At regular intervals means happening or done after equal periods of time or at equal distances.

words.tr: phrase. 可以说；在某种程度上
words.ex: He was, as it were, a walking encyclopedia.
words.ex_cn: 他可以说是活生生的百科全书。
words.en: Used to indicate that a word or statement is perhaps not exact though practically right.

words.ex: The savings amount to $500.
words.ex_cn: 这些储蓄加起来是500美元。
words.en: If something amounts to a particular total, all the parts of it add up to that total. If an idea, feeling, or action amounts to something, it has the same effect or importance as that thing.

words.tr: phrase. 上上下下；前前后后
words.ex: The ball goes up and down when he throws it.
words.ex_cn: 当他扔球时，球上下弹跳。
words.en: Moving alternately upwards and downwards or back and forth.

words.ex: He is accustomed to waking up early.
words.ex_cn: 他习惯于早起。
words.en: If you are accustomed to something, you are used to it and it is normal for you.

words.tr: phrase. 在…工作；从事于；致力于
words.ex: He works at a small shop near his home.
words.ex_cn: 他在家附近的一家小商店工作。
words.en: To be employed at a particular place or to make an effort to achieve something.

words.ex: They used him as a scapegoat for their mistakes.
words.ex_cn: 他们把他当作替罪羊，为他们的错误承担责任。
words.en: To employ someone in a particular role or function.

words.ex: She used the box as a table.
words.ex_cn: 她把箱子用作桌子。
words.en: To employ something for a particular purpose or in a particular way.

words.ex: He made for the door when he heard the alarm.
words.ex_cn: 他听到警报后走向了门。
words.en: If something makes for a particular situation, it causes that situation to exist or develop.

words.tr: phrase. 远到；至于；直到；就…而言
words.ex: The river flows as far as the next town.
words.ex_cn: 这条河一直流到下一个城镇。
words.en: used to indicate the extent or degree of something

words.tr: phrase. 照现在的样子；实际上
words.ex: We thought things would get better, but as it is, they are getting worse.
words.ex_cn: 我们以为情况会好转，但事实上，情况正在恶化。
words.en: In the actual circumstances; in reality.

words.ex: He wears a helmet to protect his head.
words.ex_cn: 他戴头盔来保护头部。
words.en: If you protect someone or something, you prevent them from being harmed or damaged.

words.ex: We need to protect children from harmful content on the internet.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要保护儿童免受互联网上的有害内容。
words.en: To keep someone safe from harm or injury.

words.ex: He goes into the room quietly.
words.ex_cn: 他悄悄地进入房间。
words.en: To enter a place, to start doing something as a job or activity, to investigate or examine something, or to discuss something in detail.

words.ex: He used up all the water.
words.ex_cn: 他把所有的水都用完了。
words.en: To consume or exhaust something completely.

words.tr: phrase. 代替；代表；做替身；使花费
words.ex: Tom will stand in for the manager while she is away.
words.ex_cn: 当经理离开时，汤姆将代替她。
words.en: To temporarily take someone's place or perform their duties.

words.ex: So far, he has finished his homework.
words.ex_cn: 到目前为止，他已经完成了作业。
words.en: Up to the present moment; until now.

words.tr: phrase. 认为某物...；把某物描述为
words.ex: She described the event as a turning point in her life.
words.ex_cn: 她将这一事件描述为她生命中的转折点。
words.en: To characterize or label something in a particular way.

words.tr: phrase. 把某人描述成；认为（说）某人是...
words.ex: His colleagues describe him as a hardworking and dedicated individual.
words.ex_cn: 他的同事们把他描述为一个勤奋且专注的人。
words.en: To say what someone or something is like by giving details about them.

words.tr: phrase. 将某事物视为；把某物看作
words.ex: He views the challenge as an opportunity to learn.
words.ex_cn: 他把挑战看作是学习的机会。
words.en: To consider or regard something in a particular way.

words.ex: She is viewed as a leader in her field.
words.ex_cn: 她在她的领域被视为领导者。
words.en: To consider or think of someone in a particular way.

words.tr: phrase. 需要时间；花些时间
words.ex: Good things take time.
words.ex_cn: 好事需要时间。
words.en: If you say that something will take time, you mean that it will take a long time.

words.ex: He is ten years old, or so.
words.ex_cn: 他十岁左右。
words.en: Approximately; used to indicate an estimate or rough quantity.

words.ex: Many old traditions die out over time.
words.ex_cn: 许多古老的传统随着时间推移而消失。
words.en: If something dies out, it becomes less and less common and eventually disappears completely.

words.ex: He tried to keep from crying.
words.ex_cn: 他努力忍住不哭。
words.en: To prevent someone from doing something or to not do something oneself.

words.ex: Speak of the devil, he just walked in.
words.ex_cn: 说曹操，曹操就到，他刚走进来。
words.en: To mention or discuss someone or something.

words.ex: We should learn from our mistakes and not repeat them.
words.ex_cn: 我们应该从错误中学习，不再重蹈覆辙。
words.en: To gain knowledge or skill by studying, practicing, being taught, or experiencing something.

words.ex: He tried once more to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他再次尝试解决这个问题。
words.en: One more time; again.

words.ex: He is late at times.
words.ex_cn: 他有时会迟到。
words.en: on some occasions; occasionally

words.ex: No matter how tired I am, I finish my homework.
words.ex_cn: 无论我多么累，我都会完成作业。
words.en: used to say that something is not important or does not affect the situation

words.ex: The number 5 corresponds to the letter E.
words.ex_cn: 数字5对应字母E。
words.en: If one thing corresponds to another, there is a close similarity or connection between them, often because one is a cause or a result of the other.

words.ex: This problem may have something to do with the weather.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题可能和天气有关。
words.en: to be related to or connected with something

words.ex: The price is relative to the quality.
words.ex_cn: 这个价格与质量相关。
words.en: In relation to; compared with.

words.ex: The two boys sat side by side on the bench.
words.ex_cn: 两个男孩并排坐在长凳上。
words.en: If two or more things are side by side, they are next to each other.

words.ex: He reacts quickly when he hears a loud noise.
words.ex_cn: 当他听到大声响时，他会迅速做出反应。
words.en: When you react to something that has happened to you, you behave in a particular way because of it.

words.tr: adj. 一致的；始终如一的；
words.ex: His answers are consistent with the data.
words.ex_cn: 他的答案与数据一致。
words.en: Someone who is consistent always behaves in the same way, has the same attitudes towards people or things, or achieves the same level of success in something.

words.ex: They struggle for freedom and justice.
words.ex_cn: 他们为自由和正义而斗争。
words.en: To make a great effort to achieve or obtain something, often against difficulties.

words.tr: phrase. 对...的关心；对...表示忧虑
words.ex: Parents have concern about their child's safety.
words.ex_cn: 父母对孩子的安全感到担心。
words.en: If you concern about something, you feel worried about it.

words.ex: He is deficient in vitamin D.
words.ex_cn: 他缺乏维生素D。
words.en: to lack something that is needed or essential

words.tr: phrase. …得多；尤其；更；到目前为止
words.ex: This is by far the best movie I have seen.
words.ex_cn: 这绝对是我看过的最好的电影。
words.en: By far is used to emphasize that something is the best, worst, biggest, etc., of its kind.

words.ex: The new technology has recently come into use.
words.ex_cn: 这项新技术最近开始被使用。
words.en: When something comes into use, it begins to be used.

words.ex: Please pay in advance.
words.ex_cn: 请提前付款。
words.en: Before a particular time, or before doing a particular thing.

words.ex: He wants to participate in the school play.
words.ex_cn: 他想参加学校的戏剧表演。
words.en: To take part in an activity or event.

words.ex: He decided to switch to a vegetarian diet.
words.ex_cn: 他决定转为素食饮食。
words.en: If you switch to something different, for example to a different system, task, or subject of conversation, you change to it from what you were doing or saying before.

words.ex: He is by no means lazy.
words.ex_cn: 他绝对不懒。
words.en: You use 'by no means' to emphasize that something is not true or is definitely not the case.

words.tr: adj. 可比较的；比得上的；类似的；
words.ex: The prices of these two phones are comparable.
words.ex_cn: 这两部手机的价格是可比较的。
words.en: Something that is comparable to something else is similar in size, amount, or quality.

words.ex: They cut down the old tree in the yard.
words.ex_cn: 他们把院子里那棵老树砍倒了。
words.en: To reduce the amount, size, or number of something, or to do less of something.

words.ex: The wind is blowing in the direction of the sea.
words.ex_cn: 风正朝大海的方向吹。
words.en: Moving or pointing towards a specific location or point.

words.ex: He found his keys in the course of cleaning his room.
words.ex_cn: 他在打扫房间的过程中找到了钥匙。
words.en: During the process or period of something happening.

words.tr: phrase. 在黑暗中；秘密地；不知道地
words.ex: The children played in the dark.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在黑暗中玩耍。
words.en: If you are in the dark about something, you do not know anything about it.

words.tr: phrase. 至于；就…来说；在...的情况
words.ex: In the case of rain, we will stay inside.
words.ex_cn: 如果下雨，我们就待在室内。
words.en: used to describe a particular situation or instance

words.ex: You can write in your comments at the end of the document.
words.ex_cn: 你可以在文档末尾写入你的评论。
words.en: To add text or information to a document or surface.

words.ex: The box is full of toys.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子里装满了玩具。
words.en: To contain or hold as much or as many as possible; to be filled with something.

words.tr: phrase. 走来走去；经常搬家
words.ex: The children move about the room quietly.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在房间里安静地走动。
words.en: To move from one place to another within a particular area or space.

words.ex: The door was opened by force.
words.ex_cn: 门被强行打开了。
words.en: Using physical strength or violence to achieve something.

words.ex: Take care when you cross the street.
words.ex_cn: 过马路时要小心。
words.en: To be cautious or attentive; to look after someone or something.

words.ex: He will succeed in passing the test.
words.ex_cn: 他会成功通过考试。
words.en: To achieve something that you have been aiming for.

words.ex: She shared her opinion about the new policy.
words.ex_cn: 她分享了她对新政策的看法。
words.en: A judgment or view held by someone about a particular matter.

words.tr: phrase. 一定注意到；务必使
words.ex: I see that you're trying to cheat again, and I won't let it happen.
words.ex_cn: 我注意到你又在试图作弊，我不会让它发生的。
words.en: To ensure or verify that something is the case.

words.tr: phrase. 典型的；有代表性的
words.ex: This behavior is typical of children his age.
words.ex_cn: 这种行为是他这个年龄的孩子典型的。
words.en: If something is typical of a particular type of thing, it has the usual qualities or features of that type.

words.ex: Seeing that it's raining, we should take an umbrella.
words.ex_cn: 鉴于下雨了，我们应该带伞。
words.en: used to introduce a reason or explanation for something

words.tr: phrase. 依靠；搁在；停留在；基于
words.ex: The bridge must rest on strong pillars.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥必须依靠坚固的支柱。
words.en: To depend or rely on something for support or as a basis.

words.ex: He fall in love with her at school.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校爱上了她。
words.en: To collapse inward; to come together in a line or formation; to become due or payable.

words.ex: This problem has nothing to do with math.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题与数学无关。
words.en: If you say that something has nothing to do with a particular subject or situation, you mean that it is not connected with it in any way.

words.tr: phrase. 在这种情况下；在这个案例中；既然这样
words.ex: He is late, in this case, he should call the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他迟到了，在这种情况下，他应该给老师打电话。
words.en: Under the particular circumstances being discussed.

words.tr: phrase. 打扫干净；收拾整洁
words.ex: They clean up the room every Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 他们每星期六打扫房间。
words.en: To make a place or thing clean and tidy by removing dirt, rubbish, or unwanted items.

words.ex: I take for granted that he will come on time.
words.ex_cn: 我认为他会准时来。
words.en: To regard or consider someone or something as being a particular thing, often mistakenly.

words.tr: phrase. 对…的信仰；对...的相信
words.ex: She has a strong belief in the power of education.
words.ex_cn: 她坚信教育的力量。
words.en: Faith or confidence in the truth or existence of something.

words.tr: n. 需求；要求；必要条件；
words.ex: The job has a requirement of two years of experience.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作的要求是两年经验。
words.en: A requirement is something that is necessary or that must be done.

words.tr: phrase. 运走；使失去自制力
words.ex: Don't carry away the books from this table.
words.ex_cn: 不要把桌上的书拿走。
words.en: To take or move someone or something from one place to another, often with some force or enthusiasm.

words.ex: The idea is interesting in itself, but it needs further development.
words.ex_cn: 这个想法本身很有趣，但还需要进一步发展。
words.en: considered without other related ideas or situations

words.ex: The new rule is in effect from Monday.
words.ex_cn: 新规定从周一开始生效。
words.en: If a law or rule is in effect, it is operating or being applied.

words.tr: phrase. 在世界上；实际上；本质上
words.ex: Dolphins in nature are very smart.
words.ex_cn: 世界上海豚非常聪明。
words.en: In the essential character of something; in reality.

words.ex: He stayed home in view of the rain.
words.ex_cn: 由于下雨，他待在家里。
words.en: You use 'in view of' when you are taking into consideration a particular fact or situation that is important in relation to what you are saying or doing.

words.ex: This book is the same as that one.
words.ex_cn: 这本书和那本书一样。
words.en: Identical or equivalent to something else.

words.ex: The two houses are adjacent to each other.
words.ex_cn: 这两栋房子彼此相邻。
words.en: If one thing is adjacent to another, it is next to it or adjoining it.

words.ex: The book is next to the pen.
words.ex_cn: 书在笔旁边。
words.en: Adjacent to; at the side of.

words.tr: phrase. 适合的；恰当的；相称的
words.ex: This shirt is appropriate for the party.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫适合这个派对。
words.en: Suitable or fitting for a particular person, purpose, or situation.

words.ex: The park was named after a famous hero.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园是以一位著名英雄的名字命名的。
words.en: If you name someone or something after another person or thing, you give them the same name as that person or thing.

words.ex: The song brings back happy memories.
words.ex_cn: 这首歌唤起了快乐的回忆。
words.en: To bring something back means to return it to the place where it was before, or to make it exist or happen again.

words.ex: He went to the post office to send a letter.
words.ex_cn: 他去邮局寄信。
words.en: A post office is a public department or corporation responsible for mail services, including the acceptance, transmission, and delivery of letters and parcels.

words.tr: phrase. 对...必要的；非常重要的
words.ex: Water is essential to life.
words.ex_cn: 水对生命至关重要。
words.en: If you say that something is essential to a particular thing, you mean that it is absolutely necessary for that thing.

words.tr: phrase. 占优势；优于…的有利条件
words.ex: Our company has a significant advantage over our competitors.
words.ex_cn: 我们公司在竞争中具有显著优势。
words.en: If you have an advantage over someone, you are in a better position than they are.

words.ex: The roof of the cave in the mountain collapsed after the heavy rain.
words.ex_cn: 大雨过后，山中洞穴的顶部塌陷了。
words.en: If something such as a roof or a ceiling caves in, it collapses inwards.

words.ex: I wait for the bus every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上等公交车。
words.en: To remain in a place until a particular time or until something else happens.

words.tr: phrase. 把某事建立在......基础上
words.ex: We should base our decisions on facts.
words.ex_cn: 我们应该基于事实来做决定。
words.en: If you base something on particular facts, ideas, or events, you use those facts, ideas, or events as the main part of it to develop it.

words.ex: Everyone came to the party except for Tom.
words.ex_cn: 除了汤姆，大家都来参加派对了。
words.en: You use except for to introduce the only thing or person that prevents a statement from being completely true.

words.ex: The lamp gives off a warm light.
words.ex_cn: 这盏灯发出温暖的光。
words.en: If something gives off or gives out a gas, heat, or a smell, it produces it and sends it out into the air.

words.ex: You can have at most three cookies.
words.ex_cn: 你最多只能吃三块饼干。
words.en: You use at most or at the most to say that a number or amount is the maximum that is possible and that the actual number or amount may be smaller.

words.ex: He draws on his old experience to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他利用自己的旧经验来解决这个问题。
words.en: To make use of something, especially a resource or skill, that one has available.

words.ex: He is serving a sentence for life.
words.ex_cn: 他正在服无期徒刑。
words.en: For the whole of a person's life; permanently.

words.ex: This forest is abundant in birds and trees.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林里鸟和树很多。
words.en: To exist in large quantities or be plentiful within a specific place or context.

words.ex: He studied hard, and yet he failed the test.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习了，但他还是没通过考试。
words.en: used to introduce a statement that contrasts with or seems to contradict something that has been said previously

words.tr: phrase. 位于…之前；在…之上；比…重要
words.ex: My birthday comes before his in the year.
words.ex_cn: 我的生日在一年中比他的早。
words.en: To precede in time or order.

words.ex: We get to the park by bus.
words.ex_cn: 我们乘公交车到公园。
words.en: If you get to a particular place, you arrive there. If you get to do something, you have the opportunity to do it. If something gets to you, it affects you emotionally.

words.tr: phrase. 对…的探究；对进行研究
words.ex: They are doing research into new ways to use solar energy.
words.ex_cn: 他们正在研究利用太阳能的新方法。
words.en: To conduct a detailed and systematic study or investigation into a particular subject or issue.

words.ex: The fish exist on tiny plankton in the sea.
words.ex_cn: 这些鱼靠海里的微小浮游生物生存。
words.en: To be present or have being in a particular place or context.

words.tr: phrase. 向某人赠送某物；将某物呈献给某人
words.ex: He presented his new invention to the board of directors.
words.ex_cn: 他将他的新发明展示给了董事会。
words.en: To give something to someone, especially in a formal way or as part of a ceremony.

words.ex: Computers can take the place of typewriters.
words.ex_cn: 计算机可以取代打字机。
words.en: To take the place of something or someone means to replace them or to be used instead of them.

words.ex: I want to find out why he is late.
words.ex_cn: 我想弄清楚他为什么迟到。
words.en: To discover a fact or piece of information, often by making an effort to do so.

words.ex: The soldiers were equipped with new rifles.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们配备了新步枪。
words.en: To provide someone or something with the necessary items for a particular purpose.

words.ex: At present, he is working as a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 目前，他是一名老师。
words.en: At the present time; now.

words.tr: n. 进展；进步；缓慢前进；稳步前进；
words.ex: The project shows slow progress.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目进展缓慢。
words.en: Progress is the process of gradually improving or getting nearer to achieving or completing something.

words.tr: phrase. 压制；拖延；为...的一员
words.ex: The government sits on the protest voices.
words.ex_cn: 政府压制了抗议的声音。
words.en: To be in a seated position on top of something; to delay dealing with something.

words.ex_cn: 他关心他的成绩。
words.en: If you are concerned with something, you are giving it your attention because you think it is important or because you are worried about it.

words.tr: phrase. 粘附；坚持；紧跟；忠于
words.ex: The glue will stick the paper to the table.
words.ex_cn: 胶水会把纸粘在桌子上。
words.en: If you stick to a promise, agreement, decision, or principle, you do what you said you would do, or do not change your mind.

words.tr: phrase. 填（写）； 填满；替代
words.ex: Please fill in the blanks with the correct words.
words.ex_cn: 请用正确的单词填空。
words.en: If you fill in a form or other document requesting information, you write information in the spaces on it.

words.ex: He agree to help me with my homework.
words.ex_cn: 他同意帮我做作业。
words.en: To consent to do something that has been suggested by another person.

words.ex: The room is free of dust.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间没有灰尘。
words.en: If something is free of something else, it does not have that thing in it or on it.

words.ex: He is more or less ready for the test.
words.ex_cn: 他差不多准备好考试了。
words.en: To a certain extent; approximately.

words.tr: phrase. 突然离开； 突然挣脱；决裂； 退出
words.ex: He broke away from the group and ran home.
words.ex_cn: 他突然离开团队，跑回家了。
words.en: To leave or escape from a person, group, or situation that controls or restricts you.

words.ex: As a rule, he walks to school.
words.ex_cn: 通常，他走路去学校。
words.en: If you say that something happens as a rule, you mean that it usually happens.

words.ex: She is skilled at playing the piano.
words.ex_cn: 她擅长弹钢琴。
words.en: To be proficient or expert in a particular activity or field.

words.ex: Life can develop from simple organisms.
words.ex_cn: 生命可以从简单的生物发展而来。
words.en: To grow or cause to grow and become more mature, advanced, or elaborate.

words.ex: She decided to talk with her boss about the issue.
words.ex_cn: 她决定与她的老板谈谈这个问题。
words.en: To have a conversation with someone.

words.ex: He must conform to the school rules.
words.ex_cn: 他必须遵守校规。
words.en: To comply with rules, standards, or laws; to behave according to socially acceptable conventions or standards.

words.ex: Water is essential for life.
words.ex_cn: 水对生命至关重要。
words.en: To be absolutely necessary or extremely important for something or someone.

words.tr: phrase. 离开；从...出发；违反；背离
words.ex: He departs from the usual route to avoid traffic.
words.ex_cn: 他离开通常的路线以避开交通拥堵。
words.en: To leave a place, especially to start a journey; to deviate from an established plan or procedure.

words.ex: Water is vital to all living things.
words.ex_cn: 水对所有生物都至关重要。
words.en: To be extremely important or necessary for the success, existence, or health of something or someone.

words.tr: phrase. 健康；在外形上；处于良好状态
words.ex: He runs every day to stay in shape.
words.ex_cn: 他每天跑步以保持健康。
words.en: In good physical condition; healthy.

words.tr: phrase. 独自地；单独地；自动地
words.ex: The book fell by itself from the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 书自己从架子上掉了下来。
words.en: without assistance or support; independently.

words.tr: phrase. 阻止；抑制；使退缩；隐瞒
words.ex: He tried to hold back his tears.
words.ex_cn: 他试图忍住眼泪。
words.en: To hold back means to prevent someone or something from moving forward or making progress, or to keep something secret or not express your feelings.

words.ex: He wiped out the board with a cloth.
words.ex_cn: 他用一块布把板擦掉了。
words.en: To completely destroy, remove, or eliminate something or someone.

words.tr: phrase. 开…的钥匙；…的答案；…的关键
words.ex: This plan is key to our success.
words.ex_cn: 这个计划对我们成功至关重要。
words.en: A key to something is the main or most important part of it, which makes it possible to understand or achieve the rest.

words.tr:
n. 信用；赊账；赞扬；贷款；荣誉；
v. 相信；
words.ex: He has good credit with the bank.
words.ex_cn: 他在银行有良好的信用。
words.en: If you are allowed credit, you are allowed to pay for goods or services several weeks or months after you have received them.

words.ex: The car was involved in a collision with a truck.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车与一辆卡车发生了碰撞。
words.en: An instance of two things striking each other with force.

words.ex: He is slow, by comparison, his brother is fast.
words.ex_cn: 相比之下，他很慢，他弟弟很快。
words.en: When you say that something is true by comparison, you mean that it is true when compared to something else.

words.ex: You can eat no more than three cookies.
words.ex_cn: 你最多只能吃三块饼干。
words.en: used to emphasize that something is not more than a particular amount, number, or level

words.ex: She is in school and cannot attend the event.
words.ex_cn: 她在上学，不能参加这个活动。
words.en: Attending an educational institution.

words.tr: phrase. 几乎；差一点；除…外其余都
words.ex: He is all but finished with his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他几乎已经做完了作业。
words.en: All but means almost or nearly. It is used to indicate that something is very close to being the case but not completely so.

words.ex_cn: 离开前一定要锁门。
words.en: To be certain or confident about something; to make certain that something happens or is done.

words.tr: phrase. 继续前进；转变话题
words.ex: He decided to move on after the breakup.
words.ex_cn: 分手后，他决定继续前行。
words.en: To continue with your life after you have dealt with a bad experience.

words.ex: By the end of the week, he finished his homework.
words.ex_cn: 到周末结束时，他完成了作业。
words.en: Indicates the point in time when something concludes or is expected to conclude.

words.tr: phrase. 跳起来；发生；迅速发展
words.ex: The ball springs up when it hits the ground.
words.ex_cn: 球碰到地面时跳起来。
words.en: To appear or develop quickly and/or suddenly.

words.tr: phrase. 提醒某人；使某人想起
words.ex: This song reminds me of my childhood.
words.ex_cn: 这首歌让我想起了我的童年。
words.en: To cause someone to remember someone or something.

words.ex: Send the package to me care of my office address.
words.ex_cn: 把包裹寄到我的办公室地址转交给我。
words.en: Used to indicate that something is to be delivered to someone at the address of another person.

words.ex: I've been waiting for ages!
words.ex_cn: 我已经等了很久了！
words.en: For a very long time.

words.ex: This book is relevant to your project.
words.ex_cn: 这本书与你的项目相关。
words.en: Pertaining to or connected with the matter at hand.

words.ex: The museum is located in the heart of the city.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆位于市中心。
words.en: If something is located in a particular place, it is situated there or exists there.

words.ex: A problem came up during the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 会议期间发生了一个问题。
words.en: To arise or occur, especially unexpectedly or as a subject of discussion.

words.ex: I will see to the children while you are away.
words.ex_cn: 你不在的时候，我会照看孩子们。
words.en: To attend to or take care of something.

words.ex: This castle dates back to the 12th century.
words.ex_cn: 这座城堡可以追溯到12世纪。
words.en: If something dates back to a particular time, it started or was made at that time.

words.ex: They wanted to share in the profits of the business.
words.ex_cn: 他们想分享企业的利润。
words.en: To participate in or experience something together with others.

words.ex: Please write down your name.
words.ex_cn: 请写下你的名字。
words.en: To record something in writing.

words.ex: He is sensitive to loud noises.
words.ex_cn: 他对大声响很敏感。
words.en: To be easily affected or influenced by something, especially in a way that is not desired.

words.ex: He is flush with cash after winning the lottery.
words.ex_cn: 他中了彩票后手头很宽裕。
words.en: If one object or surface is flush with another, they are at the same height or level as each other.

words.ex: He lives by fishing in the sea.
words.ex_cn: 他靠在海里捕鱼为生。
words.en: To follow a particular principle or way of life, or to earn a living in a specified way.

words.ex: I believe in working hard to achieve my dreams.
words.ex_cn: 我相信努力工作能实现我的梦想。
words.en: To feel certain that something exists or is true, or to have confidence in a person or thing.

words.ex: He has been happy ever since he moved to the city.
words.ex_cn: 自从他搬到城市以来，他一直很快乐。
words.en: From a particular time in the past until the present.

words.ex: She has always been good to her employees.
words.ex_cn: 她对她的员工一直很好。
words.en: To treat someone well or kindly.

words.ex: He stayed calm in the face of danger.
words.ex_cn: 他在危险面前保持冷静。
words.en: If you do something in the face of a particular situation, you do it despite the difficulties or problems that the situation causes.

words.ex: He solved the math problem with the help of his teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他在老师的帮助下解决了这道数学题。
words.en: With the assistance or support of someone or something.

words.ex: They live together in a small apartment.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在一个小公寓里。
words.en: If two people live together, they share a home and have a sexual relationship but are not married.

words.ex: The connection between the two wires is loose.
words.ex_cn: 两根电线之间的连接松了。
words.en: A connection is a relationship between two things, people, or groups.

words.tr: phrase. 顺便说说；顺便提起
words.ex: By the way, I saw your brother yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 对了，我昨天看到你弟弟了。
words.en: used to introduce a comment or question that is not directly related to the main subject of conversation

words.ex: He is afraid of dogs.
words.ex_cn: 他害怕狗。
words.en: To feel fear or anxiety about someone or something.

words.ex: He takes his health for granted.
words.ex_cn: 他把健康视为理所当然。
words.en: If you take something for granted, you believe it to be true or to exist without needing proof or evidence.

words.tr: phrase. 在手边；在附近；即将到来
words.ex: The solution is at hand.
words.ex_cn: 解决办法就在眼前。
words.en: If something is at hand, it is nearby or about to happen.

words.ex: He bought apples, bananas, and so forth.
words.ex_cn: 他买了苹果、香蕉等等。
words.en: Used at the end of a list to indicate that there are other items that could be mentioned.

words.ex: His argument doesn't hold water.
words.ex_cn: v. 他的论点站不住脚。
words.en: If an argument or theory holds water, it is reasonable and can be believed.

words.ex: The people showed resistance against the unfair law.
words.ex_cn: 人们对这项不公平的法律表示抵抗。
words.en: Resistance is the refusal to accept or comply with something; the attempt to prevent something by action or argument.

words.ex: I met my old friend by chance at the supermarket.
words.ex_cn: 我在超市碰巧遇到了我的老朋友。
words.en: If something happens by chance, it happens without being planned or intended.

words.ex: He ate a good deal of food at the party.
words.ex_cn: 他在聚会上吃了大量的食物。
words.en: A large amount or quantity of something.

words.ex: The manager required a detailed report of the project from each team member.
words.ex_cn: 经理要求每个团队成员提供项目的详细报告。
words.en: If you require something of someone, you need or expect them to do it for you.

words.tr: phrase.  献（身）于…；把（时间、精力等）用于…
words.ex: He dedicates to helping poor children.
words.ex_cn: 他献身于帮助贫困儿童。
words.en: To give a lot of your time and effort to a particular activity or purpose because you think it is important.

words.ex: They live in harmony with nature.
words.ex_cn: 他们与自然和谐相处。
words.en: A state of peaceful existence and agreement, especially in a relationship or between different elements.

words.tr: phrase. 就其本质而言；天生地
words.ex: He is by nature a quiet person.
words.ex_cn: 他天性安静。
words.en: If someone has a particular quality by nature, they have it as a natural part of their character.

words.tr: phrase. 不在适当的位置；不合适的；格格不入的
words.ex: His shirt was out of place at the formal party.
words.ex_cn: 他在正式晚会上穿的衬衫很不合适。
words.en: If someone or something is out of place, they are in a situation where they do not belong or fit in.

words.ex: I don't want to go out for one thing, it is raining.
words.ex_cn: 我不想出去，原因之一是天下雨了。
words.en: used to introduce a reason or argument

words.tr: phrase. 定居；平静下来；专心于
words.ex: He wants to settle down with a family.
words.ex_cn: 他想安定下来组建家庭。
words.en: To settle down means to start living in a place where you intend to stay for a long time, usually after moving around a lot.

words.ex: She keeps the room clean every day.
words.ex_cn: 她每天保持房间干净。
words.en: To continue to have or hold something; to maintain a condition or position.

words.ex: She has a great capacity for learning new languages.
words.ex_cn: 她有很强的学习新语言的能力。
words.en: The ability or potential to hold, contain, or accommodate something.

words.tr: phrase. 照顾；照料；处理；应付
words.ex: She takes care of her little brother after school.
words.ex_cn: 她放学后照顾她的弟弟。
words.en: To look after someone or something; to deal with something.

words.tr: phrase. 把某人当作某物；介绍某人
words.ex: The doctor referred the patient to a specialist for further treatment.
words.ex_cn: 医生把病人引荐给专科医生进行进一步治疗。
words.en: To direct someone to a source for information or help.

words.ex: You can call me at any time.
words.ex_cn: 你随时都可以给我打电话。
words.en: At any time means whenever it is needed or desired; it does not matter when.

words.tr: phrase. 代表；象征；支持；容忍
words.ex: The letter A stands for apple.
words.ex_cn: 字母A代表苹果。
words.en: If you say that a letter stands for a particular word, you mean that it is an abbreviation for that word.

words.ex: His attitude toward homework is very positive.
words.ex_cn: 他对作业的态度非常积极。
words.en: An attitude is a way of thinking or feeling about something, which is often reflected in a person's behavior.

words.ex: The caterpillar turns into a butterfly.
words.ex_cn: 毛毛虫变成了一只蝴蝶。
words.en: To change or develop into something different.

words.ex: The book is on the back of the chair.
words.ex_cn: 书在椅子的背面。
words.en: prep. If something is at the back of a place or thing, it is in a position where it cannot be seen because it is behind something else.

words.ex: He is famous for singing beautiful songs.
words.ex_cn: 他因演唱动听的歌曲而闻名。
words.en: be widely known or recognized for a particular quality or achievement

words.ex: This song is familiar to him.
words.ex_cn: 这首歌对他来说很熟悉。
words.en: If something is familiar to you, you recognize it or know it well.

words.ex: I need a couple of minutes to finish this.
words.ex_cn: 我需要几分钟来完成这个。
words.en: A couple of is used to refer to a small number of things or people, usually two or a few more than two.

words.tr: phrase. 清除；把…清出；（使）离开
words.ex: He will clear out the old boxes from the garage.
words.ex_cn: 他会把旧箱子从车库清理出去。
words.en: To remove items from a place to make it clean and empty.

words.ex: The boy ran away from home.
words.ex_cn: 那个男孩从家里跑走了。
words.en: To leave a place or person secretly and suddenly in order to escape from them or to avoid a difficult or unpleasant situation.

words.ex: She decided to run away from her problems instead of facing them.
words.ex_cn: 她决定逃离问题，而不是面对它们。
words.en: To leave a place or situation quickly in order to escape from something or someone.

words.ex: She finally felt clear of the financial burden.
words.ex_cn: 她终于感到摆脱了经济负担。
words.en: To be in a position where one is not in contact with or affected by something, especially something dangerous or unwanted.

words.ex: The mass of the population voted for the new policy.
words.ex_cn: 人口的大部分投票支持新政策。
words.en: The total amount or quantity of a substance or material.

words.tr: phrase. 对...有效；适于；代替；替…理家
words.ex: This medicine does for his cough.
words.ex_cn: 这种药对他的咳嗽有效。
words.en: To be suitable or adequate for a particular purpose or person.

words.ex: She felt herself being drawn to the mysterious stranger.
words.ex_cn: 她感到自己被那个神秘的陌生人所吸引。
words.en: To feel a strong attraction or interest in something or someone.

words.ex: He dreamt of flying like a bird.
words.ex_cn: 他梦见自己像鸟一样飞翔。
words.en: To think about something that you would like to happen or achieve.

words.ex: The children clapped in sequence.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们按顺序鼓掌。
words.en: In the correct order; one after another.

words.ex: The final decision was left to him.
words.ex_cn: 最终的决定留给了他。
words.en: If something is left to someone, it is their responsibility to deal with it or make decisions about it.

words.tr: phrase. 离开；举行；实现；成功；从…掉下
words.ex: He will come off the train at the next station.
words.ex_cn: 他将在下一站下车。
words.en: To happen or occur, especially in a particular way; to be successful or effective.

words.ex: He will not give in to the bully.
words.ex_cn: 他不会向欺凌者屈服。
words.en: To agree to something that you had been opposing, especially because someone has forced or persuaded you to.

words.ex: He is faced with a difficult problem.
words.ex_cn: 他面临一个困难的问题。
words.en: If you are faced with a problem or a difficult situation, you have to deal with it.

words.tr: phrase.  相称；成比例；按比例
words.ex: The size of the furniture should be in proportion to the size of the room.
words.ex_cn: 家具的大小应与房间的大小相称。
words.en: If one thing increases or decreases in proportion to another thing, it increases or decreases to the same degree as that thing.

words.tr: phrase. 正在考虑；正被谈论的；讨论中的；可怀疑
words.ex: The job in question is still available.
words.ex_cn: 正在讨论的工作仍然空缺。
words.en: The person, thing, or group that is in question is the one that you have been talking about or that is involved in the situation you are discussing.

words.tr: phrase. 讲得通； 有意义； 言之有理
words.ex: This plan makes sense.
words.ex_cn: 这个计划有道理。
words.en: To be reasonable or understandable.

words.ex: He wants to get rid of the old chair.
words.ex_cn: 他想扔掉那把旧椅子。
words.en: To dispose of or remove something unwanted or undesirable.

words.tr: phrase. 优越于；胜过；不屈服于
words.ex: This phone is superior to that one.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机比那部更好。
words.en: To be better or higher in quality, rank, or status than someone or something else.

words.ex: He is in search of a new job.
words.ex_cn: 他正在寻找一份新工作。
words.en: If you are in search of something, you are looking for it.

words.ex: He spoke in regard to the new school rules.
words.ex_cn: 他谈到了新的校规。
words.en: Concerning or about something.

words.ex: The noise issues from the next room.
words.ex_cn: 噪音来自隔壁房间。
words.en: To originate or emerge from a source or origin.

words.ex: The thief tried to break into the house at night.
words.ex_cn: 小偷试图在夜里闯入房子。
words.en: To enter a building or car using force, in order to steal something; to suddenly start doing something.

words.ex: The bridge connects with the other side of the river.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥连接到河的另一边。
words.en: To establish a relationship or communication with someone or something.

words.ex: When it comes to math, he always feels nervous.
words.ex_cn: 说到数学，他总是感到紧张。
words.en: You use 'when it comes to' to introduce a subject or activity that you are about to discuss or deal with.

words.tr: phrase. 不许入内； 挡在外面
words.ex: The fence is to keep out animals.
words.ex_cn: 这道篱笆是用来挡动物的。
words.en: To prevent someone or something from entering a place.

words.tr: adj. 反对的；敌对的； v. 反对；反抗；“oppose”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He was opposed to the new rule.
words.ex_cn: 他反对这个新规定。
words.en: If you are opposed to something, you disagree with it or disapprove of it.

words.tr: phrase. 闯入；打断；（使）逐渐适用
words.ex: Thieves broke in through the back door.
words.ex_cn: 小偷从后门闯入。
words.en: To enter a building by force, especially in order to steal something; to interrupt a conversation or activity.

words.tr: phrase. 经历；仔细检查；完成；通过；穿过
words.ex: He went through a hard time last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年经历了一段艰难的时光。
words.en: To experience something, often something difficult or unpleasant, or to examine or discuss something in detail.

words.ex: He called me in connection with the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他因会议的事给我打了电话。
words.en: If something happens in connection with something else, it is related to it in some way.

words.ex: The sticker adheres to the wall.
words.ex_cn: 贴纸粘在墙上。
words.en: If you adhere to a rule or agreement, you act in the way that it says you should.

words.tr: phrase. 在...之上；加之；紧接着
words.ex: The book is on top of the table.
words.ex_cn: 书在桌子上面。
words.en: In addition to; in control of or fully informed about something.

words.ex: He stopped talking at once.
words.ex_cn: 他立刻停止了说话。
words.en: Immediately; without delay; at the same time.

words.ex: Once the project was explained, the team set to work immediately.
words.ex_cn: 项目解释清楚后，团队立即开始认真工作。
words.en: To start doing something with energy and determination.

words.tr: phrase. 放置一旁；留出；不理会；取消
words.ex: He sets aside $50 each week for savings.
words.ex_cn: 他每周存下50美元作为储蓄。
words.en: To reserve or keep something for a particular purpose or person.

words.ex: He grew out of biting his nails when he became a teenager.
words.ex_cn: 他当了青少年后就戒掉了咬指甲的习惯。
words.en: If you grow out of a habit or a type of behaviour, you stop doing it or having it because you are older and more mature.

words.tr: phrase. 组成整体；装配；组合
words.ex: He put together a sandwich for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他做了个三明治当午餐。
words.en: To assemble or compile various parts or elements into a whole.

words.ex: He is good at math.
words.ex_cn: 他擅长数学。
words.en: To have a natural ability or skill in a particular area.

words.ex: You had best leave now before it gets any later.
words.ex_cn: 你最好现在就走，不然时间会更晚。
words.en: Used to advise someone that they should do something, especially because it is the most sensible or safe thing to do.

words.tr: phrase. 理解；明白；变得流行
words.ex: He didn't understand the joke at first, but then he caught on.
words.ex_cn: 他一开始没明白这个笑话，但后来明白了。
words.en: To understand or become popular.

words.ex: The company has seen a significant increase over the past year.
words.ex_cn: 公司去年有了显著的增长。
words.en: To become or make something greater in amount, number, value, etc., over a period of time.

words.ex: You had better finish your homework before going out.
words.ex_cn: 你最好在出门前完成你的作业。
words.en: used to tell someone what you think they should do

words.ex: He left behind his book on the table.
words.ex_cn: 他把书留在了桌子上。
words.en: To go away from a place without taking someone or something with you.

words.ex: He will persist in trying to learn English every day.
words.ex_cn: 他会坚持每天努力学习英语。
words.en: To continue to do something despite difficulties or opposition, in a way that can seem unreasonable.

words.ex: He pressed the button to speed up the video.
words.ex_cn: 他按了按钮来加快视频速度。
words.en: To increase the speed or rate of something.

words.tr: phrase. 在某方面擅长；熟练
words.ex: She is highly skilled in computer programming.
words.ex_cn: 她精通计算机编程。
words.en: If you are skilled in something, you have the ability and knowledge to do it well.

words.ex: He left the city for good.
words.ex_cn: 他永久离开了这座城市。
words.en: If something changes or disappears for good, it never changes back or comes back as it was before.

words.tr:
n. 导游；指南；向导；
v. 指导；指引；
words.ex: The guide showed us the ancient temple.
words.ex_cn: 导游带我们参观了这座古庙。
words.en: A guide is someone who shows other people the way to a place in a difficult or unknown region. A guide is also a book that gives you information or instructions to help you do or understand something.

words.tr: phrase. 以…为中心；重点在于…
words.ex: The lesson centers on basic math skills.
words.ex_cn: 这节课的重点是基本数学技能。
words.en: To have something as the main subject of attention or interest.

words.ex: The company came into being in 2010.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司成立于2010年。
words.en: To begin to exist or develop.

words.ex: He will move out next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周要搬出去。
words.en: To leave a place where you have been living and go to live somewhere else.

words.ex: He pulls on his jacket before going outside.
words.ex_cn: 他出门前穿上夹克。
words.en: To pull on something means to put it on by pulling, or to continue pulling something.

words.ex: He visits his grandparents from time to time.
words.ex_cn: 他时不时去看望他的祖父母。
words.en: If you do something from time to time, you do it occasionally but not regularly.

words.tr: phrase. 搁置一旁；保留；储存...备用
words.ex: He put aside his money for the trip.
words.ex_cn: 他把钱存起来用于旅行。
words.en: To place something to one side; to save something for future use.

words.ex: She decided to stretch out on the beach and enjoy the sun.
words.ex_cn: 她决定在沙滩上伸展身体，享受阳光。
words.en: To extend or lengthen one's body or a part of one's body to its full length.

words.tr: phrase. 进入；包括；参与；成为...一部分
words.ex: He will enter into the room after knocking.
words.ex_cn: 他敲门后会进入房间。
words.en: To begin or become involved in an activity, agreement, or condition.

words.ex: Tea is preferable to coffee in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 早上喝茶比喝咖啡更好。
words.en: If you say that one thing is preferable to another, you mean that it is more desirable or suitable.

words.ex: The new policy will come under review next month.
words.ex_cn: 这项新政策将在下个月接受审查。
words.en: To be subjected to or classified under a particular category or influence.

words.tr: phrase. 下沉；坠落；下降；被接受；传下去；被咽下
words.ex: The sun goes down in the evening.
words.ex_cn: 太阳在傍晚落下。
words.en: To move from a higher to a lower place or position; to decrease in size, amount, or intensity; to be accepted or believed; to happen or take place.

words.ex: She decided to commit her life to helping others.
words.ex_cn: 她决定将自己的一生奉献于帮助他人。
words.en: To entrust something to someone or an institution for safekeeping or handling; to make a pledge or promise.

words.ex: They profit by selling handmade crafts online.
words.ex_cn: 他们通过在网上出售手工工艺品获利。
words.en: To gain an advantage or benefit from something.

words.ex: We had a short conversation about the weather.
words.ex_cn: 我们简短地聊了聊天气。
words.en: A conversation is a talk between two or more people, in which news and ideas are exchanged.

words.tr: phrase. 满足于； 对 ... 感到满足
words.ex: He is content with his small house.
words.ex_cn: 他对自己的小房子感到满足。
words.en: To be satisfied with what one has or is, without desiring more or something else.

words.tr: phrase. 闹剧：一种轻松幽默的戏剧表演，通常以滑稽的情节和角色为特点。
words.ex: The play about the clumsy detective was a hit with the audience.
words.ex_cn: 关于笨拙侦探的闹剧深受观众喜爱。
words.en: A theatrical performance or drama, often light-hearted or humorous.

words.ex: His love of music stems from his childhood.
words.ex_cn: 他对音乐的热爱源于他的童年。
words.en: If a condition or problem stems from something, it was caused originally by that thing.

words.ex: She was successful in her attempt to climb the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 她成功尝试攀登了那座山。
words.en: To achieve a desired aim or result in a particular area or activity.

words.tr: phrase. 好像...似的； 仿佛...一样
words.ex: He talks as though he knows everything.
words.ex_cn: 他说话的样子好像什么都知道。
words.en: used to describe how someone or something seems to be, or how someone behaves, when this is not the real situation

words.ex: They often argue about politics.
words.ex_cn: 他们经常争论政治问题。
words.en: to speak angrily to someone, telling them that you disagree with them

words.tr: phrase. 用完；耗尽；跑出去；到期
words.ex: We run out of milk every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我们每星期天都把牛奶喝光了。
words.en: If you run out of something, you have no more of it left.

words.ex: The path leads up to the hill.
words.ex_cn: 这条小路通向小山。
words.en: To lead up to something means to happen or exist before it and often to cause it or be a part of it.

words.ex: He likes to size up the situation before making a decision.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在做决定前先评估一下情况。
words.en: To size up means to assess or evaluate something or someone, often in terms of their potential, ability, or size.

words.ex: Even now, he remembers his first day at school.
words.ex_cn: 即使到现在，他仍然记得上学的第一天。
words.en: At the present moment, despite the time that has passed.

words.tr: phrase. 导致；引起；使话题（渐渐）转向
words.ex: The warm-up exercises lead up to the main workout.
words.ex_cn: 热身运动为主要内容的锻炼做准备。
words.en: To precede and help to cause or prepare for something.

words.ex: He will go back to his hometown next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周会回他的家乡。
words.en: To return to a previous place, time, or subject.

words.ex: Aside from John, everyone went to the party.
words.ex_cn: 不包括约翰，大家都去参加派对了。
words.en: You use aside from when you are making an exception to a general statement.

words.tr: phrase. 进入；陷入；染上（坏习惯）
words.ex: He wants to get into a good university.
words.ex_cn: 他想进入一所好大学。
words.en: To enter or become involved in a particular activity, situation, or state.

words.ex: The wind wears away the rock slowly.
words.ex_cn: 风慢慢地磨损了石头。
words.en: To erode or diminish gradually through friction, use, or exposure.

words.ex: He put off his homework until tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他把作业推迟到明天。
words.en: To delay something or to cause someone to feel dislike or lack of interest.

words.ex: His opinion coincides with mine.
words.ex_cn: 他的观点与我的一致。
words.en: To happen at the same time as something else or to be the same or very similar.

words.ex: He tried to convince her to stay.
words.ex_cn: 他试图说服她留下。
words.en: If someone or something convinces you of something, they make you believe that it is true or that it exists.

words.ex: The car moves at a speed of 60 km/h.
words.ex_cn: 汽车以每小时60公里的速度行驶。
words.en: Moving or capable of moving at a specified rate or velocity.

words.tr: phrase. 确保；确定；核实；查明
words.ex: Make sure you lock the door before you leave.
words.ex_cn: 离开前确保锁好门。
words.en: To make certain that something is done or happens.

words.ex: The fire broke out in the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 火在厨房里突然烧了起来。
words.en: If something such as war, fighting, or disease breaks out, it begins suddenly.

words.ex: He has responsibility for cleaning the room.
words.ex_cn: 他负责打扫房间。
words.en: The state or fact of having a duty to deal with something or of having control over someone.

words.tr: phrase. 胡乱地； 随便地
words.ex: He picked a number at random.
words.ex_cn: 他随机选了一个数字。
words.en: If you choose people or things at random, you do not use any particular method, so they all have an equal chance of being chosen.

words.ex: He broke through the wall with his hands.
words.ex_cn: 他用手打破了墙壁。
words.en: To break through means to make a way through a barrier or to achieve success in spite of difficulties.

words.ex: The opposition to the new law was strong.
words.ex_cn: 对这项新法律的反对很强烈。
words.en: Opposition is strong disagreement with or resistance to something, especially a plan, policy, or government.

words.ex: He tried to break away from his old habits.
words.ex_cn: 他试图摆脱旧习惯。
words.en: To leave or escape from a group, place, or situation, especially in order to start something new or different.

words.ex: He tried to fill up the hole with sand.
words.ex_cn: 他试图用沙子填补那个洞。
words.en: To make something full, or to become full.

words.tr: phrase. 吵架；失和；掉落；离队
words.ex: They fell out over a small argument.
words.ex_cn: 他们因为一个小争执吵翻了。
words.en: If people fall out, they have an argument and are no longer friendly.

words.ex: He is saving $10 a week. At that rate, he will buy the bike in 10 weeks.
words.ex_cn: 他每周存10美元。按这个速度，他将在10周后买到自行车。
words.en: If something continues to happen at the same speed or in the same way as it is happening now.

words.ex: He will take part in the school play.
words.ex_cn: 他将参加学校的戏剧演出。
words.en: To be involved in an activity or event.

words.ex: He takes pride in helping others.
words.ex_cn: 他以帮助别人为荣。
words.en: To feel a sense of satisfaction or pleasure in one's own achievements, qualities, or possessions, or those of someone with whom one is closely associated.

words.tr: phrase. 首先；从一开始；压根
words.ex: I didn't go out in the first place.
words.ex_cn: 我根本就没出去。
words.en: used at the beginning of a sentence to introduce the first of several reasons, facts, or points that you want to make

words.ex: They bought apples in quantity.
words.ex_cn: 他们大量购买了苹果。
words.en: In large amounts or numbers; plentifully.

words.ex: The cost is in proportion to the size of the room.
words.ex_cn: 费用与房间的大小成正比。
words.en: If one thing changes or is done in proportion to another, it changes or is done according to how much the other thing changes or is done.

words.ex: The clothes will dry out in the sun.
words.ex_cn: 衣服在阳光下会晾干。
words.en: To remove the moisture from something or to stop drinking alcohol after a period of heavy drinking.

words.ex: The new policy will bring down prices.
words.ex_cn: 新政策将降低价格。
words.en: To cause something to fall or collapse; to reduce the level or amount of something; to cause someone in a position of power to lose their position.

words.ex: In the end, he chose to go home.
words.ex_cn: 最后，他选择回家。
words.en: finally, after everything has been considered or done

words.ex: He will run for mayor next year.
words.ex_cn: 他明年将竞选市长。
words.en: To compete for a position or office in an election.

words.ex: The heat can bring on a headache.
words.ex_cn: 炎热会引发头痛。
words.en: To cause something to happen or to lead to a particular situation.

words.ex: I see with my eyes.
words.ex_cn: 我用眼睛看。
words.en: To perceive or understand something visually or mentally.

words.ex: He is at work right now.
words.ex_cn: 他现在正在工作。
words.en: If someone is at work, they are doing their job or are busy doing a particular activity.

words.ex: The numbers add up to 100.
words.ex_cn: 这些数字加起来等于100。
words.en: If amounts add up to a particular total, they result in that total when they are put together.

words.tr: adj. 根本的；彻底的；激进的；
words.ex: The government made radical changes to the education system.
words.ex_cn: 政府对教育系统进行了根本性的改革。
words.en: A radical change or difference is very big and important.

words.ex: The weather is favorable to outdoor activities.
words.ex_cn: 天气对户外活动有利。
words.en: To be advantageous or beneficial to someone or something.

words.ex: This color is distinct from that one.
words.ex_cn: 这个颜色和那个不一样。
words.en: If one thing is distinct from another, there is a clear difference between them.

words.ex: They expect of him to be on time.
words.ex_cn: 他们期望他准时。
words.en: To consider something likely to happen or someone likely to do something.

words.ex: He makes the most of his time to study.
words.ex_cn: 他充分利用时间学习。
words.en: To use something to its fullest potential or to take full advantage of an opportunity.

words.tr: phrase. 算出；解决；锻炼；进展（顺利）
words.ex: I can work out the answer with a calculator.
words.ex_cn: 我可以用计算器算出答案。
words.en: If you work out a solution to a problem or mystery, you think about it and find a solution. If you work out the answer to a mathematical problem, you calculate it. If a plan or situation works out, it happens or progresses in a particular way.

words.ex: The numbers don't add up.
words.ex_cn: 这些数字对不上。
words.en: If facts or events do not add up, they make you confused about a situation because they do not seem to be consistent. If small amounts of something add up, they gradually increase.

words.ex: He is late, that is to say, he will miss the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他迟到了，也就是说，他会错过公交车。
words.en: used to introduce a statement that makes the meaning of something clearer or gives more information

words.ex: The cat is in danger from the big dog.
words.ex_cn: 这只猫正处在大狗的危险中。
words.en: At risk of harm, injury, or loss.

words.tr: phrase. 这样做时；在这情况下
words.ex: He helped his friend, and in doing so, he made a new friend.
words.ex_cn: 他帮助了他的朋友，这样做之后，他交了一个新朋友。
words.en: by taking this action; as a result of doing this

words.ex: The boat was at the mercy of the storm.
words.ex_cn: 船听任风暴摆布。
words.en: If one person or thing is at the mercy of another, the first person or thing is in a situation where they cannot prevent themselves being harmed or affected by the second.

words.ex: Please bear with me while I fix the computer.
words.ex_cn: 请耐心等一下，我正在修电脑。
words.en: To be patient and wait while someone does something.

words.ex: He works in the company near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他在公园附近的公司工作。
words.en: In the presence of others; accompanied by other people.

words.tr: phrase. 作为兼职；另外；暗地里
words.ex: He works as a teacher and drives a taxi on the side.
words.ex_cn: 他当老师，同时兼职开出租车。
words.en: If someone does something on the side, they do it in addition to their main job.

words.ex: He worked extra hours to make up for the lost time.
words.ex_cn: 他加班工作来弥补失去的时间。
words.en: To compensate for something that is lacking or has been lost.

words.ex: He forgot his keys once again.
words.ex_cn: 他又一次忘了带钥匙。
words.en: used to say that something happens again or is repeated

words.ex: He didn't win, but after all, he tried his best.
words.ex_cn: 他没有赢，但毕竟他尽了最大努力。
words.en: You use after all when you are saying that something that you thought might not be the case is in fact the case.

words.ex: Please fill out this form before you leave.
words.ex_cn: 请在离开前填写这张表格。
words.en: To complete a form or document by providing the required information.

words.tr: phrase. 看不见；在视野以外
words.ex: The keys are out of sight under the sofa.
words.ex_cn: 钥匙在沙发下面，看不见了。
words.en: If something is out of sight, it is too far away to be seen.

words.tr: phrase. 举起；支撑；继续下去；推举；阻挡；拦截；持械抢劫
words.ex: He held up his hand to ask a question.
words.ex_cn: 他举起了手来提问。
words.en: To hold something up means to keep it in a high position so that it does not fall or to support it. It can also mean to delay or stop the progress of something or someone, or to rob someone using violence or the threat of violence.

words.ex: By and large, he is a good student.
words.ex_cn: 总的来说，他是个好学生。
words.en: You use 'by and large' to indicate that a statement is mostly but not completely true.

words.tr: phrase. 收（债务）；引诱；（天色）接近黄昏；紧缩（开支）；（车）到站；用...绘画；吸入（气体）；缩短；拉回（网）
words.ex: The bank will draw in the loan next month.
words.ex_cn: 银行下个月将收回贷款。
words.en: To attract or entice someone or something into a place or situation.

words.ex: The dry grass burned up quickly in the sun.
words.ex_cn: 干草在阳光下迅速烧了起来。
words.en: If something burns up or if fire burns it up, it is completely destroyed by fire or heat.

words.ex: He works hard day after day.
words.ex_cn: 他日复一日地努力工作。
words.en: If something happens day after day, it happens every day without changing.

words.ex: He will report on the meeting tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天将汇报会议情况。
words.en: To give an account or description of an event, situation, or topic.

words.tr: phrase. 抽出；（昼夜）变长；使畅所欲言
words.ex: He drew out a key from his pocket.
words.ex_cn: 他从口袋里抽出一把钥匙。
words.en: To make something last longer than usual or to encourage someone to talk or express their feelings.

words.tr: phrase. 跨过；忽视；不予理会
words.ex: He passed over the small stream on the log.
words.ex_cn: 他从木头上跨过了那条小溪。
words.en: To ignore or disregard someone or something; to move across or beyond something.

words.tr: phrase. 逃跑； 流掉；迅速离开
words.ex: The boy ran off with his brother's bike.
words.ex_cn: 那个男孩骑着他哥哥的自行车跑掉了。
words.en: To leave a place or situation quickly and secretly, often to avoid a problem or responsibility; to produce copies of a document quickly; to discharge or release a liquid.

words.ex: It doesn't matter to me.
words.ex_cn: 这对我来说无所谓。
words.en: If something matters to you, it is important to you.

words.tr: adj. 可获得的；有空的；可用的；
words.ex: The books are available in the library.
words.ex_cn: 这些书在图书馆里可以借到。
words.en: If something is available, it is able to be used or obtained.

words.tr: phrase. 翻转；移交；换台；营业额达到；反复考虑
words.ex: He turned over the pancake with a spatula.
words.ex_cn: 他用铲子把煎饼翻了个面。
words.en: To cause something to move so that a different side is facing upwards; to transfer or hand over something to someone else; to achieve a certain amount of business.

words.tr: phrase. 反复地；一遍又一遍地
words.ex: He practiced the song over and over.
words.ex_cn: 他一遍又一遍地练习这首歌。
words.en: If you say that something happens over and over or over and over again, you are emphasizing that it happens many times.

words.ex: He is fond of eating apples.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢吃什么苹果。
words.en: If you are fond of someone or something, you feel affection for them or like them.

words.ex: In the main, people like simple food.
words.ex_cn: 总的来说，人们喜欢简单的食物。
words.en: For the most part; generally or mainly.

words.tr: phrase. 呈现；承担；接受；较量；雇用
words.ex: The sky takes on a pink color at sunset.
words.ex_cn: 日落时，天空呈现出粉红色。
words.en: To undertake or begin to deal with a task or responsibility; to hire someone; to acquire a particular appearance or quality.

words.ex: He helped me, and I gave him a gift in return for it.
words.ex_cn: 他帮了我，我送他一份礼物作为回报。
words.en: If you do something in return for something that someone has done for you, you do it because they did that thing for you.

words.ex: He works hard to improve his English.
words.ex_cn: 他努力改善自己的英语。
words.en: To make something better, or to become better.

words.ex: I helped him, and he gave me a gift in return.
words.ex_cn: 我帮了他，他送了我一份礼物作为回报。
words.en: If you do something in return for what someone else has done for you, you do it because they did that thing for you.

words.ex: We need to settle on a date for the trip.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要选定一个旅行的日期。
words.en: To decide on something after considering it carefully.

words.ex: He has insight into how the machine works.
words.ex_cn: 他了解这台机器的工作原理。
words.en: An understanding of the true nature of something.

words.ex: He spoke in support of his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他为朋友说话支持。
words.en: If you do something in support of someone or something, you do it in order to help them or to show that you agree with their aims or actions.

words.tr: phrase. 赞同； 同意； 适合于
words.ex: I agree with you on this point.
words.ex_cn: 我同意你的这个观点。
words.en: to have the same opinion as someone else; to accept a suggestion or idea

words.tr: phrase. 缺乏…的；完全没有…的
words.ex: The room was void of any furniture.
words.ex_cn: 房间里没有任何家具。
words.en: If you describe a situation or a feeling as void of something, you mean that it lacks that thing.

words.ex: His smile left a good impression on me.
words.ex_cn: 他的微笑给我留下了好印象。
words.en: An idea, feeling, or opinion about something or someone, especially one formed without conscious thought or on the basis of little evidence.

words.tr: phrase. 着手做；开始认真做
words.ex: He got down to work after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午饭后开始认真工作。
words.en: To begin to do or deal with something seriously or with determination.

words.tr: phrase. 取得进步；取得进展
words.ex: He is making progress in his English speaking.
words.ex_cn: 他在英语口语方面正在取得进步。
words.en: To advance or develop towards a better, more complete, or more modern state.

words.ex: He is second to none in math.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学方面无人能及。
words.en: To be inferior only to someone or something else; to be next in rank, quality, or importance.

words.ex: He has faith in his brother.
words.ex_cn: 他相信他的兄弟。
words.en: Trust or confidence in someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 彻底检查；重做；研究
words.ex: He worked over the weekend to finish the project.
words.ex_cn: 他周末加班完成了这个项目。
words.en: To examine or go over thoroughly for repair or revision; to beat someone severely.

words.ex: He cut off the power during the storm.
words.ex_cn: 他在风暴期间切断了电源。
words.en: To stop the supply of something, or to stop something from continuing.

words.tr:
n. 专家；行家；
adj. 内行的；老练的；专门的；
words.ex: He is an expert in computer science.
words.ex_cn: 他是计算机科学方面的专家。
words.en: A person who is very knowledgeable about or skillful in a particular area.

words.tr: phrase. 包裹；圆满完成；（使）穿得暖和
words.ex: She will wrap up the gift with colorful paper.
words.ex_cn: 她会用彩纸把礼物包起来。
words.en: To finish or complete something; to cover or enclose something in paper or soft material.

words.tr: v. 无法做到；失败；不及格；倒闭；
words.ex: He failed to finish the race.
words.ex_cn: 他没能完成比赛。
words.en: If you fail to do something that you were trying to do, you are unable to do it or do not succeed in doing it.

words.ex: The teacher exposes the students to new words every day.
words.ex_cn: 老师每天让学生接触新单词。
words.en: To expose something to a particular condition or influence means to allow it to be affected by that condition or influence.

words.tr: phrase. 通过；（电话）打通；度过；做完；用完
words.ex: He got through the exam with help from his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他在朋友的帮助下通过了考试。
words.en: To succeed in reaching a place or a stage in a process, or to make someone understand or accept something.

words.tr: phrase. 达到法定年龄；到了成年
words.ex: He came of age last year and now he can vote.
words.ex_cn: 他去年成年了，现在可以投票了。
words.en: To reach the age at which one is legally recognized as an adult.

words.tr: n. 应急计划，应变计划；减少，削减；储备物，备用物；退路；可依靠之物; adj. 退守的；应变的
words.ex: He used a fallback plan when the first one failed.
words.ex_cn: 当第一个计划失败时，他使用了备用方案。
words.en: A fallback is an alternative plan or course of action that is ready to be used in case the original one is not successful or possible.

words.ex: I look up the word in the dictionary.
words.ex_cn: 我在字典里查这个词。
words.en: If you look up a fact or a piece of information, you find it by looking in something such as a reference book or a list.

words.ex: He put forward a new idea in the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议上提出了一个新想法。
words.en: To suggest or propose something for consideration.

words.ex: Please put back the book on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 请把书放回书架上。
words.en: To return something to its original place or to postpone an event or action.

words.ex: The sun comes out after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 雨停后太阳出来了。
words.en: If something comes out, it becomes known, especially after it has been kept secret or it has been unknown.

words.tr: phrase. 求助于；退到；转而依靠
words.ex: He will fall back on his savings if he loses his job.
words.ex_cn: 如果他失业了，他会依靠自己的储蓄。
words.en: To rely on something or someone for help or support, especially when other options have failed.

words.tr: phrase. 跑着穿过；刺、戳；贯穿；匆匆处理；排练；划掉；挥霍
words.ex: The dog ran through the park quickly.
words.ex_cn: 狗迅速跑过了公园。
words.en: To go over or examine something quickly; to be present in every part of something; to rehearse a play, piece of music, etc.

words.ex: The two houses are far apart.
words.ex_cn: 这两栋房子相距很远。
words.en: Located at a great distance from each other.

words.tr: phrase. 进入；到达；插话；收割；当选
words.ex: He gets in the car every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上上车。
words.en: To arrive at a place, especially after a journey.

words.ex: The company will roll back the price increase.
words.ex_cn: 公司将撤销价格上调。
words.en: To return something to a previous state or condition, especially in computing or politics.

words.ex: You must look to your health before it's too late.
words.ex_cn: 你必须注意你的健康，趁还来得及。
words.en: To expect or depend on someone or something to do something or provide something.

words.tr: phrase. 草拟；停住；逼近；追上；整队
words.ex: He will draw up a plan tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会起草一个计划。
words.en: To prepare and write something such as a document or plan, or to bring a vehicle to a stop.

words.ex: What about going to the park?
words.ex_cn: 去公园怎么样？
words.en: Used to introduce a suggestion or question about a different matter or person.

words.ex: He aims for the top score in the test.
words.ex_cn: 他目标是考试得最高分。
words.en: If you aim for something, you intend to achieve it or to make it happen.

words.ex: He likes apples, bananas, and the like.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢苹果、香蕉之类的水果。
words.en: used at the end of a list to indicate that there are other similar things or people that could also be included

words.ex: He has a good reputation for honesty.
words.ex_cn: 他以诚实著称。
words.en: The opinion that people have about someone or something because of what has happened in the past.

words.tr: phrase. 穿过；抄近路走过；切断；刺穿
words.ex: He cut through the forest to save time.
words.ex_cn: 他穿过森林以节省时间。
words.en: To go through or across something, especially in a direct or efficient way.

words.ex: The idea was alien to her.
words.ex_cn: 这个想法对她来说很陌生。
words.en: If something is alien to you, it is not familiar to you or it is not the kind of thing that you normally experience or understand.

words.ex: The forest abounds in birds and deer.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林里鸟和鹿很多。
words.en: If things abound, or if a place abounds with things, there are very large numbers of them.

words.tr: phrase. 为…而建造的纪念碑
words.ex: They built a monument to the fallen soldiers.
words.ex_cn: 他们为阵亡的士兵建立了一座纪念碑。
