words.en: A structure, building, or site that is of historical interest or importance, especially one officially recognized and preserved by a government.

words.ex: He will reach out to his friend tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会联系他的朋友。
words.en: To reach out means to extend one's hand outward in order to touch or grasp something, or to make contact with someone, especially in order to offer help or support.

words.ex: I am looking forward to the weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我期待着周末。
words.en: To eagerly anticipate or look forward to something with pleasure.

words.ex: He resides in a small village near the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 他住在山附近的一个小村庄里。
words.en: If someone or something resides in a particular place, they are in that place; if a quality resides in something, it is present in that thing.

words.ex: He is ready for the test.
words.ex_cn: 他准备好考试了。
words.en: To be prepared or in a state of readiness for something that is expected to happen.

words.ex: The surgeon carefully cut away the tumor.
words.ex_cn: 外科医生小心地切除了肿瘤。
words.en: To remove something by cutting it off.

words.ex: He is loyal to his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他对朋友忠诚。
words.en: To be faithful and committed to someone or something.

words.ex: The child is safe from harm.
words.ex_cn: 孩子免受伤害。
words.en: Protected against harm or danger from someone or something.

words.ex: He lives for playing football every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末都靠踢足球而活着。
words.en: If you say that someone lives for something, you mean that it is the most important thing in their life.

words.ex: We are short of money to buy food.
words.ex_cn: 我们缺钱买食物。
words.en: If you are short of something, you do not have enough of it. If something is short of a place, it is not as far as that place.

words.ex: He wants to major in biology at university.
words.ex_cn: 他想在大学主修生物学。
words.en: To specialize in a particular subject or field of study at a college or university.

words.ex: He works hard year after year.
words.ex_cn: 他年复一年地努力工作。
words.en: If something happens year after year, it happens regularly every year.

words.tr: phrase. 跑进；撞上；偶遇；陷入；达到
words.ex: The dog ran into the house.
words.ex_cn: 狗跑进了房子。
words.en: To meet someone or find something by chance; to experience something unexpectedly; to collide with something.

words.ex: He cut into the conversation to ask a question.
words.ex_cn: 他打断了对话来问一个问题。
words.en: To interrupt or penetrate something, often abruptly or forcefully.

words.ex: He saves money for the future.
words.ex_cn: 他为将来存钱。
words.en: In the time that is yet to come; for future use or consideration.

words.ex: The young boy plays soccer every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 这个年轻的孩子每天下午都踢足球。
words.en: Someone who is young has not lived for very long or is not yet mature.

words.tr:
adj. 缓慢的；迟钝的；
v. 使减速；
words.ex: The slow car moved across the bridge.
words.ex_cn: 那辆缓慢的车驶过桥。
words.en: Moving or capable of moving only at a low speed; not fast.

words.ex: He didn't answer me back.
words.ex_cn: 他没有回我话。
words.en: To reply rudely or defiantly to someone, especially someone in authority.

words.tr: phrase. 阐明；提出；陈列；出发；把…提前
words.ex: He set forth his ideas clearly.
words.ex_cn: 他清楚地提出了自己的想法。
words.en: To present or introduce something, such as an idea, plan, or argument, in a clear and detailed way.

words.tr: phrase. 观看；面向；旁观；看待
words.ex: They look on while the children play.
words.ex_cn: 他们看着孩子们玩耍。
words.en: To watch something happen without getting involved.

words.ex: He dug out an old photo from the box.
words.ex_cn: 他从盒子里翻出了一张旧照片。
words.en: To remove something from the ground by digging; to find something after searching.

words.tr: phrase. 举起；张贴；建造；进行；提供；推举；提供食宿
words.ex: He put up his hand to ask a question.
words.ex_cn: 他举起了手来提问。
words.en: To provide someone with a place to stay temporarily; to build or erect something; to raise or lift something; to propose or suggest something; to display or post something; to increase the price of something.

words.ex: He filed for divorce from his wife last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年向妻子提出了离婚。
words.en: To legally end a marriage with someone, or to separate or disconnect something from something else.

words.tr: phrase. 下来；吞下；弯下；写下
words.ex: He got down from the chair slowly.
words.ex_cn: 他慢慢地从椅子上下来。
words.en: To move from a higher to a lower position; to write something down; to cause someone to feel sad or depressed.

words.ex: They put the baby to sleep at eight o'clock.
words.ex_cn: 他们八点钟让宝宝睡觉。
words.en: To present a question, suggestion, etc., to someone for consideration or decision; to cause to be in a certain state.

words.ex: Above all, be kind to others.
words.ex_cn: 最重要的是，对他人要善良。
words.en: Most importantly; especially.

words.ex: The soup has a smell of garlic.
words.ex_cn: 这汤有大蒜的味道。
words.en: To have a particular smell that is caused by something.

words.ex: He runs in the park every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上在公园跑步。
words.en: To drive a new car carefully for a certain distance or period of time in order to make sure that all its parts work correctly together; to visit someone informally.

words.ex: He devotes his time to helping children.
words.ex_cn: 他把时间用于帮助孩子。
words.en: To give or apply (one's time, attention, or self) entirely to a particular activity, cause, or person.

words.ex: Two plus two is equivalent to four.
words.ex_cn: 二加二等于四。
words.en: Having the same value, function, or meaning as something else.

words.ex: He answered the question from memory.
words.ex_cn: 他凭记忆回答了这个问题。
words.en: If you do something from memory, you do it without looking at or referring to something.

words.tr: phrase. 关在外面；遮住；障蔽；使不能得分
words.ex: The storm shut out the light from the windows.
words.ex_cn: 风暴把光挡在了窗外。
words.en: To prevent someone or something from entering a place or to exclude someone from participating in something.

words.ex: You must comply with the rules.
words.ex_cn: 你必须遵守规则。
words.en: To act in accordance with a wish, command, or rule.

words.ex: The car will run on gasoline.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车靠汽油运行。
words.en: If something runs on, it continues without stopping.

words.ex: He sleeps in on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他在周末睡懒觉。
words.en: To sleep later than usual in the morning.

words.ex: He is about to leave the house.
words.ex_cn: 他马上就要离开家了。
words.en: If you are about to do something, you are going to do it very soon.

words.ex: He is tired of eating the same food every day.
words.ex_cn: 他厌倦了每天吃同样的食物。
words.en: To feel that you have had enough of someone or something and do not want to have to deal with them or it any more.

words.ex: He will tire of playing video games after a while.
words.ex_cn: 过一阵子他就会厌倦玩电子游戏。
words.en: To become bored with or lose interest in something or someone.

words.ex: He cares about his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他在乎他的朋友们。
words.en: If you care about something, you feel that it is important and are concerned about it.

words.tr: phrase. 向...表示敬意；为祝贺...
words.ex: They planted a tree in honor of her birthday.
words.ex_cn: 他们种了一棵树以纪念她的生日。
words.en: If something is arranged or happens in honor of a particular event or person, it is done to celebrate that event or to show respect and admiration for that person.

words.tr: phrase. 不时；相隔一定距离（或时间）
words.ex: He checks the machine at intervals.
words.ex_cn: 他每隔一段时间检查一下机器。
words.en: If something happens at intervals, it happens occasionally or periodically, with breaks in between.

words.ex: Be careful about crossing the street without looking.
words.ex_cn: 过马路时不要不看车。
words.en: To exercise caution or prudence regarding something.

words.tr: phrase. 扎牢；妥善解决；密切联系；占用；合伙；停泊
words.ex: He will tie up the loose rope.
words.ex_cn: 他会把松开的绳子系好。
words.en: To tie up means to fasten or secure something with a cord, rope, or the like. It can also mean to occupy or engage someone or something completely, leaving no time or resources for other activities.

words.tr: phrase. 符合；一致；与…成一直线
words.ex: His decision is in line with the company's rules.
words.ex_cn: 他的决定符合公司的规定。
words.en: In agreement or conformity with something.

words.tr: phrase. 当季；正当时；处于旺季
words.ex: Apples are in season in autumn.
words.ex_cn: 苹果在秋天是当季的。
words.en: If a fruit or vegetable is in season, it is the time of year when it is ready for eating and is widely available.

words.ex: The candle burned out after five hours.
words.ex_cn: 蜡烛燃烧了五个小时后熄灭了。
words.en: If someone burns out, they become exhausted or lose their enthusiasm because they have been working too hard or for too long.

words.ex: He is at heart a kind man.
words.ex_cn: 他本质上是个善良的人。
words.en: If you say that someone has a particular quality at heart, you mean that it is a basic and important part of their character, even though they may not always show it.

words.ex: Water is in short supply during the drought.
words.ex_cn: 干旱期间，水很短缺。
words.en: If something is in short supply, there is very little of it available and it is difficult to find or obtain.

words.tr: phrase. 被绑在；被系在；被束缚
words.ex_cn: 他整天都离不开手机。
words.en: To be closely connected or associated with something; to be bound or restricted by something.

words.ex: The teacher will hand out the papers now.
words.ex_cn: 老师现在会分发试卷。
words.en: To distribute something to a group of people.

words.tr: phrase. 提出；教育；养育；呕出
words.ex: He brought up an important point in the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议上提出了一个重要的观点。
words.en: To mention a subject or start to talk about it; to care for a child until they are an adult, often giving them particular beliefs; to educate someone; to vomit.

words.ex: She cut the apple in half.
words.ex_cn: 她把苹果切成两半。
words.en: Into two equal parts.

words.ex: Please turn down the volume, it's too loud.
words.ex_cn: 请把音量调低，太大声了。
words.en: To refuse or reject an offer or request; to reduce the volume, temperature, or intensity of something.

words.ex: His intention was to help his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他的意图是帮助他的朋友。
words.en: An intention is an idea or plan of what you are going to do.

words.ex: The sign is warning against swimming in the lake.
words.ex_cn: 标志警告不要在湖里游泳。
words.en: To advise someone not to do something because it is dangerous, wrong, or could lead to an unwanted result.

words.ex: He cast off the old coat.
words.ex_cn: 他脱下了那件旧外套。
words.en: To get rid of something or someone that is no longer wanted or needed; to untie a boat from the place where it is moored.

words.ex: He arrived late, as usual.
words.ex_cn: 他像往常一样迟到了。
words.en: As usual means in the same way as what happens most of the time or in most cases.

words.ex: Books are piling up on the table.
words.ex_cn: 书正堆在桌子上。
words.en: If things pile up, they gradually increase in number or amount until there is a large quantity of them.

words.tr: phrase. 使用；接近；可以利用
words.ex: Students have access to the library after school.
words.ex_cn: 学生放学后可以使用图书馆。
words.en: To have the right or opportunity to use or see something.

words.ex: They plant out tomatoes in spring.
words.ex_cn: 他们在春天把番茄苗移栽到户外。
words.en: To plant out means to transfer young plants from a place where they have been sown or raised to their permanent growing positions outdoors.

words.ex: He finished his homework at last.
words.ex_cn: 他终于完成了作业。
words.en: After a long time or delay; finally.

words.ex: The children play with toys in the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在公园里玩玩具。
words.en: To engage in activity for enjoyment and recreation rather than a serious or practical purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 不挂断；稍等 ；紧紧抓住
words.ex: Hang on, I will be there soon.
words.ex_cn: 等一下，我马上就到。
words.en: To hold onto something tightly; to wait for a short time.

words.ex: He is responsible to his teacher for the homework.
words.ex_cn: 他对老师负责他的作业。
words.en: To have a duty to someone to ensure that something is done or to take care of someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 平行的；类似的；相同的
words.ex: The road is parallel to the river.
words.ex_cn: 这条路与河流平行。
words.en: If one thing is parallel to another, it happens at the same time as it or is similar to it.

words.tr: phrase. 采取行动；提出诉讼
words.ex: He must take action now.
words.ex_cn: 他现在必须采取行动。
words.en: To do something in order to deal with a situation or problem.

words.ex: I don't like the movie, but at any rate, it was short.
words.ex_cn: 我不喜欢这部电影，但无论如何，它很短。
words.en: Used to indicate that a statement is true or relevant in any case.

words.ex: The case is under investigation.
words.ex_cn: 这个案件正在调查中。
words.en: If someone or something is under investigation, they are being investigated.

words.ex: He sent the letter by way of his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他通过朋友寄了这封信。
words.en: If you do something by way of a particular method, you use that method to do it.

words.tr: phrase. 一点也不； 不必客气
words.ex: I don't like spicy food, not at all.
words.ex_cn: 我不喜欢辣的食物，一点也不。
words.en: Used as a polite response to thanks or to express that something is not a problem or does not matter.

words.ex: I saw a car pass by my house.
words.ex_cn: 我看到一辆车从我家旁边开过。
words.en: To move past or go past something or someone without stopping or without paying attention to them.

words.ex: He sent the package by air.
words.ex_cn: 他通过空运寄出了包裹。
words.en: Using aircraft as a means of transport.

words.ex: They go to the forest to hunt for food.
words.ex_cn: 他们去森林里寻找食物。
words.en: To search for something or someone very carefully and thoroughly.

words.ex: Many readers identify with the main character's struggles.
words.ex_cn: 许多读者对主角的挣扎感同身受。
words.en: If you identify with someone or something, you feel that you understand them or their feelings and ideas.

words.ex: He got over and above what he needed.
words.ex_cn: 他得到了比需要的更多的东西。
words.en: In addition to; besides.

words.ex: He visits his grandma off and on.
words.ex_cn: 他断断续续地去看望他的奶奶。
words.en: If something happens off and on, it happens occasionally or at intervals, but not regularly or continuously.

words.ex: He was late owing to the bus delay.
words.ex_cn: 他迟到了，因为公交车晚点了。
words.en: You use owing to when you are introducing the reason for something.

words.ex: The beauty of the painting was of itself; no other piece could compare.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画的美是本身就有的，没有其他作品可以与之相比。
words.en: By itself; inherently.

words.ex: No wonder he is tired, he worked all night.
words.ex_cn: 难怪他累了，他整晚都在工作。
words.en: It is not surprising that something is the case.

words.ex: The teacher took into account his effort, not just his grade.
words.ex_cn: 老师重视他的努力，而不仅仅是他的分数。
words.en: To consider or remember something when judging a situation.

words.tr: phrase. 吸收；领会；接待；接受
words.ex: Plants take in sunlight to make food.
words.ex_cn: 植物吸收阳光来制造食物。
words.en: To take something in means to understand it or to absorb it. It can also mean to deceive someone or to make clothes smaller.

words.tr: phrase. 对…免疫；不受影响的
words.ex: He seems to be immune to the flu.
words.ex_cn: 他似乎对流感有免疫力。
words.en: If you are immune to something, you are protected against it and therefore unlikely to be affected by it.

words.ex: Can you sum up the total cost?
words.ex_cn: 你能合计一下总费用吗？
words.en: If you sum something up, you briefly describe the main features or ideas of it.

words.tr: phrase. 飞行时差反应；时差感
words.ex: He feels tired because of jet lag.
words.ex_cn: 他因为时差而感到疲倦。
words.en: A temporary disorder that causes fatigue, insomnia, and other symptoms as a result of rapid travel across several time zones.

words.ex: The boy kicked up dust while running.
words.ex_cn: 男孩跑步时踢起了灰尘。
words.en: To cause something to rise or increase, especially dust, a fuss, or prices.

words.ex: Don't kick up a fuss just because you didn't get the toy.
words.ex_cn: 不要因为没得到玩具就大吵大闹。
words.en: To make a lot of unnecessary noise or complaints about something, often in a way that is not justified.

words.ex: I will see you in person tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我明天亲自见你。
words.en: If you do something in person, you do it yourself rather than letting someone else do it for you.

words.ex: Don't pass up this opportunity; it may never come again.
words.ex_cn: 不要错过这个机会；它可能再也不会来了。
words.en: To choose not to take advantage of an opportunity.

words.ex: On the one hand, I like coffee; on the other hand, I hate its taste.
words.ex_cn: 一方面，我喜欢咖啡；另一方面，我讨厌它的味道。
words.en: used to introduce the first of two contrasting points, facts, or ways of looking at something.

words.ex: My friend always backs up my ideas in meetings.
words.ex_cn: 我的朋友总是在会议上支持我的想法。
words.en: To support someone or something; to make a copy of computer data to protect against loss.

words.ex: Before long, he will finish his homework.
words.ex_cn: 不久之后，他就会完成作业。
words.en: If you say that something will happen or is true before long, you mean that it will happen or is true soon.

words.tr: phrase. 对…有怀疑；对…有猜疑
words.ex: She became suspicious of his intentions.
words.ex_cn: 她开始怀疑他的意图。
words.en: Having or showing a cautious distrust of someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 自由；随意；闲着；有空
words.ex: He felt at liberty to express his true feelings.
words.ex_cn: 他觉得可以自由地表达自己的真实感受。
words.en: If someone is at liberty to do something, they have been given permission to do it.

words.ex: The walls of the city began to close in on us.
words.ex_cn: 城市的围墙开始向我们逼近。
words.en: To move nearer to someone or something, especially in order to surround them and prevent them from escaping.

words.ex: The students stand up when the teacher enters the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 当老师走进教室时，学生们站起来。
words.en: If you stand up, you rise to your feet from a sitting or lying position.

words.tr: phrase. 意识到；察觉到；知道
words.ex: Be aware of the danger near the river.
words.ex_cn: 注意河边的危险。
words.en: To have knowledge or understanding of something.

words.ex: We tuck into our breakfast at 7 a.m. every day.
words.ex_cn: 我们每天早上7点开始吃早餐。
words.en: To start eating something with enthusiasm.

words.ex: His social life got in the way of his studies.
words.ex_cn: 他的社交生活妨碍了他的学习。
words.en: Concerning or in the matter of; with regard to.

words.tr: phrase. 用坏；穿破；（使）筋疲力尽；耗尽
words.ex: He wore out his shoes after running every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天跑步，把鞋子磨坏了。
words.en: To wear out means to make something old and damaged because it has been used a lot, or to make someone extremely tired.

words.ex: In the wake of the storm, the city was left in ruins.
words.ex_cn: 风暴过后，城市变成了一片废墟。
words.en: Following immediately after, often as a result of.

words.ex: He started to tear into the sandwich with his hands.
words.ex_cn: 他用手开始撕开三明治。
words.en: To criticize or attack someone or something very severely.

words.ex: There is a small table in between the two chairs.
words.ex_cn: 两把椅子之间有一张小桌子。
words.en: Located or occurring in the space separating two things or points.

words.ex: In the long run, eating healthy saves money on doctor visits.
words.ex_cn: 从长远来看，健康饮食可以节省看医生的费用。
words.en: Over an extended period of time; in the future, especially in the distant future.

words.tr: phrase. 可被...利用或得到的
words.ex: The new software will be available to the public next month.
words.ex_cn: 这款新软件将于下个月对公众开放使用。
words.en: If something is available to someone, they are able to use it or obtain it.

words.ex: He has in excess of ten books on science.
words.ex_cn: 他有十本以上的科学书籍。
words.en: If something is in excess of a particular amount, it is more than that amount.

words.tr: phrase. 着手干；进行；（经常）表现得
words.ex: He goes about his work quietly.
words.ex_cn: 他安静地做自己的工作。
words.en: If you go about a task or problem in a particular way, you start dealing with it in that way.

words.ex: The food provided was sufficient for everyone.
words.ex_cn: 提供的食物足够每个人食用。
words.en: to be enough in quantity or quality for a particular purpose or need

words.ex: He taught math in primary school.
words.ex_cn: 他在小学教数学。
words.en: A primary school is a school for children between the ages of about five and eleven.

words.ex: The wind will blow in from the sea tonight.
words.ex_cn: 今晚风会从海上吹来。
words.en: To arrive or appear somewhere suddenly or unexpectedly.

words.ex: How should we go about solving this problem?
words.ex_cn: 我们应该如何着手解决这个问题？
words.en: If you go about something in a particular way, you start to do it or deal with it in that way.

words.ex: He gave me a book in exchange for a pen.
words.ex_cn: 他用一本书换了我的钢笔。
words.en: If you give or do something in exchange for something else, you give or do it in order to get that thing.

words.tr: phrase. 参加…选拔；测试；试验
words.ex: He wants to try out for the school soccer team.
words.ex_cn: 他想参加校足球队的选拔。
words.en: To test something to see if it is suitable or effective.

words.ex: He visits his grandparents on occasion.
words.ex_cn: 他偶尔去看望祖父母。
words.en: Sometimes but not often.

words.ex: If you go against the rules, you might get in trouble.
words.ex_cn: 如果你违反规定，可能会惹上麻烦。
words.en: To oppose or act in contradiction to something or someone.

words.ex: My mom is proud of me because I passed the test.
words.ex_cn: 我妈妈为我通过考试而感到骄傲。
words.en: To feel a sense of pride or satisfaction in something or someone.

words.ex: The heavy rain was the cause for the delay.
words.ex_cn: n. 大雨是延误的原因。
words.en: A reason or justification for something.

words.ex: His portrait was painted to the life.
words.ex_cn: 他的肖像画得栩栩如生。
words.en: In a way that is true to real life; realistic or authentic.

words.ex: The company decided to present each employee with a gift on their birthday.
words.ex_cn: 公司决定在每位员工的生日时赠送一份礼物。
words.en: To give or show something to someone in a formal way.

words.ex: We ran out of milk this morning.
words.ex_cn: 我们今天早上牛奶喝完了。
words.en: If you run out of something, you have no more of it left.

words.tr: phrase. 洗餐具；洗脸和手；将...冲上岸；结束；毁掉
words.ex: He washes up after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他饭后洗碗。
words.en: To clean the dishes, cutlery, and other utensils used in preparing and eating a meal; to clean one's hands and face.

words.ex: The price of apples will go up next week.
words.ex_cn: 苹果的价格将在下周上涨。
words.en: If a price, amount, or level goes up, it becomes higher or greater than it was.

words.ex: She was certain of her decision.
words.ex_cn: 她对自己的决定很有把握。
words.en: If you are certain of something, you have no doubt about it.

words.ex: Eating vegetables is good for your health.
words.ex_cn: 吃蔬菜对你的健康有好处。
words.en: To be beneficial or advantageous for someone or something.

words.ex: The steps are as follows.
words.ex_cn: 步骤如下。
words.en: used to introduce a list of items or points

words.tr: phrase. 大体上；基本上；总的来说
words.ex: On the whole, the movie was good.
words.ex_cn: 总的来说，这部电影不错。
words.en: You use on the whole to indicate that what you are saying is true in general but may not be true in every case, or that you are giving a general opinion or summary of something.

words.ex: To some extent, he likes the new job.
words.ex_cn: 在某种程度上，他喜欢这份新工作。
words.en: To some extent means to a certain degree or in a certain measure, but not completely.

words.ex: The conference aims to bring together experts from various fields.
words.ex_cn: 这次会议旨在汇集来自不同领域的专家。
words.en: To cause people or things to come together in one place or for a common purpose.

words.ex: They go out to watch a movie on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他们周末外出看电影。
words.en: To leave a place, especially one's home, for a short time, usually for a specific purpose such as entertainment or socializing.

words.ex: On the average, they work 40 hours per week.
words.ex_cn: 平均而言，他们每周工作40小时。
words.en: When you say 'on the average', you are referring to the mean value or the typical case in a set of data or a group of people.

words.ex: We arrive at the station at 9 o'clock.
words.ex_cn: 我们九点到达车站。
words.en: To reach a destination or to come to a decision or conclusion after consideration.

words.tr: phrase. 使表现出；说出；呈出；出版
words.ex: The new lighting really brings out the colors in the painting.
words.ex_cn: 新灯光让画中的颜色更加突出。
words.en: To cause something to be seen or known; to publish something.

words.ex: This song is popular with teenagers.
words.ex_cn: 这首歌在青少年中很受欢迎。
words.en: If someone or something is popular with a particular group of people, they are liked or admired by those people.

words.ex: He ran fast to catch up with his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得很快，以便追上他的朋友。
words.en: To reach someone or something that is ahead of you, or to make up for lost time or progress.

words.ex: He refused to recognize the new government as legitimate.
words.ex_cn: 他拒绝承认新政府为合法政府。
words.en: To acknowledge or accept something as being true or as having a particular status or quality.

words.tr: phrase. 认出某人是；承认某人是……
words.ex: The company recognized him as the best employee of the year.
words.ex_cn: 公司认可他为年度最佳员工。
words.en: To acknowledge someone as having a particular status or identity.

words.tr:
v. 答复；回答；
n. 答复；回答；
words.ex: He replied to my message quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快回复了我的消息。
words.en: To reply means to say or write something as an answer to something that someone has said or written.

words.tr: phrase. 回答某人；回复某人
words.ex: She didn't reply to my message.
words.ex_cn: 她没有回复我的信息。
words.en: To respond to a message or question from someone.

words.tr: phrase. 代表某人；描述某人
words.ex: He was accused of representing himself as a doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他被指控把自己描述成一名医生。
words.en: To describe or portray someone in a particular way, often in a way that is not accurate or fair.

words.tr: phrase. 把某事物描述成……；将某事物表现为……
words.ex: He represents the problem as a simple picture.
words.ex_cn: 他把这个问题表示成一幅简单的图画。
words.en: To describe or show something in a particular way, often to create a specific impression.

words.ex: Before making the decision, they decided to consult with their legal advisor.
words.ex_cn: 在做决定之前，他们决定与他们的法律顾问商量。
words.en: To discuss something with someone in order to get their advice or opinion.

words.ex: He will consult a doctor for his headache.
words.ex_cn: 他将咨询医生治疗他的头痛。
words.en: to seek information or advice from someone, especially someone who is an expert in a particular field

words.ex: He takes issue with the new rules.
words.ex_cn: 他不同意这些新规则。
words.en: To disagree with or challenge a particular point or statement.

words.ex: We figure on leaving early tomorrow morning.
words.ex_cn: 我们打算明天一早出发。
words.en: To expect or plan for something; to take something into account.

words.ex: One day, he will become a doctor.
words.ex_cn: 总有一天，他会成为一名医生。
words.en: At some time in the future, especially when it is not known exactly when.

words.ex: He left early, of necessity, to catch the train.
words.ex_cn: 他不得不早点离开，以便赶上火车。
words.en: If you say that something is of necessity the case, you mean that it must be the case and cannot be different.

words.tr: phrase. 陆续地；一个接一个地
words.ex: The children left the room one after another.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们一个接一个地离开了房间。
words.en: If things happen one after another, they happen in sequence, with little or no time in between.

words.tr: phrase. 远近；四面八方；到处
words.ex: People came from far and near to see the spectacle.
words.ex_cn: 人们从四面八方赶来看这场盛况。
words.en: From a lot of different places, both near and far.

words.ex: He plans to start his retirement next year.
words.ex_cn: 他计划明年退休。
words.en: Retirement is the period of one's life after leaving one's job and ceasing to work.

words.ex: Look out the window to see the birds.
words.ex_cn: 往窗外看，看看那些鸟。
words.en: To be vigilant or cautious.

words.ex: He answered the question on the spot.
words.ex_cn: 他当场回答了问题。
words.en: If you do something on the spot, you do it immediately without any delay.

words.ex: You need to feed in the correct password to access the system.
words.ex_cn: 你需要输入正确的密码才能访问系统。
words.en: To supply or introduce something into a system or process.

words.tr: phrase. 充足；以全文；全部地
words.ex: He paid the bill in full.
words.ex_cn: 他全额支付了账单。
words.en: If something is done or happens in full, it is done or happens completely.

words.ex: He has nothing but praise for his teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他对老师只有赞美。
words.en: used to emphasize that something is only what you say it is and nothing more

words.ex: He arrives on time every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都准时到达。
words.en: If something happens on time, it happens at the time that was planned.

words.ex: Please keep down the noise.
words.ex_cn: 请把噪音压低。
words.en: To prevent something from increasing, spreading, or becoming too noticeable.

words.ex: Keep in mind that the bus leaves at 6 o'clock.
words.ex_cn: 记住，公交车六点发车。
words.en: To remember or not forget something.

words.ex: How do you feel about moving to a new city?
words.ex_cn: 你对搬到一个新城市有什么感觉？
words.en: To have a particular opinion or attitude towards something.

words.ex: He changed his plan in light of the new weather forecast.
words.ex_cn: 根据新的天气预报，他改变了计划。
words.en: Used to introduce a fact or situation that is the reason for a particular action or decision.

words.ex: He tried to rid himself of the bad habit.
words.ex_cn: 他试图改掉这个坏习惯。
words.en: To free someone from something unwanted or unpleasant.

words.ex: He left right away when he heard the news.
words.ex_cn: 他一听到消息就离开了。
words.en: If you do something right away, you do it immediately.

words.ex: Now that it is sunny, we can go outside.
words.ex_cn: 既然天晴了，我们可以出去了。
words.en: Used to introduce a reason or explanation, often implying that the situation has changed.

words.tr: phrase. 对…是致命的；给…带来灾难
words.ex: Smoking can be fatal to your health.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟对你的健康可能是致命的。
words.en: If something is fatal to someone or something, it causes them to die or to fail completely.

words.ex: He looked through the book quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他快速翻阅了那本书。
words.en: To look through something means to examine or read it quickly or casually.

words.ex: This book is of importance to students.
words.ex_cn: 这本书对学生很重要。
words.en: Having significance or value; important.

words.ex: The obedient child cleaned his room without being told.
words.ex_cn: 这个听话的孩子没被要求就打扫了房间。
words.en: An obedient person or animal does what they are told to do.

words.tr:
v. 给…打电话；响铃；
n. 环；环形物；铃声；拳击场；
words.ex: I will ring you tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我明天给你打电话。
words.en: A ring is a small circular band, typically of precious metal and often set with one or more gemstones, worn on a finger as an ornament or a token of marriage, engagement, or authority. It can also refer to the act of making a clear resonant or vibrating sound, or to encircle or surround something.

words.ex: In future, I will be more careful with my spending.
words.ex_cn: 从今以后，我会更加小心我的开支。
words.en: From now on; at a future time.

words.ex: The story revolves around a boy who finds a magic stone.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事围绕一个发现魔法石的男孩展开。
words.en: To revolve around something means to have it as the main subject or purpose.

words.ex: His familiarity with the city helped him find the way.
words.ex_cn: 他对这座城市的熟悉帮助他找到了路。
words.en: A thorough knowledge or mastery of a subject, place, or situation, often gained through experience.

words.ex: He says he likes quiet, on the contrary, he always listens to loud music.
words.ex_cn: 他说他喜欢安静，相反，他总是听大声的音乐。
words.en: You use 'on the contrary' when you are contradicting what has just been said or implied, or making a contrast between two things.

words.ex: He insists on walking to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 他坚持每天步行上学。
words.en: If you insist on something, you demand it and refuse to accept any alternative.

words.ex: In the mass, people prefer peace to war.
words.ex_cn: 总体上，人们更喜欢和平而不是战争。
words.en: Considered as a whole; in general.

words.ex: Every bit of information helps.
words.ex_cn: 每一点信息都有帮助。
words.en: To the same degree; equally.

words.ex: He goes to the gym every other day.
words.ex_cn: 他每隔一天去一次健身房。
words.en: You use every other to indicate that an action or event happens regularly, with a fixed period of time between each one and the next.

words.ex: The dog run at the ball.
words.ex_cn: 狗跑向球。
words.en: To move quickly towards someone or something in order to attack them.

words.ex: It's getting late, I think I'll run along now.
words.ex_cn: 天色已晚，我想我现在该走了。
words.en: To leave or go away, especially in a hurry or without delay.

words.tr: v. 扩大；膨胀；更充分地阐述；
words.ex: The company plans to expand its business to other countries.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司计划将其业务扩大到其他国家。
words.en: To increase in size, number, or importance, or to make something increase in this way.

words.ex: The captain asked the crew to get on board.
words.ex_cn: 船长让船员们上船。
words.en: On board means to be on a ship, aircraft, or other vehicle.

words.ex: This rule applies to all cases without exception to the rule.
words.ex_cn: n. 这条规则适用于所有情况，没有例外。
words.en: An exception to something is a particular thing, person, or situation that is not included in a general statement, judgment, or rule.

words.ex: The cost of food is on the rise.
words.ex_cn: 食品价格正在上涨。
words.en: Increasing in number, amount, or intensity.

words.ex: The paintings are on display in the museum.
words.ex_cn: 这些画在博物馆里展出。
words.en: If something is on display, it is arranged for people to look at in a public place.

words.ex: The entrance to the building is on the left.
words.ex_cn: 这座建筑的入口在左边。
words.en: An entrance is a way into a place, such as a door or gate. It can also refer to the act of entering a place or the right to enter.

words.ex: We have enough food on hand for the party.
words.ex_cn: 我们手头有足够的食物用于聚会。
words.en: Available or present; ready for use.

words.ex: He likes to indulge in chocolate after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢晚饭后吃巧克力。
words.en: To allow oneself to enjoy the pleasure of something, often something that is considered bad for you.

words.ex: Please make certain the door is closed.
words.ex_cn: 请确保门是关着的。
words.en: To make sure that something is done or happens.

words.ex: The weather is independent of my plans.
words.ex_cn: 天气与我的计划无关。
words.en: To not be influenced or controlled by something or someone.

words.ex: The building was on fire, and people were trying to escape.
words.ex_cn: 大楼着火了，人们正在试图逃离。
words.en: If something is on fire, it is burning and being damaged or destroyed by flames.

words.ex: Please inform the staff of the change in schedule.
words.ex_cn: 请通知员工日程安排的变更。
words.en: To tell someone about something, especially in an official way.

words.tr: phrase. 即使那样；即使在那时
words.ex: Even then, he didn't give up.
words.ex_cn: 即使那时候，他也没有放弃。
words.en: used to emphasize that something is the case although it might not be expected or although there are other factors that might prevent it

words.tr: phrase. 理解；辨认出；书写；进展；设法应付；亲热
words.ex: I can't make out the words in this small print.
words.ex_cn: 我看不清这些小字。
words.en: to manage to see, hear, or understand someone or something with difficulty

words.tr: phrase. 次于； 不如；在....之下
words.ex: This phone is inferior to that one.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机不如那部。
words.en: To be lower in quality, rank, or importance than someone or something else.

words.ex: Two plus two is equal to four.
words.ex_cn: 二加二等于四。
words.en: If one thing is equal to another, they are the same in size, number, standard, or value.

words.ex: He makes a living by selling vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 他靠卖蔬菜谋生。
words.en: To earn enough money to support oneself.

words.tr: phrase. 联合起来；加入；会合；参军
words.ex: They decided to join up at the train station at 9 AM.
words.ex_cn: 他们决定早上9点在火车站碰面。
words.en: To connect or link together; to become a member of a group or organization.

words.ex: He grows vegetables on a small scale in his backyard.
words.ex_cn: 他在后院小规模地种植蔬菜。
words.en: In a way that is not large in size or amount; involving few people or things.

words.ex: The book fell off the table.
words.ex_cn: 书从桌子上掉了下来。
words.en: If something falls off, it becomes detached from something to which it was attached.

words.ex: Can you join in the game?
words.ex_cn: 你能加入这个游戏吗？
words.en: If you join in an activity, you take part in it or become involved in it.

words.ex: He talks to his dog in private.
words.ex_cn: 他私下跟他的狗说话。
words.en: If you do something in private, you do it without other people being present, often because it is something that you want to keep secret.

words.ex: He knows the rules, but in practice, he forgets them.
words.ex_cn: 他知道这些规则，但在实践中却忘了。
words.en: Used to say what actually happens or is done, especially when this is different from what is expected or supposed to happen.

words.tr: phrase. 在途中；在路上；到处奔走
words.ex: She spends most of her time on the road, traveling for work.
words.ex_cn: 她大部分时间都在路上，为工作出差。
words.en: Traveling or touring, especially as part of a band or sports team.

words.ex: Your support could make the difference in the outcome of the election.
words.ex_cn: 你的支持可能会对选举结果产生重大影响。
words.en: To have a significant effect on a situation or outcome.

words.ex: You need to keep at your studies if you want to pass the exam.
words.ex_cn: 如果你想通过考试，就需要坚持学习。
words.en: If you keep at something, you continue to do it or work on it, even though it is difficult or you are making slow progress.

words.tr: phrase. 几乎；正是；大约；马上
words.ex: I have just about finished my homework.
words.ex_cn: 我差不多快写完作业了。
words.en: Almost; very nearly.

words.ex: He acted on the principle of fairness.
words.ex_cn: 他根据公平的原则行事。
words.en: Based on the principle of; according to the principle of

words.ex: He spoke on behalf of his sister.
words.ex_cn: 他代表他的妹妹发言。
words.en: If you do something on behalf of someone, you do it as their representative or in their interest.

words.ex: The soldiers marched in step with the drumbeat.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们随着鼓点同步行进。
words.en: Moving or progressing at the same rate and in the same direction as someone or something else.

words.ex: He loses his temper when he hears loud noise.
words.ex_cn: 他听到吵闹声时就会发脾气。
words.en: To lose one's temper means to suddenly become very angry.

words.ex: He ruled out the wrong answer on the test.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试中划去了错误的答案。
words.en: To decide that something is not possible or not worth considering.

words.ex: She felt that it was inappropriate for her to interfere in their personal affairs.
words.ex_cn: 她觉得干预他们的私事是不合适的。
words.en: To involve oneself in a situation where one is not wanted or needed, often causing problems or difficulties.

words.ex: In sum, he did a good job.
words.ex_cn: 总之，他做得很好。
words.en: In sum is used to introduce a summary or conclusion, indicating that what follows is a brief statement of the main points.

words.ex: The number of visitors fell by half last month.
words.ex_cn: 上个月游客数量减少了一半。
words.en: To decrease in number, amount, or value.

words.ex: The ghost is invisible to the human eye.
words.ex_cn: 这个鬼魂肉眼看不见。
words.en: If something is invisible, you cannot see it because it is hidden or because it is very difficult to see.

words.ex: He goes to school on foot.
words.ex_cn: 他步行去学校。
words.en: By walking.

words.ex: The police launched an investigation into the missing person case.
words.ex_cn: 警方对这起失踪案展开了调查。
words.en: An inquiry into or examination of a particular matter, especially a formal or official one.

words.ex: She remained faithful to her principles throughout her life.
words.ex_cn: 她一生都忠于自己的原则。
words.en: To remain loyal or constant to someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 在某种程度上，就某种程度而言
words.ex: He will help you insofar as he can.
words.ex_cn: 他能帮多少就帮多少。
words.en: to the extent or degree that

words.ex: He will hand in his homework tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天交作业。
words.en: To give something to someone in authority, especially a piece of work or a document.

words.ex: My grandmother will hand down her old watch to me.
words.ex_cn: 我的祖母会把她的旧表传给我。
words.en: To pass something from one generation to the next or to officially give a decision or judgment.

words.ex: He is friendly with his classmates.
words.ex_cn: 他和同学们相处友好。
words.en: To behave in a kind, pleasant, and approachable manner towards someone.

words.ex: Freedom from fear is a fundamental human right.
words.ex_cn: 免于恐惧的自由是一项基本人权。
words.en: The condition of being free from something undesirable or oppressive.

words.ex: The child points at the dog and laughs.
words.ex_cn: 那孩子指着狗笑。
words.en: To direct someone's attention towards something by extending one's finger or a similar object in its direction.

words.ex: The arrow points towards the door.
words.ex_cn: 箭头指向门。
words.en: To direct someone's attention towards something or to indicate a direction.

words.tr: phrase. 从…释放出来；使摆脱；免于；不受影响
words.ex: The water is free from pollution.
words.ex_cn: 这种水没有污染。
words.en: To release or liberate someone or something from a particular constraint or problem.

words.ex: Teenagers often react against rules set by parents.
words.ex_cn: 青少年经常反抗父母设定的规矩。
words.en: To act in opposition to a force, influence, or movement.

words.ex: They reach agreement on the plan.
words.ex_cn: 他们就这个计划达成了一致。
words.en: To come to a mutual understanding or arrangement.

words.ex: Needless to say, he was late again.
words.ex_cn: 不用说，他又迟到了。
words.en: used to say that something is so obvious that it does not need to be mentioned

words.ex: Please plug in the charger.
words.ex_cn: 请把充电器插上。
words.en: To connect an electrical device to a power supply by inserting a plug into a socket.

words.ex: He studied hard for the sake of his family.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习是为了家人。
words.en: If you do something for the sake of something, you do it for that purpose or in order to achieve that result.

words.ex: He can piece together the puzzle in five minutes.
words.ex_cn: 他能在五分钟内把拼图拼好。
words.en: If you piece together the truth about something, you gradually discover it by considering all the separate bits of information you have.

words.ex: He has an advantage because he speaks two languages.
words.ex_cn: 他有优势，因为他会说两种语言。
words.en: To be in a better position or situation than someone else, especially in a competition or conflict.

words.ex: For the rest, the conference was a success.
words.ex_cn: 就其余部分而言，会议是成功的。
words.en: Regarding the remaining part of a group, time, or situation.

words.ex: She often refers to her husband as 'the boss'.
words.ex_cn: 她经常把她丈夫称为“老板”。
words.en: To call or describe something or someone in a particular way.

words.ex: She often refers to her boss as 'the big cheese'.
words.ex_cn: 她经常称她的老板为“大人物”。
words.en: To call someone by a particular name or title.

words.ex: He lies on the bed every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 他每天下午都躺在床上。
words.en: To be situated or placed upon a surface or object.

words.ex: He is liable to make mistakes when he is tired.
words.ex_cn: 当他累了的时候，容易出错。
words.en: If someone or something is liable to something, they are likely to experience it or do it.

words.tr: phrase. 把…看错成；把…误解成
words.ex: He often mistakes the cat for the dog.
words.ex_cn: 他经常把猫错认成狗。
words.en: To confuse someone or something with another person or thing.

words.ex: The soldiers were ordered to lay down their arms.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们被命令放下武器。
words.en: To lay something down means to put it down, often in a careful or deliberate way. It can also mean to establish something, such as rules or guidelines.

words.ex: No fewer than 500 people attended the event.
words.ex_cn: 至少有500人参加了这个活动。
words.en: Used to emphasize that a number is not less than a particular amount.

words.tr: phrase. 躺下；接受；忍受；逃避（职责）
words.ex: He lies down after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午饭后躺下。
words.en: To recline or rest in a horizontal position.

words.tr: phrase. 仔细检查；复习；重做；转向；受欢迎
words.ex: I will go over my homework tonight.
words.ex_cn: 我今晚会复习我的家庭作业。
words.en: To examine or review something carefully; to cross over something.

words.ex: The bus will pull into the station in five minutes.
words.ex_cn: 公交车将在五分钟后进站。
words.en: To arrive at a particular place, especially a station or harbor, by moving towards it.

words.ex: We get together every weekend to play basketball.
words.ex_cn: 我们每周末聚在一起打篮球。
words.en: If people get together, they meet in order to spend time with each other.

words.tr: phrase. 拔出；驶离路边；退出
words.ex: He pulled out a coin from his pocket.
words.ex_cn: 他从口袋里掏出了一枚硬币。
words.en: To remove something or someone from a place or situation.

words.ex: The bus pulls in at the station every ten minutes.
words.ex_cn: 公交车每十分钟进站一次。
words.en: To attract or earn money; to arrest someone; (of a vehicle) to move into a particular place or to stop at a station.

words.ex: The milk will go bad if you leave it out of the fridge.
words.ex_cn: 如果你把牛奶放在冰箱外面，它会变质的。
words.en: If food goes bad, it is no longer fresh or good to eat.

words.ex: He will lead the way to the park.
words.ex_cn: 他将带路去公园。
words.en: To go first in order to show others how to follow; to be a pioneer or innovator in a particular field.

words.ex: Please let in the cat when it starts to rain.
words.ex_cn: 当下雨时，请让猫进来。
words.en: To allow someone or something to enter a place.

words.ex: He was put through a tough training program.
words.ex_cn: 他经受了一项严格的训练计划。
words.en: To cause someone to experience something, especially something difficult or unpleasant, or to connect a telephone call.

words.ex: Can you move over? I need more space.
words.ex_cn: 你能挪一下吗？我需要更多空间。
words.en: To change position or place, especially so that someone else can have your previous position.

words.tr: phrase. 赠送；分发；背叛；泄露
words.ex: He will give away his old books to the library.
words.ex_cn: 他将把他的旧书捐给图书馆。
words.en: To give something to someone without asking for payment, or to reveal something secret or private.

words.ex: This method can lend itself to better results.
words.ex_cn: 这种方法可能带来更好的结果。
words.en: If something lends itself to a particular activity or result, it is easy for it to be used for that activity or to achieve that result.

words.tr: phrase. 分发；发出；发表；用尽
words.ex: He gives out books to the students.
words.ex_cn: 他把书分发给学生们。
words.en: To distribute or hand out something; to emit or produce something such as a sound or smell; to announce or make something known publicly.

words.ex: The boy got punishment for breaking the window.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩因为打碎了窗户而受到了处罚。
words.en: Punishment is the act of punishing someone or the state of being punished.

words.tr: phrase. 穿戴；上演；增加（体重）
words.ex: He puts on his coat before going out.
words.ex_cn: 他出门前穿上外套。
words.en: To put on something means to dress oneself in it, or to start wearing it. It can also mean to produce a play, show, or other performance. Additionally, it can refer to gaining weight or to pretend to have a particular feeling or quality.

words.tr: phrase. 领会；贿赂；查明；够到
words.ex: I don't know what you are getting at.
words.ex_cn: 我不明白你到底想表达什么。
words.en: If you ask someone what they are getting at, you are asking them to explain what they mean, usually because you think they are being unpleasant or are suggesting something that is untrue.

words.ex: Many people profit from selling things online.
words.ex_cn: 许多人通过在网上卖东西获利。
words.en: To gain an advantage or benefit from something.

words.ex: The firework went off at midnight.
words.ex_cn: 烟花在午夜爆炸了。
words.en: If a device or alarm goes off, it starts to ring loudly or make a loud noise. To leave a place, especially in order to do something. To happen in a particular way. To stop liking someone or something. To explode or fire. To decay or become rotten.

words.ex: Quite a few students passed the test.
words.ex_cn: 相当多的学生通过了考试。
words.en: You use quite a few to emphasize that you are referring to a considerable number of things or people.

words.ex: The movie will go on for two hours.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影将持续两个小时。
words.en: To continue for a particular period of time.

words.ex: His ideas are near to mine, but not exactly the same.
words.ex_cn: 他的想法接近于我的，但并不完全相同。
words.en: To be close to something or someone in distance.

words.ex: The school prohibits students from using phones in class.
words.ex_cn: 学校禁止学生在课堂上使用手机。
words.en: If a law or someone in authority prohibits something, they forbid it or make it illegal.

words.ex: Time goes by quickly when you are happy.
words.ex_cn: 当你开心时，时间过得很快。
words.en: If you say that time goes by, you mean that it passes.

words.ex: He learned English and put it to use in his job.
words.ex_cn: 他学了英语，并在工作中加以运用。
words.en: To use something for a particular purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 重新开始；继续；回去；（事后）答复
words.ex: After lunch, we will get back to work.
words.ex_cn: 午饭后，我们将重新开始工作。
words.en: To return to a place, state, or activity.

words.tr: phrase. 开始工作；开始运转；生效
words.ex: The new factory will go into operation next month.
words.ex_cn: 新工厂将于下个月开始运营。
words.en: If a system, rule, or plan goes into operation, it starts to be used or to start working.

words.ex: The wind scattered the leaves in all directions.
words.ex_cn: adv. 风把树叶吹得四散。
words.en: In every direction; everywhere around.

words.ex: I keep track of my expenses every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天记录我的开支。
words.en: To keep track of something means to stay informed about it or to record it, especially in order to notice any changes or developments.

words.ex: He is lazy, in a word.
words.ex_cn: 总之，他很懒。
words.en: used to give a summary or to introduce a conclusion

words.ex: She looks after her little brother every day.
words.ex_cn: 她每天照顾她的弟弟。
words.en: To take care of someone or something.

words.ex: The crowd made way for the ambulance.
words.ex_cn: 人群为救护车让路。
words.en: To move aside or to allow someone or something to pass by.

words.ex: Her approach to problem-solving is quite other from her colleagues.
words.ex_cn: 她在解决问题的方法上与同事们截然不同。
words.en: Different from; not the same as.

words.ex: He tries to keep up with his classmates.
words.ex_cn: 他努力跟上他的同学。
words.en: To continue to do something; to maintain something at a high level; to stay level or equal with someone or something.

words.tr:
n. 请求；要求的事；
v. 要求；请求；
words.ex: He made a request for help.
words.ex_cn: 他提出了一个帮助的请求。
words.en: If you request something, you ask for it politely or formally.

words.ex: He is ignorant of the rules.
words.ex_cn: 他不知道这些规则。
words.en: If you are ignorant of something, you do not know about it.

words.ex: She was impatient for the results of the test.
words.ex_cn: 她迫不及待地想知道测试的结果。
words.en: To be eager or anxious for something to happen or be done.

words.ex: She has been longing for a vacation for months.
words.ex_cn: 她已经盼望了几个月的假期。
words.en: To have a strong desire or wish for something.

words.ex: The government tried to impose new taxes on the citizens.
words.ex_cn: 政府试图向公民征收新税。
words.en: To force someone to accept something, especially a belief or way of living, or to place a tax or burden on someone.

words.ex: Can I help you in any way?
words.ex_cn: 我能在任何方面帮助你吗？
words.en: used to emphasize that something is true or possible in any manner or method

words.ex: He keeps to his schedule every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都遵守自己的日程。
words.en: To continue to do something or to stay in a particular state or condition.

words.ex: Her views are completely opposite to mine.
words.ex_cn: 她的观点与我的完全相反。
words.en: To be completely different from something else in nature or direction.

words.ex: He runs fast, in comparison with his brother.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得很快，与他哥哥相比。
words.en: Used to say that something is being considered in relation to something else, especially to show how they are different or similar.

words.ex: The money I have is not nearly enough to buy the house.
words.ex_cn: 我手头的钱远远不够买这栋房子。
words.en: Used to emphasize that something is much less than what is expected or needed.

words.ex: I don't mind helping, only that I'm busy now.
words.ex_cn: 我不介意帮忙，只是我现在很忙。
words.en: Used to emphasize that something is the only thing that matters or is true.

words.tr: phrase. 调查；研究；观察；检查
words.ex: The police will look into the accident.
words.ex_cn: 警察将调查这起事故。
words.en: If you look into a problem or matter, you investigate it or examine it.

words.ex: I will look in on my grandma after work.
words.ex_cn: 我下班后会去看望我奶奶。
words.en: To make a brief visit or inspection.

words.ex: He looks down on people who work hard.
words.ex_cn: 他瞧不起努力工作的人。
words.en: To regard someone or something as inferior or unworthy of respect.

words.ex: The research was conducted in association with a local university.
words.ex_cn: 这项研究是与当地一所大学联合进行的。
words.en: In partnership or conjunction with someone or something.

words.tr:
n. 方面；尊重；尊敬；
v. 遵从；尊重；尊敬；
words.ex: In this respect, the plan is good.
words.ex_cn: 在这个方面，这个计划很好。
words.en: If you respect someone, you have a good opinion of their character or ideas.

words.tr: phrase. 更确切地说；倒不如说
words.ex: He is not lazy, or rather, he is efficient in his own way.
words.ex_cn: 他并不懒，或者更准确地说，他有自己的高效方式。
words.en: used to correct or modify what has just been said, or to say it more accurately

words.tr: phrase. 假使；如果；万一；以防
words.ex: Keep a flashlight in case of power outage.
words.ex_cn: 以防停电，准备一个手电筒。
words.en: used to describe what should be done if a particular situation, especially a bad one, occurs

words.ex: I look forward to the weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我期待着周末。
words.en: If you look forward to something that is going to happen, you want it to happen because you think you will enjoy it.

words.ex: Hurry up, or else you'll miss the bus.
words.ex_cn: 快点，否则你会错过公交车。
words.en: Used to introduce the alternative that is likely or certain to happen if something does not happen or is not done.

words.tr: n. 加价；毛利；涨价幅度
words.ex: The store adds a 20% markup to the cost of goods.
words.ex_cn: 商店在商品成本上加了20%的利润。
words.en: The amount added to the cost price of goods to cover overhead and profit.

words.ex: The two cars collided head on.
words.ex_cn: 两辆车迎面相撞。
words.en: In a direct and often confrontational manner.

words.ex: This problem has to do with counting money.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题与数钱有关。
words.en: to be connected or associated with something

words.ex: I haven't heard from my friend for a week.
words.ex_cn: 我一周没有收到我朋友的消息了。
words.en: to receive communication from someone

words.ex: Please pay attention to the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 请专心听老师讲课。
words.en: To focus one's mind or efforts on something or someone, especially in order to understand or learn.

words.ex: I will love you forever.
words.ex_cn: 我会永远爱你。
words.en: If you say that something will happen or continue forever, you mean that it will always happen or continue.

words.ex: He calls her Lily for short.
words.ex_cn: 他简短地叫她莉莉。
words.en: used to indicate that a shorter form of a name or word is being used

words.ex: Sometimes things happen for the best.
words.ex_cn: 有时候事情发生是为了达到最好的结果。
words.en: Used to say that something, although perhaps unpleasant, will have the best possible outcome in the end.

words.ex: The situation is changing for the better.
words.ex_cn: 情况正在好转。
words.en: If something changes for the better, it improves.

words.ex: I met with an old friend at the supermarket.
words.ex_cn: 我在超市偶遇了一位老朋友。
words.en: to experience or encounter something, especially something that is unexpected or unpleasant; to have a meeting with someone.

words.ex: Her curiosity knows no bounds.
words.ex_cn: 她的好奇心无限。
words.en: If you say that something knows no bounds, you are emphasizing that it is not limited in any way.

words.ex: She decided to line the box with velvet to make it more luxurious.
words.ex_cn: 她决定用天鹅绒衬里来装饰盒子，使其更显奢华。
words.en: To cover the inner surface of something with a layer of a different material.

words.tr: phrase. 在某方面帮助某人
words.ex: I help my brother with his math homework.
words.ex_cn: 我帮我的弟弟做数学作业。
words.en: To assist someone in doing something.

words.ex: He tries to keep up with his classmates.
words.ex_cn: 他努力跟上他的同学。
words.en: To keep up with something means to manage to do or have as much of it as is necessary or desirable, or to move at the same speed as someone or something else.

words.ex: If only I had more time, I would finish my homework.
words.ex_cn: 要是我有更多时间，我就能完成作业了。
words.en: used to express a wish that something had happened differently or that something would happen

words.tr: phrase. 紧紧抓住；坚持；保持
words.ex: Please hold on to the handrail when the bus starts.
words.ex_cn: 当公共汽车启动时，请抓紧扶手。
words.en: To hold on to something means to keep it in your possession or to not let it go, often because it is valuable or important to you.

words.tr: phrase. 抓紧不放；继续；不挂断；坚持
words.ex: Hold on the rope tightly!
words.ex_cn: 紧紧抓住绳子！
words.en: To continue to do something or to wait for a short time.

words.ex: She has a passion for classical music.
words.ex_cn: 她对古典音乐有着极大的热爱。
words.en: A very strong feeling of liking or loving something or someone.

words.ex: She was happy with her marriage to John.
words.ex_cn: 她对与约翰的婚姻感到幸福。
words.en: The state of being united to a person of the opposite sex as husband or wife in a consensual and contractual relationship recognized by law.

words.ex: He will flesh out the plan with more details tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会用更多细节充实这个计划。
words.en: To flesh out something means to add more details to it in order to make it more complete or more substantial.

words.tr: phrase. 用钩钩住；和…有联系；安装
words.ex: They decided to hook up the printer to the computer.
words.ex_cn: 他们决定把打印机连接到电脑上。
words.en: To connect or link something to a power supply, a network, or another device; to form a relationship or partnership with someone, especially in a casual or non-serious way.

words.ex: He holds to his promise no matter what.
words.ex_cn: 无论发生什么，他都会遵守自己的承诺。
words.en: To continue to believe in or adhere to an idea, principle, or plan, despite difficulties or opposition.

words.tr:
n. 避难所；庇护所；
v. 庇护；遮蔽；
words.ex: The refugees found shelter in a small building.
words.ex_cn: 难民们在一个小建筑里找到了避难所。
words.en: A shelter is a small building or covered place which is made to protect people from bad weather or danger.

words.ex: The movie comes to an end at nine o'clock.
words.ex_cn: 电影在九点结束。
words.en: To reach a point where something stops or finishes.

words.ex: He is certain of his answer.
words.ex_cn: 他确信自己的答案。
words.en: To be sure or confident about something.

words.ex: The paper caught fire quickly.
words.ex_cn: 纸很快着火了。
words.en: To begin to burn; to ignite.

words.ex: This painting is remarkable for its bright colors.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画因其鲜艳的色彩而引人注目。
words.en: To be notable or famous for a particular quality or feature.

words.ex: He keeps his knowledge up to date.
words.ex_cn: 他让自己的知识保持最新。
words.en: If something is up to date, it is the newest thing of its kind.

words.ex: They define success as hard work and patience.
words.ex_cn: 他们把成功定义为努力工作和耐心。
words.en: To describe the essential nature or meaning of something.

words.ex: They define him as a genius.
words.ex_cn: 他们把他定义为天才。
words.en: To describe the nature or basic qualities of someone.

words.ex: His ambition is to become a president.
words.ex_cn: 他的野心是成为总统。
words.en: An ambition is a strong desire to achieve something, typically requiring determination and hard work.

words.tr: phrase. 赶上；逮捕并处罚；（麻烦事）缠上
words.ex: He needs to catch up with his classmates.
words.ex_cn: 他需要赶上他的同学。
words.en: To reach the same standard or level as someone or something else, especially after a period of lagging behind.

words.ex: He passed the test by virtue of his hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他凭借努力学习通过了考试。
words.en: Because of or as a result of something.

words.ex: Please be seated before the class starts.
words.ex_cn: 请在上课前坐好。
words.en: To take a seat; to sit down.

words.ex: The temperature decreased by 5 degrees last night.
words.ex_cn: 昨晚温度降低了5度。
words.en: To reduce something by a certain amount or percentage.

words.ex: He shifted the book from the table to the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 他把书从桌子移到了架子上。
words.en: To move or transfer something from one place, position, or focus to another.

words.tr: phrase. 就…而言；到…程度；只要
words.ex: So far as I know, he is still at work.
words.ex_cn: 据我所知，他还在工作。
words.en: to the extent that; with regard to

words.tr: phrase. 迅速成长；迅速上升；猛增
words.ex: The prices shoot up during the holiday season.
words.ex_cn: 假期期间，价格迅速上涨。
words.en: To increase rapidly in size, amount, or intensity; to inject a drug.

words.tr: phrase. 一般的；普遍；未被捕；详尽
words.ex: The issue is important at large.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题在一般情况下很重要。
words.en: If someone dangerous is at large, they are not in prison or have not been caught. It also means discussing something in a general way without considering details.

words.ex: Scientists are looking for a cure for the common cold.
words.ex_cn: 科学家们正在寻找治疗普通感冒的方法。
words.en: A substance or treatment that eliminates a disease or condition.

words.ex: He string out the clothes on the line to dry.
words.ex_cn: 他把衣服成行地展开在绳子上晾干。
words.en: To extend or prolong something, typically a discussion or event, over a longer period of time than originally intended.

words.tr: phrase. 插嘴；打断；超车抢档
words.ex: He cut in while I was talking.
words.ex_cn: 我正在说话时，他插嘴了。
words.en: To interrupt someone who is speaking, or to move into a line of traffic by driving in front of someone else.

words.ex: He shoots at the target with a toy gun.
words.ex_cn: 他用玩具枪射击目标。
words.en: To discharge a projectile or projectiles at someone or something.

words.ex: The new plan tie in with our goals.
words.ex_cn: 新计划与我们的目标一致。
words.en: To be connected or related to something in a way that is necessary or logical.

words.ex: I catch a glimpse of the bird in the tree.
words.ex_cn: 我瞥见了树上的鸟。
words.en: To see someone or something for a very short time.

words.ex: The kids shoot out water from their toy guns.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们用玩具枪喷出水。
words.en: To move suddenly and quickly in a particular direction.

words.tr:
v. 回答；回应；
n. 回答；答案；
words.ex: He answered the question quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快回答了问题。
words.en: An answer is something that you say or write when you reply to a question or remark.

words.tr: phrase. 以...为中心；集中于...；围绕
words.ex: The discussion will center around one main idea.
words.ex_cn: 讨论将围绕一个主要观点展开。
words.en: To have something as the main subject of attention or interest.

words.ex: He works by night and sleeps by day.
words.ex_cn: 他晚上工作，白天睡觉。
words.en: During the night; at night.

words.tr: phrase. 过来；顺便来访；改变立场；突然感觉；显得
words.ex: Come over to my house after school.
words.ex_cn: 放学后到我家来。
words.en: To move or travel towards someone or something, especially in order to visit them.

words.ex: Be cautious about crossing the street without looking.
words.ex_cn: 过马路时不要不看就横穿。
words.en: To be careful or wary about something, often because it might be dangerous or risky.

words.tr: phrase. 制定；（使）放下；（叫…）下车；记下
words.ex: The government set down new rules for safety.
words.ex_cn: 政府制定了新的安全规则。
words.en: To place something on a surface or to write or record something officially.

words.ex: This book is useful to students.
words.ex_cn: 这本书对学生有帮助。
words.en: If something is useful to someone, it helps them in some way.

words.tr: phrase. 别的东西；另一回事
words.ex: He solved the problem using something else.
words.ex_cn: 他用别的方法解决了这个问题。
words.en: used to refer to a different or additional thing or person

words.ex: Everyone passed the test, with the exception of Tom.
words.ex_cn: 除了汤姆，所有人都通过了考试。
words.en: You use 'with the exception of' to introduce a thing or person that is not included in a general statement that you are making.

words.ex: He threw away the old book.
words.ex_cn: 他扔掉了那本旧书。
words.en: To dispose of something that is no longer useful or wanted; to waste an opportunity or advantage.

words.ex: He is talking all the time.
words.ex_cn: 他一直在说话。
words.en: If something happens or is done all the time, it happens or is done continually or repeatedly.

words.ex: He threw off his coat and started working.
words.ex_cn: 他脱下外套，开始工作。
words.en: To get rid of something or someone that is bothering you or that you do not want.

words.tr: phrase. 渐渐消失；平息；变弱
words.ex: The wind will die down in the evening.
words.ex_cn: 风在晚上会逐渐减弱。
words.en: If something dies down, it becomes much less noticeable or active.

words.tr: phrase. 到达；显现；实现；成功地完成；（健康）恢复；渡过
words.ex: The package will come through tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 包裹明天会到达。
words.en: To successfully deal with a difficult situation or to do what is needed or expected.

words.ex: The storm deprived him of his power.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴使他失去了电力。
words.en: To take something away from someone; to prevent someone from having something.

words.ex: He decided to take a chance and apply for the job.
words.ex_cn: 他决定冒险申请这份工作。
words.en: To do something that involves risk or uncertainty, often with the hope of success.

words.ex: The sound of the bell died away slowly.
words.ex_cn: 铃声渐渐消失了。
words.en: If a sound dies away, it gradually becomes weaker or quieter and then stops completely.

words.tr: phrase. 出发；动身；使爆炸；引起
words.ex: He set off early to avoid traffic.
words.ex_cn: 他早早出发以避开交通拥堵。
words.en: To begin a journey or to cause something to start or happen.

words.ex: He left the room by request.
words.ex_cn: 他应要求离开了房间。
words.en: If something is done by request, it is done because someone has asked for it to be done.

words.ex: He is thick with his best friend every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都和他最好的朋友形影不离。
words.en: To be filled with a large amount of something; to have a close relationship with someone.

words.ex: The old tree won't die hard; it's still green after the fire.
words.ex_cn: 这棵老树难断气；火灾后它依然翠绿。
words.en: To persist stubbornly despite opposition or difficulty.

words.tr: phrase. 扔掉；不受理；赶走；开除
words.ex: He decided to throw out the old furniture.
words.ex_cn: 他决定丢弃旧家具。
words.en: To throw something out means to get rid of it because you no longer want or need it.

words.ex: The dog set on the intruder.
words.ex_cn: 狗攻击了入侵者。
words.en: To cause someone or something to attack or confront someone or something else.

words.ex: Happiness consists in simple moments.
words.ex_cn: 幸福在于简单的时刻。
words.en: If you say that something consists in a particular thing, you mean that the thing mentioned is the main or essential feature of it.

words.tr: adj. 恒定的；不变的；持续的；
words.ex: The temperature is constant in this room.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间的温度是恒定的。
words.en: Something that is constant happens all the time or is always there.

words.ex: The dog can smell out the hidden food.
words.ex_cn: 这只狗能闻出藏起来的食物。
words.en: To detect or perceive something by the sense of smell.

words.ex: I cannot help laughing when I see that cat.
words.ex_cn: 当我看到那只猫时，我忍不住笑。
words.en: If you say that you cannot help doing something, you mean that you cannot stop yourself from doing it.

words.ex: Her dream will come true next year.
words.ex_cn: 她的梦想明年将会实现。
words.en: If a dream, hope, or prediction comes true, it actually happens.

words.ex: The doctor will transfer him to the hospital.
words.ex_cn: 医生会把他转到医院。
words.en: to move someone from one place, job, or position to another

words.tr: phrase. 与…通信； 与…相一致
words.ex: I correspond with my friend by email every week.
words.ex_cn: 我每周通过电子邮件和朋友通信。
words.en: If one thing corresponds with another, there is a close similarity or connection between them.

words.ex: He suffers from a bad cold.
words.ex_cn: 他患了重感冒。
words.en: If you suffer from an illness or from a medical condition, you are badly affected by it.

words.ex: I cannot help but smile when I see my dog.
words.ex_cn: 当我看到我的狗时，我忍不住微笑。
words.en: If you say that you cannot help doing something, you mean that you cannot prevent yourself from doing it.

words.ex: He can run at the best 10 kilometers per hour.
words.ex_cn: 他最快每小时只能跑10公里。
words.en: Under the most favorable circumstances; at most.

words.ex: He will comment on the game after it ends.
words.ex_cn: 比赛结束后，他会对此发表评论。
words.en: To express an opinion or reaction about something.

words.ex: I want a book of my friend.
words.ex_cn: 我想要我朋友的一本书。
words.en: To require or expect something from someone.

words.ex: We can carry over the unused vacation days to next year.
words.ex_cn: 我们可以把未用完的假期天数延到明年。
words.en: To transfer or extend something from one time or place to another.

words.ex: His words touched off a big argument.
words.ex_cn: 他的话引发了激烈的争论。
words.en: To cause something to happen, especially something involving strong feelings or actions.

words.tr: phrase. 走进；走路时撞上；不意落入
words.ex: He walk into the room and say hello.
words.ex_cn: 他走进房间并打了声招呼。
words.en: To enter a place by walking, often used to describe entering a room, building, or area in a casual or unintentional manner.

words.ex: The country declared a war against terrorism.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家宣布对恐怖主义开战。
words.en: A conflict or struggle aimed at opposing or eliminating something considered harmful or undesirable.

words.tr: phrase. 热身；变暖；使活跃起来
words.ex: He warms up before running.
words.ex_cn: 他在跑步前热身。
words.en: To prepare for physical exertion or a performance by exercising or practicing gently beforehand.

words.tr: phrase. 突然产生；要求；成为...负担；偶遇
words.ex: A good idea came upon her while she was walking.
words.ex_cn: 她在散步时突然产生了一个好主意。
words.en: To meet or find someone or something by chance; to suddenly have a thought or feeling.

words.tr:
n. 指挥；命令；
v. 掌握；
words.ex: The general has command of the army.
words.ex_cn: 将军指挥着军队。
words.en: If someone in authority commands you to do something, they tell you that you must do it.

words.tr: phrase. 迄今为止；到那时为止
words.ex: He has not finished his homework as yet.
words.ex_cn: 他还没有完成作业。
words.en: Up to the present time; until now.

words.tr: phrase. 到顶点；到最大限度
words.ex: He ran to the limit and fell down.
words.ex_cn: 他跑到了极限，然后倒下了。
words.en: To the limit means to the maximum extent possible or as far as something can go.

words.tr: phrase. 服侍；招待；焦急地等待
words.ex: The waitress waits on customers at dinner.
words.ex_cn: 女服务员在晚餐时服侍顾客。
words.en: To serve food and drink, especially to customers in a restaurant or at a table; to wait for something to happen or for someone to arrive.

words.tr: phrase. 对…持批评态度的；对…苛求的
words.ex: He is critical of the new school rules.
words.ex_cn: 他批评新的校规。
words.en: To express disapproval of someone or something based on perceived faults or mistakes.

words.tr: phrase. 拜访；要求；呼吁；号召
words.ex: I will call upon my grandmother this weekend.
words.ex_cn: 这个周末我会去拜访我的祖母。
words.en: To call upon someone is to ask them to do something or to use something that they can offer.

words.tr: phrase. 拜访；要求；呼吁；号召
words.ex: I will call on my grandma this weekend.
words.ex_cn: 这个周末我将去拜访我的奶奶。
words.en: To visit someone; to formally ask or request someone to do something.

words.ex: He said it was easy, but to the contrary, it was very hard.
words.ex_cn: 他说这很容易，但恰恰相反，它非常难。
words.en: If you say 'to the contrary', you are indicating that the opposite of what has been said is true.

words.ex: This rule is applicable to all students.
words.ex_cn: 这条规则适用于所有学生。
words.en: To be relevant or appropriate to a particular situation or case.

words.ex: He must be clear about his goals.
words.ex_cn: 他必须清楚自己的目标。
words.en: To have a good understanding or knowledge of something.

words.ex: The court stripped him of his license.
words.ex_cn: 法院撤销了他的执照。
words.en: To remove something from someone, especially as a punishment or because they are not considered worthy of it.

words.tr: phrase. 一直；随时；每时每刻
words.ex: He wears a helmet at all times when riding a bike.
words.ex_cn: 他骑自行车时一直戴着头盔。
words.en: If something happens or is done at all times, it happens or is done all the time or always.

words.tr: adj. 适当的；合适的；恰当的；
words.ex: This dress is appropriate for a wedding.
words.ex_cn: 这条裙子适合参加婚礼。
words.en: Something that is appropriate is suitable or acceptable for a particular situation.

words.ex: The teacher singled out one student for praise.
words.ex_cn: 老师挑出一名学生进行表扬。
words.en: To choose someone or something from a group for special attention or treatment.

words.ex: I can count on my brother to help me.
words.ex_cn: 我可以依靠我哥哥帮我。
words.en: If you count on someone or something, you rely on them to support you or help you.

words.ex: My parents approve of my new job.
words.ex_cn: 我父母赞成我的新工作。
words.en: To have a favorable opinion of someone or something; to agree with or support a decision, action, or suggestion.

words.ex: He can translate words into pictures.
words.ex_cn: 他能把词语转化为图画。
words.en: To translate means to change written or spoken words from one language into another, or to explain something in a way that is easier to understand.

words.ex: This shirt is suitable for the party.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫适合这场派对。
words.en: Something that is suitable for a particular person or thing is right or acceptable for them.

words.ex: It took time for the news to sink in.
words.ex_cn: 这则消息花了点时间才让他明白。
words.en: If a fact or idea sinks in, you gradually start to believe it, understand it, or realize the effect it will have on you.

words.ex: He uses a cloth to cover over the dirty table.
words.ex_cn: 他用一块布盖住脏桌子。
words.en: To conceal or hide something.

words.ex: He tried to cover up his mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他试图掩盖自己的错误。
words.en: To conceal something, especially a mistake or a crime, by hiding it or by pretending that it does not exist.

words.ex: He signs in to his account every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上登录他的账户。
words.en: To sign in means to record your arrival at a workplace, hotel, etc., by writing your name on a list or by entering your name and password into a computer.

words.tr: phrase. 困惑；不知所措；亏本地
words.ex: He was at a loss when the teacher asked him a question.
words.ex_cn: 当老师问他问题时，他不知所措。
words.en: If you say that you are at a loss, you mean that you do not know what to do in a particular situation.

words.tr: phrase. 签约受雇；签约雇佣；开始广播
words.ex: He signs on to the new job next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周正式加入新工作。
words.en: To agree to become an employee; to start broadcasting.

words.ex: The price is $50, couple with free shipping.
words.ex_cn: 价格是50美元，再加上免费送货。
words.en: To combine or link something with something else, especially in a way that enhances or complements it.

words.tr: phrase. 有点像；大约；了不起的
words.ex: He bought something like a new phone.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一部类似新手机的东西。
words.en: Used to indicate that what you are mentioning is an example or approximation of the thing you mean.

words.ex: His absence from school was due to illness.
words.ex_cn: 他因病没来学校。
words.en: The state of being away from a place where one is expected to be.

words.ex: The fire is under control.
words.ex_cn: 火势得到了控制。
words.en: If a situation or a person is under control, they are being dealt with successfully and there is no danger of them becoming unmanageable.

words.tr: phrase. 拿掉；离开；起飞；脱下；突然成功
words.ex: Please take off your hat before entering.
words.ex_cn: 进入前请把帽子拿掉。
words.en: If an aircraft, bird, or insect takes off, it leaves the ground and begins to fly.

words.tr: phrase. 撕下；匆匆完成；跑掉
words.ex: He tore off the label from the bottle.
words.ex_cn: 他把瓶子上的标签撕掉了。
words.en: To remove something by pulling it roughly or violently.

words.ex: He was absent from school yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天没去上学。
words.en: If someone is absent from a place where they are usually found or where they are expected to be, they are not there.

words.tr: phrase. 开进...；在...上行驶（开车）
words.ex: They drive in to the city every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天早上开车进城。
words.en: To operate and control the direction and speed of a motor vehicle to enter a place.

words.tr: phrase. 大约；大概；是个…问题
words.ex: It is a matter of time before he arrives.
words.ex_cn: 他到达只是时间问题。
words.en: used to refer to a situation or subject that is being discussed or considered

words.ex: They go to the game to cheer on their team.
words.ex_cn: 他们去比赛为他们的队伍加油。
words.en: To encourage someone or a team to do their best, especially by shouting and showing support.

words.tr: phrase. 在附近；在...身边；围绕
words.ex: My brother is around after school.
words.ex_cn: 我哥哥放学后在家。
words.en: If someone or something is around, they are present in a place or situation.

words.ex: He tore down the poster from the wall.
words.ex_cn: 他把海报从墙上扯了下来。
words.en: To tear down something means to destroy or remove it completely, especially a building or other structure.

words.ex: He has an acquaintance with basic math.
words.ex_cn: 他熟悉基础数学。
words.en: Knowledge of or familiarity with someone or something.

words.ex: He acted on the advice and got better.
words.ex_cn: 他按照建议做了，结果好多了。
words.en: To do something as a result of information or advice received.

words.tr: phrase. 大声喊；突发；闯出来
words.ex: He burst out laughing when he heard the joke.
words.ex_cn: 他听到这个笑话时突然大笑起来。
words.en: If you burst out doing something, you suddenly start doing it or saying it.

words.tr: phrase. 粘在一起；团结一致；互相支持
words.ex: The siblings stick together when they face problems.
words.ex_cn: 当兄弟姐妹遇到问题时，他们团结在一起。
words.en: If people stick together, they support and help each other.

words.ex: He will come forward to tell the truth.
words.ex_cn: 他将站出来说出真相。
words.en: If someone comes forward, they offer to do something or to give some information in response to a request for help.

words.tr: phrase. 全神贯注于...；专心于...
words.ex: He is absorbed in his book.
words.ex_cn: 他全神贯注于他的书。
words.en: If someone is absorbed in something, they are very interested in it and it takes up all their attention.

words.ex: The land is under cultivation.
words.ex_cn: 这块土地正在耕种中。
words.en: Land that is under cultivation is being used for growing crops.

words.ex: Eating vegetables is beneficial to your health.
words.ex_cn: 吃蔬菜对你的健康有益。
words.en: To be beneficial to something means to have a good effect or influence on it.

words.ex: The sauce will boil down if you cook it longer.
words.ex_cn: 如果你多煮一会儿，酱汁会变浓稠。
words.en: If you say that a situation or problem boils down to a particular thing or can be boiled down to a particular thing, you mean that this is the most important or the most basic aspect of it.

words.ex: He solved the math problem step by step.
words.ex_cn: 他一步一步地解出了这道数学题。
words.en: Proceeding gradually from one stage to the next.

words.ex: Traffic is very heavy during rush hours.
words.ex_cn: 在高峰时段交通非常拥堵。
words.en: The times at the beginning and end of the working day when many people are traveling to or from work.

words.ex: He rushed out to buy bread.
words.ex_cn: 他冲出去买面包了。
words.en: To leave or do something very quickly.

words.tr: phrase. 支持；遵守；袖手旁观；准备行动
words.ex: I will stand by you when you face difficulties.
words.ex_cn: 当你遇到困难时，我会支持你。
words.en: To be ready to support or act if needed; to wait in a state of readiness.

words.ex: The box is empty of toys.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子里没有玩具。
words.en: Lacking or devoid of something.

words.tr: phrase. 全神贯注于；专心于
words.ex: He is absorbed in reading a book.
words.ex_cn: 他正专心致志地读书。
words.en: To be so interested in something that you do not notice anything else.

words.ex: I don't eat sweets any more.
words.ex_cn: 我不再吃甜食了。
words.en: used to say that something is not happening now or is not true now, although it happened or was true before

words.tr: phrase. 突然出现；重新露面；调大
words.ex: He didn't turn up to the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他没有出席会议。
words.en: To arrive or appear somewhere, often unexpectedly; to increase the volume or intensity of something.

words.ex: He stays up late to watch movies.
words.ex_cn: 他熬夜看电影。
words.en: To remain awake and not go to bed.

words.ex: Please take the weather into account when you plan the trip.
words.ex_cn: 计划旅行时请考虑天气因素。
words.en: To consider something when making a decision or judgment.

words.tr: phrase. 偶遇；偶然发现；使产生…印象
words.ex: I came across an old photo while cleaning my room.
words.ex_cn: 我在打扫房间时发现了一张旧照片。
words.en: If you come across something or someone, you find them or meet them by chance.

words.tr: phrase. 吹掉；放出；取消约会
words.ex: The wind blew off the hat.
words.ex_cn: 风吹掉了帽子。
words.en: To blow off something means to ignore it or not do it, especially something that you are supposed to do.

words.ex: He decided to drop out of the competition.
words.ex_cn: 他决定不参加比赛。
words.en: If someone drops out of a school or a course, they leave it before they have finished it.

words.ex: He will come after you if you take his toy.
words.ex_cn: 如果你拿走他的玩具，他会来找你。
words.en: To follow someone or something in order or sequence.

words.ex: He has a taste of chocolate cake every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每个星期天都会吃一点巧克力蛋糕。
words.en: To experience or sample something, especially food or drink.

words.tr: phrase. 擦掉灰尘；打扫；从...上除灰尘
words.ex: He dusts off his shoes before entering the house.
words.ex_cn: 他进屋前把鞋子上的灰尘掸掉。
words.en: To remove dust from something; to bring something out of storage or disuse and prepare it for use again.

words.ex: He eats an apple every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃一个苹果。
words.en: To consume food, typically as a regular part of one's diet.

words.tr: phrase. 大不相同； 悬殊
words.ex: This new phone is a far cry from the old one.
words.ex_cn: 这部新手机和旧的完全不同。
words.en: If you say that one thing is a far cry from another, you are emphasizing that the first thing is very different from the second.

words.tr: phrase. 使充气；爆炸；发怒；夸大
words.ex: He blew up the balloon with his mouth.
words.ex_cn: 他用嘴把气球吹鼓了。
