words.en: If someone blows something up or if it blows up, it is destroyed by an explosion.

words.tr: phrase. 吹灭；爆裂；突然冒出
words.ex: He will blow out the candle on his birthday cake.
words.ex_cn: 他会在生日蛋糕上吹灭蜡烛。
words.en: To extinguish something by blowing, or to burst suddenly.

words.ex: I saved all my money save for one dollar.
words.ex_cn: 我把所有的钱都存起来了，除了一美元。
words.en: If you say that something is true save for a particular thing, you mean that it is true except for that thing.

words.ex: He comes home after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后回家。
words.en: To return to one's home.

words.ex: The crowd shouted 'down with corruption!'
words.ex_cn: 人群高喊‘打倒腐败！’
words.en: Used to express a wish or a call for the overthrow or end of something or someone.

words.ex: He seeks out new friends at school.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校里主动结交新朋友。
words.en: To seek out means to look for and find someone or something, especially when this is difficult or takes a lot of effort.

words.ex: He does well in math class.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学课上表现很好。
words.en: To perform well or successfully in a particular activity or task.

words.ex: The police charged him with stealing.
words.ex_cn: 警察指控他偷窃。
words.en: To formally accuse someone of committing a crime.

words.tr: phrase. 仔细考虑；重新考虑
words.ex: I need time to think over your offer.
words.ex_cn: 我需要时间考虑你的提议。
words.en: To consider carefully before making a decision.

words.ex: The storm took from the harvest this year.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴减损了今年的收成。
words.en: To remove something from a place or to subtract something from a total.

words.ex: Eating vegetables does you good.
words.ex_cn: 吃蔬菜对你有好处。
words.en: To be beneficial or advantageous to someone.

words.tr: phrase. 代表…说话；要求得到；订购
words.ex: He cannot speak for me.
words.ex_cn: 他不能代表我说话。
words.en: To speak on behalf of someone or something; to represent or defend someone or something in speech.

words.ex: He seeks after truth in every book he reads.
words.ex_cn: 他每读一本书都在追求真理。
words.en: To try to find or obtain something, often something that is difficult to get.

words.tr: phrase. 为了；目的是；从...角度
words.ex: He saved money with the view of buying a car.
words.ex_cn: 他存钱是为了买一辆车。
words.en: With the intention or purpose of doing something.

words.ex: I'll stop by your office later.
words.ex_cn: 我稍后会顺便去你办公室拜访。
words.en: To visit someone briefly, often while on the way to another place.

words.tr: phrase. 和…有关；对...施加压力；瞄准
words.ex: This new fact does not bear on the case.
words.ex_cn: 这个新事实与案件无关。
words.en: To be relevant or important to; to have an effect on.

words.tr:
n. 攻击；袭击；
v. 攻击；袭击；
words.ex: The attack happened at night.
words.ex_cn: 这次攻击发生在夜晚。
words.en: To attack means to try to hurt or defeat someone or something by using force or violence.

words.ex: Education is the door to success.
words.ex_cn: 教育是通往成功的途径。
words.en: A means of access or approach to something.

words.ex: She will change into her pajamas after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 她晚饭后会换上睡衣。
words.en: To become something different or to make something become different.

words.ex: We can do without sugar in our coffee.
words.ex_cn: 我们咖啡里可以不加糖。
words.en: To manage or survive without something that one would like to have.

words.ex: The project is under way.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目正在进行中。
words.en: If an activity is under way, it has already started.

words.ex: He broke the vase by accident.
words.ex_cn: 他不小心打碎了花瓶。
words.en: If something happens by accident, it happens without being planned or intended.

words.ex: She has no doubt about his sincerity.
words.ex_cn: 她对他的真诚没有怀疑。
words.en: To feel uncertain about something; to question the truth or fact of something.

words.ex: He will take charge of the project next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周将负责这个项目。
words.en: To assume control or responsibility over something.

words.tr: phrase. 在...上的权威；是...方面的权威
words.ex: She is considered an authority on ancient history.
words.ex_cn: 她被认为是古代历史方面的权威。
words.en: Expert knowledge or recognized power in a particular subject.

words.ex: He was drawn into the argument even though he wanted to stay out.
words.ex_cn: 他被卷入了争论，尽管他想置身事外。
words.en: To involve or persuade someone to participate in something.

words.ex: He is without question the best student in class.
words.ex_cn: 他无疑是班上最好的学生。
words.en: If you do something without question, you do it without arguing or asking why.

words.tr: phrase. 消除；终止；废除；杀死；干掉
words.ex: They want to do away with the old rules.
words.ex_cn: 他们想废除旧规则。
words.en: To do away with something means to get rid of it or to stop using it.

words.ex: He set about cleaning the room after breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他吃完早餐后开始打扫房间。
words.en: To start doing something, especially something that needs a lot of effort or time.

words.tr: phrase. 帮助某人度过...；支持某人
words.ex: His friends saw him through the difficult period.
words.ex_cn: 他的朋友们帮助他渡过了难关。
words.en: To help someone to deal with a difficult situation or to complete something.

words.ex: He will take charge of the project next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周将负责这个项目。
words.en: To assume control or responsibility for something.

words.ex: He went to the library with the purpose of finding some research materials.
words.ex_cn: 他去图书馆是为了找到一些研究资料。
words.en: With the intention of achieving something.

words.ex: I can see through his lie.
words.ex_cn: 我看穿了他的谎言。
words.en: To perceive the true nature of someone or something, especially their deceitfulness or the real situation. Also, to support someone or something until the end of a difficult situation.

words.ex: He admit to making a mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他承认犯了一个错误。
words.en: If you admit to something, you agree, often unwillingly, that it is true or that you have done it.
